projectDesc.p: A plain, archival TEI rendering of the text published on e-Śārṅgadhara (https://github.com/sushrutaproject/eSharngadhara), itself built from the digital edition named in the sourceDesc. The file is generated automatically from the site's chapter pages.

editorialDecl.p: The text is given in IAST as it appears on the web edition. Chapter and verse divisions follow the source edition. Each stretch of text ending in one of the source's verse or section numbers (e.g. ||12||) is encoded as seg[@type='unit'] with that number in @n; the number itself is retained in the text.
This file contains the root text only: all commentary blocks, and the notes anchored in them, have been omitted. Root-text blocks are ab[@type='mula'].

The source embeds the editor's notes (variant readings marked pā., remarks on the Calcutta printing, passages judged interpolated, etc.) in the running text; the web edition gathers them as numbered notes at the foot of each chapter. Notes are placed at their point of reference as note[@place='foot'][@type='editorial'], with the source's note number in @n.
The work is divided into three khaṇḍas, encoded as div[@type='khanda'].
Each commentary block opens with a siglum (Dī. for the Dīpikā, Gū. for the Gūḍhārthadīpikā), normalized from the source's own abbreviations and encoded as label[@type='siglum'].
Two comments that carry no siglum in the source and whose attribution is uncertain (Uttarakhaṇḍa 3 and 4) are encoded as ab[@type='commentary'][@subtype='unattributed'] without @resp.
A stray line of the Carakasaṃhitā at the end of Pūrvakhaṇḍa 7 in the source is omitted.

div.head: atha mānaparibhāṣādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: śriyaṃ sa dadyādbhavatāṃ purāri- ryadaṅgatejaḥprasare bhavānī | virājate nirmalacandrikāyāṃ mahauṣadhīva jvalitā himādrau || 1 ||
prasiddhayogā munibhiḥ prayuktā- ścikitsakairye bahuśo'nubhūtāḥ | vidhīyate śārṅgadhareṇa teṣāṃ susaṃgrahaḥ sajjanarañjanāya || 2 ||
hetvādirūpākṛtisātmyajāti- bhedaiḥ samīkṣyāturasarvarogān | cikitsitaṃ karṣaṇabṛṃhaṇākhyaṃ kurvīta vaidyo vidhivatsuyogaiḥ || 3 ||
divyauṣadhīnāṃ bahavaḥ prabhedā vṛndārakāṇāmiva visphuranti | jñātveti saṃdehamapāsya dhīraiḥ saṃbhāvanīyā vividhaprabhāvāḥ || 4 ||
svābhāvikāgantukakāyikāntarā rogā bhaveyuḥ kila karmadoṣajāḥ tacchedanārthaṃ duritāpahāriṇaḥ śreyomayānyogavarānniyojayet || 5 ||
prayogānāgamātsiddhānpratyakṣādanumānataḥ | sarvalokahitārthāya vakṣyāmyanativistarān || 6 ||
prathamaṃ paribhāṣā syādbhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ tathā | nāḍīparīkṣādividhistato dīpanapācanam || 7 ||
tataḥ kalādikākhyānamāhārādigatistathā | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā ceti pūrvakhaṇḍo'yamīritaḥ || 8 ||

div.ab: svarasaḥ kvāthaphāṇṭau ca himaḥ‘vighnabhūtā ityatrābhūtatadbhāve cvirna sambhavati, rogāṇāmutpattita eva vighnasvarūpatvenāvighnasvarūpatvābhāvāt’ iti gaṅgādharaḥ; kalkaśca cūrṇakam | tathaiva guṭikālehau snehaḥ sandhānameva ca || 9 || dhātuśuddhī rasāścaiva khaṇḍo'yaṃ madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ |

snehapānaṃ svedavidhirvamanaṃ ca virecanam || 10 || tatastu snehabastiḥ syāttataścāpi nirūhaṇam | tataścāpyuttaro bastistato nasyavidhirmataḥ || 11 || dhūmapānavidhiścaiva gaṇḍūṣādividhistathā | lepādīnāṃ vidhiḥ khyātastathā śoṇitavisrutiḥ||12|| netrakarmaprakāraśca khaṇḍaḥ syāduttarastvayam |
dvātriṃśatsaṃmitādhyāyairyukteyaṃ saṃhitā smṛtā || 13 || ṣaḍviṃśatiśatānyatra ślokānāṃ gaṇitāni ca |
atha māgadhaparibhāṣā | na mānena vinā yuktirdravyāṇāṃ jāyate kvacit || 14|| ataḥ prayogakāryārthaṃ mānamatrocyate mayā |
māgadhīyaṃ mānam-- trasareṇurbudhaiḥ proktastriṃśatā paramāṇubhiḥ || 15 || trasareṇustu paryāyanāmnā vaṃśī nigadyayate |

ab.seg: jālāntaragate bhānau yatsūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ || 16||
tasya triṃśattamo bhāgaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa kathyate | jālāntaragataiḥ sūryakarairvaṃśī vilokyate || 17 ||
ṣaḍvaṃśībhirmarīciḥ syāttābhiḥ ṣaḍbhistu rājikā | tisṛbhī rājikābhiśca sarṣapaḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 18 ||
yavo'ṣṭasarṣapaiḥ prokto guñjā syāttaccatuṣṭayam | ṣaḍbhistu raktikābhiḥ syānmāṣako hemadhānyakau || 19||

div.ab: māṣaiścaturbhiḥ śāṇaḥ syāddharaṇaḥ sa nigadyate | ṭaṅkaḥ sa eva kathitastaddvayaṃ kola ucyate ||20|| kṣudrako vaṭakaścaiva draṅkṣaṇaḥ sa nigadyate |

ab.seg: koladvayaṃ ca karṣaḥ syātsa proktaḥ pāṇimānikā ||21||
akṣaṃ picuḥ pāṇitalaṃ kiṃcitpāṇiśca tindukam | biḍālapadakaṃ caiva tathā ṣoḍaśikā matā || 22 ||
karamadhyo haṃsapadaṃ suvarṇaṃ kavalagrahaḥ | udumbaraṃ ca paryāyaiḥ karṣa eva nigadyate || 23 ||

div.ab: syātkarṣābhyāmardhapalaṃ śuktiraṣṭamikā tathā | śuktibhyāṃ ca palaṃ jñeyaṃ muṣṭirāmraṃ caturthikā || 24 || prakuñcaḥ ṣoḍaśī bilvaṃ palamevātra kīrtyate |

palābhyāṃ prasṛtirjñeyā prasūtaśca nigadyate || 25 || prasṛtibhyāmañjaliḥ syātkuḍavo 'rdhaśarāvakaḥ | aṣṭamānaṃ ca sa jñeyaḥ kuḍavābhyāṃ ca mānikā ||26|| śarāvo 'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvajjñeyamatra vicakṣaṇaiḥ |
śarāvābhyāṃ bhavetprasthaścatuḥprasthaistathāḍhakam || 27 || bhājanaṃ kaṃsapātraṃ ca catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ca tat |

caturbhirāḍhakairdroṇaḥ kalaśo nalvaṇormaṇaḥ || 28 || unmānaśca ghaṭo rāśirdroṇaparyāyasaṃjñakāḥ | droṇābhyāṃ śūrpakumbhau ca catuḥṣaṣṭiśarāvakāḥ || 29 || śūrpābhyāṃ ca bhaveddroṇī vāhī goṇī ca sā smṛtā |
droṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ khārī kathitā sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ || 30 || catuḥsahasrapalikā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikā ca sā |
palānāṃ dvisahasraṃ ca bhāra ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31 || tulā palaśataṃ jñeyā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ |
māṣaṭaṅkākṣabilvāni kuḍavaḥ prasthamāḍhakam || 32 || rāśirgoṇī khāriketi yathottaracaturguṇāḥ |

guñjādimānamārabhya yāvatsyātkuḍavasthitiḥ || 33 || dravārdraśuṣkadravyāṇāṃ tāvanmānaṃ samaṃ matam | prasthādimānamārabhya dviguṇaṃ‘dravāderdviguṇaṃ matam’ pā. | taddravārdrayoḥ || 34 || mānaṃ tathā tulāyāśca dviguṇaṃ na kvacitsmṛtam |
mṛdvṛkṣaveṇulohāderbhāṇḍaṃ yaccaturaṅgulam || 35 || vistīrṇaṃ ca tathoccaṃ ca tanmānaṃ kuḍavaṃ vadet |
yadauṣadhaṃ tu prathamaṃ yasya yogasya kathyate || 36 || tannāmnaiva sa yogo hi kathyate 'tra viniścayaḥ |
atha kāliṅgaparibhāṣā | sthitirnāstyeva mātrāyāḥ kālamagniṃ vayo balam ||37|| prakṛtiṃ doṣadeśau ca dṛṣṭvā mātrāṃ prakalpayet |
yato mandāgnayo hrasvā hīnasattvā narāḥ kalau ||38|| atastu mātrā tadyogyā procyate sujñasammatā |

ab.seg: yavo dvādaśabhirgaurasarṣapaiḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 39 ||
yavadvayena guñjā syāttriguñjo valla ucyate | māṣo guñjābhiraṣṭābhiḥ saptabhirvā bhavetkvacit||40||
syāccaturmāṣakaiḥ śāṇaḥ sa niṣkaṣṭaṅka eva ca | gadyāṇo māṣakaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ karṣaḥ syāddaśamāṣikaḥ ||41 ||
catuṣkarṣaiḥ palaṃ proktaṃ daśaśāṇamitaṃ budhaiḥ | catuṣpalaiśca kuḍavaṃ prasthādyāḥ pūrvavanmatāḥ || 42 ||

div.ab: kāliṅgaṃ māgadhaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ mānamucyate || 43 || kāliṅgānmāgadhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mānaṃ mānavido‘prāhurmānavido janāḥ’ pā. | viduḥ |
navānyeva hi yojyāni dravyāṇyakhilakarmasu | vinā viḍaṅgakṛṣṇābhyāṃ guḍadhānyājyamākṣikaiḥ ||44|

guḍūcī kuṭajo vāsā kūṣmāṇḍaṃ ca śatāvarī | aśvagandhā sahacarī śatapuṣpā prasāriṇī ||45|| prayoktavyā sadaivārdrā dviguṇā‘vāsānimbapaṭolaketakabalākṛṣmāṇḍakendrīvarī varṣābhukuṭajāśca kandasahitā: sāpūtigndhāmṛatā: | aindrīnāgabalākuraṇṭakapuraśchamṛtā sarvadā sādro eva tu na kvacidviguṇitā: kāryeṣu yojyā budhai: ||’ iti bhāvamiśroktamapīha dhyeyam || naiva yojayet | śuṣkaṃdīpikāmate prakṣiptamidam| navīnaṃ yaddravyaṃ yojyaṃ sakalakarmasu || 46 || ārdraṃ ca dviguṇaṃ yuñjyādeṣa sarvatra niścayaḥ |

ab.seg: kāle 'nukte prabhātaṃ syādaṅge 'nukte jaṭā bhavet|| 47 ||
bhāge 'nukte tu sāmyaṃ syātpātre 'nukte ca mṛṇmayam | drave 'nukteprakṣiptamidam| jalaṃ grāhyaṃ taile 'nukte tilodbhavam ||48||
ekamapyauṣadhaṃ yoge yasminyatpunarucyate | mānato dviguṇaṃ kāryaṃ taddravyaṃ tattvadarśibhiḥ || 49 ||
cūrṇasnehāsavā lehāḥ prāyaśaścandanānvitāḥ | kaṣāyalepayoḥ prāyo yujyate raktacandanam || 50 ||
guṇahīnaṃ bhavedvarṣādūrdhvaṃ tadrūpamauṣadham | māsadvayāttathā cūrṇaṃ hīnavīryatvamāpnuyāt || 51 ||
hīnatvaṃ guṭikālehau labhete vatsarātparam | hīnāḥ syurghṛtatailādyāścaturmāsādhikāttathā || 52 ||
oṣadhyo laghupākāḥ syurnirvīryā vatsarātparam | purāṇāḥ syurguṇairyuktā āsavā dhātavo rasāḥ ||53||
vyādherayuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ gaṇoktamapi tattyajet | anuktamapi yadyuktaṃ yojayettatra tadbudhaḥ || 54 ||

div.ab: āgneyā vindhyaśailādyāḥ saumyo himagirirmataḥ | atastadauṣadhāni syuranurūpāṇi hetubhiḥ || 55 || anyeṣvapi prarohanti vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca |

ab.seg: gṛhṇīyāttāni sumanāḥ śuciḥ prātaḥ suvāsare ||56||
ādityasaṃmukho maunī namaskṛtya śivaṃ hṛdi | sādhāraṇadharādravyaṃ gṛhṇīyāduttarāśritam || 57 ||
valmīkakutsitānūpaśmaśānoṣaramārgajāḥ | jantuvahnihimavyāptā nauṣadhyaḥ kāryasiddhidāḥ‘sādhikāḥ’ pā. | ||58||
śaradyakhilakāryārthaṃ grāhyaṃ sarasamauṣadham | virekavamanārthaṃ ca vasantānte samāharet || 59 ||
atisthūlajaṭā yāḥ syustāsāṃ grāhyāstvaco budhaiḥ | gṛhṇīyātsūkṣmamūlāni sakalānyapi buddhimān ||60||
nyagrodhādestvaco grāhyāḥ sāraḥ syādbījakāditaḥ | tālīsādeśca patrāṇi phalaṃ syāttriphalāditaḥ || 61 ||
dhātakyādeśca puṣpāṇi snuhyādeḥ kṣīramāharet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe paribhāṣā nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha bhaiṣajyākhyānakādhyāyaḥ | bhaiṣajyamabhyavaharetprabhāte prāyaśo budhaḥ | kaṣāyāṃśca viśeṣeṇa tatra bhedastu darśitaḥ || 1 ||

div.ab: jñeyaḥ pañcavidhaḥ kālo bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe nṛṇām | kiñcitsūryodaye jāte tathā divasabhojane || 2 || sāyantane bhojane ca muhuścāpi tathā niśi |

ab.seg: prāyaḥ pittakaphodreke virekavamanārthayoḥ || 3 ||
lekhanārthaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ prabhāte tatsamāharet | evaṃ syātprathamaḥ kālo bhaiṣajyagrahaṇe nṛṇām || 4 ||

div.ab: bhaiṣajyaṃ viguṇe 'pāne bhojanāgre praśasyate | arucau citrabhojyaiśca miśraṃ ruciramāharet || 5 || samānavāte viguṇe mande 'gnāvagnidīpanam | dadyādbhojanamadhye ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kuśalo bhiṣak || 6 || vyānakope ca bhaiṣajyaṃ bhojanānte samāharet | hikkākṣepakakampeṣu pūrvamante ca bhojanāt || 7 || evaṃ dvitīyakālaśca prokto bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi |

udāne kupite vāte svarabhaṅgādikāriṇi || 8 || grāse grāsāntare deyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ sāndhyabhojane | prāṇe praduṣṭe sāndhyasya bhuktasyānte ca dīyate || 9 || auṣadhaṃ prāyaśo dhīraiḥ kālo 'yaṃ syāttṛtīyakaḥ |
muhurmuhuśca tṛṭchardihikkāśvāsagareṣu ca || 10 || sānnaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ dadyāditi kālaścaturthakaḥ |

ab.seg: ūrdhvajatruvikāreṣu lekhane bṛṃhaṇe tathā || 11 ||
pācanaṃ śamanaṃ deyamanannaṃ bheṣajaṃ niśi | iti pañcamakālaḥ syāt prokto bhaiṣajyakarmaṇi||12||

div.ab: dravye raso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktireva ca | saṃbandhenasaṃvedana pā. | kramādetāḥ pañcāvasthāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||13|| rasaḥ - madhuro 'mlaḥ paṭuścaiva kaṭutiktakaṣāyakāḥ | ityete ṣaḍrasāḥ khyātā nānādravyasamāśritāḥ||14|| dharāmbukṣmānalajalajvalanākāśamārutaiḥ | vāyvagnikṣmānilairbhūtadvayai rasabhavaḥ kramāt || 15 || guṇāḥ - guruḥ snigdhaśca tīkṣṇaśca rūkṣo laghuriti kramāt | dharāmbuvahnipavanavyomnāṃ prāyo guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||16|| eṣvevāntarbhavantyanye guṇeṣu guṇasañcayāḥ | vīryam - vīryamuṣṇaṃ tathā śītaṃ prāyaśo dravyasaṃśrayam ||1 7|| tatsarvamagnīṣomīyaṃ dṛśyate bhuvanatraye | atraivāntarbhaviṣyanti vīryāṇyanyāni yānyapi||18|| vipākaḥ - tridhā vipāko dravyasya svādvamlakaṭukātmakaḥ | miṣṭaḥ paṭuśca madhuramamlo 'mlaṃ pacyate rasaḥ || 19 || kaṣāyakaṭutiktānāṃ pākaḥ syātprāyaśaḥ kaṭuḥ | madhurājjāyate śleṣmā pittamamlācca jāyate || 20 || kaṭukājjāyate vāyuḥ karmāṇīti vipākataḥ | prabhāvaḥ - prabhāvastu yathā dhātrī lakucasya rasādibhiḥ || 21 || samāpi kurute doṣaṃ niyatasya vināśanam | kvacittu kevalaṃ dravyaṃ karma kuryātprabhāvataḥ || 22 || jvaraṃ hanti śirobaddhā sahadevījaṭā yathā | kvacidraso guṇo vīryaṃ vipākaḥ śaktireva ca ||23|| karma svaṃ svaṃ prakurvanti dravyamāśritya ye sthitāḥ |
cayakopaśamā yasmindoṣāṇāṃ saṃbhavanti hi || 24 || ṛtuṣaṭkaṃ tadākhyātaṃ rave rāśiṣu saṃkramāt |

ab.seg: grīṣmo meṣavṛṣau proktau prāvṛḍmithunakarkayoḥ || 25 ||
siṃhakanye smṛtā varṣāstulāvṛścikayoḥ śarat | dhanurgrāhau ca hemanto vasantaḥ kumbhamīnayoḥ || 26 ||

div.ab: grīṣme saṃcīyate vāyuḥ prāvṛṭkāle prakupyati | varṣāsu cīyate pittaṃ śaratkāle prakupyati || 27 || hemante cīyate śleṣmā vasante ca prakupyati | prāyeṇa praśamaṃ yāti svayameva samīraṇaḥ || 28 || śaratkāle vasante ca pittaṃ prāvṛḍṛtau kaphaḥ | kārtikasyaprakṣiptamidam | dinānyaṣṭāvaṣṭāvāgrayaṇasya ca || 29 || yamadaṃṣṭrā samākhyātā svalpabhukto hi jīvati |

cayakopaśamā doṣā vihārāhārasevanaiḥ || 30 || samānairyāntyakāle 'pi viparītairviparyayam | laghurūkṣamitāhārādatiśītācchramāttathā || 31 || pradoṣe kāmaśokābhyāṃ bhīcintārātrijāgaraiḥ | abhighātādapāṃ gāhājjīrṇe 'nne dhātusaṃkṣayāt ||32|| vāyuḥ prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati | vidāhikaṭukāmloṣṇabhojyairatyuṣṇasevanāt || 33 || madhyāhne kṣuttṛṣo rodhājjīryatyanne 'rdharātrake | pittaṃ prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati 34 || madhurasnigdhaśītādibhojyairdivasanidrayā | mande 'gnau ca prabhāte ca bhuktamātre tathā 'śramāt || 35|| śleṣmā prakopaṃ yātyebhiḥ pratyanīkaiśca śāmyati || iti dāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ pūrvakhaṇḍe bhaiṣajyākhyānakaṃ nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ dravyarasaguṇavipākaprabhāva ṛtuṣaṭkākhyānādhyāyo dvitīyaḥ ||

div.head: atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ | atha nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ | karasyāṅguṣṭhamūle yā dhamanī jīvasākṣiṇī | tacceṣṭayā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jñeyaṃ kāyasya paṇḍitaiḥ || 1 ||

div.ab: nāḍī dhatte marutkope jalaukāsarpayorgatim | kuliṅgakākamaṇḍūkagatiṃ pittasya kopataḥ || 2 || haṃsapārāvatagatiṃ dhatte śleṣmaprakopataḥ |
lāvatittiravartīnāṃ gamanaṃ saṃnipātataḥ || 3 || kadācinmandagamanā kadācidvegavāhinī | dvidoṣakopato jñeyā -

ab.seg: hanti ca sthānavicyutā || 4 ||
sthitvā sthitvā calati yā sā smṛtā prāṇanāśinī | atikṣīṇā ca śītā ca jīvitaṃ hantyasaṃśayam || 5 ||

div.ab: jvarakopeṇa dhamanī soṣṇā vegavatī bhavet | kāmakrodhādvegavahā kṣīṇā cintābhayaplutā || 6 || mandāgneḥ kṣīṇadhātośca nāḍī mandatarā bhavet | asṛkpūrṇā bhavetkoṣṇā gurvī sāmā garīyasī || 7 || laghvī vahati dīptāgnestathā vegavatī matā | sukhitasya sthirā jñeyā tathā balavatī smṛtā || 8 || capalā kṣudhitasyāpi tṛptasya vahati sthirā |

ab.seg: dūtāḥ svajātayo 'vyaṅgāḥ paṭavo nirmalāmbarāḥ | sukhino 'śvavṛṣārūḍhāḥ śubhrapuṣpaphalairyutāḥ || 9 ||
sujātayaḥ suceṣṭāśca sajīvadiśi saṃśritāḥ | bhiṣajaṃ samaye prāptā rogiṇaḥ sukhahetave || 10 ||

div.ab: vaidyāhvānāya dūtasya gacchato rogiṇaḥ kṛte || 11 || na śubhaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ pradīptaṃ ca sukhāvaham | cikitsāṃ rogiṇaḥ kartuṃ gacchato bhiṣajaḥ śubham || 12 || yātreyaṃ saumyaśakunaṃ proktaṃ dīptaṃ na śobhanam |
nijaprakṛtivarṇābhyāṃ yuktaḥ sattvena saṃyutaḥ || 13 || cikitsyo bhiṣajā rogī vaidyabhakto jitendriyaḥ |

ab.seg: svapneṣu nagnānmuṇḍāṃśca raktakṛṣṇāmbarāvṛtān || 14 ||
vyaṅgāṃśca vikṛtānkṛṣṇānsapāśānsāyudhānapi | badhnato nighnataścāpi dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritān ||15||
mahiṣoṣṭrakharārūḍhāṃstrīpuṃso yastu paśyati | sa svastho labhate vyādhiṃ rogī yātyeva pañcatām||16||
adho yo nipatatyuccājjale 'gnau vā vilīyate | śvāpadairhanyate yo 'pi matsyādyairgilito bhavet || 17||
yasya netre vilīyete dīpo nirvāṇatāṃ vrajet | tailaṃ surāṃ pibedvāpi lohaṃ vā labhate tilān ||18||
pakvānnaṃ labhate 'śnāti viśetkūpaṃ rasātalam | sa svastho labhate rogaṃ rogī yātyeva pañcatām ||19||
duḥsvapnānevamādīṃśca dṛṣṭvā brūyānna kasyacit | snānaṃ kuryāduṣasyeva dadyāddhematilānapaḥ || 20 ||
paṭhetstotrāṇi devānāṃ rātrau devālaye vaset | kṛtvaivaṃ tridinaṃ martyo duḥsvapnātparimucyate || 21 ||

div.ab: svapneṣu yaḥ surānbhūpāñjīvataḥ suhṛdo dvijān | gosamiddhāgnitīrthāni paśyetsukhamavāpnuyāt || 22 || tīrtvā kaluṣanīrāṇi jitvā śatrugaṇānapi | āruhya saudhagośailakarivāhānsukhī bhavet || 23 || śubhrapuṣpāṇi vāsāṃsi māṃsamatsya phalāni ca | prāpyāturaḥ sukhī bhūyātsvastho dhanamavāpnuyāt ||24|| agamyāgamanaṃ lepo viṣṭhayā ruditaṃ mṛtiḥ | āmamāṃsāśanaṃ svapne dhanārogyāptaye viduḥ || 25 || jalaukā bhramarī sarpo makṣikā vāpi yaṃ daśet | rogī sa bhūyādullāgha: svastho dhanamavāpnuyāt ||26|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nāḍīparīkṣādividhiradhyāyaḥ ||
pacennāmaṃ vahnikṛcca dīpanaṃ tadyathā miśiḥ |

div.head: atha dīpanapācanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: pacennāmaṃ vahnikṛcca dīpanaṃ tadyathā miśiḥ |
pacatyāmaṃ na vahniṃ ca kuryādyattaddhi pācanam || 1 || nāgakeśaravadvidyāccitro dīpanapācanaḥ |
na śodhayati na dveṣṭi samān doṣāṃstathoddhatān ||2|| samīkaroti viṣamāñśamanaṃ tadyathā 'mṛtā |
kṛtvā pākaṃ malānāṃ yadbhittvā bandhamadho nayet ||3|| taccānulomanaṃ jñeyaṃ yathā proktā harītakī |
paktavyaṃ yadapaktvaiva śliṣṭaṃ koṣṭhe malādikam || 4 || nayatyadhaḥ sraṃsanaṃ‘śra’ ka. tadyathā syātkṛtamālakaḥ |
malādikamabaddhaṃ ca baddhaṃ vā piṇḍitaṃ malaiḥ || 5 || bhittvādhaḥ pātayati tadbhedanaṃ kaṭukī yathā |
vipakvaṃ yadapakvaṃ vā malādi dravatāṃ nayet || 6 || recayatyapi tajjñeyaṃ recanaṃ trivṛtā yathā |
apakvapittaśleṣmāṇau balādūrdhvaṃ nayettu yat || 7 || vamanaṃ taddhi vijñeyaṃ madanasya phalaṃ yathā |
sthānādbahirnayedūrdhvamadho vā malasaṃcayam || 8 || dehasaṃśodhanaṃ tatsyāddevadālīphalaṃ yathā |
śliṣṭānkaphādikāndoṣānunmūlayati yadbalāt ||9|| chedanaṃ tadyathā kṣārā maricāni śilājatu ||
dhātūnmalānvā dehasya viśoṣyollekhayecca yat ||1 .|| lekhanaṃ tadyathā kṣaudraṃ nīramuṣṇaṃ vacā yavāḥ |
dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ yatsyāduṣṇatvāddravaśoṣakam || 11 || grāhi tacca yathā śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ gajapippalī |
raukṣyācchaityātkaṣāyatvāllaghupākācca yadbhavet || 12 || vātakṛtstambhanaṃ tatsyādyathā vatsakaṭuṇṭukau |
rasāyanaṃ ca tajjñeyaṃ yajjarāvyādhināśanam || 13 || yathā 'mṛtā rudantī ca gugguluśca harītakī |
yasmādravyādbhavetstrīṣu harṣo vājīkaraṃ ca tat || 14 || yathā nāgabalādyāḥ syurbījaṃ ca kapikacchujam |
yasmācchukrasya vṛddhiḥ syācchukralaṃ ca taducyate || 15|| yathā 'śvagandhā musalī śarkarā ca śatāvarī |
dugdhaṃ māṣāśca bhallātaphalamajjāmalāni ca || 16 || pravartakāni kathyante janakāni ca retasaḥ |
pravartanī strī śukrasya recanaṃ bṛhatīphalam || 17 || jātīphalaṃ stambhakaṃ ca śoṣaṇī ca harītakī |
dehasya sūkṣmachidreṣu viśedyatsūkṣmamucyate || 18 || tadyathā saindhavaṃ kṣaudraṃ nimbatailaṃ rubūdbhavam |
pūrvaṃ vyāpyākhilaṃ kāyaṃ tataḥ pākaṃ ca gacchati ||19|| vyavāyi tadyathā bhaṅgā phenaṃ cāhisamudbhavam |
sandhibandhāṃstu śithilānyatkaroti vikāśi tat || 20 || viśleṣyaujaśca dhātubhyo yathā kramukakodravāḥ |
buddhiṃ lumpati yaddravyaṃ madakāri taducyate || 21 || tamoguṇapradhānaṃ ca yathā madyaṃ surādikam |
vyavāyi ca vikāśi syātsūkṣmaṃ chedi madāvaham || 22 || āgneyaṃ jīvitaharaṃ yogavāhi smṛtaṃ viṣam |
nijavīryeṇa yaddravyaṃ srotobhyo doṣasaṃcayam || 23 || nirasyati pramāthi syāttadyathā maricaṃ vacā |

paicchilyādgauravāddravyaṃ ruddhvā rasavahāḥ śirāḥ || 24 || dhatte yadgauravaṃ tatsyādabhiṣyandi yathā dadhi || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ sūtrasthāne dīpanapācanā'dhyāyaścaturthaḥ |

div.head: atha kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: dhātvāśayāntarasthastupnakṣiptamidam | yaḥ kledastvadhitiṣṭhati | dehoṣmaṇā vipakvo yaḥ sā kaletyabhidhīyate ||1||) kalāḥ saptāśayāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ sapta tanmalāḥ | saptopadhātavaḥ sapta tvacaḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ || 1 || trayo doṣā navaśataṃ snāyūnāṃ saṃdhayastathā | daśā'dhikaṃ ca dviśatamasthnāṃ ca triśataṃ tathā ||2|| saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ śirāḥ saptaśataṃ tathā | caturviṃśatirākhyātā dhamanyo rasavāhikāḥ || 3 || māṃsapeśyaḥ samākhyātā nṛṇāṃ pañcaśataṃ budhaiḥ | strīṇāṃ ca viṃśatyadhikāḥ kaṇḍarāścaiva ṣoḍaśa ||4|| nṛdehe daśa randhrāṇi nārīdehe trayodaśa |’ etatsamāsataḥ proktaṃ vistareṇādhunocyate || 5 || atha sapta kalāḥ |kalāsvarūpaṃ-‘snāyubhiśca praticchannānsantatāṃśca jarāyuṇā | śleṣmaṇā veṣṭitāṃścāpi kalābhāgāṃstu tān viduḥ || dhātvāśayāntare dhāturyaḥ kledastvadhitiṣṭhati| dehoṣmaṇābhipakvaśca sā kaletyamidhīyate ||’ iti | māṃsāsṛṅmedasāṃ tisro yakṛtplīhnoścaturthikā | pañcamī ca tathā'ntrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhī cāgnidharā matā || 6 || retodharā saptamī syāditi sapta kalāḥ smṛtāḥ |

ab.seg: śleṣmāśayaḥ syādurasi tasmādāmāśayastvadhaḥ || 7 ||
ūrdhvamagnyāśayo nābhervāmabhāge vyavasthitaḥ | tasyopari tilaṃ jñeyaṃ tadadhaḥ pavanāśayaḥ || 8 ||
malāśayastvadhastasmādastirmūtrāśayastvadhaḥ | jīvaraktāśayamuro jñeyāḥ saptāśayāstvamī || 9 ||
puruṣebhyo'dhikāścānye nārīṇāmāśayāstrayaḥ | dharā garbhāśayaḥ proktaḥ stanau stanyāśayau matau ||10||
rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedo'sthimajjāśukrāṇi dhātavaḥ | jāyante'nyonyataḥ sarve pācitāḥ pittatejasā ||11||
(rasādraktaṃprakṣiptamidam | tato māṃsaṃ māṃsānmedaḥ prajāyate | medaso'sthi tato majjā majjāyāḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ ||12||
jihvānetrakapolānāṃ jalaṃ pittaṃ ca rañjakam | karṇaviḍrasanādantakakṣāmeḍhrādijaṃ malam ||13||
nakhanetramalaṃ vaktre strigdhatvaṃ piṇḍikāstathā | jāyante saptadhātūnāṃ malānyetānyanukramāt || 14 ||
kaphaḥ pittaṃ malaṃ kheṣu prasvedo nakharoma ca | netraviṭ tvakṣu ca sneho dhātūnāṃ kramaśo malāḥ ||15||

div.ab: stanyaṃ rajaśca nārīṇāṃ kāle bhavati gacchati | śuddhamāṃsabhava snehaḥ sā vasā parikīrtitā || 16|| svedodantāstathā keśāstathaivojaśca saptamam| iti dhātubhavā jñeyā ete saptopadhātavaḥ || 17 || ojaḥ sarvaśarīrasthaṃ śītaṃ snigdhaṃ‘snigdhaṃ sāndraṃ sthiraṃ’ iti ‘ka’ ‘snigdhaṃ śvetaṃ sthiraṃ guruḥ’ iti ‘kha’ pustake| sthitaṃ matam | somātmakaṃ śarīrasya balapuṣṭikaraṃ matam || 18 |

ab.seg: jñeyāvabhāsinī pūrvaṃ sidhmasthānaṃ ca sā matā | dvitīyā lohitā jñeyā tilakālakajanmabhūḥ ||19||
śvetā tṛtīyā saṃkhyātā sthānaṃ carmadalasya ca | tāmrā caturthī vijñeyā kilāsaśvitrabhūmikā || 20||
pañcamī vedanī khyātā sarvakuṣṭhodbhavastataḥ | vikhyātā rohiṇī ṣaṣṭhī granthigaṇḍāpacīsthitiḥ ||21||
sthūlā tvaksaptamī khyātā vidradhyādeḥ sthitiśca sā | iti sapta tvacaḥ proktāḥ sthūlā vrīhidvimātrayā ||22||
vāyuḥ pittaṃ kapho doṣā dhātavaśca malā matāḥ | tatrāpi pañcadhā khyātāḥ pratyekaṃ dehadhāraṇāt ||23||
(śarīradūṣaṇāddoṣāprakṣiptam | dhātavo dehadhāraṇāt | vātapittakaphā jñeyā malinīkaraṇānmalāḥ || 24 ||
) pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ | vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat ||25||
pavanasteṣu balavānvibhāgakaraṇānmataḥ | rajoguṇamayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śīto rūkṣo laghuścalaḥ ||26||
malāśaye caretkoṣṭhe vahnisthāne tathā hṛdi | kaṇṭhe sarvāṅgadeśeṣu vāyuḥ pañcaprakārataḥ || 27 ||
apānaḥ syātsamānaśca prāṇodānau tathaiva ca | vyānaśceti samīrasya nāmānyuktānyanukramāt ||28||

div.ab: pittamuṣṇaṃ dravaṃ pītaṃ nīlaṃ sattvaguṇottaram | kaṭutiktarasaṃ jñeyaṃ vidagdhaṃ cāmlatāṃ vrajet || 29 || agnyāśaye bhavetpittamagnirūpaṃ tilonmitam | tvaci kāntakaraṃ jñeyaṃ lepābhyaṅgādipācakam||30|| dṛśyaṃ yakṛti yatpittaṃ tadrasaṃ śoṇitaṃ nayet | yatpittaṃ netrayugule rūpadarśanakāri tat || 31 || yatpittaṃ hṛdaye tiṣṭhenmedhāprajñākaraṃ ca tat | pācakaṃ bhrājakaṃ caiva rañjakālocake tathā || 32 || sādhakaṃ ceti pañcaiva pittanāmānyanukramāt |

kaphaḥ snigdho guruḥ śvetaḥ picchilaḥ śītalastathā ||33|| tamoguṇādhikaḥ svādurvidagdho lavaṇo bhavet | kaphaścāmāśaye mūrdhni kaṇṭhe hṛdi ca saṃdhiṣu || 34 || tiṣṭhankaroti deheṣu sthairyaṃ sarvāṅgapāṭavam | kledanaḥ snehanaścaiva rasanaścāvalambanaḥ || 35 || śleṣmakaśceti nāmāni kaphasyoktānyanukramāt |
snāyavo bandhanaṃ proktā dehe māṃsāsthimedastam||36|| sandhayaścāṅgasandhānāddehe proktāḥ kaphānvitā: | ādhāraśca tathāsāraḥ kāye'sthīni budhā viduḥ||37|| marmāṇi jīvādhārāṇi prāyeṇa munayo jaguḥ |
saṃdhibandhanakāriṇyo doṣadhātuvahāḥ śirāḥ || 38 || dhamanyo rasavāhibhyo dhamanti pavanaṃ tanau |
māṃsapeśyo balāya syuravaṣṭambhāya dehinām ||39|| prasāraṇākuñcanayoraṅgānāṃ kaṇḍarā matāḥ |

ab.seg: nāsānayanakarṇānāṃ dve dve randhre prakīrtite || 40 ||
mehanāpānavaktrāṇāmekaikaṃ randhramucyate | daśamaṃ mastake proktaṃ randhrāṇīti nṛṇāṃ viduḥ ||41||
strīṇāṃ trīṇyadhikāni syuḥ stanayorgarbhavartmanaḥ | sūkṣmacchidrāṇi cānyāni matāni tvaci janminām||42||

div.ab: tadvāme phupphusaplīhau dakṣiṇāṅge yakṛnmatam | udānavāyorādhāraḥ phupphusaḥ procyate budhaiḥ || 43 || raktavāhiśirāmūlaṃ plīhā khyātā maharṣibhiḥ | yakṛdrañjakapittasya sthānaṃ raktasya saṃśrayaḥ || 44 || jalavāhiśirāmūlaṃ tṛṣṇācchādanakaṃ tilam |
vṛkkau puṣṭikarau proktau jaṭharasthasya bhedataḥ ||45 || vīryavāhiśirādhārau vṛṣaṇau pauruṣāvahau | garbhādhānakaraṃ liṅgamayanaṃ vīryamūtrayoḥ || 46|| hṛdayaṃ cetanāsthānamojasaścāśrayo matam |

ab.seg: śirā dhamanyo nābhisthāḥ sarvā vyāpya sthitāstanum | puṣṇanti cāniśaṃ vāyoḥ saṃyogātsarvadhātubhiḥ ||47||

div.ab: nābhistha: prāṇapavanaḥ spṛṣṭvā hṛtkamalāntaram ||48|| kaṇṭhādbahirviniryāti pātuṃ viṣṇupadāmṛtam | pītvā cāmbarapīyūṣaṃayameva pāścātyaiḥ Oxygen ‘~oksijana’ nāmnā vyavahriyamāṇaḥ prāṇapradavāyuviśeṣa ihāvagantavyaḥ | idaṃ ca tatvaṃ vāyau 29 tibhāgātmakatvena jale ca 16 śabhāgātmakatvena vyavasthitam | tathāca śrutiḥ - ‘apsu me somo abravīdantarviśvāni bheṣajā | agniñca viśvaśambhuvamāpaśca viśvabheṣajīḥ’ ( ka. saṃ. 1,23,20) iti, ‘apsu jyoti: pratiṣṭhitam’ (tai. ā. 9,8) iti ca | vāyau cāpi ‘udutye aruṇapsavaścitrāyāmemirīrate | vāśrā adhiṣṇunā diva: |’ (kra.sa. 7,7) iti vāyūnāmaruṇatvaṃ, citradarśatvaṃ vidyudruṇayuktatvaṃ prāṇadavāyunaiveti | punarāyāti vegataḥ || 49 || prīṇayandehamakhilaṃ jīvayañjaṭharānalam |

ab.seg: śarīraprāṇayoreva saṃyogādāyurucyate || 50 ||
kālena tadviyogācca pañcatvaṃ kathyate budhaiḥ | na jantuḥ kaścidamaraḥ pṛthivyāṃ jāyate kvacit | ato mṛtyuravārya: syāt kiṃtu rogānnivārayet ||51 ||
yāpyatvaṃ yāti sādhyastu yāpyo gacchatyasādhyatām | jīvitaṃ hantyasādhyastu narasyā'pratikāriṇaḥ || 52 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ yata: | ato rugbhyastanuṃ rakṣennaraḥ karmavipākavit || 53 ||
dhātavastanmalā doṣā nāśayantyasamāstanum | samāḥ sukhāya vijñeyā balāyopacayāya ca || 54 ||
atha sṛṣṭikramaḥ | jagadyoneranicchasya cidānamdaikarūpiṇaḥ | puṃso'sti prakṛtirnityā praticchāyeva bhāsvataḥ ||55||
acetanādi caitanyayogena paramātmanaḥ | akarodviśvamakhilamanityaṃ nāṭakākṛti || 56 ||
prakṛtirviśvajananī pūrvaṃ buddhimajījanat || 57 ||
icchāmayīṃ mahadrūpāmahaṅkārastato'bhavat | trividhaḥ so'pi saṃjāto rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ ||58||

div.ab: tasmātsattvarajoyuktādindriyāṇi daśābhavan | manaśca jātaṃ tānyāhuḥ śrotratvaṅnayanaṃ tathā || 59 || jihvāghrāṇavacohastapādopasthagudāni ca | pañca buddhīndriyāṇyāhuḥ prāktanānītarāṇi ca ||60|| karmendriyāṇi pañcaiva kathyante sūkṣmabuddhibhiḥ |

rajaḥsattvaguṇotkṛṣṭādahaṅkārādathābhavat‘tama’ iti gūḍhārthadīpikāsammata: pāṭhaḥ” | || 61 || tanmātrapañcakaṃ tasya nāmānyuktāni sūribhiḥ | śbdatanmātrakaṃ sparśatanmātraṃ rūpamātrakam || 62 || rasatanmātrakaṃ gandhatanmātraṃ ceti tadviduḥ | tanmātrapañcakāttasmātsaṃjātaṃ bhūtapañcakam || 63 || vyomānilānalajalakṣoṇīrūpaṃ ca tanmatam |
śabda: sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasagandhāvanukramāt ||64|| tanmātrāṇāṃ viśeṣāḥ syuḥ sthūlabhāvamupāgatāḥ |

ab.seg: buddhīndriyāṇāṃ pañcaiva śabdādyā viṣayā matāḥ||65||
karmendriyāṇāṃ viṣayā bhāṣādānavihāritāḥ | ānandotsargakau caiva kathitāstattvadarśibhiḥ || 66||
pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ śaktirnityā cāvikṛtistathā | etāni tasyā nāmāni śivamāśritya yā sthitā || 67 ||
mahānahaṅkṛtiḥ pañcatanmātrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak | prakṛtirvikṛtiścaiba saptaitāni budhā jaguḥ || 68 ||
daśendriyāṇi cittaṃ ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca | vikārāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyāḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya jagatsthitāḥ || 69 ||
evaṃ caturviṃśatibhistattvaiḥ siddhe vapurgṛhe | jīvātmā niyato nityo vasati svāntadūtavān || 70 ||
sa dehī kathyate pāpapuṇyaduḥkhasukhādibhiḥ | vyāpto baddhaśca manasā kṛtrimaiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ || 71 ||
kamākrodhau lobhamohāvahaṅkāraśca pañcamaḥ | daśendriyāṇi buddhiśca tasya bandhāya dehinaḥ ||72||
āpnoti bandhamajñānādātmajñānācca mucyate | taddu:khayogakṛdvyādhirārogyaṃ tatsukhāvaham || 73 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ kalādikākhyānādhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

div.head: athāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | athāhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ | yātyāmāśayamāhāraḥ pūrvaṃ prāṇānilerita: | mādhuryaṃ phenabhāvaṃ ca ṣaḍraso'pi labheta saḥ || 1 ||
atha pācakapattena vidagdhaścāmlatāṃ vrajet | tataḥ samānamarutā grahaṇīmabhinīyate || 2 ||
(ṣaṣṭhī pittadharāprakṣiptamidam | nāma yā kalā parikīrtitā | pakvāmāśayamadhyasthā grahaṇītyabhidhīyate || 3 ||
grahaṇyāṃ pacyate koṣṭhavahninā jāyate kaṭuḥ | raso bhavati saṃpakvādapakvādāmasaṃbhavaḥ || 4 ||
vahnerbalena mādhuryaṃ snigdhatāṃ yāti tadrasaḥ | puṣṇāti dhātūnakhilānsamyakpakvo'mṛtopamaḥ ||5||
mandavahnividagdhaśca kaṭuścāmlo bhavedrasaḥ | viṣabhāvaṃ vrajedvāpi kuryādvā rogasaṃkaram || 6 ||

div.ab: āhārasya rasaḥ sāraḥ sārahīno maladravaḥ | śirābhistajjalaṃ nītaṃ bastau mūtratvamāpnuyāt ||7|| tatkiṭṭaṃ ca malaṃ jñeyaṃ tiṣṭhetpakvāśaye ca tat | valitritayamārgeṇa yātyapānena noditam || 8 || pravāhiṇī sarjanī ca grāhiketi valitrayam |
rasastu hṛdayaṃ yāti samānamaruteritaḥ || 9 || rañjitaḥ pācitastatra pittenāyāti raktatām | raktaṃ sarvaśarīrasthaṃ jīvasyādhāramuttamam || 10 || snigdhaṃ guru calaṃ svādu vidagdhaṃ pittavadbhavet |
pācitāḥ pittatāpena rasādyā dhātavaḥ kramāt ||11 || śukratvaṃ yānti māsena tathā strīṇāṃ rajo bhavet |
kāmānmithunasaṃyoge śuddhaśoṇitaśukrajaḥ ||12|| garbhaḥ saṃjāyate nāryāḥ sa jāto bāla ucyate | ādhikye rajasaḥ kanyā putraḥ śukrādhike bhavet||13|| napuṃsakaṃ samatvena yathecchā pārameśvarī |

ab.seg: bālasya prathame māsi deyā bheṣajaraktikā || 14 ||
avalehīkṛtaikaiva kṣīrakṣaudrasitāghṛtaiḥ | vardhayettāvadekaikāṃ yāvadbhavati vatsaraḥ ||15||
māṣairvṛddhistadūrdhvaṃ syādyāvatṣoḍaśavatsaraḥ | tataḥ sthirā bhavettāvadyāvadvarṣāṇi saptatiḥ || 16 ||
tato bālakavanmātrā hāsanīyā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | mātreyaṃ kalkacūrṇānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāṃ caturguṇā || 17 ||
añjanaṃ ca tathā lepaḥ snānamabhyaṅgakarma ca | vamanaṃ pratimarśaśca janmaprabhṛti śasyate || 18 ||
kavalaḥ pañcamādvarṣādaṣṭamānnasyakarma ca | virekaḥ ṣoḍaśādvarṣādviṃśateścaiva maithunam || 19 ||
bālyaṃ vṛddhiśchavirmedhā tvagdṛṣṭiḥ śukravikramau | buddhiḥ karmendriyaṃ ceto jīvitaṃ daśato hraset||20||
alpakeśaḥ kṛśo rūkṣo vācālaścalamānasaḥ | ākāśacārī svapneṣu vātaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 21 ||
akālapalitairvyāpto dhīmānsvedī ca roṣaṇaḥ | svapneṣu jyotiṣāṃ draṣṭā pittaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 22 ||

div.ab: gambhīrabuddhiḥ sthūlāṅgaḥ snigdhakeśo mahābalaḥ | svapne jalāśayālokī śleṣmaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 23 || jñātavyā miśracihnaiśca dvitridoṣolbaṇā narāḥ |
tamaḥkaphābhyāṃ nidrā syānmūrcchā pittatamobhavā||24|| rajaḥpittānilairbhrāntistandrā śleṣmatamonilaiḥ |
glānirojaḥkṣayādduḥkhādajīrṇācca śramādbhavet || 25 || yaḥ sāmarthye'pyanutsāhastadālasyamudīryate |

caitanyaśithilatvādyaḥ pītvaikaṃ śvāsamudvamet ||26|| vidīrṇavadanaḥ śvāsaṃ jṛmbhā sā kathyate budhaiḥ| udānaprāṇayorūrdhvayogānmaulikaphasnavāt || 27|| śabda: saṃjāyate nasta: kṣutaṃ‘tena’ ka | tatkathyate budhaiḥ |

ab.seg: udānakopādāhārasvasthitatvācca yadbhavet ||28||
pavanasyordhvagamanaṃ tamudgāraṃ pracakṣate | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ śārīre āhārādigatiradhyāyaḥ || 6 ||

div.head: atha rogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha rogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ | rogāṇāṃ gaṇanā pūrvaṃ munibhiryā prakīrtitā | mayātra procyate saiva tadbhedā bahavo matāḥ || 1 ||

div.ab: pañcaviṃśatiruddiṣṭā jvarāstadbheda ucyate | pṛthagdoṣaistathā dvandvabhedena trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || ekaśca sannipātena tadbhedā bahavo matāḥ | prāyaśaḥ sannipātena pañca syurviṣamajvarāḥ || 3 || santataḥ‘santataṃ satato'nyedyustṛtīyakacaturdhakau’ iti ‘ka.’ pā. | satataścaiva anyedyuṣkastṛtīyakaḥ | cāturthakaścanāsti ‘ka’ pustake | pañcaite kīrtitā viṣamajvarāḥ || 4 || tathāgantujvaro'pyekastrayodaśavidho mataḥ | abhicāragrahāveśaśāpairāgantukastridhā‘ntava’ ‘ka.’ pā.| || 5 || śramācchedātkṣatāddāhāccaturdhā‘kledā’ ‘ka’ pā. | ghātajo jvaraḥ | kāmādbhīteḥ śuco roṣādviṣādauṣadhagandhataḥ || 6 || abhiṣaṅgajvarāḥ ṣaṭ syurevaṃ jvaraviniścayaḥ |
pṛthaktridoṣaiḥ sarvaiśca śokādāmādbhayādapi || 7 || atīsāraḥ saptadhā syādgrahaṇī pañcadhā matā | pṛthagdoṣaiḥ sannipātāttathā cāmena pañcamī || 8 || pravāhikā caturdhā syātpṛthagdoṣaistathāsrataḥ |

ab.seg: ajīrṇaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ viṣṭabdhaṃ vāyunā matam ||9||
pittādvidagdhaṃ vijñeyaṃ kaphenāmaṃ taducyate | viṣājīrṇaṃ rasādekaṃ doṣaiḥ syādalasastridhā || 10||
visūcī trividhā proktā doṣaiḥ sā syātpṛthakpṛthak | daṇḍakālasakaścaika ekaiva syādvilambikā ||11||
arśāṃsi ṣaḍvidhānyāhurvātapittakaphāsrataḥ | sannipātācca saṃsargātteṣāṃ bhedo dvidhā mataḥ || 12||
sahajottarajanmabhyāṃ tathā śuṣkārdrabhedataḥ | tridhaiva carmakīlāni vātātpittātkaphādapi ||13||
evaṃ viṃśatibhedena kṛmayaḥ syurdvidhā ca te | bāhyāstathābhyantarāḥ syusteṣu yūkā bahiścarāḥ ||14||
likṣāścānye'ntaracarāḥ kaphātte hṛdayodakāḥ | antrādā udarāveṣṭāścyuravaśca mahāguhāḥ || 15 ||
sugandhā darbhakusumāstathā raktāśca mātaraḥ | saurasā lomavidhvaṃsā romadvīpā udumbarāḥ || 16||
keśādāśca tathaivānye śakṛjjātā makerukā: | lelihāśca salūnāśca sausurādāḥ kakerukāḥ || 17 ||
tathānyaḥ kapharaktābhyāṃ saṃjātaḥ snāyukaḥ smṛtaḥ | vraṇasya kṛmayaścānye viṣamā bāhyayonayaḥ || 18||

div.ab: pāṇḍurogāśca pañca syurvātapittakaphaistridhā | tridoṣairmṛttikābhiśca tathaikā kāmalā smṛtā ||19|| syātkumbhakāmalā caikā tathaikaṃ ca halīmakam |
raktapittaṃ tridhā proktamūrdhvagaṃ kaphasaṃbhavam ||20|| adhogaṃ mārutaṃ jñeyaṃ taddvayena dvimārgagam |
kāsāḥ pañca samuddiṣṭāste trayastu tribhirmalaiḥ ||21|| uraḥkṣatāñcaturthaḥ syātkṣayāddhātośca pañcamaḥ |

kṣayāḥ pañcaiva vijñeyāstribhirdoṣaistrayaśca te || 22 || caturthaḥ sannipātena pañcamaḥ syāduraḥkṣatāt | śoṣā: syu: ṣaṭprakāreṇa strīprasaṅgācchuco vraṇāt || 23 || adhvaśramācca vyāyāmādvārdhakyādapi jāyate |
śvāsāśca pañca vijñeyāḥ kṣudraḥ syāttamakastathā || 24 || ūrdhvaśvāso mahāśvāsaśchinnaśvāsaśca pañcamaḥ |
kathitāḥ pañca hikkāstu tāstu kṣudrā'nnajastathā ||25|| gambhīrā yamalā caiva mahatī pañcamī smṛtā |
catvāro'gnervikārāḥ syurviṣamo vātasaṃbhavaḥ || 26 || tīkṣṇaḥ pittātkaphānmando bhasyako vātapittayoḥ |
pañcaivārocakā jñeyā vātapittakaphaistridhā || 27 || sannipātānmanastāpāt -
chardayaḥ saptadhā matāḥ | tribhirdoṣaiḥ pṛthaktisra kṛmibhiḥ sannipātataḥ || 28|| ghṛṇayā ca tathā strīṇāṃ garbhādhānācca jāyate |
svarabhedāḥ ṣaḍeva syurvātapittakaphaistrayaḥ || 29 || medasā sannipātena kṣayātṣaṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
tṛṣṇā ca ṣaḍvidhā proktā vātātpittātkaphādapi || 30 || tridoṣairupasargeṇa kṣayāddhātośca ṣaṣṭhikā |

ab.seg: mūrcchā caturvidhā jñeyā vātapittakaphaiḥ pṛthak ||31||
caturthī sannipātena tathaikaśca bhramaḥ smṛtaḥ | nidrā tandrā ca saṃnyāso glāniścaikaikaśaḥ smṛtāḥ||32 ||

div.ab: madāḥ sapta samākhyātā vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ | tridoṣairasṛjā madyādviṣādapi ca saptama: || 33 || madātyayaścaturdhā syādvātātpittātkaphādapi | tridoṣairapi vijñeya ekaḥ paramadastathā || 34 || pānājīrṇaṃ tathā caikaṃ tathaikaḥ pānavibhramaḥ | pānātyayastathā caiko -

ab.seg: dāhā: sapta matāstathā || 35 ||
raktapittāttathā raktāttṛṣṇāyāḥ pittatastathā | dhātukṣayānmarmaghātādraktapūrṇodarādapi || 36 ||

div.ab: unmādāḥ ṣaṭ samākhyātāstribhirdoṣaistrayaśca te | sannipātādviṣājjñeyaḥ ṣaṣṭho duḥkhena cetasaḥ || 37 || bhūtonmādā viṃśatiḥ syuste devāddānavādapi | gandharvātkiṃnarādyakṣātpitṛbhyo guruśāpataḥ || 38 || pretācca guhyakādvṛddhātsiddhādbhūtātpiśācataḥ | jalādhidevatāyāśca nāgādvai brahmarākṣasāt || 39 || rākṣasādapi kūṣmāṇḍākūtyāvetālayorapi |
apasmāraścaturdhā syātsamīrātpittatastathā || 40 || śleṣmaṇo'pi tṛtīyaḥ syāccaturtha: sannipātataḥ |
catvāraścāmavātāḥ syurvātapittakaphaisridhā || 41|| caturthaḥ sannipātena

śūlānyaṣṭau budhā jaguḥ | pṛthagdoṣaistridhā dvandvabhedena vividhānyapi || 42 || āmena saptamaṃ proktaṃ sannipātena cāṣṭamam |pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlamaṣṭadhā parikīrtitam || 43 || malairyai: śūlasaṃkhyā syāttaireva pariṇāmajam | annadravabhavaṃ śūlaṃ jaratpittabhavaṃ tathā || 44 || ekaikaṃ gaṇitaṃ sujñai:

ab.seg: udāvartāstrayodaśa | ekaḥ kṣunnigrahātproktastṛṣṇārodhāddvitīyakaḥ || 45 ||
nidrāghātātṛtīyaḥ syāccaturthaḥ śvāsanigrahāt | chardirodhātpañcamaḥ syātṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣavathunigrahāt ||46||
jṛmbhārodhātsaptamaḥ syādudgāragrahato'ṣṭamaḥ | navamaḥ syādaśrurodhāddaśamaḥ śukradhāraṇāt || 47 ||
mūtrarodhānmalasyāpi rodhādvātavinigrahāt | udāvartāstrayaścaite ghoropadravakārakāḥ || 48 ||
ānāho dvividho jñeya ekaḥ pakvāśayodbhavaḥ | āmāśayodbhavaścānyaḥ pratyānāhaḥ sa kathyate || 49 ||

div.ab: urograhastathā caiko -
hadrogāḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ | vātadibhistrayaḥ proktāścaturthaḥ sannipātataḥ || 50 || pañcamaḥ krimisaṃjātaḥ -
tathāṣṭāvudarāṇi ca | vātātpittātkaphāttrīṇi tridoṣebhyo jalādapi || 51 || plīhna: kṣatādbaddhagudādaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitam |
gulmāstvaṣṭau samākhyātā vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ || 52|| dvandrabhedāstrayaḥ proktā: saptamaḥ sannipātataḥ | raktādaṣṭamakaḥ khyāto

mūtrāghātāstroyodaśa || 53 || vātakuṇḍalikā pūrvaṃ vātāṣṭhīlā tataḥ param | vātabastistṛtīyaḥ syānmūtrātītaścaturthakaḥ || 54 || pañcamaṃ mūtrajaṭharaṃ ṣaṣṭho mūtrakṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ | mūtrotsargaḥ saptamaḥ syānmūtragranthistathāṣṭamaḥ || 55 || mūtraśukraṃ tu navamaṃ viḍghāto daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ | mūtrāsādaścoṣṇavāto bastikuṇḍalikā tathā ||56|| trayo'pyete mūtraghātāḥ pṛthagghorāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
mūtrakṛcchāṇi cāṣṭau syurvātapittakaphaistridhā || 57|| sannipātāccaturthaṃ syācchukrakṛcchraṃ ca pañcamam | viṭkṛcchraṃ ṣaṣṭhamākhyātaṃ ghātakṛcchraṃ ca saptamam||58|| aṣṭamaṃ cāśmarīkṛcchraṃ -
caturdhā cāśmarī matā | vātātpittātkaphācchukrāt --

tathā mehāśca viṃśatiḥ || 59 || ikṣumehaḥ surāmehaḥ piṣṭamehaśca sāndrakaḥ | śukramehodakākhyau ca lālāmehaśca śītakaḥ ||60|| sikatākhyaḥ śanairmeho daśaite kaphasaṃbhavāḥ | mañjiṣṭhākhyo haridrākhyo nīlamehaśca raktakaḥ ||61|| kṛṣṇameha: kṣāramehaḥ ṣaḍete pittasaṃbhavāḥ | hastimeho vasāmeho majjāmeho madhuprabhaḥ || 62 || catvāro vātajā mehā iti mehāśca viṃśatiḥ |
somarogastathā caikaḥ -
śarāvikā kacchapikā putriṇī vinatālajī | masūrikā sarṣapikā valinī ca vidārikā || 64 || vidradhiśca daśaitāḥ syuḥ piḍakā mehasaṃbhavāḥ |
medodoṣastathā caikaḥ -
śotharogā nava smṛtāḥ || 65 || doṣai: pṛthagvayaiḥ sarvairabhighātādviṣādapi |
vṛddhaya: sapta gaditā vātātpittātkaphena ca || 66 || raktena medasā mūtrādantravṛddhiśca saptamī |
aṇḍavṛddhistathā caikā --

ab.seg: tathaikā gaṇḍamālikā ||67||

div.ab: gaṇḍālajī tu caikā syāt
granthayo navadhā matāḥ | tribhirdoṣaistrayo raktācchirābhirmedaso vraṇāt || 68 || asthnā māṃsena navamaḥ

ab.seg: ṣaḍvidhaṃ svāttathārbudam | vātātpittātkaphādraktānmāṃsādapi ca medasaḥ ||69||

div.ab: ślīpadaṃ ca tridhā proktaṃ vātātpittātkaphādapi |
vidradhiḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ khyāto vātapittakaphaistrayaḥ||70|| raktatkṣatāttridoṣaiśca -

ab.seg: vraṇāḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ | teṣāṃ caturdhā bhedāḥ syurāganturdehajastathā || 71||
śuddho duṣṭaśca vijñeyastatsaṃkhyā kathyate pṛthak | vātavraṇaḥ pittajaśca kaphajo raktajo vraṇaḥ || 72 ||
vātapittabhavaścānyo vātaśleṣmabhavastathā | tathā pittakaphābhyāṃ ca sannipātena cāṣṭama:|| 73 ||
navamo vātaraktena daśamo raktapittataḥ | śleṣmaraktabhavaścānyo vātapittāsṛgudbhavaḥ || 74 ||
vātaśleṣmāsṛgutpannaḥ pittaśleṣmāsrasaṃbhavaḥ | sannipātāsṛgudbhūta iti pañcadaśa vraṇāḥ || 75 ||
sadyovraṇastvaṣṭadhā syādavikḷptavilambinau | chinnabhinnapracalitā ghṛṣṭaviddhanipātitaḥ || 76 ||

div.ab: koṣṭhabhedo dvidhā proktaśchinnāntro ni:sṛtāntrakaḥ |

asthibhaṅgo'ṣṭadhā prokto bhagnapṛṣṭhavidāritau || 77 || vivartitaśca viśliṣṭastiryakkṣiptastvadhogataḥ | ūrdhvagaḥ sandhibhagnaśca vahnidagdhaścaturvidhaḥ ||78|| pluṣṭo'tidagdho durdagdhaḥ samyagdagdhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
nāḍya: pañca samākhyātā vātapittakaphaistridhā ||79|| tridoṣairapi śalyena -

tathāṣṭau syurbhagandarāḥ | śataponastu pavanāduṣṭragrīvaśca pittataḥ || 80 || parisrāvī kaphājjñeya ṛjurvātakaphodbhavaḥ | parikṣepī marutpittādarśojaḥ kaphapittataḥ || 81 || bhāganjujātaśconmārgī śaṅkhāvartastridoṣaja: |
meḍhre pañcopadaṃśāḥ syurvātapittakaphaistridhā || 82 || sannipātena raktācca -

ab.seg: meḍhre śūkāmayāstathā | caturviṃśatirākhyātā liṅgārśo grathitaṃ tathā || 83 ||
nivṛttamavamanthaśca mṛditaṃ śataponakaḥ | aṣṭhīlikā sarṣapikā tvakpākaścāvapāṭikā || 84 ||
māṃsapākaḥ sparśahānirniruddhamaṇiruttamā | māṃsārbudaṃ puṣkarikā saṃmūḍhapiḍakālajī || 85 ||
raktārbudaṃ vidradhiśca kumbhikā tilakālakaḥ | niruddhaprakāśaḥ proktastathaiva parivartikā‘kīrtitā’ pā. | || 86 ||
kuṣṭhānyaṣṭādaśoktāni vātātkāpālikaṃ bhavet | pittenodumbaraṃ proktaṃ kaphānmaṇḍalacarcike || 87 ||
marutpittādṛṣyajihvaṃ‘kṣajihvaṃ’ pā. ‘dṛkṣajihve pā. | śleṣmavātādvipādikā | tathā sidhmaikakuṣṭhaṃ ca kiṭibhaṃ cālasaṃ tathā || 88 ||
kaphapittātpunardadrū: pāmā vitphoṭakaṃ tathā | mahākuṣṭhaṃ carmadalaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ śatārukam || 89 ||
tridoṣaiḥ kākaṇaṃ‘tridoṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ’ pā. | jñeyaṃ tathānyacchvitrasaṃjñitam | tathā vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā ca tridhā bhavet ||90||

div.ab: kṣudrarogāḥ ṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāsteṣvādau śarkarārbudam | indravṛddhā panasikā vivṛtāndhālajī‘antrālajī’ti pā. | tathā || 91 || varāhadaṃṣṭro valmīkaṃ kacchapī tilakālakaḥ | gardabhī rakasā caiva yavaprakhyā vidārikā || 92 || kadaro maṣakaścaiva nīlikā jālagardabhaḥ | irivellī jatumaṇirgudabhraṃśo'gnirohiṇī ||93|| saṃniruddhagudaḥ koṭha: kunakho'nuśayī tathā | padminīkaṇṭakaścipyamalaso mukhadūṣikā ||94|| kakṣā vṛṣakakacchūśca gandhaḥ pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ | rājikā ca tathā vyaṅgaścaturdhā parikīrtitaḥ 95 || vātātpittātkaphādraktādityuktaṃ vyaṅgalakṣaṇam | viskoṭā: kṣudrarogeṣu te'ṣṭadhā parikirtitāḥ ||96|| pṛthagdoṣaistrayo dvandvaistrividha: saptamo'sṛja: | aṣṭama: sannipātena kṣudrarukṣu masūrikā || 97 || caturdaśaprakāreṇa tribhirdoṣaistridhā ca sā | dvandvajā trividhā proktā sannipātena saptamī ||98|| aṣṭamī tvaggatā jñeyā navamī raktajā matā| daśamī māṃsajā khyātā catasro'nyāśca dustarāḥ|| 99|| medo'sthimajjāśukrasthā: kṣudrarogāḥ itīritā: |

ab.seg: visarparogo navadhā vātapittakaphaistridhā ||100||
tridhā sa dvandvabhedena sannipātena saptamaḥ | aṣṭamo vahnidāhena navamaścābhighātajaḥ || 101 ||
tathaikaḥ śleṣmapittābhyāmudardaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | vātapittena caikastu śītapittāmaya: smṛtaḥ ||102 ||
amlapittaṃ tridhā proktaṃ vātena śleṣmaṇā tathā | tṛtīyaṃ śleṣmavātābhyāṃ vātaraktaṃ tathāṣṭadhā || 103 ||
vātādhikyena pittācca kaphāddoṣatrayeṇa ca | raktādhikyena doṣāṇāṃ dvandve na trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||104 ||

div.ab: aśītirvātajā rogāḥ kathyante munibhāṣitāḥ | ākṣepako hanustambha ūrustambhaḥ śirograhaḥ ||105|| bāhyāyāmo'ntarāyāmaḥ pārśvaśūlaṃ kaṭigrahaḥ | daṇḍāpatānakaḥ khallī jihvāstambhastathārditam||106|| pakṣāghātaḥ kroṣṭuśīrṣo manyāstambhaśca paṅgutā | kalāyakhañjatā tūnī pratitūnī ca khañjatā || 107|| pādaharṣo gṛdhrasī ca viśvācī cāpabāhukaḥ | apatāno vraṇāyāmo vātakaṇṭo'patantrākaḥ ||108|| aṅgabhedo'ṅgaśoṣaśca minmimatvaṃ ca kallatāgadgadaḥ ’vikṛtaśita pāṭhabhedau | | pratyaṣṭhīlā'ṣṭhīlikā ca vāmanatvaṃ ca kuñjatā ||109|| (aṅgabhaṅgo'ṅgaśūlaṃ ca saṃkocastambharūkṣatā |) aṅgapīḍāṅgavibhraṃśo viḍgraho baddhaviṭkatā ||110|| mūkatvamatijṛmbhā syādatyudgāro'ntrakūjanam | vātapravṛttiḥ sphuraṇaṃ śirāṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā |111 || kampaḥ kārśyaṃ śyāvatā ca pralāpaḥ kṣipramūtratā | nidrānāśaḥ svedanāśo durbalatvaṃ balakṣayaḥ ||112|| atipravṛttiḥ śukrasya kārśyaṃ nāśaśca retasaḥ | anavasthitacittattvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ virasāsyatā ||113|| (kaṣāyavakratādhmānaṃprakṣiptamidam | pratyādhmānaṃ ca śītatā | romaharṣaśca bhīrutvaṃ todaḥ kaṇḍūrasājñatā ||114||) śabdājñatā prasuptiśca gandhājñatvaṃ dṛśaḥ kṣayaḥ |

ab.seg: atha pittabhavā rogāścatvāriṃśadihoditāḥ || 1 15|| dhūmodgāro vidāhaḥ syāduṣṇāṅgatvaṃ matibhramaḥ | kāntihāniḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣo mukhaśoṣo'lpaśukratā || 116 ||
tiktāsyatāmlavakratvaṃ svedasrāvo'ṅgapākatā | klamo haritavarṇatvamatṛptiḥ pītagātratā || 117 ||
raktadrāvo'ṅgadaraṇaṃ lohagandhāsyatā tathā | daurgandhyaṃ pītamūtratvamaratiḥ pītaviṭkatā ||118||
pītāvalokanaṃ pītanetratā pītadantatā | śītecchā pītanakhatā tejodveṣo'lpanidratā ||1 1 9|| kopaśca gātrasādaśca bhinnaviṭkatvamandhatā | uṣṇocchvāsatvamuṣṇatvaṃ mūtrasya ca malasya ca ||120||
tamaso darśanaṃ pītamaṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam | ni:sahatvaṃ ca pittasya catvāriṃśadrujaḥ smṛtāḥ ||121||

div.ab: kaphasya viṃśatiḥ proktā rogāstandrātinidratā | gauravaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ mukhalepaḥ prasekatā ||122 || śvetāvalokanaṃ śvetaviṭkatvaṃ śvetamūtratā | śvetāṅgavarṇatā śaityamuṣṇecchā tiktakāmitā ||123|| malādhikyaṃ ca śukrasya bāhulyaṃ bahumūtratā | ālasyaṃ mandabuddhitvaṃ tṛptirghargharavākyatā || 124 || acaitanyaṃ ca gaditā viṃśatiḥ śleṣmajā gadāḥ |

raktasya ca daśa proktā vyādhayasteṣu gauravam ||125|| raktamaṇḍalatā raktanetratvaṃ raktamūtratā | raktaniṣṭhīvanaṃ raktapiḍakānāṃ ca darśanam || 126 || auṣṇyaṃ ca pūtigandhatvaṃ pīḍā pākaśca jāyate |

ab.seg: catuḥsaptatisaṃkhyākā mukharogāstathoditāḥ || 127 ||
teṣvoṣṭharogā gaṇitā ekādaśamitā budhaiḥ | vātapittakaphaistredhā tridoṣairasṛjā tathā || 128 ||
kṣataṃ māṃsārbudaṃ caiva khaṇḍoṣṭhaṃ ca jalārbudam | medo'rbudaṃ cārbudaṃ ca rogā ekādaśa smṛtāḥ || 129||
dantarogā daśākhyātā dālanaḥ kṛmidantakaḥ | dantaharṣaḥ karālaśca dantacālaśca śarkarā || 130 ||
adhidantaḥ śyāvadanto dantabhedaḥ kapālikā | tathā trayodaśamitā dantamūlāmayāḥ smṛtāḥ || 131 ||
śītādopakuśau dvau tu dantavidradhipuppuṭau | adhimāṃso vidarbhaśca mahāsauṣirasauṣirau || 132 ||
teṣveva gatayaḥ pañca vātātpittātkaphādapi | sannipātādgatiścānyā raktanāḍī ca pañcamī || 133||

div.ab: tathā jihvāmayāḥ ṣaṭ syurvātapittakaphaistridhā | alāsaśca caturthaḥ syādadhijihvā ca pañcamī || 134|| ṣaṣṭhī caivopajihvā syāt
tathāṣṭau tālujā gadāḥ | arbudaṃ tālupiḍakā kacchapī tālusaṃhatiḥ || 135 || galaśuṇḍī tāluśothastālupākaśca puppuṭaḥ |

ab.seg: galarogāstathākhyātā aṣṭādaśamitā budhaiḥ || 136||
vātarohiṇikā pūrvaṃ dvitīyā pittarohiṇī | kapharohiṇikā proktā tridoṣairapi rohiṇī || 137||
medorohiṇikā vṛndo galaugho galavidradhiḥ | svarahā tuṇḍikerī ca śataghnī śāluko'rbudam|| 168||
gilāyurvalayaścāpi vātādgaṇḍaḥ kaphāttathā | medogaṇḍastathaiva syādityaṣṭādaśa kaṇṭhajāḥ || 139 ||
mukhāntaḥsaṃbhavā rogā aṣṭau khyātā maharṣibhiḥ | mukhapāko bhavedvātātpittāttadvatkaphādapi || 140 ||
raktāya sannipātācca pūtyāsyordhvagadādapi | arbudaṃ ceti mukhajāścatu:saptatirāmayāḥ || 141 ||

div.ab: karṇarogāḥ samākhyātā aṣṭādaśamitā budhaiḥ | vātātpittātkāphādraktātsannipātācca vidradhiḥ || 142 || śotho'rbudaṃ pūtikarṇaḥ karṇārśaḥ karṇahallikā | bādhiryaṃ tannikā kaṇḍūḥ śaṣkulī kṛmikarṇakaḥ ||143 || karṇanādaḥ pratīnāha ityaṣṭādaśa karṇajāḥ ||

ab.seg: karṇapālīsamudbhūtā rogāḥ sapta ihoditāḥ ||144||
utpātaḥ pāliśoṣaśca vidārī duḥkhavardhanaḥ | paripoṭaśca lehī ca pippalī ceti saṃskṛtā || 145||

div.ab: karṇamūlāmayāḥ pañca vātātpittātkaphādapi | sannipātācca raktācca -

tathā nāsābhavā gadāḥ || 146 || aṣṭādaśaiva saṃkhyātāḥ pratiśyāyāstu teṣvapi | vātātpittāttātkaphādraktātsannipātena pañcamaḥ || 147|| apīnasaḥ pūtināso nāsārśo bhraṃśathuḥ kṣavaḥ | nāsānāhaḥ pūtiraktamarbudaṃ duṣṭapīnasam || 148 || nāsāśoṣo ghrāṇapākaḥ pūyasrāvaśca dīptakaḥ |
tathā daśa śirorogā vātenārdhāvabhedakaḥ || 149 || śirastāpaśca vātena pittapīḍā tṛtīyakā | caturthī kaphajā pīḍā raktajā sannipātajā ||150|| sūryāvatācchiraḥkampātkrimibhiḥ śaṅkhakena ca |

ab.seg: tathā kapālarogāḥ syurnava teṣūpaśīrṣakam ||151||
aruṃṣikā vidradhiśca dāruṇaṃ piḍikā'rbudam | indraluptaṃ ca khalatiḥ palitaṃ ceti te nava || 152 ||

div.ab: tathā netrabhavāḥ khyātāścaturnavatirāmayāḥ | teṣu vartmagadāḥ proktāścaturviṃśatisaṃjñakāḥ || 153 || kṛcchronmīlaḥ pakṣmapātaḥ kaphotkliṣṭaśca lohitaḥ | arunnimeṣaḥ kathito raktotkliṣṭaḥ kukūṇakaḥ || 154 || pakṣmārśaḥ pakṣmarodhaśca pittotkliṣṭaśca pothakī | kliṣṭavartmā ca bahalaḥ pakṣmotsaṃgastathārbudam || 155|| kumbhikā sikatāvartma lagaṇo'ñjananāmikā | kardamaḥ śyāvavartmā ca bisavartmā tathā'lajī || 156|| utkliṣṭavartmeti gadāḥ proktā vartmasamudbhavāḥ | netrasaṃdhisamudbhūtā nava rogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 157 || jalasrāvaḥ kaphasrāvo raktasrāvaśca parvaṇī | pūyasrāvaḥ krimigranthirupanāhastathā'lajī || 158 || pūyālasa iti proktā rogā nayanasaṃdhijāḥ | tathā śuklagatā rogā budhaiḥ proktāstrayodaśa || 159|| sirotpātaḥ sirāharṣaḥ sirājālaśca śuklikā | śuklārma cādhimāṃsārma prastāryarma ca piṣṭakaḥ || 160 || śirāyāścippiṭaṃ caiva kaphagrathitako'rjunaḥ | snāyvarma śoṇitārma syāditi śuklagatā gadāḥ || 161|| tathā kṛṣṇasamudbhūtāḥ pañca rogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | śuddhaśukraṃ śirāśukraṃ kṣataśukraṃ tathā'jakā || 162 || śirāsaṃgaśca sarve'pi proktā kṛṣṇagatā gadāḥ | kācaṃ tu ṣaḍvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ vātātpittātkaphādapi || 163 || sannipātācca raktācca ṣaṣṭhaṃ saṃsargasaṃbhavam | timirāṇi ṣaḍeva syurvātapittakaphaistridhā || 164 || saṃsargeṇa ca raktena ṣaṣṭhaṃ syātsaṃnipātataḥ | liṅganāśaḥ saptadhā syādvātātpittātkaphena ca || 165|| tridoṣairupasargeṇa saṃsargeṇāsṛjā tathā | aṣṭadhā dṛṣṭirogāḥ syusteṣu pittavidagdhakam || 166|| amlapittavidagdhaṃ ca tathaivoṣṇavidagdhakam | nakulāndhyaṃ dhūsarāndhyaṃ ratryāndhyaṃ hrasvadṛṣṭikaḥ || 167 || gambhīradṛṣṭirityete rogā dṛṣṭigatā matāḥ ||118 || (catvāraścādhimanthāḥ syurvātapittakaphāsrataḥ || 168) abhiṣyandāśca catvāro raktāddoṣaistribhistridhā | sarvākṣirogāścāṣṭau syusteṣu vātaviparyayaḥ || 169 || alpaśopho'nyatovātastathā pākātyayaḥ smṛtaḥ | śuṣkākṣipākaśca tathā śopho'dhyuṣita eva ca || 170|| hatādhimantha ityete rogāḥ sarvākṣisaṃbhavāḥ |
puṃstvadoṣāstu pañcaiva proktāstatrerṣyakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 171 || āsekyaścaiva kumbhīkaḥ sugandhiḥ ṣaṇḍhasaṃjñakaḥ |

śukradoṣāstathāṣṭau syurvātātpittātkaphena ca || 172|| kuṇapaṃ cāsrapittābhyāṃ pūyābhaṃ śleṣmapittataḥ | kṣīṇaṃ ca vātapittābhyāṃ granthilaṃ śleṣmavātataḥ|| 173|| malābhaṃ saṃnipātācca śukradoṣā itīritāḥ |

ab.seg: atha strīroganāmāni procyante pūrvaśāsrataḥ ||174||
aṣṭāvārtavadoṣāḥ syurvātapittakaphaistridhā | pūyābhaṃ kuṇapaṃ granthi kṣīṇaṃ malasamaṃ tathā || 175 ||
tathā ca raktapradaraṃ caturvidhamudāhṛtam | vātapittakaphaistredhā caturthaṃ saṃnipātaḥ || 176 ||
viṃśatiryonirogāḥ syarvātātpittātkaphādapi | saṃnipātācca raktācca lohitakṣayatastathā ||177||
śuṣkā ca vāminī caiva khaṇḍitāntarmukhī tathā | sūcīmukhī viplutā ca putraghnī ca pariplutā || 178||
upaplutā prākcaraṇā mahāyoniśca karṇinī | svānnandā cāticaraṇā yonirogā itīritāḥ ||179||

div.ab: caturvidhaṃ yonikandaṃ vātapittakaphaistridhā | caturthaṃ saṃnipātena -
tathāṣṭau garbhajā gadāḥ || 180 || upaviṣṭakagarbhaḥ syāttathā nāgodaraḥ smṛtaḥ | makkallo mūḍhagarbhaśca viṣkambho gūḍhagarbhakaḥ || 181 || jarāyudoṣo garbhasya pātaścāṣṭamakaḥ smṛtaḥ |

pañcaiva stanarogāḥ sturvātātpittātkaphādapi || 182|| saṃnipātātkṣatāccaiva tathā stanyodbhavā gadāḥ | bālarogeṣu kathitāḥ strīdoṣāśca trayaḥsmṛtāḥ|| 183|| adakṣapuruṣotpanna: sapatnīvihitastathā | daivājjātastṛtīyastu tathā ye sūtikāgadāḥ || 184|| jvarādayaścikitsyāste yathādoṣaṃ yathābalam |

ab.seg: dvāviṃśatirbālarogāsteṣu kṣīrālasāstrayaḥ ||185 ||
vātātpittātkaphāccaiva dantodbhedaścaturthakaḥ | dantaghāto dantaśabdo'kāladanto'hipūtanam 186 || mukhapāko mukhasrāvo gudapākopaśīrṣakau | pārśvaruṇastālukaṇṭo vicchinnaṃ pārigarbhikaḥ ||187||
daurbalyaṃ gātraśoṣaśca śayyāmūtraṃ kukūṇakaḥ | rodanaṃ cājagallī syāditi dvāviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ ||188||

div.ab: tathā bālagrahāḥ khyātā dvādaśaiva munīśvaraiḥ | skandagraho viśākhaḥ syātsvagrahaśca pitṛgrahaḥ || 189|| naigameyagrahastadvacchakuni: śītapūtanā | mukhamaṇḍitikā tadvatpūtanā cāndhapūtanā || 190 || revatī caiva saṃkhyātā tathā syācchuṣkarevatī |
tathā caraṇabhedāstu vātaraktādikāśca ye || 191 || dvicatvāriṃśaduktāste rogeṣveva munīśvaraiḥ | dviṣaṣṭirdoṣabhedāḥ syuḥ sannipātādikāśca ye || 192|| te'pi rogeṣu gaṇitāḥ pṛthakproktā na te kvacit |
hīnamithyātiyogena bhedaiḥ pañcadaśoditāḥ || 193 || pañcakarmabhavā rogā rogeṣveva prakīrtitāḥ | snehasvedau tathā dhūmo gaṇḍūṣo'ñjanatarpaṇe || 194 || pīḍā aṣṭādaśaitajjāstāśca rogeṣu lakṣitāḥ |
śītopadrava ekaḥ syādekaścoṣṇodbhavo mataḥ|| 195|| śalyopadrava ekaśca kṣārāccaikaḥ smṛtastathā |

ab.seg: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛtrimaṃ ca tridhā viṣam ||196||
teṣāṃ ca kālakūṭādyairnavadhā sthāvaraṃ viṣam | jaṅgamaṃ bahudhā proktaṃ tatra lūtā bhujaṅgamā: ||197||

vṛścikā mūṣikāḥ kīṭāḥ pratyekaṃ te caturvidhāḥ | 1 - vāgbhaṭasaṃhitāyāṃ tu - ‘saṃsargādrasarudhirādibhistathaiṣāṃ doṣāṃstu kṣayasamatāvivṛddhibhedaiḥ | ānantyaṃ taratamayogataśca yātān jānīyādavahitamānaso yathāsvam ||’ ityanantatvaṃ kathitam | vṛddhikṣayasamarūpā doṣāṇāṃ tridhā gatiḥ | daṃṣṭrāviṣaṃ nakhaviṣaṃ vālaśṛṅgāsthibhistathā || 198 ||
mūtrātpurīṣācchukrācca dṛṣṭerniśvāsatastathā | lālāyāḥ sparśatastadvattathā śaṅkāviṣaṃ matam || 199 ||
kṛtrimaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ garadūṣīvibhedataḥ | saptadhātuviṣaṃ jñeyaṃ tathā saptopadhātujam || 200 ||
tathaivopaviṣebhyaśca jātaṃ saptavidhaṃ matam | duṣṭanīraviṣaṃ caikaṃ tathaikaṃ digdhajaṃ viṣam || 201 ||
kapikacchūbhavā kaṇḍūrduṣṭanīrabhavā tathā | tathā sūraṇakaṇḍūśca śotho bhallātajastathā || 202||
madaścaturvidhaścānyaḥ pūgabhaṅgākṣakodravaiḥ | caturvidho'nyo dravyāṇāṃ phalatvaṅmūlapatrajaḥ ||203||

div.ab: iti prasiddhā gaṇitā ye kilopadravā bhuvi | asaṃkhyāścāpare dhātumūlajīvādisaṃbhavāḥ || 204 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ nidānarogagaṇanādhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha svarasādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyām - madhyamakhaṇḍa: atha svarasādhyāya : | athātaḥ svarasaḥ kalkaḥ kvāthaśca himaphāṇṭakau | jñeyāḥ kaṣāyāḥ pañjaite laghavaḥ syuryathottaram || 1 ||
. āhatāttatkṣaṇākṛṣṭāddravyātkṣuṇṇātsamuddharet | vastraniṣpīḍito yaḥ sa rasaḥ‘yaḥ syātsvaraso rasa’ pā. | svarasa uccate ||2||
kuḍavaṃ cūrṇitaṃ dravyaṃ kṣiptaṃ ca dviguṇe jale | ahorātraṃ‘ahorātrāt’ pā. | sthitaṃ tasmādbhavedvā rasa uttamaḥ ||3||
ādāya śuṣkadravyaṃ vā svarasānāmasaṃbhave | jale'ṣṭaguṇite sādhyaṃ pādaśiṣṭaṃ3-‘śeṣaṃ’ pā. | ca gṛhyate ||4||
svarasasya gurutvācca palamardhaṃ prayojayet | niśoṣitaṃ cāgnisiddhaṃ palamātraṃ rasaṃ pibet ||5||
prakṣepapramāṇam| madhu śvetā guḍaṃ kṣārān jīrakaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā | ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ cūrṇādīnkolamātrānrase kṣipet || 6 ||

amṛtāsvarasaḥ | sa yathāsa yatheti | sa yathā ityādivākyena prayogān prakaṭayati granthakāraḥ, athavā guṇayuktijñāpanārthaṃ śiṣyavacanamidaṃ evaṃ sarvatra ‘sa yathe’ti jñātavyam | - amṛtāyā rasaḥ kṣaudrayuktaḥ sarvapramehajit | haridrācūrṇayukto vā raso dhātryāḥ samākṣikaḥ ||7||
raktapittādiṣu vāsakādisvarasaḥ | vāsakaḥ svarasaḥ peyo madhunā raktapittajit | jvarakāsakṣayaharaḥ kāmalāśleṣmapittahā || 8 ||
triphalāyā rasaḥ kṣaudrayukto dārvīraso'tha vā | nimbasya vā guḍūcyā vā pīto jayati kāmalām|| 9 ||
viṣamajvare tulasīdroṇapuṣpīsvarasau | pīto maricacūrṇena tulasīpatrajo rasaḥ | droṇapuṣṣīraso vāpi nihanti viṣamajvarān ||10||
raktātisāre jambvādisvarasaḥ | jambvāsrāmalakīnāṃ ca pallavottho raso jayet | madhvājyakṣīrasaṃyukto raktātīsāramulbaṇam ||11||
babbūla – syonāka - kuṭajasvarasāḥ | sthūlababbūlikāpatrarasa: pānādvyapohati | sarvātisārānsyonākakuṭajatvagraso'thavā || 12 ||
pratiśyāye - ārdrakasvarasaḥ | ārdrakasvarasaḥ kṣaudrayukto vṛṣaṇavātanut | śvāsakāsārucīrhanti pratiśyāyaṃ vyapohati || 13 ||
pārśvādiśūleṣu - bījapūrasvarasaḥ | bījapūrarasaḥ pānānmadhukṣārayuto jayet | pārśvahṛddhastiśūlāni koṣṭhavāyuṃ ca dāruṇam || 14 ||
pittaśūla-śatāvarīsvarasaḥ | śatāvaryāśca madhunā pittaśūlaharo rasaḥ | niśācūrṇayutaḥ kanyārasaḥ plīhāpacīharaḥ || 15 ||
athālambuṣāsvarasa apacyādau - alambuṣāyāḥ svarasaḥ pīto dvipalamātrayā | apacīgaṇḍamālānāṃ kāmalāyāśca nāśanaḥ || 16 ||

muṇḍīsvarasaḥ - sūryāvartārdhaśīrṣavyathādau | raso1-‘sa ca muṇḍyā rasaḥ’ pā. | ’śaśamuṇḍyā rasaḥ koṣṇo’ iti pāṭhaḥ | ‘śaṅkhapuṣpīmuṇḍīrasaḥ’ iti kha-pustake | muṇḍyāḥ sakoṣṇo vā maricaireva dhūlitaḥ | jayetsaptadinābhyāsātsūryāvartārdhamedakau ||17||
athonmādādau - brāhmyādisvarasaḥ | brāhmīkūṣmāṇḍaṣaḍgranthāśaṅkhinīsvarasāḥ pṛthak | madhukuṣṭhayutāḥ pītāḥ sarvonmādāpahāriṇaḥ2-‘rakāḥ’ pā. | || 18 ||
kodravamade - kūṣmāṇḍasvarasaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakasya svaraso guḍena saha yojitaḥ | duṣṭakodravasaṃjātamadaṃ2-‘kuṣṭha’ pā. | pānādvyapohati || 19 ||
gāṅgerukīsvarasamāha vraṇe - khaḍgādicchinnagātrasya tatkālaṃ pūrito vraṇaḥ | gāṅgerukīmūlarasairjāyate gatavedanaḥ || 20 ||

div.ab: puṭapākavidhiḥ | puṭapākasya kalkasya svaraso gṛhyate yataḥ | atastu puṭapākānāṃ yuktiratrocyate mayā || 21 || puṭapākasya mātreyaṃ lepasyāṅgāravarṇatā | lepaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ sthūlaṃ kuryādvāṅguṣṭhamātrakam || 22 || kāśmarīvaṭajambvādipatrairveṣṭanamuttamam | palamātro raso grāhyaḥ karṣamātraṃ madhu kṣipet ||23|| kalkacūrṇadravādyāstu deyā: svarasavadbudhai: |

ab.seg: kuṭajapuṭapāka atīsāre - sa yathā - tatkālākṛṣṭakuṭajatvacaṃ taṇḍulavāriṇā || 24 ||
piṣṭāṃ catuṣpalamitāṃ jambūpallavaveṣṭitām | sūtreṇa baddhāṃ godhūmapiṣṭena pariveṣṭitām || 25 ||
liptāṃ ca dhanapaṅkena gomayairvahninā dahet | aṅgāravarṇāṃ ca mṛdaṃ dṛṣṭvā vahneḥ samuddharet || 26 ||
tato rasaṃ gṛhītvā ca śītaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ1-’kṣaudrarasaṃ pā. | pibet | jayetsarvānatīsārāndustarānsucirotthitān || 27 ||
kaṇḍitaṃ taṃḍulapalaṃ jale'ṣṭaguṇite kṣipet | bhāvayitvā jalaṃ grāhyaṃ deyaṃ sarvatra karmasu || 28 ||
atīsāre - aralūpuṭapākaḥ | aralūtvakkṛtaścaiva puṭapāko'gnidīpanaḥ | medhumocarasābhyāṃ ca yuktaḥ sarvātisārajit ||29||

div.ab: sarvātīsāre - tittirapuṭapākaḥ | nyagrodhādeśca kalkene pūrayedgauratittireḥ9-‘tittiram’ iti pā. | | nirantramudaraṃ samyakpuṭapākena tatpacet || 30| tatkalkasya rasaḥ kṣaudrayuktaḥ sarvātisāranut2-‘jit’ iti pā. | |
atīsāraviśeṣe dāḍimīpuṭapākamāha - puṭapākena vipacetsupakvaṃ dāḍimīphalam ||31|| tadraso madhusaṃyuktaḥ sarvātīsāranāśanaḥ |

ab.seg: atha bījapūrādipuṭapākaśchardyām - bījapūrāmrajambūnāṃ pallavāni jaṭāḥ pṛthak || 32 ||
vipacetpuṭapākena kṣaudrayuktaśca tadrasaḥ | chardiṃ nivārayedghorāṃ sarvadoṣasamudbhavām || 33 ||
raktapittādau – vāsāpuṭapākamāha - piṣṭānāṃ vṛṣapatrāṇāṃ puṭapākaraso himaḥ | madhuyukto jayedraktapittakāsajvarakṣayān || 34 ||
atha kaṇṭakārīpuṭapākaḥ kāsaśvāsādau – pacetkṣudrāṃ sapañcāṅgāṃ puṭapākena tadrasaḥ | pippalīcūrṇasaṃyuktaḥ kāsaśvāsakaphāpahaḥ || 35 ||
atha bibhītakapuṭapākaḥ kāsādau - bibhītakaphalaṃ kiṃcidghṛtenābhyajya lepayet | godhūmapiṣṭenāṅgārairvipacetpuṭapākavat || 36 ||
tataḥ pakvaṃ samuddhṛtya tvacaṃ tasya mukhe kṣipet | kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyasvarabhaṅgāñjayettataḥ || 37 ||
atha śuṇṭhīpuṭapāka āmātīsārādau cūrṇaṃ kiṃcidghṛtābhyaktaṃ śuṇṭhyā eraṇḍajairdalaiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ puṭapākena vipacenmandavahninā || 38 ||
tata uddhṛtya taccūrṇaṃ grāhmaṃ prātaḥ sitānvitam | tena yānti śamaṃ pīḍā āmātīsārasaṃbhavāḥ ||39||

div.ab: atha śuṇṭhīpuṭapāka āmavātādau - śuṇṭhīkalkaṃ vinikṣipya rasaireraṇḍamūlajaiḥ | vipacetpuṭapākena tadrasaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyutaḥ || 40 || āmavātasamudbhūtāṃ pīḍāṃ jayati dustarām |
suraṇapuṭapāka arśoroge -- sauraṇaṃ kandamādāya puṭapākena pācayet || 41 || satailalavaṇastasya rasaścārśovikāranut |

ab.seg: atha mṛgaśṛṅgapuṭapākaḥ śūlādau -- śarāvasaṃpuṭe dagdhaṃ śṛṅgaṃ hariṇajaṃ pibet || 42 ||
gavyena sarpiṣā yuktaṃ hṛcchūlaṃ nāśayeddhruvam |iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśrīśārṅgadharācāryaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe svarasādikalpanā nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

div.head: atha kvāthakalpanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ | pānīyaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ kṣuṇṇe dravyapale kṣipet | mṛtpātre kvāthayedgrāhyamaṣṭamāṃśāvaśeṣitam ||1|| tajjalaṃ pāyaceddhīmānkoṣṇaṃ mṛdvagnisādhitam |

śṛta: kvāthaḥ kaṣāyaśca niryūha: sa nigadyate || 2 || āhārarasapāke ca saṃjāte dvipalonmitam | vṛddhavaidyopadeśena pibetkāthaṃ supācitam ||6|| kvāthe kṣipetsitāmaṃśaiścaturthāṣṭamaṣoḍaśaiḥ | vātapittakaphātaṅke viparītaṃ madhu smṛtam || 4 || jīrakaṃ gugguluṃ kṣāraṃ lavaṇaṃ ca śilājatu | hiṅgu trikaṭukaṃ caiva kvāthe śāṇonmitaṃ kṣipet || 5 || kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ guḍaṃ tailaṃ mūtraṃ cānyaddravaṃ tathā | kalkaṃ cūrṇādikaṃ kkāthe nikṣipetkarṣasaṃmitam || 6 || (apidhānamukhe pātre jalaṃ durjaratāṃ vrajet | tasmādāvaraṇaṃ tyaktvā kvāthādīnāṃ viniścayaḥ1-prakṣipta: | ||7||)

sarvajvare guḍūcyādikkāthaḥ - sa yathā - guḍūcīdhānyakāriṣṭaraktacandanapadmakaiḥ | guḍūcyādigaṇakkāthaḥ sarvajvaraharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || dīpano dāhahṛllāsatṛṣṇāchardyarucīrjayet | “nāgaraṃkeṣucinmudritapustakeṣu mūlapāṭhatvena dhṛtaḥ | devakāṣṭhaṃ ca dhānyakaṃ bṛhatīdvayam | dadyātpācanakaṃ pūrvaṃ jvaritānāṃ jvarāpaham || kṣudrā kirātatiktaṃ ca śuṇṭhī chinnā ca pauṣkaram | kaṣāya eṣāṃ śamayetpītaścāṣṭhavidhaṃ jvaram ||’

guḍūcīpippalīmūlanāgaraiḥ pācanaṃ smṛtam || 9 || dadyādvātajvare pūrṇaliṅge saptamavāsare | śāliparṇī balā drākṣā guḍūcī sārivā tathā ||10|| āsāṃ kvāthaṃ pibetkoṣṇaṃ tīvravātajvaracchidam| kāśmarīsārivādrākṣātrāyamāṇāmṛtābhavaḥ ||11|| kaṣāyaḥ saguḍaḥ pīto vātajvaravināśanaḥ | kaṭphalendrayavāpāṭhātiktāmustaiḥ śṛtaṃ jalam || 12|| pācanaṃ daśame'hni syāttīvre pittajvare nṛṇām | parpaṭo vāsakastiktā kairāto dhanvayāsakaḥ ||13|| priyaṅguśca kṛtaḥ kkātha eṣāṃ śarkarayā yutaḥ | pipāsādāhapittāsrayutaṃ pittajvaraṃ jayet || 14 || drākṣā harītakī mustaṃ kaṭukī kṛtamālakaḥ | parpaṭaśca kṛtaḥ kvātha eṣāṃ pittajvarāpahaḥ || 15 || tṛṇmūrcchādāhapittāsṛkśamano bhedanaḥ smṛtaḥ | (ekaḥprakṣiptaḥ | parpaṭakaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pittajvaravināśanaḥ ||16|| kiṃ punaryadi yujyeta candanośīravālakaiḥ |)
atha bījapūrādiḥ śleṣmajvare - bījapūraśiphāpathyānāgaragranthikaiḥ śṛtam ||17 || sakṣāraṃ pācanaṃ śleṣmajvare dvādaśavāsare |

kaphajvare - bhūnimbādikāthaḥ | bhūnimbanimbapippalya: śaṭhī śuṇṭhī śatāvarī ||18|| guḍūcī bṛhatī ceti kvātho hanyātkaphajvaram | paṭolatriphalātiktāśaṭhīvāsāmṛtābhavaḥ || 19 || kvātho madhuyutaḥ pīto hanyātkaphakṛtaṃ jvaram |
vātapittajvare - pañcabhadrakvāthaḥ | parpaṭābdāmṛtāviśvakairātaiḥ sādhitaṃ jalam || 20 || pañcabhadramidaṃ jñeyaṃ vātapittajvarāpaham |

ab.seg: kaphavātajvarādau laghukṣudrādikkāthaḥ | kṣudrāśuṇṭhīguḍūcīnāṃ kaṣāyaḥ pauṣkarasya ca || 21 ||
kaphavātādhike peyo jvare vāpi tridoṣaje | kāsaśvāsāruciharekare pā. pārśvaśūlavināśanaḥvidhāyini pā. || 22 ||

div.ab: vātakaphajvarādau āragvadhādikvāthaḥ | āragvadhakaṇāmūlamustātiktābhayākṛtaḥ | kvāthaḥ śamayati kṣipraṃ jvaraṃ vātakaphodbhavam|| 23 || āmaśūlapraśamano bhedī dīpanapācanaḥ |

pittaśleṣmajvare - amṛtāṣṭakam | amṛtāriṣṭakaṭukāmustendrayavanāgaraiḥ || 24 || paṭolacandanābhyāṃ ca pippalīcūrṇayukśṛtam | amṛtāṣṭakametacca pittaśleṣmajvarāpaham || 25 || chardyarocakahṛllāsadāhatṛṣṇāvināśanam |

paṭolaṃprakṣipto'yam | candanaṃ mūrvātiktāpāṭhāmṛtāgaṇaḥ || 26 || pittaśleṣmajvaracchardidāhakaṇḍūviṣāpahaḥ | sarvajvarādau - kaṇṭakārikvāthaḥ | kaṇṭakāridvayaṃ śuṇṭhī dhānyakaṃ suradāru ca || 27 || ebhiḥ śṛtaṃ pācanaṃ syātsarvajvaravināśanam |

ab.seg: atha daśamūlakvāthaḥ vātaśleṣmajvare | śāliparṇīpṛṣṭhiparṇībṛhatīdvayagokṣuraiḥ || 28 ||
bilvāgnimanthasyonākakāśmarīpāṭalāyutaiḥ | daśamūlamiti khyātaṃ kvathitaṃ tajjalaṃ pibet || 29||
pippalīcūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ vātaśleṣmajvarāpaham| saṃnipātajvaraharaṃ sūtikādoṣanāśanam || 30 ||
śoṣaśaityabhramasvedakāsaśvāsavikāranut | hṛtkaṇṭhagrahapārśvārtitandrāmastakaśūlahṛt || 31 ||
athābhayādikvāthastridoṣādau - abhayāmustadhānyākaraktacandanapadmakaiḥ | vāsakendrayavośīraguḍūcīkṛtamālakaiḥ ||32||
pāṭhānāgaratiktābhiḥ pippalīcūrṇayukśṛtam | pibettridoṣajvarajitpipāsākāsadāhanut || 33 ||
pralāpaśvāsatandrāghnaṃ dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ param | viṇmūtrānilaviṣṭambhavamiśoṣāruciṃ jayet ||34||
pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitakanāgaraiḥprakṣiptā: | | vacāsātiviṣājājīpāṭhāvatsakareṇukaiḥ ||35||
kirātatiktakaṃ mūrvā sarṣapā maricāni ca | kaṭukaṃ puṣkaraṃ bhārṅgī viḍaṅgaṃ; karkaṭāhvayam || 36 ||
arkamūlaṃ bṛhatsiṃhī śreyasī sadurālabhā | dīpyakaṃ cājamodā ca śukanāsādihiṅgubhiḥ || 37 ||
etāni samabhāgāni gaṇo'ṣṭaviṃśako mataḥ | kaṣāyamupabhuñjīta vātaśleṣmajvarāpaham || 38 ||
hanti vātaṃ tathā śītaṃ chedajaṃ pravalaṃ kapham | pralāpaṃ cātinidrāṃ ca romaharṣārucī tathā || 39 ||
mahāvāte'patantre ca sarvagātre ca śūnyatām | ayaṃ sarvajvarānhanti saṃnipātāṃstrayodaśa || 40 ||
atha saṃnipātajvare aṣṭādaśāṅgakvāthaḥ | kairātakaṭukīmustādhānyendrayavanāgaraiḥ | daśamūlamahādārugajapippalikāyutaiḥ || 41 ||
kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ pārśvārtisaṃnipātajvaraṃ jayet | kāsaśvāsavamīhikvātandrāhṛdgrahanāśanaḥ || 42 ||
tridoṣajajvarādau kaṭphalādikvāthaḥ | kaṭphalāmbudabhārṅgībhirdhānyarohiṣaparpaṭaiḥ | vacāharītakīśṛṅgīdevadārumahauṣadhaiḥ || 43 ||
hikkāṃ kāsajvaraṃ hanti śvāsaśleṣmagalagrahān | kvātho jīrṇajvaraṃ hanti guḍūcyāḥ pippalīyutaḥ ||44||
tathā parpaṭajaḥ kvāthaḥ pittajvaraharaḥ paraḥ | kiṃ punaryadi yujyeta candanodīcyanāgaraiḥ || 45 ||

div.ab: atha nidigdhikādirjīrṇajvare - nidigdhikāmṛtāśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ‘śṛṃgī’ pā. pāyayedbhiṣak | pippalīcūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ śvāsakāsārditāpaham || 46 || pīnasārucivaisvaryaśūlājīrṇajvaracchidam | (devadāruprakṣiptā ime | vacā kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam || 47 || kaṭphalaṃ mustabhūnimbatiktadhānyā harītakī | gajakṛṣṇā ca duḥsparśā gokṣururdhanvayāsakam ||48|| bṛhatyativiṣā chinnā karkaṭaṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam | kvāthamaṣṭāvaśeṣaṃ tu prasūtāṃ pāyayetstriyam || 49 || śūlakāsajvaraśvāsamūrcchākampaśirortijit |)

idānīṃ viṣamajvaranāśanārthaṃ yogapañcakamāha - kṣudrādhānyakaśuṇṭhībhirguḍūcīmustapadmakaiḥ || 50 || raktacandanabhūnimbapaṭolavṛṣapauṣkaraiḥ | kaṭukendrayavā'riṣṭabhārṅgīparpaṭakaiḥ samaiḥ || 51 || kvāthaṃ prātarniṣeveta sarvaśītajvaracchidam |

mustakṣudrāmṛtāśuṇṭhīdhātrīkvāthaḥ samākṣikaḥ ||52|| pippalīcūrṇasaṃyukto viṣamajvaranāśanaḥ | paṭolendrayavādārutriphalāmustagostanaiḥ || 53|| madhukāmṛtavāsānāṃ kvāthaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ pibet | saṃtate satate caiva dvitīyakatṛtīyake || 54 || aikāhike vā viṣame dāhapūrve navajvare |
paṭolatriphalānimbadrākṣāśamyākavāsakaiḥ || 55 || kvāthaḥ sitāmadhuyuto jayedaikāhikaṃ jvaram |

ab.seg: atha guḍūcyādistṛtīyakajvare - guḍūcīdhānyamustābhiścandanośīranāgaraiḥ || 56||
kṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ pibetkṣaudrasitāyuktaṃ jvarāturaḥ | tṛtīyajvaranāśāya tṛṣṇādāhanivāraṇam || 57 ||

div.ab: atha devadārvādi cāturthikajvare - devadāruśivāvāsāśāliparṇīmahauṣadhaiḥ | dhātrīyutaṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ dadyānmadhusitāyutam || 58 || cāturthikajvare śvāse kāse mandānale tathā |

atha bṛhadguḍūcyādi jvarātīsāre - guḍūcīdhānyakośīraśuṇṭhīvālakaparpaṭaiḥ || 59 || bilvaprativiṣāpāṭhāraktacandanavatsakaiḥ | kirātamustendrayavaiḥ kvathitaṃ śiśiraṃ pibet || 60 || sakṣaudraṃ raktapittaghnaṃ jvarātīsāranāśanam |
atha nāgarādikvātho jvarātīsāre - nāgaraṃ kuṭajo mustamamṛtāttiviṣā tathā ||61|| ebhiḥ kṛtaṃ pibetkvāthaṃ jvarātīsāranāśanam |
atha dhānyapañcakakvātha āmaśūlādau - dhānyavālakabilvābdanāgaraiḥ sādhitaṃ jalam||62| āmaśūlaharaṃ grāhi dīpanaṃ pācanaṃ param |
dhānyanāgarakvātha: pācane - dhānyanāgarajaḥ kvāthaḥ pācano dīpanastathā || 63 || eraṇḍamūlayuktaśca jayedāmānilavyathām |
atha vatsakādikvāthaḥ sāmaraktātīsāre - vatsakātiviṣābilvamustavālakajaḥ śṛtaḥ || 64 || atīsāraṃ jayetsāmaṃ cirajaṃ raktaśūlajit |

atha kuṭajāṣṭakaṃ āmaraktaśūlādau - kuṭajātiviṣāpāṭhādhātakīlodhramustakaiḥ || 65 || hrīberadāḍimayutaiḥ kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ samākṣikaḥ | peyo mocarasenaiva kuṭajāṣṭakasaṃjñakaḥ || 66 || atīsārāñjayeddāharaktaśūlāmadustarān |

atha hrīberādikvātho'tīsāre hrīberadhātakīlodhrapāṭhālajjāluvatsakaiḥ || 67 || dhānyakātiviṣāmustāguḍūcībilvanāgaraiḥ | kṛtaḥ kaṣāyaḥ śamayedatīsāraṃ cirotthitam ||68|| arocakāmaśūlāsrajvaraghnaḥ pācanaḥ smṛtaḥ |

ab.seg: atha dhātakyādiḥ kvāthaḥ bālātīsāre - dhātakībilvarodhrāṇi vālakaṃ gajapippalī || 69||
ebhiḥ kṛtaṃ śṛtaṃ śītaṃ śiśumyaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyutam | pradadyādavalehaṃ vā sarvātīsāraśāntaye || 70 ||
atha śāliparṇyādikvātho grahaṇyāṃ - śāliparṇībalābilvadhānyaśuṇṭhīkṛtaḥ śṛtaḥ | ādhmānaśūlasahitāṃ vātajāṃ grahaṇīṃ jayet ||71||
guḍūcyativiṣāśuṇṭhīmustaiḥ kvātha: kṛto jayet | āmānuṣaktāṃ grahaṇīṃ grāhī pācanadīpanaḥ || 72 ||
atha indrayavādikvāthaḥ sarvātīsāre - yavadhānyapaṭolānāṃ kvāthaḥ sakṣaudraśarkaraḥ | yojyaḥ sarvātisāreṣu bilvāmrāsthibhavastathā ||73||

div.ab: atha phalādikvāthaḥ kṛmiroge - triphalā devadāruśca mustā mūṣakakarṇikā | śigrūretaiḥ kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ pippalīcūrṇasaṃyutaḥ ||74|| viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktaśca kṛmighnaḥ krimirogahā | phalatrikāmṛtātiktānimbakairātavāsakaiḥ ||75|| jayenmadhuyutaḥ kvātha: kāmalāṃ pāṇḍutāṃ tathā |

ab.seg: atha punarnavādikvāthaḥ pāṇḍuśothādau - punarnavābhayānimbadārvītiktāpaṭolakaiḥ || 76 ||
guḍūcīnāgarayutaiḥ kvātho gomūtrasaṃyutaḥ | pāṇḍukāsodaraśvāsaśūlasarvāṅgaśothahā || 77 ||
atha vāsādikvāthaḥ raktapittādau - vāsādrākṣābhayākvāthaḥ pītaḥ sakṣaudraśarkaraḥ | nihanti raktapittārtiśvāsakāsānsudāruṇān ||78||
raktapittaṃ kṣayaṃ kāsaṃ śleṣmapittajvaraṃ tathā | kevalo vāsakakvāthaḥ pītaḥ kṣaudreṇa nāśayet ||79||
kāse yogadvayamāha - vāsākṣudrāmṛtākvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa jvarakāsahā | kāsaghnaḥ pippalīcūrṇayuktaḥ kṣudrāśṛtastathā || 80 ||
atha śvāsakāsādau kṣudrakvāthaḥ - kṣudrākulitthavāsābhirnāgareṇa ca sādhitaḥ | kvātha: pauṣkaracūrṇāḍhya: śvāsakāsau nivārayet || 81||
atha hikvāyāṃ reṇukādikāthaḥ - reṇukāpippalīkvātho hiṅgukalkena saṃyutaḥ | pānādeva hi pañcāpi hikkā nāśayati kṣaṇāt||82||
bilvatvaco guḍūcyā vā kvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa saṃyutaḥ | jayettridoṣajāṃ chardiṃ parpaṭaḥ pittajāṃ tathā || 83 ||
atha gṛdhrasyāṃ yogadvayamāha - hiṅgupuṣkaracūrṇāḍhyaṃ daśamūlaśṛtaṃ jayet | gṛdhrasīṃ kevalaḥ kvāthaḥ śephālīpatrajastathā || 84 ||
rāsnāpañcakaṃ saptadhātugatavāte -- rāsnāmṛtāmahādārunāgarairaṇḍajaiḥ śṛtam | saptadhātugate vāte sāme sarvāṅgaje pibet || 85 ||
gū. - atha rāsnāsaptakaṃ jaṃghāvātādau - rāsnā gokṣurakairaṇḍadevadāru punarnavā | guḍūcyāragvadhaścaiva kvāthameṣāṃ vipācayet ||86||
śuṇṭhīcūrṇena saṃyuktaṃ pibejjaṅghākaṭigrahe | pārśvapṛṣṭhorupīḍāyāmāmavāte sudustare || 87 ||
mahārāsnādiyogaḥ sarvavātaroge-- rāsnā dviguṇabhāgā syādekabhāgāstataḥ pare | dhanvayāsabalairaṇḍadevadāruśaṭhīvacāḥ || 88 ||
vāsako nāgaraṃ pathyā cavyā mustā punarnavā | guḍūcī vṛddhadāruśca śatapuṣpā ca gokṣuraḥ || 89 ||
aśvagandhā prativiṣā kṛtamālaḥ śatāvarī | kṛṣṇā sahacaraścaiva dhānyakaṃ bṛhatīdvayam || 90 ||
ebhiḥ kṛtaṃ pibetkāthaṃ śuṇṭhīcūrṇena saṃyutam | kṛṣṇācūrṇena vā yogarājaguggulunāthavā || 91 ||
ajamodādinā vāpi tailenairaṇḍajena vā | sarvāṅgakampe kubjatve pakṣāghāte'pabāhuke || 92 ||
gṛdhrasyāmāmavāte ca ślīpade cāpatānake | antravṛddhau tathādhmāne jaṅghājānugate'rdite || 93 ||
śukrāmaye meḍhraroge vandhyāyonyāmayeṣu ca | mahārāsnādirākhyāto brahmaṇā garbhakāraṇam || 94 ||
eraṇḍasaptakaṃ stanādigatavāte - eraṇḍo bījapūraśca gokṣuro bṛhatīdvayam | aśmabhedastathā bilva etanmūlaiḥ kṛtaḥ śṛtaḥ ||95||
eraṇḍatailahiṅgvāḍhyaḥ sayavakṣārasaindhavaḥ| stanaskandhakaṭīmeḍhrahṛdayotthāṃ vyathāṃ jayet || 96 ||
nāgarādirvātaśūlādau - nāgarairaṇḍaja: kvāthaḥ indrayavasya ca | hiṅgusauvarcalopeto vātaśūlanivāraṇaḥ || 97 ||
pittaśūle triphalādikvāthaḥ | triphalāragvadhakvāthaḥ śarkarākṣaudrasaṃyutaḥ | raktapittaharo dāhapittaśūlanivāraṇaḥ || 98 ||
kaphaśūlādau eraṇḍakvāthaḥ | eraṇḍamūlaṃ dvipalaṃ jale'ṣṭaguṇite pacet | tatkvātho yāvaśūkāḍhya: pārśvahṛtkaphaśūlahā || 99 ||
hṛdrogādau daśamūlakvāthaḥ | daśamūlakṛtaḥ kvātha: sayavakṣārasaindhavaḥ | hṛdrogagulmaśūlāni kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ ca nāśayet ||100||

div.ab: harītakyādi mūtrakṛcchrādau-- harītakīdurālambhākṛtamālakagokṣuraiḥ | pāṣāṇabhedasahitaiḥ kvātho mākṣikasaṃyutaḥ || 101 || vibandhe mūtrakṛcchre ca sadāhe saruje hitaḥ |

vīratarvādigaṇaḥ | vīratarurvṛkṣavandā kāśaḥ sahacarannayam || 102 || kuśadvayaṃ nalo gundrā bakapuṣpo'gnimanthakaḥ | mūrvā pāṣāṇabhedaśca syonāko gokṣurastathā || 103 || apāmārgaśca kamalaṃ brāhmī ceti gaṇo varaḥ | vīratarvādirityuktaḥ śarkarāśmarikṛcchrahā || 104 || mūtrāghātaṃ vāyurogānnāśayennikhilānapi |

ab.seg: mūtrakṛcchre elādikvāthaḥ - elāmadhukagokaṇṭareṇukairaṇḍavāsakāḥ || 105 ||
kṛṣṇāśmabhedasahitāḥ kvātha eṣāṃ susādhitaḥ | śilājatuyutaḥ peyaḥ śarkarāśmarikṛcchrahā || 106 ||
samūlagokṣurakvāthaḥ sitāmākṣikasaṃyutaḥ | nāśayenmūtrakṛcchrāṇi tathā coṣṇasamīraṇam ||107||
atha pramehe varādikvāthaḥ - varādārvyabdadārūṇāṃ kvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa mehahā | vatsakatriphalā dārvī mustako bījakastathā || 108 ||
phalatrikādiḥ pramehe - phalatrikābdadārvīṇāṃ viśālāyāḥ śṛtaṃ pibet | niśākalkayutaṃ sarvapramehavinivṛttaye || 109 ||

div.ab: dārvyādikvāthaḥ pradare - dārvī rasāñjanaṃ mustaṃ bhallātaḥ śrīphalaṃ vṛṣaḥ | kairātaśca pibedeṣāṃ kvāthaṃ śītaṃ samākṣikam || 110|| jayetsaśūlaṃ pradaraṃ pītaśvetāsitāruṇam |

nyagrodhādikvāthaḥ yonirogavraṇādau - nyagrodhaplakṣakośāmravetasā badarī tuṇiḥ || 111|| madhuyaṣṭī priyālaśca lodhradvayamudumbaraḥ | pippalaśca madhūkaśca taścā pārisapippalaḥ ||112|| sallakī tindukī jambūdvayamāmrataruḥ śivā | kadambakakubhau caiva bhallātakaphalāni ca || 113 || nyagrodhādigaṇakvāthaṃ yathālābhaṃ ca kārayet | ayaṃ kvātho mahāgrāhī vraṇyo bhagnaṃ ca sādhayet ||114|| yonidoṣaharo dāhamedomehaviṣāpahaḥ |

atha medodoṣe yogatrayaṃ - bilvo'gnimantha: syonākaḥ kāśmarī pāṭalā tathā ||115|| kvātha eṣāṃ jayenmedodoṣaṃ kṣaudreṇa saṃyutaḥ | kṣaudreṇa triphalākvāthaḥ pīto medoharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||116|| śītībhūtaṃ tathoṣṇāmbu medohṛtkṣaudrasaṃyutam |
udararoge cavyādikvāthaḥ - cavyacitrakaviśvānāṃ sādhito devadāruṇā || 117 || kvāthastrivṛccūrṇayuto gomūtreṇodarāñjayet |
śothodare punarnavādikvāthaḥ - punarnavāmṛtādārupathyānāgarasādhitaḥ || 118 || gomūtragugguluyutaḥ kvāthaḥ śothodarāpahaḥ |
pathyādikvāthaḥ yakṛtplīhagulmodare - pathyārohitakakvāthaṃ yavakṣārakaṇāyutam || 119 || pibetprātaryakṛtplīhagulmodaranivṛttaye |

ab.seg: śothe punarnavādikvāthaḥ - punarnavā dāruniśā niśā śuṇṭhī harītakī || 120||
guḍūcī citrako bhārṅgī devadāru ca taiḥ śṛtaḥ | pāṇipādodaramukhaprāptaṃ śophaṃ nivārayet || 121 ||
vṛṣaṇaśothe triphalādiḥ - phalatrikodbhavaṃ kvāthaṃ gomūtreṇaiva pāyayet | vātaśleṣmakṛtaṃ hanti śothaṃ vṛṣaṇasaṃbhavam || 122 ||
rāstrādiḥ antravṛddhau - rāsnāmṛtābalāyaṣṭīgokaṇṭairaṇḍajaḥ śṛtaḥ | eraṇḍatailasaṃyukto vṛddhimantrabhavāṃ jayet || 123 ||
kāñcanārakvāthaḥ gaṇḍamālāyāṃ - kāñcanāratvacaḥ kvāthaḥ śuṇṭhīcūrṇena nāśayet | gaṇḍamālāṃ tathā kvāthaḥ kṣaudreṇa varuṇatvacaḥ || 124||
atha śākhoṭakvāthaḥ ślīpade medoroge ca - śākhoṭavalkalakvāthaṃ gomūtreṇa yutaṃ pibet | ślīpadānāṃ vināśāya medodoṣanivṛttaye || 125 ||
punarbhavāvaruṇayoḥ kvātho'ntarvidramadhiṃ jayet | tathā śigrubhavaḥ kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 126||
aparamapi vidradhau varuṇādikayogamāha - varuṇādigaṇakvāthamapakve madhyavidradhau | ūṣakādirajoyuktaṃ pibecchamanahetave || 127 ||
varuṇo bakapuṣpaśca bilvāpāmārgacitrakāḥ | agnimanthadvayaṃ śigrudvayaṃ ca bṛhatīdvayam || 128 ||
saureyakatrayaṃ mūrvā meṣaśṛṅgī kirātakaḥ | ajaśṛṅgī ca bimbī ca karañjaśca śatāvarī ||129||
varuṇādigaṇakvāthaḥ kaphamedoharaḥ smṛtaḥ | hanti gulmaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ tathābhyantaravidradhīn ||130||
khadirādirbhagandare - khadiratriphalākvātho mahiṣīghṛtasaṃyutaḥ | viḍaṅgacūrṇayuktaśca bhagandaravināśanaḥ || 131 ||
paṭolādiḥ upadaṃśaroge -- paṭolatriphalanimbakirātakhadirāsanaiḥ | kvāthaḥ pīto jayetsarvānupadaṃśānsagugguluḥ || 132 ||
amṛtādirvātarakte - amṛtairaṇḍavāsānāṃ kvātha eraṇḍatailayuk | pītaḥ sarvāṅgasaṃcāri vātaraktaṃ jayeddhruvam ||133||
atha paṭolādikvātho vātarakte - paṭolaṃ triphalā tiktā guḍūcī ca śatāvarī | etatkvātho jayetpīto vātāstraṃ dāhasaṃyutam||134||
śvetakuṣṭhe bākucīkvāthaḥ | kvātho'valgujacūrṇāḍhyo dhātrīkhadirasārayoḥ | jayetsuśīlito nityaṃ śvitraṃ pathyāśināṃ nṛṇām ||135 ||

div.ab: raktakuṣṭhādaulaghumañjiṣṭhādikvāthaḥ | mañjiṣṭhā triphalā tiktā vacā dāruniśāmṛtā | nimbaścaiṣāṃ kṛtaḥ kvātho vātaraktavināśanaḥ ||136|| pāmākapālikākuṣṭharaktamaṇḍalajinmataḥ |

bṛhanmañjiṣṭhādiḥ sarvakuṣṭhe - mañjiṣṭhāmustakuṭajaguḍūcīkuṣṭhanāgaraiḥ ||137 || bhārṅgīkṣudrāvacānimbaniśādvayaphalatrikaiḥ | paṭolakaṭukīmūrvāviḍaṅgāsanacitrakaiḥ || 138 || śatāvarītrāyamāṇākṛṣṇendrayavavāsakaiḥ | bhṛṅgarājamahādārupāṭhākhadiracandanaiḥ || 139 || trivṛdvaruṇakairātabākucīkṛtamālakaiḥ | śākhoṭakamahānimbakarañjātiviṣājalaiḥ ||140|| indravāruṇikānantāsārivāparpaṭaiḥ samaiḥ | ebhiḥ kṛtaṃ pibetkvāthaṃ kaṇāguggulusaṃyutam || 141|| aṣṭādaśasu kuṣṭheṣu vātaraktārdite tathā | upadaṃśe ślīpade ca prasuptau pakṣaghātake || 142 || medodoṣe netraroge mañjiṣṭhādiḥ praśasyate |

ab.seg: pathyādiṣaḍaṅgakvāthaḥ śiroroge netrarogādau ca - pathyākṣadhātrībhūnimbairniśānimbāmṛtāyutaiḥ ||143||
kṛtaḥ kvāthaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo'yaṃ saguḍaḥ śīrṣaśūlahṛt?hā ? pā. | | bhrūśaṅkhakarṇaśūlāni tathārdhaśiraso rujam ||144||
sūryāvartaṃ śaṅkhakaṃ ca dantapātaṃ ca tadrujam | naktāndhyaṃ paṭalaṃ śukraṃ cakṣu:pīḍāṃ vyapohati ||145||
atha vāsādirnetraroge - vāsāviśvāmṛtādārvīraktacandanacitrakaiḥ | bhūnimbanimbakaṭukāpaṭolatriphalāmbudaiḥ || 146||
yavakāliṅgakuṭajaiḥ kvāthaḥ sarvākṣirogahā | vaisvaryaṃ pīnasaṃ śvāsaṃ nāśayedurasaḥ kṣatam || 147 ||
athāmṛtādirnetraroge - amṛtātriphalākvāthaḥ pippalīcūrṇasaṃyutaḥ | sakṣaudraḥ śīlito nityaṃ sarvanetravyathāṃ jayet ||148 ||
pañcavalkalakvātho vraṇakṣālanādau -- aśvatthodumbaraplakṣavaṭavetasajaṃ śṛtam | vraṇaśothopadaṃśānāṃ nāśanaṃ kṣālanātsmṛtam||149||
pramathyā procyate dravyapalātkalkīkṛtācchṛtāt | toye'ṣṭaguṇite tasyāḥ pānamāhuḥ paladvayam ||150||
sā yathā - mustakendrayavaiḥ siddhā pramathyā dvipalonmitā| suśītā madhusaṃyuktā raktātīsāranāśinī || 151 ||
idānīṃ yavāgūparibhāṣāmāha - sādhyaṃ catuṣpalaṃ dravyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale'mbunijale pā. | | tatkāthenārdhaśiṣṭena yavāgūṃ sādhayeddhanām || 152 ||
sā yathā - āmrāmrātakajambūtvakkaṣāye vipacedbudhaḥ | yavāgūṃ śālibhiryuktāṃ tāṃ bhuktvā grahaṇīṃ jayet ||153||
saṃprati yūṣamāha - kalkadravyapalaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī cārdhakārṣikī | vāriprasthena vipacetsa dravo pūṣa ucyate || 154 ||
saptamuṣṭiyūṣaḥ | sa yathā - kulatthayavakolaiśca mudgairmūlakaśuṇṭhakaiḥ | śuṇṭhīdhānyākayuktaiśca yūṣaḥ śleṣmānilāpahaḥ ||155||
saptamuṣṭika ityeṣa saṃnipātajvarāñjayet | āmavātaharaḥ kaṇṭhahṛdvakrāṇāṃ viśodhanaḥ ||156||
idānīṃ pānādikalpanāmāha - kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ sādhyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale | ardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca taddeyaṃ pāne bhaktādisaṃvidhau || 157 ||
ṣaḍaṅgapānam | sā‘sā’ pānādikalpanā ityartha:| yathā - uśīraparpaṭodīcyamustanāgaracandanaiḥ | jalaṃ śṛtaṃ himaṃ peyaṃ pipāsājvaranāśanam || 158 ||
jvarādau uṣṇodakavidhiṃ darśayannāha -- aṣṭamenāṃśaśeṣeṇa caturthenārdhakena vā | athavā kathanenaiva siddhamuṣṇodakaṃ vadet || 159 ||
śleṣmāmavātamedoghnaṃ bastiśodhanadīpanam | kāsaśvāsajvaraharaṃ pītamuṣṇodakaṃ niśi || 160 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ kṣīrapākavidhimāha - kṣīramaṣṭaguṇaṃ dravyātkṣīrānnīraṃ caturguṇam | kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ tatpītaṃ śūlamāmodbhavaṃ jayet || 161 || pañcamūlapayaḥ | (sarvajvarāṇāṃ jīrṇānāṃ kṣīraṃ bhaiṣajyamuttamam | śvāsātkāsācchiraḥśūlātpārśvaśūlātsapīnasāt ||162|| mucyate jvaritaḥ pītvā pañcamūlīśṛtaṃ payaḥ | trikaṇṭakapayaḥ | trikaṇṭakabalāvyāghrīguḍanāgarasādhitam || 163 || varcomūtravibandhaghnaṃ kaphajvaraharaṃ payaḥprakṣiptam |)

saṃprati yavāgūprabhṛtikānnaprakriyāmāha - athānnaprakriyātraiva procyate nātivistarāt || 164 || yavāgūḥ ṣaṅguṇajale siddhā syātkṛśarā ghanā | taṇḍulairmudgamāṣaiśca tilairvā sādhitā hitā || 165 || yavāgūrgrāhiṇī bālyā tarpaṇī vātanāśinī |
atha vilepīvivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - vilepī ghanasikthā syātsiddhā nīre caturguṇe ||166|| tarpaṇī bṛṃhaṇī hṛdyā madhurā pittanāśinī |

idānīṃ peyāyūṣāvapyāha - dravādhikā svalpasikthā caturdaśaguṇe jale ||167|| siddhā peyā budhairjñeyā yūṣaḥ kiṃcidghanastataḥ | peyā laghutarā jñeyā grāhiṇī dhātupuṣṭidā || 168 || yūṣo balyastataḥ kaṇṭhyo laghupākaḥ kaphāpahaḥ |
idānīṃ bhaktavidhimāha - jale caturdaśaguṇe taṇḍulānāṃ catuṣpalam ||169 || vipacetsrāvayenmaṇḍaṃ sa bhakto madhuro laghuḥ |
adhunā śuddhamaṇḍamāha - nīre caturdaśaguṇe siddho maṇḍastvasikthakaḥ ||170|| śuṇṭhīsaindhavasaṃyuktaḥ pācano dīpanaḥ smṛtaḥ |

athāṣṭaguṇamaṇḍamāha -- dhānyatrikaṭusindhūtthamudgataṇḍulayojitaḥ‘yuktastakreṇa’ pā.| || 171 || bhṛṣṭaśca hiṅgutailābhyāṃ sa maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ | dīpanaḥ prāṇado bastiśodhano raktavardhanaḥ ||172 || jvarajitsarvadoṣaghno maṇḍo'ṣṭaguṇa ucyate |
idānīṃ vāṭyamaṇḍamāha - sukaṇḍitaistathā bhṛṣṭairvāṭyamaṇḍo yavairbhayet ||173|| kaphapittaharaḥ kaṇṭhyo raktapittaprasādanaḥ |

atha lājamaṇḍamāha - lājairvā taṇḍulairbhṛṣṭairlājamaṇḍa: prakīrtitaḥ || 174|| śleṣmapittaharo grāhī pipāsājvarajinmataḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne kvāthakalpanā- dhyāyo dvitīyaḥ |

div.head: atha phāṇṭādikalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ | phāṇṭakalpanā | kṣuṇṇe dravyapale samyagjalamuṣṇaṃ vinikṣipet | mṛtpātre kuḍavonmānaṃ tatastu srāvayetpaṭāt || 1 ||
tasya?sa syāccū.? pā. cūrṇadravaḥ phāṇṭastanmānaṃ dvipalonmitam | sitāmadhuguḍādīṃśca kvāthavattatra nikṣipet || 2 ||
atha bṛhanmadhūkaphāṇṭaḥ | sa yathā - madhūkapuṣpaṃ madhukaṃ candanaṃ saparūṣakam | mṛṇālaṃ kamalaṃ lodhraṃ kambhārī nāgakeśaram ||3||
triphalā-sārivā-drākṣā-lājānkoṣṇajale kṣipet | sitāmadhuyutaḥ peyaḥ phāṇṭo vāsau himo'thavā ||4||
vātapittajvaraṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrcchāratibhramān | raktapittaṃ madaṃ hanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||5||

div.ab: athāmrādiphāṇṭaḥ jvarādau | āmrajambukisalayairvaṭaśuṅgaprarohakaiḥ | uśīreṇa kṛtaḥ phāṇṭa: sakṣaudro jvaranāśanaḥ || 6 || pipāsāchardyatīsārānmūrcchāṃ jayati dustarām |

ab.seg: laghumadhūkapuṣpādiphāṇṭo dāhapittādau | madhūkapuṣpakambhārīcandanośīradhānyakaiḥ || 7 ||
drākṣayā ca kṛtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ śītaḥ śarkarayā yutaḥ | tṛṣṇāpittaharaḥ prokto dāhamūrcchābhramāñjayet ||8||

div.ab: manthavidhiḥ | mantho'pi phāṇṭabhedaḥ syāttena cātraiva kathyate | jale catuḥpale śīte kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ kṣipet || 9 || mṛtpātre manthayetsamyaktasmācca dvipalaṃ pibet |
madātyayādau kharjūrādimanthaḥ | sa yathā - kharjūradāḍimīdrākṣātintiḍīkāmlikāmalaiḥ ||10|| saparūṣaiḥ kṛto manthaḥ sarvamadyavikāranut |
atha masūrādimanthaḥ chardyām - kṣaudrayuktā masūrāṇāṃ saktavo dāḍimāmbhasā || 11|| mathitā vārayantyāśu chārdiṃ doṣatrayodbhavām |

tṛṣṇādāhādau yavasaktumanthaḥ | plāvitaiḥ śītanīreṇa saghṛtairyavasaktubhiḥ ||12|| nātisāndradravo manthastṛṣṇādāhāstrapittahā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe phāṇṭādikalpanā nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ |

div.head: atha himakalpanādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: caturtho'dhyāyaḥ | kṣuṇṇaṃ dravyapalaṃ samyakṣaḍbhirnīrapalaiḥ plutam | niśoṣitaṃ himaḥ sa syāttathā śītakaṣāyakaḥ ||1|| tanmānaṃ phāṇṭavajjñeyaṃ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ |
āmrādihimo raktapitte | sa yathā - āmra-jambū ca kakubhaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya jale kṣipet ||2|| himaṃ tasya pibetprātaḥ sukṣaudraṃ raktapittajit |
atha marīcyādihimastṛṣṇādau - marīcaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca kākodumbarapallavāḥ || 3 || nīlotpalaṃ himastajjastṛṣṇāchardinivāraṇaḥ |
