vātapittādau nīlotpalādihimaḥ | nīlotpalaṃ balā drākṣā madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ tathā || 4 || uśīraṃ padmakaṃ caiva kāśmarī ca parūṣakam | eṣa śītakaṣāyaśca vātapittajvarāñjayet || 5 || sapralāpabhramacchardimohatṛṣṇānivāraṇaḥ |
guḍūcīhimaḥ jīrṇajvare - amṛtāyā himaḥ peyo jīrṇajvaraharaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6 || vāsāyāśca himaḥ kāsaṃ raktapittajvarāñjayet |
atha dhānyādihimo'ntardāhādau - prātaḥ saśarkaraḥ peyo himo dhānyākasaṃbhavaḥ || 7 || antardāhaṃ tathā tṛṣṇāṃ jayetsrotoviśodhanaḥ |

atha dhānyākādirhimaḥ raktapittādau - dhānyākadhātrīvāsānāṃ drākṣāparpaṭayorhimaḥ || 8 || raktapittajvaraṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ śoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe himakalpanā nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |

div.head: atha kalkakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ | athedānīṃ kalkakalpanāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ - dravyamārdraṃ śilāpiṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ vā sajalaṃ bhavet | prakṣepāvāpakalkāste tanmānaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 1 ||
kalke madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ deyaṃ dviguṇamātrayā | sitāguḍaṃ samaṃ dadyāddravā deyāścaturguṇāḥ || 2 ||

div.ab: vardhamānapippalyaḥ | sa‘sa’kalka ityartha:| yathā - trivṛddhyā pañcavṛddhyā vā saptavṛddhyāthavā kaṇāḥ | pibetpiṣṭvā daśadinaṃ tāstathaivāpakarṣayet ||3|| evaṃ viṃśaddinaiḥ siddhaṃ pippalīvardhamānakam | anena pāṇḍuvātāsrakāsaśvāsārucijvarāḥ || 4 || udarārśaḥkṣayaśleṣmavātā naśyantyurograhāḥ |
atha nimbakalko vraṇacchardyādau - lepānnimbadalaiḥ kalko vraṇaśodhanaropaṇaḥ || 5 || bhakṣaṇācchardikuṣṭhāni pittaśleṣmakṛmīñjayet |

ab.seg: atha mahānimbakalko gṛdhrasyām - mahānimbajaṭākalko gṛdhrasīnāśanaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 ||
atha rasonakalkaḥ vātarogaviṣamajvarādau - śuddhaḥ kalko rasonasya tilatailena miśrita: | vātarogāñjayettīvrānviṣamajvaranāśanaḥ || 7 ||
atha dvitīyarasonakalko vātavyādhau - pakvakandarasonasya gulikā nistuṣīkṛtāḥ | pāṭayitvā ca madhyasthaṃ dūrīkuryāttadaṅkuram || 8 ||
tadugragandhanāśāya rātrau takre vinikṣipet | apanīya ca tanmadhyācchilāyāṃ peṣayettataḥ || 9 ||
tanmadhye pañcamāṃśena cūrṇameṣāṃ vinikṣipet | sauvarcalaṃ yavānīṃ ca bharjitaṃ hiṅgu saindhavam || 10||
kaṭutrikaṃ jīrakaṃ ca samabhāgāni cūrṇayet | ekīkṛtya tataḥ sarvaṃ kalkaṃ karṣapramāṇataḥ || 11 ||
khādedagnibalāpekṣī ṛtudoṣādyapekṣayā | anupānaṃ tataḥ kuryāderaṇḍaśṛtamanvaham || 12 ||
sarvāṅgaikāṅgajaṃ vātamarditaṃ cāpatantrakam | apasmāramathonmādamūrustambhaṃ ca gṛdhrasīm || 13 ||
uraḥpṛṣṭhakaṭīpārśvakukṣipīḍāṃ krimīñjayet | ajīrṇamātapaṃ roṣamatinīraṃ payo guḍam || 14 ||
rasonamaśnanpuruṣastyajedetannirantaram | madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathāmlaṃ ca rasaṃ seveta nityaśaḥ || 15 ||
pippalyādikalka ūrustambhe - pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ bhallātakaphalāni ca | etatkalkaśca sakṣaudra ūrustambhanivāraṇaḥ ||16 ||
atha viṣṇukrāntākalkaḥ pariṇāmaśūle - viṣṇukrāntājaṭākalkaḥ sitākṣaudraghṛtairyutaḥ | pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlaṃ nāśayetsaptabhirdinaiḥ || 17 ||
aparamapi pariṇāmaśūlārthaṃ prayogamāha - śuṇṭhītilaguḍaiḥ kalko dugdhena saha yojayet | pariṇāmabhavaṃ śūlamāmavātaṃ ca nāśayet || 18 ||
athāpāmārgakalkaḥ raktārśasi - apāmārgasya bījānāṃ kalkastaṇḍulavāriṇā | pīto raktārśasāṃ nāśaṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ ||19||
atha badarīmūlakalkaḥ raktātīsāre - badarīmūlakalkena tilakalkaśca yojitaḥ | madhukṣārayutaḥ kuryādraktātīsāranāśanaḥ ||20||
raktakṣaye lākṣākalkaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakarasopetāṃ lākṣāṃ karṣadvayaṃ pibet | raktakṣayamuroghātaṃ kṣayarogaṃ ca nāśayet || 21 ||
atha taṇḍulīyakalkaḥ raktapradare - taṇḍulīyajaṭākalkaḥ sakṣaudraḥ sarasāñjanaḥ taṇḍulodakasaṃpīto raktapradaranāśanaḥ || 22 ||
athāṅkoṭakakalko'tīsārādau - aṅkoṭamūlakalkaśca sakṣaudrastaṇḍulāmbunā | atīsāraharaḥ proktastathā viṣaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 ||
vandhyākarkoṭikāmūlaṃ pāṭalāyā jaṭā'thavā | ghṛtena bilvamūlaṃ vā dvividhaṃ nāśayedviṣam ||24||
athābhayādikalkaḥ pācanādau - abhayāsaindhavakaṇāśuṇṭhīkalkastridoṣahā | pathyāsaindhavaśuṇṭhībhiḥ kalko dīpanapācanaḥ ||25||

div.ab: atha trivṛtādikalkaḥ kṛmiroge - trivṛtpalāśabījāni pārasīkayamānikā | kampillakaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ ca guḍaśca samabhāgikam ||26|| takreṇa kalkameteṣāṃ pibet krimigaṇāpaham |
raktārśasi tilakalkaḥ | navanītatilaiḥ kalko jetā raktārśasāṃ smṛtaḥ ||27|| navanītasitānāgakeśairaścāpi tadvidhaḥ |

saṃgrahaṇyāṃ śuṇṭhīkalkaḥ | pīto masūrayūṣeṇa kalkaḥ śuṇṭhīśalāṭuja: ||28 || jayetsaṃgrahaṇīṃ tadvattakreṇa bṛhatībhavaḥ | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe kalkakalpanā nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ |

div.head: atha cūrṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ | atyantaśuṣkaṃ yaddravyaṃ supiṣṭaṃ vastragālitam | tatsyāccūrṇaṃ rajaḥ kṣodastanmātrā karṣasaṃmitā || 1 ||
cūrṇe guḍādimānakalpanā | idānīmaviśeṣokteṣu śarkarāguḍayormānapūrvakaṃ prakṣepavidhimāha - cūrṇe guḍaḥ samo deyaḥ śarkarā dviguṇā bhavet | cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛdbhavet ||2||
liheccūrṇaṃ dravaiḥ sarvairghṛtādyairdviguṇonmitaiḥ | pibeccaturguṇaireva cūrṇamāloḍitaṃ dravaiḥ ||3||
atha cūrṇādīnāmanupānamātrāṃ darśayannāha - cūrṇāvalehaguṭikākalkānāmanupānakam | vātapittakaphātaṅke tridvyekapalamāharet || 4 ||
yathā tailaṃ jale kṣiptaṃ kṣaṇenaiva prasarpati | anupānabalādaṅge tathā sarpati bheṣajam || 5 ||
atha cūrṇārthaṃ bhāvanāparimāṇamāha - draveṇa yāvatā samyakcūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ plutaṃ bhavet | bhāvanāyāḥ pramāṇaṃ tu cūrṇe proktaṃ bhiṣagvarai: || 6 ||

div.ab: athāmalakyādicūrṇaṃ jvarādau - āmalaṃ citrakaṃ pathyā pippalī saindhavastathā | cūrṇito'yaṃ gaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvajvaravināśanaḥ || 7 || bhedī rucikaraḥ śleṣmajetā dīpanapācanaḥ |
atha pippalīcūrṇaṃ jvare - madhunā pippalīcūrṇaṃ lihetkāsajvarāpaham || 8 || hikkāśvāsaharaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ plīhaghnaṃ bālakocitam |

ab.seg: mehādikeṣu triphalācūrṇam - ekā harītakī yojyā dvau ca yojyau bibhītikau ||9 ||
catvāryāmalakānyevaṃ triphalaiṣāṃ prakīrtitā | triphalā mehaśothaghnī nāśayedviṣamajvarān || 10 ||
dīpanī śleṣmapittaghnī kuṣṭhahantrī rasāyanī | sarpirmadhubhyāṃ saṃyuktā saiva netrāmayāñjayet || 11 ||

div.ab: atha tryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ dīpanādau - pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī tribhistryūṣaṇamucyate | dīpanaṃ śleṣmamedoghnaṃ kuṣṭhapīnasanāśanam || 12 || jayedarocakaṃ sāmaṃ mehagulmagalāmayān|

ab.seg: atha pañcakolamarucyādau - pippalīcavyaviśvāhnāpippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 13 ||
pañjakolamiti khyātaṃ rucyaṃ dīpanapācanam | ānāhaplīhagulmaghnaṃ śūlaśleṣmodarāpaham || 14 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ trigandhacāturjātakacūrṇamāha - trigandhamelātvakpatraiścaturjātaṃ sakeśaraiḥ | trigandhaṃ sacaturjātaṃ rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghu pittakṛt ||15|| varṇyaṃ rucikaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ viṣaśleṣmāmayāñjayet |

atha jīvanīyagaṇaḥ - kākolī kṣīrakākolī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||16|| medā cānyā mahāmedā jīvantī madhukaṃ tathā | mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī jīvanīyo gaṇastvayam || 17 || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ svādurgarbhasaṃdhānakṛdguruḥ | stanyakṛdbṛṃhaṇo vṛṣyaḥ snigdhaḥ śītastṛṣāpahaḥ ||18|| raktapittaṃ kṣayaṃ śoṣaṃ jvaradāhanilāñjayet |

ab.seg: athāṣṭakavargaḥ - dve mede dve ca kākolyau jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||19||
ṛddhivṛddhī ca taiḥ sarvairaṣṭavarga udāhṛtaḥ | aṣṭavargo budhaiḥ prokto jīvanīyasamo guṇaiḥ ||20||
atha lavaṇapañcakaṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtrādau - sindhu sauvarcalaṃ caiva biḍaṃ sāmudrikaṃ gaḍam | ekadvitricatuṣpañcalavaṇāni kramādviduḥ || 21 ||
teṣu mukhyaṃ saindhavaṃ syādanukte tatprayojayet | saindhavādyaṃ romakāntaṃ jñeyaṃ lavaṇapañcakam || 22 ||
madhuraṃ sṛṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ balāpaham| vīryoṣṇaṃ dīpanaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kaphapittavivardhanam || 23 ||
atha kṣārayogaṃ darśayannāha - svarjikā yāvaśūkaśca kṣārayugmamudāhṛtam | jñeyau vahnisamau kṣārau svarjikāyāvaśūkajau || 24||
kṣārāścānye'pi gulmārśograhaṇīrukchidaḥ sarāḥ | pācanāḥ kṛmipuṃstvaghnāḥ śarkarāśmarināśanāḥ ||25||
sudarśanacūrṇam triphalā rajanīyugmaṃ kaṇṭakārīyugaṃ śaṭhī | trikaṭu granthikaṃ mūrvā guḍūcī dhanvayāsakaḥ || 26 ||
kaṭukā parpaṭo mustaṃ trāyamāṇā ca vālakam | nimba: puṣkaramūlaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭī ca vatsakam || 27 ||
yamānīndrayavo bhārṅgī śigrubījaṃ surāṣṭrakam | vacā tvakpadmakośīraṃ candanātiviṣābalāḥ || 28 ||
śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī viḍaṅgaṃ tagaraṃ tathā | citrako devadāruśca cavyaṃ patraṃ paṭolajam || 29 ||
jīvakarṣabhakau caiva lavaṅgaṃ vaṃśalocanā | puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kākolī patrakaṃ jātipatrakam || 30 ||
tālīsapatraṃ ca tathā samabhāgāni cūrṇayet | sarvacūrṇasya cārdhāṃśaṃ kairātaṃ nikṣipetsudhīḥ || 31 ||
etatsudarśanaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ doṣatrayāpaham | jvarāṃśca nikhilānhanyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||32||
pṛthagdvandvāgantujāṃśca dhātusthānviṣamajvarān | saṃnipātodbhavāṃścāpi mānasānapi nāśayet || 33 ||
śītajvaraikāhikādīnmohaṃ tandrāṃ bhramaṃ tṛṣām | śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ ca hṛdrogaṃ hanti kāmalām||34||
trikapṛṣṭhakaṭījānupārśvaśūlanivāraṇam | śītāmbunā pibeddhīmānsarvajvaranivṛttaye ||35||
sudarśanaṃ yathā cakraṃ dānavānāṃ vināśanam | tadvajjvarāṇāṃ sarveṣāmidaṃ cūrṇaṃ praṇāśanam ||36||
atha jvare pippalīcūrṇam | kāsaśvāsajvaraharī triphalā pippalīyutā | cūrṇitā madhunā līḍhā bhedinī cāgnibodhinī||37||
kaṭphalaṃ mustakaṃ tiktā śaṭhī śṛṅgī ca pauṣkaram | cūrṇameṣāṃ ca madhunā śṛṅgaberarasena vā || 38 ||
lehyaṃ jvaraharaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ kāsaśvāsārucīrjayet | vāyuśūlaṃ tathā chardiṃ kṣayaṃ caiva vyapohati || 39 ||
atha bṛhatkaṭphalādicūrṇa - kaṭphalaṃbīpikāyāṃ nā'sti| pauṣkaraṃ śṛṅgī mustā trikaṭukaṃ śaṭhī | samastānyekaśo vāpi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet ||40||
ārdrakasvarasakṣaudrairlihyātkaphavināśanam | śūlānilārucicchardikāsaśvāsakṣayāpaham || 41 ||
kaṭphalaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kṛṣṇā śṛṅgī ca madhunā saha | śvāsakāsajvaraharaḥ śreṣṭho lehaḥ kaphāntakṛt || 42 ||
śṛṅgīcūrṇam | śṛṅgīṃ prativiṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ cūrṇitāṃ madhunā lihet | śiśoḥ kāsajvaracchardiśāntyai vā kevalāṃ viṣām ||43||

div.ab: yavakṣārādicūrṇam - (yavakṣāraprakṣiptam| viṣāśṛṅgīmāgadhīpauṣkarodbhavam | cūrṇaṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ līḍhaṃ pañcakāsāñjayecchiśoḥ ||44||)

ab.seg: atīsāre śuṇṭhyādicūrṇamāha - śuṇṭhīprativiṣāhiṅgumustākuṭajacitrakaiḥ | cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pītamāmātīsāranāśanam || 45 ||

div.ab: atha harītakyādicūrṇamāmātīsārādau - harītakī prativiṣā sindhu sauvarcalaṃ vacā | hiṅgu ceti kṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ pibeduṣṇena vāriṇā ||46|| āmātīsāraśamanaṃ grāhi cāgniprabodhanam |

laghugaṅgādharacūrṇam | mustamindrayavaṃ bilvaṃ lodhraṃ mocarasaṃ tathā || 47 || dhātakīṃ cūrṇayettakraguḍābhyāṃ pāyayetsudhīḥ | sarvātīsāraśamanaṃ niruṇaddhi pravāhikām || 48 || laghugaṅgādharaṃ nāma cūrṇaṃ saṃgrāhakaṃ param |

atha bṛhadgaṅgādharacūrṇam - mustāralukaśuṇṭhībhirdhātakīlodhravālakaiḥ || 49 || bilvamocarasābhyāṃ ca pāṭhendrayavavatsakaiḥ | āmrabījaṃ prativiṣā lajjāluriti cūrṇitam || 50 || kṣaudrataṇḍulapānīyaiḥ pītairyāti pravāhikā | sarvātisāragrahaṇī praśamaṃ yāti vegataḥ || 51 || vṛddhagaṅgādharaṃ cūrṇaṃ saridvegasya rodhakamge'pi bandhakam” pā.| |

ab.seg: athājamodādicūrṇamatīsāre - ajamodā mocarasaṃ saśṛṃgaberaṃ sadhātakī kumumam | godadhimathitayuktaṃ gaṃgāmapi vāhinīṃ rudhyāt ||52||
maricādicūrṇaṃ - takreṇa yaḥ pibennityaṃ cūrṇaṃ maricasaṃbhavam | citrasauvarcalopetaṃ grahaṇī tasya naśyati | udaraplīhamandāgnigulmārśonāśanaṃ bhavet || 53 ||
atha kapitthāṣṭakaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau - aṣṭau bhāgāḥ kapitthasya ṣaḍbhāgā śarkarā matā | dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ dhātakī tathā ||54||
ajamodā pippalī ca pratyekaṃ syustribhāgikāḥ | maricaṃ jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ granthikaṃ vālakaṃ tathā || 55 ||
sauvarcalaṃ yamānī ca cāturjātaṃ sacitrakam | nāgaraṃ caikabhāgāḥ syu: pratyekaṃ sūkṣmacūrṇitam||56||
kapitthāṣṭakasaṃjñaṃ syāccūrṇametadgalāmayān | atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca vyapohati || 57 ||
dāḍimāṣṭakam | dāḍimī dvipalā grāhyā khaṇḍāddaśapalani ca | trigandhasya palaṃ caikaṃ trikaṭu syātpalatrayam || 58 ||
etadekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cūrṇaṃ syāddāḍimāṣṭakam | rucikṛddīpanaṃ kaṇṭhyaṃ grāhi kāsajvarāpaham || 59 ||

div.ab: atha bṛhaddāḍimāṣṭakam atīsārādau - dāḍimasya palānyaṣṭau śarkarāyāḥ palāṣṭakam | pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ yamānī maricaṃ tathā || 60|| dhānyakaṃ jīrakaṃ śuṇṭhī pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitam | karṣamātrā tugākṣīrī tvakpatrailāśca keśaram || 61 || pratyekaṃ kolamātrāḥ syustaccūrṇaṃ dāḍimāṣṭakam | atīsāraṃ kṣayaṃ gulmaṃ grahaṇīṃ ca galagraham || 62 || mandāgniṃ pīnasaṃ kāsaṃ cūrṇametadvyapohati |

pippalyādicūrṇam | (pippalī bṛhatī vyāghrī yavakṣārakaliṅgakāḥ ||63|| citrakaṃ sārivā pāṭhā śaṭhī lavaṇapañcakam | taccūrṇaṃ pāyayeddadhnā surayoṣṇāmbunāpi vā || 64 || mārutagrahaṇīdoṣaśamanaṃ paramaṃ hitam |)

atha lavaṅgādicūrṇam arocakādau - lavaṅgaṃ śuddhakarpūramelātvaṅnāgakeśaram || 65 || jātīphalamuśīraṃ ca nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇajīrakam | kṛṣṇāgarustugākṣīrī māṃsī nīlotpalaṃ kaṇā ||66|| candanaṃ tagaraṃ vālaṃ kaṅkolaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | samabhāgāni sarvāṇi sarvemyo'rdhā sitā bhavet ||67|| lavaṅgādyamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ rājārhaṃ vahnidīpanam | ropaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ vṛṣyaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ balapradam || 68 || hṛdrogaṃ kaṇṭharogaṃ ca kāsaṃ hikvāṃ ca pīnasam | yakṣmāṇaṃ tamakaṃ śvāsamatīsāramuraḥkṣatam || 69 || pramehārucigulmādīngrahaṇīmapi nāśayet |

ab.seg: atha jātīphalādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ grahaṇyādau - jātī phalalavaṅgailāpatratvaṅnāgakeśaraiḥ ||70||
karpūracandanatilaistvakkṣīrītagarāmalaiḥ | tālīsapippalīpathyāsthūlajīrakacitrakaiḥ ||71||
śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgamaricaiḥ samabhāgavicūrṇitaiḥ | yāvantyetāni sarvāṇi kuryādbhaṅgāṃ ca tāvatīm ||72||
sarvacūrṇasamā deyā śarkarā ca bhiṣagvaraiḥ | karṣamātraṃ tataḥ khādenmadhunā plāvitaṃ sudhīḥ ||73||
asya prabhāvādgrahaṇīkāsaśvāsārucikṣayāḥ | vātaśleṣmapratiśyāyāḥ praśamaṃ yānti vegataḥ ||74||
atha mahākhāṇḍavacūrṇamarucyādau - maricaṃ nāgapuṣpāṇi tālīsaṃ lavaṇāni ca | pratyekamekabhāgāḥ syuḥ pippalīmūlacitrakaiḥ || 75 ||
tvakvaṇā tintiḍīkaṃ ca jīrakaṃ ca dvibhāgikam | dhānyāmlavetasau viśvaṃ bhadrailā badarāṇi ca || 76 ||
ajamodā jaladharaḥ pratyekaṃ syustribhāgikāḥ | sarvauṣadhicaturthāṃśaṃ dāḍimasya phalaṃ bhavet || 77 ||
dravyemyo nikhilebhyaśca sitā deyārdhamātrayā | mahākhāṇḍavasaṃjñaṃ syāccūrṇametatsurocanam || 78 ||
agnidīptikaraṃ hṛdyaṃ kāsātīsāranāśanam | hṛdrogakaṇṭhajaṭharamukharogapraṇāśanam || 79 ||
viṣūcikāṃ tathādhmānamarśogulmakṛmīnapi | chardiṃ pañcavidhāṃ śvāsaṃ cūrṇametadvyapohati ||80||
atha nārāyaṇacūrṇamudarādau - citrakaṃ triphalā vyoṣaṃ jīrakaṃ hapuṣā vacā | yamānī pippalīmūlaṃ śatapuṣpā'jagandhikā || 81 ||
ajamodā śaṭhī dhānyaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ sthūlajīrakam | hemāhvā pauṣkaraṃ mūlaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam || 82 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ ceti samāṃśāni viśālā syāddvibhāgikā | trivṛttribhāgā vijñeyā dantyā bhāgatrayaṃ bhavet||83||
caturbhāgā śātalā syātsarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet | pācanasnehanādyaiśca snigdhakoṣṭhasya rogiṇaḥ || 84 ||
dadyāccūrṇaṃ virekāya sarvarogapraṇāśanam | hṛdroge pāṇḍuroge ca kāse śvāse bhagandare ||85||
mandāgnau ca jvare kuṣṭhe grahaṇyāṃ ca galagrahe | dadyādyuktānupānena tathādhmāne surādibhiḥ || 86 ||
gulme badaranīreṇa viḍbhede dadhimastunā | uṣṇāmbubhirajīrṇe ca vṛkṣāmlaiḥ parikartiṣu || 87 ||
uṣṭrīdugdhenodareṣu tathā takreṇa vā gavām | prasannayā vātaroge dāḍimāmbubhirarśasi || 88 ||
dvividhe ca viṣe dadyātghṛtena viṣanāśanam | cūrṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāma duṣṭarogagaṇāpaham || 89 ||

div.ab: atha hapuṣādyaṃ cūrṇamajīrṇodarādau - hapuṣā triphalā caiva trāyamāṇā ca pippalī | hemakṣīrī trivṛccaiva śātalā kaṭukā vacā || 90 || nīlinī saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | uṣṇodakena mūtreṇa dāḍimatriphalārasaiḥ || 91 || tathā māṃsarasenāpi yathāyogyaṃ pibennaraḥ | ajīrṇe plīhni gulmeṣu śophārśoviṣamāgniṣu ||92|| halīmakāmalāpāṇḍukuṣṭhādhmānodareṣvapi |

atha pañcasamaṃ cūrṇaṃ śūlādau - śuṇṭhī harītakī kṛṣṇā trivṛtsauvarcalaṃ tathā ||93|| samabhāgāni sarvāṇi sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet | jñeyaṃ pañcasamaṃ cūrṇametacchūlaharaṃ param || 94 || ādhmānajaṭharārśoghnamāmavātaharaṃ smṛtam |

atha nārācacūrṇamādhmānaśūlādau - karṣamātrā bhavetkṛṣṇā trivṛtā syātpalonmitā ||95|| khaṇḍātpalaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ cūrṇamekatra kārayet| karṣonmitaṃ lihedetatkṣaudreṇādhmānanāśanam ||96 || gāḍhaviṭkodarakaphānpittaśūlaṃ ca nāśayet |

atha lavaṇatritayādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ yakṛtplīhaśūlādau - lavaṇatritayaṃ kṣārau śatapuṣpādvayaṃ vacā ||97|| ajamodā'jagandhā ca hapuṣā jīrakadvayam | maricaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalī gajapippalī ||98 || hiṅguśca hiṅgupatrī ca śaṭhī pāṭhopakuñcikā | śuṇṭhī citrakacavyāni viḍaṅgaṃ cāmlavetasam ||99|| dāḍimaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca trivṛddantī śatāvarī | indravāruṇikā bhārṅgī devadāru yamānikā || 100|| kustumburustumburūṇi pauṣkaraṃ badarāṇi ca | śivā ceti samāṃśāni cūrṇamekatra kārayet|| 101|| bhāvabhedārdrakarasairbījapūrarasaistathā | tatpibetsarpiṣā jīrṇemadyenoṣṇodakena vā || 102 || kolāmbhasā vā takreṇa dugdhenauṣṭreṇa mastunā | yakṛtpṛṣṭhakaṭīśūlagudakukṣihṛdāmayam ||103|| arśoviṣṭambhamandāgnigulmaplīhodarāṇi‘aṣṭhīlā’ pā.| ca | hikkādhmānaśvāsakāsāñjayedetānna saṃśayaḥ ||104 || etairevauṣadhaiḥ samyagghṛtaṃ vā sādhayetsudhīḥ |

ab.seg: atha śūlādau tumburādicūrṇam | tumburūṇi trilavaṇaṃ yamānī puṣkarāhvayam || 105 ||
yavakṣārābhayāhiṅguviḍaṅgāni samāni ca | trivṛttribhāgā vijñeyā sūkṣmacūrṇāni kārayet||106||
pibeduṣṇena toyena yavakvāthena vā pibet | jayetsarvāṇi śūlāni gulmādhmānodarāṇi ca ||107||
atha citrakādyaṃ cūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau - citrakaṃ nāgaraṃ hiṅgu pippalī pippalījaṭā | cavyājamodā maricaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣasaṃmitam || 108 ||
svarjikā ca yavakṣāraḥ sindhu sauvarcalaṃ biḍam | sāmudrakaṃ romakaṃ ca kolamātrāṇi kārayet ||109||
ekīkṛtyākhilaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhāvayenmātuluṅgajaiḥ | rasairdāḍimajairvāpi śoṣayedātapena ca || 110||
etaccūrṇaṃ jayedgulmaṃ grahaṇīmāmajāṃ rujam | agniṃ ca kurute dīptaṃ rucikṛtkaphanāśanam || 111 ||

div.ab: atha vaḍavānalacūrṇaṃ mandāgnyādau - saindhavaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ pippalī cavyacitrakam | śuṇṭhī harītakī ceti kramavṛddhāni cūrṇayet ||112|| vaḍavānalanāmaiccūrṇaṃ syādagnidīpanam |

atha ajamodādyaṃ cūrṇam āmavātaśothādau - ajamodā viḍaṅgāni saindhavaṃ devadāru ca || 113 || citrakaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ śatapuṣpā ca pippalī | maricaṃ ceti karṣāṃśaṃ pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||114|| karṣāstu pañca pathyāyā daśa syurvṛddhadārukāt | nāgarācca daśaiva syuḥ sarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet ||115|| pibetkoṣṇajalenaiva cūrṇaṃ śvayathunāśanam | āmavātarujaṃ hanti saṃdhipīḍāṃ ca gṛdhrasīm ||116|| kaṭipṛṣṭhagudasthāṃ ca jaṅghayośca rujāṃ jayet | tūnīpratūnīviśvācīkaphavātāmayāñjayet || 117 || samena vā guḍenāsya vaṭakānkārayedbhiṣak |

ab.seg: śvāsādau śuṇṭhyādicūrṇam | (śuṇṭhī sauvarcalaṃprakṣiptam | hiṅgu dāḍimaṃ cāmlavetasam ||118||
cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā peyaṃ śvāsahṛdrogaśāntaye |) atha hiṃgvādicūrṇaṃ śūlādau - hiṅgu pāṭhā'bhayā dhānyaṃ dāḍimaṃ citrakaḥ śaṭhī ||119||
ajamodā trikaṭukaṃ hapuṣā cāmlavetasam | ajagandhā tintiḍīkaṃ jīrakaṃ pauṣkaraṃ vacā ||120||
cavyaṃ kṣāradvayaṃ pañca lavaṇāni vicūrṇayet | prāgbhojanasya madhye vā cūrṇametatprayojayet ||121||
pibedvā jīrṇamadyena takreṇoṣṇodakena vā | gulme vātakaphodbhūte hṛdgrahe'ṣṭhīlikāsu‘viḍgrahe’ pā.| ca ||122 ||
hṛdbastipārśvaśūleṣu śūle ca gudayonije | mūtrakṛcchre tathānāhe pāṇḍuroge'rucau tathā ||123||
hikvāyāṃ yakṛti plīhni śvāse kāse galagrahe | grahaṇyarśovikāreṣu cūrṇametatpraśasyate || 124 ||
bhāvitaṃ mātuluṅgasya bahuśaḥ svarasena vā | kuryācca guṭikā bahvīrvātaśleṣmāmayāpahāḥ || 125 ||

div.ab: atha yamānīkhāṇḍavacūrṇamarocakādau - yamānī dāḍimaṃ śuṇṭhī tintinīkāmlavetasau | badarāmlaṃ ca kurvīta catuḥśāṇamitāni ca || 126 || sārdhadviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ pippalī daśaśāṇikā | tvaksauvarcaladhānyākaṃ jīrakaṃ dvidviśāṇakam ||127 || catuḥṣaṣṭimitaiḥ śāṇai śarkarāmatra yojayet | cūrṇitaṃ sarvamekatra yamānīkhāṇḍavābhidham|| 128|| cūrṇaṃ jayetpāṇḍurogaṃ hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ jvaram | chardiśoṣātisārāṃśca plīhānāhavibandhatām||129|| aruciṃ śūlamandāgnimarśojihvāgalāmayān |

atha tālīsādicūrṇam arocakādau - tālīsaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī vaṃśarocanam ||130|| ekadvitricatuḥpañcakarṣairbhāgānprakalpayet | elātvacostu karṣārdhaṃ pratyekaṃ bhāgamācaret || 131|| dvātriṃśatkarṣatulitā pradeyā śarkarā budhaiḥ | tālīsādyamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ rocanaṃ pācanaṃ smṛtam|| 132|| kāsaśvāsajvaraharaṃ chardyatīsāranāśanam | śoṣādhmānaharaṃ plīhāgrahaṇīpāṇḍurogajit || 133|| paktvā vā śarkarāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṣipetsyādguṭikā tataḥ |

ab.seg: atha sitopalādicūrṇaṃ kāsakṣayapittadāhādau - sitopalā ṣoḍaśa syādaṣṭau syādvaṃśarocanā ||134||
pippalī syāccatuṣkarṣā syādelā ca dvikārṣikī | ekaḥ karṣastvacaḥ kāryaścūrṇayetsarvamekataḥ ||135||
sitopalādikaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhusarpiryutaṃ lihet | śvāsakāsakṣayaharaṃ hastapādāṅgadāhajit ||136 ||
mandāgniṃ suptajihvatvaṃ pārśvaśūlamarocakam | jvaramūrdhvagataṃ raktaṃ pittamāśu vyapohati ||137||
atha lavaṇabhāskaracūrṇaṃ grahaṇīgulmādau - sāmudralavaṇaṃ kāryamaṣṭakarṣamitaṃ budhaiḥ | pañca sauvarcalaṃ grāhyaṃ niḍaṃ saindhavadhānyakāt || 138||
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ kṛṣṇajīrakapatrakam | nāgakeśaratālīsamamlavetasakaṃ tathā || 139 ||
dvikarṣamātrāṇyetāni pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | maricaṃ jīrakaṃ viśvamekaikaṃ karṣamātrakam || 140 ||
dāḍimaṃ syāccatuṣkarṣaṃ tvagele cārdhakārṣike | etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhāskarābhidham ||141 ||
śāṇapramāṇaṃ deyaṃ tu mastutakrasurāsavaiḥ | vātaśleṣmabhavaṃ gulmaṃ plīhānamudaraṃ kṣayam‘kṣataṃ’ pā. | || 142||
arśāṃsi grahaṇīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vibandha‘vividhaṃ’ pā. | ca bhagandaram | śophaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsakāsāvāmavātaṃ ca hṛdrujam || 143||
mandāgniṃ nāśayedetaddīpanaṃ pācanaṃ param | sarvalokahitārthāya bhāskareṇoditaṃ purā ||144||

div.ab: atha elādicūrṇaṃ chardiroge - elāpriyaṅgumustāni kolamajjā ca pippalī | śrīcandanaṃ tathā lājā lavaṅgaṃ nāgakeśaram || 145|| etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sitākṣaudrayutaṃ lihet | vātapittakaphodbhūtāṃ chardiṃ hantyativegataḥ ||146 || vyāghrīcūrṇam | (vyāghrījīrakadhātrīṇāṃprakṣiptam | cūrṇaṃ madhuyutaṃ lihet | ūrdhvavātamahāśvāsatamakairmucyate kṣaṇāt ||147||)

ab.seg: atha pañcanimbacūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhādau - mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvacaṃ nimbātsamāharet | sūkṣmacūrṇamidaṃ kuryātpalapañcadaśonmitam || 148||
lohabhasmaharītakyau cakramardakacitrakau | bhallātakaṃ viḍaṅgāni śarkarāmalakaṃ niśā || 149 ||
pippalī maricaṃ śuṇṭhī bākucī kṛtamālakaḥ | gokṣuraśca palonmānamekaikaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 150 ||
sarvamekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgarājena bhāvayet | aṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭena khadirāsanavāriṇā || 151 ||
bhāvayitvā ca saṃśoṣya karṣamātraṃ tataḥ pibet | khadirāsanatoyena sarpiṣā payasāthavā || 152 ||
māsena sarvakuṣṭhāni vinihanti rasāyanam | pañcanimbamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvarogapraṇāśanam ||153||
śatāvarīcūrṇam - śatāvarī gokṣuraśca bījaṃ ca kapikacchujam | gāṅgerukī cātibalā bījamikṣurakodbhavam || 154 ||
cūrṇitaṃ sarvamekatra godugdhena pibenniśi | na tṛptiṃ yāti nārībhirnaraścūrṇaprabhāvataḥ ||155||
aśvagandhādicūrṇam - aśvagandhā daśapalā tanmātro vṛddhadāruka: | cūrṇīkṛtyobhayaṃ vidvānghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||156||
karṣaikaṃ payasā pītvā nārībhirnaiva tṛpyati | agatvā pramadāṃ bhūyādvalīpalitavarjitaḥ ||157||

div.ab: musalīcūrṇam - (musalīkandacūrṇaṃprakṣiptam | tu guḍūcīsattvasaṃyutam | vānarīgokṣurābhyāṃ ca śālmalīśarkarāmalaiḥ ||158 || āloḍya ghṛtadugdhena pāyayetkāmavardhanam |)

navāyasacūrṇam - citrakastriphalā mustaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ tryūṣaṇāni ca ||159|| samabhāgāni kāryāṇi nava bhāgā hatāyasaḥ | etadekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ madhusarpiryutaṃ lihet ||160|| gomūtramathavā takramanupāne praśasyate | pāṇḍurogaṃ jayatyugraṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca bhagandaram ||161|| śothakuṣṭhodarārśāṃsi mandāgnimaruciṃ kṛmīn |

ākārakarabhādicūrṇaṃ stambhanādau - ākārakarabhaḥ śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ kuṅkamaṃ kaṇā ||162|| jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca candanaṃ ceti kārṣikān | cūrṇāni mānataḥ kuryādahiphenaṃ palonmitam|| 163|| sarvamekīkṛtaṃ cūrṇaṃ māṣaikaṃ madhunā lihet | śukrastambhakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ puṃsāmānandakārakam ||164|| nārīṇāṃ prītijananaṃ seveta niśi kāmukaḥ || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe cūrṇakalpanā nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ |

div.head: atha guṭikādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | vaṭakāścātha kathyante tannāma guṭikā vaṭī | modako vaṭikā piṇḍī guḍo vartistathocyate ||1||
lehavatsādhyate vahnau guḍo vā śarkarā tathā | guggulurvā kṣipettatra cūrṇaṃ tannirmitā vaṭī ||2||
kuryādavahnisiddhena kvacidguggulunā vaṭīm | draveṇa madhunā vāpi guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||3||

div.ab: sitā caturguṇā deyā vaṭīṣu dviguṇo guḍaḥ | cūrṇāccūrṇasamaḥ kāryo guggulurmadhu tatsamam || 4 || dravaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ modakeṣu bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

ab.seg: karṣapramāṇaṃ tanmānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayujyate || 5 ||

div.ab: atha śrībāhuśālo guḍaḥ arśādau - sa yathā - indravāruṇikā mustaṃ śuṇṭhī dantī harītakī | trivṛcchaṭhī viḍaṅgāni gokṣuraścitrakastathā || 6 || tejohvā ca dvikarṣāṇi pṛthagdravyāṇi kārayet | sūraṇasya palānyaṣṭau vṛddhadāru catuṣpalam ||7|| catuṣpalaṃ syādbhallātaḥ kvāthayetsarvamekataḥ | jaladroṇe caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyātkvāthamuttamam || 8 || kvāthyadravyāttriguṇitaṃ guḍaṃ kṣiptvā punaḥ pacet | samyakpakvaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā cūrṇametatpradāpayet ||9|| citrakatrivṛtādantītejohvā: palikāḥ pṛthak | pṛthaktripalikāḥ kāryā vyoṣailāmalakatvacaḥ‘maricaṃ’ pā.| ||10|| nikṣipenmadhu śīte ca tasminprasthapramāṇataḥ | evaṃ siddho bhavecchrīmānbāhuśālaguḍā'bhidhaḥ ||11|| jayedarśāṃsi sarvāṇi gulmaṃ vātodaraṃ tathā | āḍhyavātapratiśyāyaṃ mahāntaṃ kṣayapīnasam ||12|| halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ pramehaṃ ca rasāyanam |

ab.seg: atha maricādiguṭikā kāsādau - maricaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātpippalī karṣasaṃmitā || 13 ||
ardhakarṣo yavakṣāraḥ karṣayugmaṃ ca dāḍimam | etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ yuñjyādaṣṭakarṣaguḍena hi ||14||
śāṇapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā vaktreṇa dhārayet | asyā: prabhāvātsarve'pi kāsā yāntyeva saṃkṣayam ||15||
śvāsakāsādau guḍavaṭikā | guḍaśuṇṭhīśivāmustairguṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe | śvāsakāseṣu sarveṣu bibhītaṃ vāpi kevalam ||16||

div.ab: āmalakyādiguṭikā tṛṣṇādau - āmalaṃ kamalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lājāśca vaṭarohakaḥ | etaccūrṇasya madhunā guṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe ||17|| tṛṣṇā pravṛddhāṃ hantyeṣā mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇam |

atha jvare sañjīvanīvaṭī tridoṣe ca - viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇā pathyāmalabibhītakam ||18|| vacā guḍūcī bhallātaṃ sadviṣaṃ cātra yojayet | etāni samabhāgāni gomūtreṇaiva peṣayet||19|| guñjābhā guṭikā kāryā dadyādārdrakajai rasaiḥ | ekāmajīrṇagulmeṣu dve viṣūcyāṃ pradāpayet ||20|| tisraśca sarpadaṣṭe tu catasraḥ sāṃnipātike | vaṭī saṃjīvanī nāmnā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||2 1||

atha vyoṣādiguṭikā pīnasādau - vyoṣāmlavetasaṃ cavyaṃ tālīsaṃ citrakaṃ tathā | jīrakaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgikam || 22 || trisugandhaṃ triśāṇaṃ syādguḍaḥ syātkarṣaviṃśatiḥ | vyoṣādiguṭikā seyaṃ pīnasaśvāsakāsajit ||23|| rucisvarakarī khyātā pratiśyāyapraṇāśinī |
atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā āmādau - āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīmajīrṇe guḍapippalīm ||24|| kṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ dadyādarśaḥsu saguḍābhayām |
atha vṛddhadārumodakaḥ - vṛddhadārukabhallātaśuṇṭhīcūrṇena yojitaḥ || 25 || modakaḥ saguḍo hanyātṣaḍvidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujam |

atha sūraṇapiṇḍī arśoroge - śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇasya bhāgāndvātriṃśadāharet || 26|| bhāgānṣoḍaśa citrasya śuṇṭhyā bhāgacatuṣṭayam | dvau bhāgau maricasyāpi sarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet || 27 || guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryādarśasāṃ nāśanīṃ parām |

ab.seg: sūraṇavaṭakāḥ | sūraṇo vṛddhadāruśca bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak || 28 ||
muśalīcitrakau jñeyāvaṣṭabhāgamitau pṛthak | śivā bibhītakī dhātrī viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kaṇā ||29||
bhallātaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ tālīsaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | caturbhāgapramāṇāni tvagelā maricaṃ tathā ||30||
dvibhāgamātrāṇi pṛthaktatastvekatra cūrṇayet | dviguṇena guḍenātha vaṭakānkārayedbudhaḥ || 31||
prabalāgnikarā ete tathārśonāśanāḥ parāḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajāṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ kṣayāmayam ||32||
plīhānaṃ ślīpadaṃ śothaṃ pramehaṃ ca bhagandaram | nihānyu: palitaṃ vṛdhyāstathā medhyā rasāyanā: ||33||

div.ab: maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ kāmalādau - triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau | dāru mākṣikadhātuśca dārvī mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam || 34 || pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi sarvadviguṇitaṃ tathā | maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayecchuddhaṃ gomūtre'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet || 35 || paktvā ca vaṭakānkṛtvā dadyāttakrānupānataḥ | kāmalāpāṇḍumehārśaḥśothakuṣṭhakaphāmayān ||36 || ūrustambhamajīrṇaṃ ca plīhānaṃ nāśayedapi |

dhātugatajvarādau pippalīmodakaḥ - (kṣaudrāddviguṇitaṃprakṣiptam | tasyā: pippalyā: | kṣīraṃ gavyaṃ, cāturjātaṃ cūrṇādhikāroktam | sarpirghṛtāddviguṇapippalī || 37 || sitā dviguṇitā tasyāḥ kṣīraṃ deyaṃ caturguṇam | cāturjātaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ paktvā kuryācca modakān ||38|| dhātusthāṃśca jvarānsarvān vāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍutām | dhātukṣayaṃ vahnimāndyaṃ pippalīmodako jayet ||39||)

ab.seg: atha candraprabhāgugguluḥ pramehādau - candraprabhā vacā mustaṃ bhūnimbāmṛtadārukam | haridrātiviṣā dārvī pippalīmūlacitrakau ||40||
dhānyakaṃ triphalā cavyaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī | vyoṣaṃ mākṣikadhātuśca dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam ||41||
etāni śāṇamātrāṇi pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | trivṛddantīpatrakaṃ ca tvagelā vaṃśarocanā ||42||
pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi kuryādetāni buddhimān | dvikarṣaṃ hatalohaṃ syāccatuṣkarṣā sitā bhavet ||43||
śilājatvaṣṭakarṣaṃ syādaṣṭau karṣāśca gugguloḥ | ebhirekatra saṃkṣuṇṇaiḥ kartavyā guṭikā śubhā ||44 ||
candraprabhādivikhyātā sarvarogapraṇāśinī | pramehānviṃśatiṃ kṛcchraṃ mūtrāghātaṃ tathāśmarīm ||45||
vibandhā''nāhaśūlāni mehanaṃ granthimarbudam | antravṛddhiṃ kaṭīśūlaṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ vicarcikām ||46||
aṇḍavṛddhiṃ tathā pāṇḍuṃ kāmalāṃ ca halīmakam | kuṣṭhānyarśāṃsi kaṇḍūṃ ca plīhodarabhagandaram ||47||
dantarogaṃ netrarogaṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam | puṃsāṃ śukragatān doṣān mandāgnimaruciṃ tathā || 48 ||
vāyuṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ hanyādbalyā vṛṣyā rasāyanī | candraprabhāyāṃ karṣastu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate || 49 ||

div.ab: atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikā gulmādau - yamānī jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ maricaṃ girikarṇikā | ajamodopakuñcī ca catuḥśāṇāḥ pṛthakpūthak ||50|| hiṅgu ṣaṭśāṇikaṃ kāryaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam | trivṛccāṣṭamitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ kalpayetsudhīḥ ||51|| dantī śaṭhī pauṣkaraṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ śivā | citro'mlavetasaḥ śuṇṭhī śāṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak ||52|| bījapūrarasenaiṣāṃ guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | ghṛtena payasā madyairamlairuṣṇodakena vā || 53 || pibetkāṅkāyanaproktāṃ guṭikāṃ gulmanāśinīm | madyena vātikaṃ gulmaṃ gokṣīreṇa ca paittikam ||54|| mūtreṇa kaphagulmaṃ ca daśamūlaistridoṣajam | uṣṭrīdugdhena nārīṇāṃ raktagulmaṃ vināśayet ||55|| hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ śūlaṃ krimīnarśāṃsi nāśayet |

athaṃ yogarājaguggulurvātaroge āmavāte vā - nāgaraṃ pippalī cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau ||56|| mṛṣṭaṃ hiṅgvajamodā ca sarṣapo jīrakadvayam | reṇukendrayavāḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī || 57 || kaṭukātiviṣā bhārṅgī vacāmūrve tribhāgataḥ | pratyekaṃ śāṇakāni syurdravyāṇīmāni viṃśatiḥ ||58|| dravyebhyaḥ sakalebhyaśca triphalā dviguṇā bhavet | ebhiścūrṇīkṛtaiḥ sarvaiḥ samo deyaśca gugguluḥ || 59 || (vaṅgaṃ raupyaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca lohasārastathābhrakam | maṇḍūraṃ rasasindūraṃ pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitam ||60|| guḍapākasamaṃ kṛtvā imaṃ dadyādyathocitam| ekapiṇḍaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhārayedghṛtabhājane ||61|| guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrāstu kṛtvā grāhyā yathocitāḥ | gugguluryogarājo'yaṃ tridoṣaghno rasāyanaḥ || 62 || maithunāhārapānānāṃ tyāgo naivātra vidyate | sarvānvātāmayānkuṣṭhānarśāṃsi grahaṇīgadam || 63 || pramehaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca nābhiśūlaṃ bhagandaram | udāvartaṃ kṣayaṃ gulmamapasmāramurograham || 64 || mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsaṃ ca nāśayedaruciṃ tathā | retodoṣaharaḥ puṃsāṃ rajodoṣaharaḥ striyām || 65 || puṃsāmapatyajanako vandhyānāṃ garbhadastathā | rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukto vividhaṃ hanti mārutam ||66|| kāṅkolyādiśṛtātpittaṃ kaphamāragvadhādinā | dārvīśṛtena mehāṃśca gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutām || 67|| medovṛddhiṃ ca madhunā kuṣṭhaṃ nimbaśṛtena ca | chinnākvāthena vātāsraṃ śothaṃ śūlaṃ kaṇā‘mūlakajāt’ pā. | śṛtāt||68|| pāṭalākvāthasahito viṣaṃ mūṣakajaṃ jayet | triphalākvāthasahito netrārtiṃ hanti dāruṇām|| 69|| punarnavādikvāthena hanyātsarvodarāṇyapi |

ab.seg: atha kaiśoraguggulurvātaraktādau - triphalāyāstrayaḥ prasthāḥ prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet||70||
saṃkuṭya lohapātreṇa sārdhadroṇāmbunā pacet | jalamardhaśṛtaṃ jñātvā gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 71 ||
tataḥ kvāthe kṣipecchuddhaṃ gugguluṃ prasthasaṃmitam | punaḥ pacedayaḥpātre darvyā saṃgharṣayenmuhuḥ || 72 ||
sāndrībhūtaṃ tato jñātvā guḍapākasamākṛtim | cūrṇīkṛtya tatastatra dravyāṇīmāni nikṣipet || 73 ||
triphalā dvipalā jñeyā guḍūcī palikā matā| ṣaḍakṣaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ pnoktaṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ palārdhakam || 74 ||
dantī karṣamitā kāryā trivṛtkarṣamitā smṛtā | tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛtapātre vinikṣipet || 75 ||
guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa yuñjyāddoṣādyapekṣayā | anupāne bhiṣagdadyātkoṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo'thavā || 76 ||
mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtaṃ vāpi yuktiyuktamutāparam | jayetsarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni vātaraktaṃ tridoṣajam || 77 ||
sarvavraṇāni gulmāni pramehapiḍikāstathā | pramehodaramandāgnikāsaśvayathupāṇḍujān || 78 ||
hanti sarvāmayānnityamupayukto rasāyanaḥ | kaiśorakābhidhāno'yaṃ gugguluḥ kāntikārakaḥ ||79||
vāsādinā netragadāngulmādīnvaruṇādinā | kvāthena khadirasyāpi vraṇakuṣṭhāni nāśayet || 80 ||
amlaṃ tīkṣṇamajīrṇaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ‘vyavāyaṃ’ pā. | śramamātapam | madyaṃ roṣaṃ tyajetsamyagguṇārthī purasevakaḥ || 81 ||
atha triphalāguggulurbhagandarādau - tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ palonmitam | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikaṃ kṣodayetsarvamekataḥ || 82 ||
tatastu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā prayuñjyādvahnyapekṣayā | bhagandaraṃ gulmaśothāvarśāṃnti ca vināśayet || 83 ||
atha gokṣurādigugguluḥ pramehādau - aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palānyānīya gokṣurāt | vipacetṣaḍguṇe nīre kvātho grāhyo'rdhaśeṣitaḥ ||84||
tataḥ punaḥ pacettatra puraṃ saptapalaṃ kṣipet | guḍapākasamākāraṃ jñātvā tatra vinikṣipet|| 85 ||
trikaṭu triphalā mustaṃ cūrṇitaṃ palasaptakam | tata: piṇḍīkṛtasyāsya guṭikā mukhyojitā || 86 ||
hanyātpramehaṃ kṛcchraṃ ca pradaraṃ mūtraghātakam | vātāsraṃ vātarogāṃśca śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 87 ||

div.ab: atha triphalāmodakaḥ kuṣṭhādau - triphalāṣṭapalā kāryā bhallātaṃ ca catuṣpalam | vākucī pañcapalikā viḍaṅgānāṃ catuṣpalam || 88 || hatalohaṃ trivṛccaiva gugguluśca śilājatu | ekaikaṃ palamātraṃ syātpalārdhaṃ pauṣkaraṃ bhavet || 89 || citrakasya palārdhaṃ syāddviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ bhavet | nāgaraṃ pippalī mustā tvagelāpatrakuṅkumam ||90|| śāṇonmitaṃ syādekaikaṃ cūrṇayetsarvamekataḥ | tatastatprakṣipeccūrṇaṃ pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame ||91|| modakānpalikānkṛtvā prayuñjīta yathocitān | hanyāt sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni tridoṣaprabhavāmayān ||92|| bhagandaraplīhagulmāñjihvātālugalāmayān | śiro'kṣibhrugatānrogānhanyātpṛṣṭhagatānapi ||93 || prāgbhojanasya deyaṃ syādadhaḥ kāyasthite gade | bheṣajaṃ bhaktamadhye ca roge jaṭharasaṃsthite || bhojanasyopari grāhyamūrdhvajatrugadeṣu ca |

ab.seg: atha kāñcanāragugguluḥ gaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthībhagandarādau - kāñcanāratvaco grāhyaṃ palānāṃ daśakaṃ budhaiḥ ||95||
triphalā ṣaṭpalā kāryā trikaṭu syātpalatrayam | palaikaṃ varuṇaṃ kuryādelātvakpatrakaṃ tathā || 96 ||
ekaikaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātsarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet | yāvaccūrṇamidaṃ sarvaṃ tāvanmātrastu gugguluḥ || 97 ||
saṃkuṇṭhya sarvamekatra piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayet | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa prātargrāhyā yathocitam ||98||
gaṇḍamālāṃ jayatyugrāmapacīmarbudāni ca | granthīnvraṇāṃśca gulmāṃśca kuṣṭhāni ca bhagandaram|| 99 ||
pradeyaścānupānārthaṃ kvātho muṇḍitakābhavaḥ | kvāthaḥkhadirasārasya pathyākvātho'tha koṣṇakam ||100||

div.ab: atha māṣādimodakaḥ puṣṭau - nistuṣaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ syāttathā godhūmasaṃbhavam | nistuṣaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ ca śālitaṇḍulajaṃ tathā || 101 || sūkṣmaṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ palikānyupakalpayet | tata ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bharjayedgoghṛtena ca || 102 || ardhamātreṇa sarvebhyastataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ kṣipet | jalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dattvā pācayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 103 || tataḥ pakvaṃ samuddhṛtya vṛttānkurvīta modakān | bhuktvā sāyaṃ palaikaṃ ca pibetkṣīraṃ caturguṇam|| 104 || varjanīyau viśeṣeṇa kṣārāmlau dvau rasāvapi | kṛtvaivaṃ ramayennārīrbahvīrna kṣīyate naraḥ || 105 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe vaṭakakalpanā nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha avalehādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | kvāthādīnāṃ punaḥ pākādghanatvaṃ sā rasakriyā | so'valehaśca lehaḥ syāttanmātrā syātpalonmitā ||1 ||
sitā caturguṇā kāryā cūrṇācca dviguṇo guḍaḥ | dravaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyāditi sarvatra niścaya || 2 ||
athāvalehasya siddhilakṣaṇamāha - supakve tantumattvaṃ syādavaleho'psu majjati | kharatvaṃ pīḍite mudrāgandhavarṇarasodbhavaḥ || 3 ||
idānīmanukteṣvanupānamāha - dugdhamikṣuraso yūṣaḥ pañcamūlīkaṣāyajam | vāsākātho yathāyogyamanupānaṃ praśasyate || 4 ||
atha kāsaśvāsādau kaṇṭakāryavalehaḥ - sa yathā - kaṇṭakārītulāṃ nīradroṇe paktvā kaṣāyakam | pādaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca tasmiṃścūrṇāni dāpayet || 5 ||
pṛthakpalani caitani guḍūcīcavyacitrakāḥ | mustaṃ karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca tryūṣaṇaṃ dhanvayāsakaḥ || 6 ||
bhārgī rāsnā śaṭhī caiva śarkarā palaviṃśatiḥ | pratyekaṃ ca palānyaṣṭau pradadyādghṛtatailayoḥ || 7 ||
paktvā lehatvamānīya śīte madhupalāṣṭakam | catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryāḥ pippalīnāṃ catuṣpalam || 8 ||
kṣiptvā nidadhyātsudṛḍhe mṛṇmaye bhājane śubhe | leho'yaṃ hanti hikvārtiśvāsakāsānaśeṣataḥ || 9 ||

div.ab: atha cyavanaprāśaḥ kṣayakṣīṇādau - pāṭalā'raṇikāśmaryabilvāralukagokṣurāḥ | parṇyau bṛhatyau pippalyaḥ śṛṅgī drākṣāmṛtābhayāḥ||10|| balā bhūmyāmalī vāsā ṛddhirjīvantikā śaṭhī | jīvakarṣabhakau mustaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kākanāsikā || 11 || mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī vidārī ca punarnavā | kākolyau kamalaṃ bhede sūkṣmailāgarucandanam || 12|| ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitamauṣadham | ekīkṛtya mahatpātre pañcāmalaśatāni ca || 13 || paceddroṇajale kṣiptvā grāhyamaṣṭāvaśeṣitam | tatastu tānyāmalāni niṣkulīkṛtya vāsasā ||14|| dṛḍhahastena saṃpīḍya kṣiptvā tatra tato ghṛtam| palasaptamitaṃ tāni kiṃcidbhṛṣṭvālpavahninā || 15 || tatastatra kṣipetkvāthaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cārdhatulonmitam | lehavatsādhayitvā ca cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet ||16|| pippalī dvipalā deyā tugākṣīrī catuṣpalā | pratyekaṃ ca triśāṇaṃ syāttvagelāpatrakeśaram || 17 || tatastvekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣipetkṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalam | ityetaccyavanaproktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñitam || 18 || lehaṃ vahnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā khādetkṣīṇo rasāyanam | bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇā nārīkṣīṇāśca śoṣiṇaḥ || 19 || hṛdrogiṇaḥ svarakṣīṇā ye narāsteṣu yujyate | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ pipāsāṃ ca vātāsramuraso graham ||20|| vātapittaṃ śukradoṣaṃ mūtradoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | medhāṃ smṛtiṃ strīṣu harṣaṃ krāntiṃ varṇaprasannatām ||21|| asya prayogādāpnoti naro jīrṇavivarjitaḥ |

atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehaḥ - niṣkulīkṛtya kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍātpalaśataṃ pacet ||22|| nikṣipya dviguṇaṃ nīramardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhyate | tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni pīḍayeddṛḍhavāsasā || 23 || ātape śoṣayetkiṃcicchūlāgrairbahuśo vyadhet | kṣiptvā tāmrakaṭāhe ca dadyādaṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtam || 24 || tena kiṃcidbharjayitvā pūrvoktaṃ tajjalaṃ kṣipet | khaṇḍātpalaśataṃ dattvā sarvamekatra pācayet || 25 || supakve pippalī śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ dvipalaṃ pṛthak | pṛthakpalārdhaṃ dhānyākaṃ patrailā maricaṃ tvacam || 26|| cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipettatra ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudramāvapet | khādedagnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā raktapittī kṣayī jvarī ||27 || śoṣatṛṣṇāvamicchardiśvāsakāsakṣatāturaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakāvaleho'yaṃ bālavṛddheṣu yujyate || 28 || uraḥsandhānakṛdvṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇo balakṛnmataḥ |
atha khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehaḥ arśoroge - yuktyā kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya sūraṇaṃ vipacetsudhīḥ ||29|| arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate |

ab.seg: atha agastyaharītakyavalehaḥ - harītakīśataṃ bhadraṃ yavānāmāḍhakaṃ tathā || 30||
palāni daśamūlasya viṃśatiṃ ca niyojayet | citrakaḥ pippalīmūlamapāmārgaḥ śaṭhī tathā || 31 ||
kapikacchuḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī bhārṅgī ca gajapippalī | balā puṣkaramūlaṃ ca pṛthagdvipalamātrayā || 32 ||
pacetpañcāḍhake nīre yavaiḥ svinnai: śṛtaṃ nayet | taccābhayāśataṃ dadyātkvāthe tasminvicakṣaṇaḥ || 36 ||
sarpistailāṣṭapalakaṃ kṣipedguḍatulāṃ tathā | paktvā lehatvamānīya siddhe śīte pṛthakpṛthak ||34||
kṣaudraṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ dadyātkuḍavamātrayā | harītakīdvayaṃ khādettena lehena nityaśaḥ || 35 ||
ayaṃ kāsaṃ jvaraṃ śvāsaṃ hikvārśo'rucipīnasān | grahaṇīṃ nāśayedeṣa valīpalitanāśanaḥ || 36 ||
balavarṇakaraḥ puṃsāmavaleho rasāyanam | vihito'gastyamuninā sarvarogapraṇāśanaḥ || 37 ||

div.ab: arśādau kuṭajāvalehaḥ | kuṭajatvaktulāṃ droṇe jalasya vipacetsudhīḥ | kaṣāyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 38 || triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātra dattvā ca vipacetpunaḥ| sāndratvamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet|| 39 || rasāñjanaṃ mocarataṃ trikaṭu triphalāṃ tathā | lajjāluṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāṃ bilvamindrayavaṃ tvacām ||40|| bhallātakaṃ prativiṣāṃ viḍaṅgāni ca vālakam | pratyekaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ ghṛtasya kuḍavaṃ tathā || 41 | siddhaśīte tato dadyānmadhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā | jayedeṣo'valehastu sarvāṇyarśāṃsi vegata: || 42 || durnāmaprabhavānrogānatīsāramarocakam | grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca raktapittaṃ ca kāmalām ||43|| amlapittaṃ tathā śothaṃ kārśyaṃ caiva pravāhikām | anupāne prayoktavyamājaṃ takraṃ payo dadhi || 44 | ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vā jīrṇe ca pathyabhojī bhavennaraḥ |

ab.seg: atīsārādau kuṭajāṣṭakāvalehamāha - kuṭajatvaktulāmārdrāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet || 45 ||
pādaśeṣa śṛtaṃ nītvā cūrṇānyetāni dāpayet | lajjālurdhātakī bilvaṃ pāṭhā mocarasastathā || 46 ||
mustaṃ prativiṣā caiva pratyekaṃ syātpalaṃ palam | tatastu vipacedbhūyo yāvaddarvīpralepanam || 47 ||
jalena chāgadugdhena pīto maṇḍena vā jayet | sarvātisārānghorāṃstu nānāvarṇānsavedanān || 48 ||
asṛgdaraṃ samastaṃ ca sarvārśāṃsi pravāhikām | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe'valehakalpanā nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

div.head: atha tailādhikārādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha snehaparibhāṣā | kalkāccaturguṇīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ vā tailameva vā | caturguṇe drave sādhyaṃ tasya mātrā palonmitā ||1||
nikṣipya kvāthayettoyaṃ kvāthyadravyāccaturguṇam | pādaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhītvā ca snehaṃ tenaiva sādhayet ||2||

div.ab: mṛdudravyādau kvathane jalapramāṇamāha - caturguṇaṃ mṛdudravye kaṭhine'ṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam | tathāca madhyame dravye dadyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ || 3 || atyantakaṭhine dravye nīraṃ ṣoḍaśikaṃ matam |

ab.seg: atha matāntare parimāṇaviśeṣamāha - karṣāditaḥ palaṃ yāvatkṣipetṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam || 4 ||
tadūrdhvaṃ kuḍavaṃ yāvadbhavedaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | prasthāditaḥ kṣipennīraṃ khārī yāvaccaturguṇam || 5 ||
ambukvātharasairyatra pṛthaksnehasya sādhanam | kalkasyāṃśaṃ tatra dadyāccaturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṣṭamam || 6 ||
dugdhe dadhni rase nakre kalko deyo'ṣṭamāṃśakaḥ | kalkasya samyakpākārthaṃ toyamatra caturguṇam || 7 ||
dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni bhavanti hi | tatra snehasamānyāhuryathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇam || 8 ||
kevalakvāthapāke vidhānamāha - dravyeṇa kevalenaiva snehapāko bhavedyadi | tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ syājjalaṃ cātra caturguṇam || 9||
kvāthena kevalenaiva pāko yatreritaḥ kvacit | kvāthyadravyasya kalko'pi tatra snehe prayujyate ||10||

div.ab: kalkahīnastu yaḥ srehaḥ sa sādhyaḥ kevale drave |
puṣpakalkastu yaḥ snehastatra toyaṃ caturguṇam || 11 || snehe snehāṣṭamāṃśaśca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate |

ab.seg: vartivatsnehakalkaḥ syādyadāṅgulyā vimarditaḥ ||12||
śabdahīno'gninikṣiptaḥ snehaḥ siddho bhavettadā| yadā phenodgamastaile phenaśāntiśca sarpiṣi ||13||
gandhavarṇarasotpattiḥ snehasiddhistadā bhavet | snehapākastridhā prokto mṛdurmadhyaḥ kharastathā ||14||
īṣatsarasakalkastu snehapāko mṛdurbhavet | madhyapākasya siddhiśca kalke nīrasakomalaḥ ||15||
īṣatkaṭhinakalkaśca snehapāko bhavetkharaḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapākaḥ syāddāhakṛnniṣprayojanaḥ || 16 ||

div.ab: āmapākaśca nirvīryo vahnimāndyakaro guru: | nasyārthaṃ stanmṛdu: pāko madhyamaḥ sarvakarmasu ||17|| abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ prokto yuñjyādevaṃ yathohitam | ghṛtatailaguḍādīṃśca sādhayennaikavāsare ||18|| prakurvantyuṣitā hyete viśeṣādguṇasaṃcayam |

atha ghṛtakalpanā sa yathā- pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ || 19 || sasaindhavaiśca palikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā tadghṛtaṃ plīhanāśanam || 20|| viṣamajvaramandāgniharaṃ rucikaraṃ param |

atha cāṃgerīghṛtaṃ atīsāragrahaṇyoḥ - pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī ||21|| śvadaṃṣṭrā nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ pāṭhā bilvaṃ yavānikā | dravyaiśca palikairetaiścatuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ghṛtam || 22 || ghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ deyaṃ cāṅgairīsvarasaṃ budhaiḥ | tathā caturguṇaṃ dattvā dadhi sarpirvipācayet ||23|| śanaiḥ śanairvipaktavyaṃ cāṅgerīghṛtamuttamam | tadghṛtaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ grahaṇyarśovikāranut || 24 || hantyānāhaṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām |

atha masūraghṛtam atīsārādau - masūrāṇāṃ palaśataṃ nīradroṇe vipācayet ||25|| pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā datvā bilvapalāṣṭakam | ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacettena sarvātīsāranāśanam ||26|| grahaṇīṃ bhinnaviṭkaṃ ca nāśayecca pravāhikām |

ab.seg: atha kāmadevaghṛtaṃ raktapittādau - aśvagandhā‘aśvagandhā palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ matam | punarnavāśvatthaśuṇṭhīkāśmaryāstu phalānyapi || padmabījaṃ māṣabījaṃ daṣāddaśapalaṃ pṛthak | caturdroṇāmbhasā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ padmakaṃ raktacandanam | patrakaṃ pippalī drākṣā kapikacchuphalaṃ tathā || nīlotpalaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ sārive dve bale tathā | pṛthakvarṣasamā bhāgāḥ śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || rasaśca pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | ghṛtasya cāḍhakaṃ dattvā pācayenmṛdunāgninā || ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ paṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || vātaraktaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca kāmalām | śukrakṣayamurodāhaṃ kārśyamojaḥkṣayaṃ tathā || strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ garbhadaṃ śukradaṃ nṛṇām | kāmadevaghṛtaṃ nāma hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ rasāyanam’ || iti pāṭhāntaram | palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ smṛtam | śatāvarī vidārī ca śālaparṇī balāmṛtā || 27 ||
aśvatthasya ca śuṅgāni padmabījaṃ punarnavā | kāśmaryāśca phalaṃ caiva māṣabījaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 ||
pṛthagdaśapalānbhāgān caturdroṇe'mbhasi pacet | droṇe śeṣe rase tasmin paceccaiva ghṛtāḍhakam ||29||
mṛdvīkā padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī raktacandanam | patrakaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca ātmaguptāphalaṃ tathā || 30||
nīlotpalaṃ sārive dve jīvanīyo gaṇastathā | pṛthakvarṣasamānbhāgān śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || 31||
rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | caturguṇena payasā ghṛtāḍhakaṃ vipācayet || 32 ||
ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || 33 ||
mūtrakṛcchramurodāhaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca nāśayet | etatsarpiḥ prayoktavyaṃ bahvanta: puravāsinām || 34 ||
strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ durbalānāṃ ca dehinām | śreṣṭhaṃ balakaraṃ varṇyaṃ hṛdyaṃ puṣṭirasāyanam ||35||
ojastejaskaraṃ hṛdyamāyuṣyaṃ prāṇavardhanam| saṃvardhayati śukraṃ hi puruṣaṃ durbalendriyam || 36 ||
sarvarogavinirmuktau payaḥsikto yathā drumaḥ | kāmadeva iti khyātaṃ sarpiruktaṃ mahāguṇam || 37 ||
apasmārādau pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ - triphalā dve niśe kauntī sārive dve priyaṅgukā | śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī devadārvyelavālukam || 38 ||
nataṃ viśālā dantī ca dāḍimaṃ nāgakeśaram | nīlotpalailā mañjiṣṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ kuṣṭhapadmakam || 39 ||
jātipuṣpaṃ candanaṃ ca tālīsaṃ bṛhatī tathā | etaiḥ karṣasamaiḥ kalkairjalaṃ dattvā caturguṇam || 40 ||
ghṛtaprasthaṃ paceddhīmānapasmāre jvare kṣaye | unmāde vātarakte ca kāse mandānale tathā || 41 ||
pratiśyāye kaṭīśūle tṛtīyakacaturthake | mūtrakṛcchre visarpe ca kaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmaye tathā || 42 ||
viṣadvaye prameheṣu sarvathaivopayujyate | vandhyānāṃ putradaṃ bhūtayakṣarakṣoharaṃ smṛtam || 43 ||
amṛtāghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhādau - amṛtākvāthakalkābhyāṃ sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam | vātaraktaṃ jayatyāśu kuṣṭhaṃ jayati dustaram || 44 ||
atha mahātiktakaghṛtaṃ vātaraktakuṣṭhādau - saptacchadaḥ prativiṣā śyāmākaḥ kaṭurohiṇī | pāṭhā mustamuśīraṃ ca triphalā parpaṭastathā || 45 ||
paṭolanimbamañjiṣṭhāḥ pippalī padmakaṃ śaṭhī | candanaṃ dhanvayāsaśca viśāle dve niśe tathā || 46 ||
guḍūcī sārive dve ca mūrvā vāsā śatāvarī | trāyantīndrayavāyaṣṭībhūnimbaścākṣabhāgikāḥ || 47 ||
ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyādghṛtādāmalakīrasaḥ | dviguṇaḥ sarpiṣaścātra jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 48 ||
tatsiddhaṃ pāyayetsarpirvātarakteṣu sarvathā | kuṣṭhāni raktapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi ca pāṇḍutām ||49||
hṛdrogagulmavīsarpapradaraṃ gaṇḍamālikām | kṣudrarogān jvarāṃścaiva mahātiktamidaṃ jayet ||50||
atha kāsīsādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhe dadrūpāmāśira:sphoṭādau - kāsīsaṃ dve niśe mustaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām | kampillakaṃ gandhakaṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 51 ||
sikthakaṃ maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tutthakaṃ gaurasarṣapān | rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāsaṃ raktacandanam || 52 ||
irimedaṃ nimbapatraṃ karañjaṃ sārivāṃ vacām | mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhukaṃ māṃsīṃ śirīṣaṃ lodhrapadmakam ||53||
harītakīṃ prapunnāṭaṃ cūrṇayetkārṣikānpṛthak | tatastaccūrṇamāloḍya triṃśatpalamite ghṛte || 54 ||
sthāpayettāmrapātre ca gharme sapta dināvadhi | asyābhyaṅgena kuṣṭhāni dadrūpāmāvicarcikāḥ || 55 ||
śūkadoṣā visarpāśca visphoṭā vātaraktajāḥ | śira:sphoṭopadaṃśāśca nāḍīduṣṭavraṇāni ca || 56 ||
śotho bhagandaraścaiva lūtāḥ śāmyanti dehinām | śodhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva savarṇakaraṇaṃ ghṛtam || 57 ||

div.ab: atha vraṇe jātyādighṛtaṃ- jatinimbapaṭolaṃ ca dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī | mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ sikthaṃ karañjośīrasārivāḥ || 58 || tutthaṃ va vipacetsamyakvalkairebhirghṛtaṃ budhaḥ | asya lepādvirohanti sūkṣmanāḍīvraṇā api || 59 || marmāśritāḥ kledinaśca gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ |

atha bindughṛtaṃ jalodaravirecanādau- citrakaṃ śaṅkinī pathyā kampillastrivṛtāyugam ||60|| vṛddhadāruśca śamyāko dantī dantīphalaṃ tathā | kośātakī devadālī nīlinī girikarṇikā ||61|| sātalā pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ kaṭukī tathā | hemakṣīrī ca vipacetkalkairebhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ ||62|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ ṣaṭpale tu paladvayam | arkakṣīrasya matimāṃstatsiddhaṃ gulmakuṣṭhahṛt ||63|| hanti śūlamudāvartaṃ śothādhmānaṃ bhagandaram | śamayatyudarāṇyaṣṭau nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā || 64 || godugdhenoṣṭradugdhena kaulatthena śṛtena vā | uṣṇodakena vā pītvā binduvegairviricyate || 65 || etadbindughṛtaṃ nāma nābhilepādviricyate |

ab.seg: atha triphalāghṛtaṃ netraroge timirādau - triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ vāsārasodbhavam || 66 ||
bhṛṅgarājarasaprasthaṃ prasthamātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam | dattvā tatra ghṛtaprasthaṃ kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak || 67 ||
triphalā pippalī drākṣā candanaṃ saindhavaṃ balā | kākolī kṣīrakākolī bhedā maricanāgaram ||68||
śarkarā puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca punarnavā | niśāyugmaṃ ca madhukaṃ sarvairebhirvipācayet || 69 ||
naktāndhyaṃ nakulāndhyaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ pillaṃ tathaiva ca | netrasrāvaṃ ca paṭalaṃ timiraṃ kācakaṃ jayet || 70||
anye'pi praśamaṃ yānti netrarogāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | traiphalaṃ ghṛtametaddhi pāne nasyādiṣūcitam || 71 ||
atha gaurādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vraṇe - dve haridre sthirā mūrvā sārivā candanadvayam | madhuparṇī ca madhukaṃ paḍmakeśarapadmakam || 72 ||
utpalośīramedābhistriphalāpañcavalkalaiḥ | kalkaiḥ karṣamitairetairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet || 73 ||
visarpalūtāvisphoṭaviṣakīṭavraṇāpaham | gaurādyamiti vikhyātaṃ sarpirviṣaharaṃ param || 74 ||

div.ab: atha mayūraghṛtaṃ śirorogādau - balāmadhukarāsnābhirdaśamūlaphalatrikaiḥ | pṛthagdvipalikairebhirdroṇanīreṇa pācayet || 75 || mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitam | pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamam ||76|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetsamyagjīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitaiḥ | tatsiddhaṃ śirasaḥ pīḍāṃ manyāpṛṣṭhagrahaṃ tathā || 77 || arditaṃ karṇanāsākṣijihvāgalarujo jayet | pāne nasye tathābhyaṅge karṇapūreṣu yujyate || 78 || hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu ca śasyate |

atha phalaghṛtaṃ vandhyādoṣe - triphalā madhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī || 79 || viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī mustaṃ viśālā kaṭphalaṃ vacā | dve mede dve ca kākolyau sārive dve priyaṅgukā ||80|| śatapuṣpā hiṅgu rāsnā candanaṃ raktacandanam| jātīpuṣpaṃ tugākṣīrī kamalaṃ śarkarā tathā || 81 || ajamodā ca dantī ca kalkairetaiśca kārṣikaiḥ | jīvadvatsaikavarṇāyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca goḥ kṣipet || 82 || caturguṇena payasā pacedāraṇyagomayaiḥ | sutithau puṣyanakṣatre mṛdbhāṇḍe tāmraje tathā || 83 || tataḥ pibecchubhadine nārī vā puruṣo'thavā | etatsarpirnaraḥ pītvā strīṣu nityaṃ vṛṣāyate || 84 || putrānutpādayeddhīmānvandhyāpi labhate sutam | anāyuṣaṃ vā janayedyā ca sūtā punaḥ sthitā ||85|| putraṃ prāpnoti sā nārī buddhimantaṃ śatāyuṣam | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma bhāradvājena bhāṣitam || 86 || anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ kṣipettatra cikitsakaḥ |

ab.seg: atha laghuphalaghṛtaṃ yoniroge - triphalāṃ dve sahacare guḍūcīṃ sapunarnavām | śukanāsāṃ haridre dve rāsnāṃ medāṃ śatāvarīm ||87||
kalkīkṛtya ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetkṣīre caturguṇe | tatsiddhaṃ pāyayennārīṃ yoniśūlanipīḍitām|| 88 ||
pīḍitā calitā yā ca niḥsṛtā vivṛtā ca yā | pittayoniśca vibhrāntā ṣaṇḍhayoniśca yā smṛtā ||89||
prapadyante hi tāḥ sthānaṃ garbhaṃ gṛhṇanti cāsakṛt | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma yonidoṣaharaṃ param || 90 ||
atha pañcatiktakaṃ ghṛtaṃ viṣamajvarādau - vṛṣanimbāmṛtāvyāghrīpaṭolānāṃ śṛtena ca ||91||
kalkena pakvaṃ sarpistu nihanyādviṣamajvarān | pāṇḍuṃ kuṣṭhaṃ visarpaṃ ca kṛmīnarśāṃsi nāśayet ||92||
lākṣāḍhakaṃ kvāthayitvā jalasya caturāḍhakaiḥ | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā tailaprasthe vinikṣipet || 93 ||
mastvāḍhakaṃ ca godadhnastatraiva viniyojayet | śatapuṣpāmaśvagandhāṃ haridrāṃ devadāru ca || 94 ||
kaṭukīṃ reṇukāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭikām | candanaṃ mustakaṃ rāsnāṃ pṛthakvarṣapramāṇataḥ || 95 ||
cūrṇayettatra nikṣipya sādhayenmṛduvahninā | asyābhyaṅgātpraśāmyanti sarve'pi viṣamajvarāḥ||96||
kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyatrikapṛṣṭhagrahāstathā | vātaṃ pittamapasmāramunmādaṃ yakṣarākṣasān || 97 ||
kaṇḍūṃ śūlaṃ ca daurgandhyaṃ gātrāṇāṃ sphuraṇaṃ jayet | puṣṭagarbhā bhavedasya garbhiṇyamyaṅgato bhṛśam || 98 ||

div.ab: (aṅgāratailamprakṣiptam| )- mūrvā lākṣā haridre dve mañjiṣṭhā sendravāruṇī | bṛhatī saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rāsnā māṃsī śatāvarī ||99 || āranālāḍhake tatra tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet | tailamaṅgārakaṃ nāma sarvajvaravimokṣaṇam ||100|| atha vātarogādau nārāyaṇatailam - aśvagandhāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ pāṭalāṃ bṛhatīdvayam | adaṃṣṭrātibalā nimbaṃ syonākaṃ ca punarnavā || 101|| prasāriṇīmagnimanthaṃ kuryāddaśapalaṃ bhiṣak | caturdroṇe jale paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet ||102|| tailāḍhakena saṃyojya śatāvaryā rasāḍhakam | kṣipettatra ca gokṣīraṃ tailāttasyāccaturguṇam ||103|| śanairvipācayedebhiḥ kalkairdvipalikaiḥ pṛthak | kuṣṭhailācandanabalāmāṃsīśaileyasaindhavaiḥ || 104 || aśvagandhāvacārāsnāśatapuṣpendradārubhiḥ | parṇīcatuṣṭayenaiva tagareṇa ca sādhayet || 105 || tattailaṃ nāvane'bhyaṅge pāne bastau ca yojayet | pakṣāghātaṃ hanustambhaṃ manyāstambhaṃ galagraham ||106|| khallatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca gatibhaṅgaṃ kaṭigraham | gātraśoṣendriyadhvaṃsāvasṛkśukrajvarakṣayān ||107|| annavṛddhiṃ kuraṇḍaṃ ca dantarogaṃ śirograham | pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pāṅgulyaṃ buddhihāniṃ ca gṛdhrasīm ||109|| anyāṃśca viṣamānvātāñjayetsarvāṅgasaṃśrayān | asya prabhāvādvandhyāpi nārī putraṃ prasūyate || 109 || martyo gajo vā turagastailādasmātsukhī bhavet | yathā nārāyaṇo devo duṣṭadaityavināśanaḥ || 110|| tathaiva vātarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ tailamuttamam |

ab.seg: (vāruṇītailaṃ kamparoge) vāruṇyāprakṣiptam | vāruṇī-indravāruṇī auttaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ tu palatrayam | paladvādaśakaṃ tailaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vahnau vipācitam || 111 ||
niṣkatrayaṃ bhaktayuktaṃ sevetāsmādvinaśyati | hastakampa: śiraḥkampaḥ kampo manyāśirābhavaḥ||112||
atha balādyaṃ tailaṃ vātavyādhau - balāmūlakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlaśṛtena ca || 113 ||
kulatthayavakolānāṃ kvāthena payasā tathā | aṣṭāṣṭabhāgayuktena bhāgamekaṃ ca tailataḥ ||114 ||
gaṇena jīvanīyena śatāvaryendradāruṇā | mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhaśaileyatagarāgarusaindhavaiḥ ||115||
vacāpunarnavāmāṃsīsārivādvayapatrakaiḥ | śatapuṣpāśvagandhābhyāmelayā ca vipācayet||116||
garbhārthinīnāṃ nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ kṣīṇaretasām | vyāyāmakṣīṇagātrāṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ ca yujyate ||117||
rājayogyamidaṃ tailaṃ sukhināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | balātailamiti khyātaṃ sarvavātāmayāpaham || 118 ||

div.ab: vātakaphāmayādau prasāriṇītailamāha - prasāriṇīpalaśataṃ jaladroṇena pācayet | pādaśiṣṭaḥ śṛto grāhyastailaṃ dadhi ca tatsamam|| 119|| kāñjikaṃ ca samaṃ tailātkṣīraṃ tailāccaturguṇam | tailāttathāṣṭamāṃśena sarvakalkāni yojayet || 120|| madhukaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaḥ saindhavaṃ vacā | prasāriṇī devadāru rāsnā ca gajapippalī || 121|| bhallātaḥ śatapuṣpā ca māṃsīcaibhirvipācayet | etattailavaraṃ pakvaṃ vātaśleṣmāmayāñjayet || 122 || kaubjaṃ paṅgutvakhañjatve gṛdhrasīmarditaṃ tathā | hanupṛṣṭhaśirogrīvākaṭīstambhaṃ ca nāśayet || 123 || anyāṃśca viṣamānvātānsarvānāśu vyapohati |

ab.seg: atha māṣāditailaṃ vātavikārādau - māṣo yavātasī kṣudrā sarkaṭī ca kuraṇṭakaḥ || 124 ||
gokaṇṭaṣṭuṇṭukaścaiṣāṃ kuryātsaptapalaṃ pṛthak | caturguṇāmbunā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet ||125||
kārpāsāsthīni badaraṃ śaṇabījaṃ kulatthakam | pṛthakcaturdaśapalaṃ caturguṇajale pacet || 126 ||
caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhṇīyātkvāthamuttamam | prasthaikaṃ chāgamāṃsasya catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale ||127||
nikṣipya pācayeddhīmānpādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet | tailaprasthe tata: sarvānkvāthānetānvinikṣipet ||128||
kalkairebhiśca vipacedamṛtākuṣṭhanāgaraiḥ | rāsnāpunarnavairaṇḍaiḥ pippalyā śatapuṣpayā ||129 ||
balāprasāriṇībhyāṃ ca māṃsyā kaṭukayā tathā | pṛthagardhapalairetaiḥ sādhayenmṛduvahninā || 130||
hanyāttailamidaṃ śīghraṃ grīvāstambhāpabāhukau | ardhāṅgaśoṣamākṣepamūrustambhāpatānakau ||121||
śākhākampaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ viśvācīmarditaṃ tathā | māṣādikamidaṃ tailaṃ sarvavātavikāranut || 132 ||

div.ab: atha śatāvarītailaṃ vātādau - śatāvarī balāyugmaṃ parṇyau gandharvahastakaḥ | aśvagandhā śvadaṃṣṭraśca bilvaḥ kāśaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||133|| etān sārdhapalānbhāgānkalkayecca vipācayet | caturguṇena nīreṇa pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || 194 || niyojya tailaprasthe ca kṣīraprasthaṃ vinikṣipet | śatāvarīrasaprasthaṃ jalaprasthaṃ ca yojayet || 135 || śatāvarīdevadārumāṃsītagaracandanam | śatapuṣpā balā kuṣṭhamelā śaileyamutpalam ||136|| ṛddhirmedā ca madhukaṃ kākolī jīvakastathā | eṣā karṣasamaiḥ kalkaistailaṃ gomayavahninā ||137 || pacettanmūrdhatailena naraḥ strīṣu vṛṣāyate | nārī ca labhate putraṃ yoniśūlaṃ ca naśyati ||138|| aṅgaśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ kāmalāṃ pāṇḍutāṃ garam | gṛdhrasīplīhaśoṣāṃśca mehāndaṇḍāpatānakam ||139|| sadāhaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca vātapittagadārditam | asṛgdaraṃ tathādhmānaṃ raktapittaṃ ca naśyati ||140|| śatāvarītailamidaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitam | oum nārāyaṇyai svāhā || uttarābhimukho bhūtvā khanetkhadiraśaṅkunā ||141 || oum sarvavyādhināśinyai svāhā | ityutpāṭanamantraḥ | oum kumārījīvanyai svāhā | iti pānamantraḥ |

kāsīsaṃ lāṅgalī kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhī kṛṣṇā ca saindhavam | manaḥśilāśvamāraśca viḍaṅgaṃ citrako drumaḥ ||142|| dantī kośātakībījaṃ hemāhvā haritālakam | kalkaiḥ karṣamitairetaistailaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||143|| snuhyarkapayasī dadyātpṛthagdvipalasaṃmite | caturguṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ datvā samyakprasādhayet ||144|| kathitaṃ kharanādena tailamarśovināśanam | kṣāravatpātayatyetadarśāṃsyabhyaṅgato bhṛśam ||145|| valīrna dūṣayatyetatkṣārakarmakaraṃ smṛtam ||
atha piṇḍatailaṃ vātarakte - mañjiṣṭhāsārivāsarjayaṣṭīsikthaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 146|| piṇḍākhyaṃ sādhayettailamabhyaṅgādvātaraktanut |
kuṣṭharogādau arkatailam -- arkapatrarase pakvaṃ haridrākalkasaṃyutam || 147 || nāśayetsārṣape tailaṃ pāmāṃ kacchūṃ vicarcikām |

ab.seg: atha maricāditailaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇādau -- maricaṃ haritālaṃ ca trivṛtaṃ raktacandanam || 148 ||
mustaṃ manaḥśilā māṃsī dve niśe devadāru ca | viśālā karavīraṃ ca kuṣṭhamarkapayastathā || 149 ||
tathaiva gomayarasaṃ kuryātkarṣamitānpṛthak | viṣaṃ cārdhapalaṃ deyaṃ prasthaṃ ca kaṭutailakam || 150 ||
gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyājjalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ bhavet | maricādyamidaṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇāpaham || 151 ||
jayetkuṣṭāni sarvāṇi puṇḍarīkaṃ vicarcikām | pāmāṃ śvitrāṇi raktaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ kacchūṃ praṇāśayet || 152||
arūṃṣikāyāṃ triphalāditailam - triphalāriṣṭabhūnimbaṃ dve niśe raktacandanam | etaiḥ siddhamarūṃṣīṇāṃ tailamabhyañjane hitam ||153||

div.ab: atha nimbabījatailaṃ palite - bhāvayennimbabījāni bhṛṅgarājarasena hi | tathāsanasya toyena tattailaṃ hanti nasyataḥ ||154|| akālapalitaṃ sadyaḥ puṃsāṃ dugdhānnabhojinām |
atha yaṣṭīmadhukatailaṃ palite - yaṣṭīmadhukakṣārabhyāṃ‘kṣīrābhyā’miti gūḍhārtha. sammata: pāṭhaḥ | navadhātrīphalaiḥ śṛtam ||155|| tailaṃ nasyakṛtaṃ kuryātkeśāñśmaśrūṇi saṅghaśaḥ |
atha karañjatailam indralupte - karañjaścitrako jātī karavīraśca pācitam || 156|| tailamebhirdrutaṃ hanyādabhyaṅgādindraluptakam |

atha nīlikādyaṃ tailaṃ keśakalpādau - nīlikā ketakīkandaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||157|| tathārjunasya puṣpāṇi bījakātkusumānyapi | kṛṣṇāstilāśca tagaraṃ samūlaṃ kamalaṃ tathā ||158|| ayorajaḥ priyaṅguśca dāḍimatvagguḍūcikā | triphalā padmapaṅkaśca kalkairebhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||159|| karṣamātraiḥ pacettailaṃ triphalākvāthasaṃyutam | bhṛṅgarājarasenaiva siddhaṃ keśasthirīkṛtam ||160|| akālapalitaṃ hanti dāruṇaṃ copajihvikām |

ab.seg: akālapalitādau bhṛṅgarājatailam -- bhṛṅgarājarasenaiva lohakiṭṭaṃ phalatrikam ||161||
sārivāṃ ca pacetkalkaistailaṃ dāruṇanāśanam | akālapalitaṃ kaṇḍūmindraluptaṃ ca nāśayet ||162||

div.ab: irimedādyaṃ tailaṃ mukhadantarogādau - irimedatvacaṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ pacecchatapalonmitām | jaladroṇe tataḥ kvāthaṃ gṛhṇīyātpādaśeṣitam|| 163|| tailasyārdhāḍhakaṃ dattvā kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pacet | irimedalavaṅgābhyāṃ gairikāgarupadmakaiḥ ||164|| mañjiṣṭhālodhramadhukairlākṣānyagrodhamustakaiḥ | tvagjātīphalakarpūrakaṅkolakhadiraistathā ||165|| pataṅgadhātakīpuṣpasūkṣmailānāgakeśaram | kaṭphalena ca saṃsiddhaṃ tailaṃ mukharujaṃ jayet ||166|| praduṣṭamāṃsaṃ palitaṃ śīrṇadantaṃ ca sauṣiram | śyāvadantaṃ praharṣaṃ ca vidradhiṃ kṛmidantakam || 167 || dantasphuraṇadaurgandhyaṃ jihvātālvoṣṭhajāṃ rujam |

jātyāditailam | (jātīprakṣiptam | naktamāla:-karañja: | nimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavāḥ ||168|| sikthaṃ samadhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī | mañjiṣṭhā padmakaṃ lodhramabhayā nīlamutpalam ||169|| tutthakaṃ sārivā bījaṃ naktamālasya dāpayet | etāni samabhāgāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||170|| nāḍīvraṇe samutpanne sphoṭake kacchurogiṣu | sadyaḥ śastraprahāreṣu dagdhaviddheṣu caiva hi ||171|| nakhadantakṣate dehe vraṇe duṣṭe praśasyate |)
atha hiṃgvādyaṃ tailaṃ karṇaśūle - hiṅgutumburuśuṇṭhībhiḥ kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet ||172|| tasya pūraṇamātreṇa karṇaśūlaṃ praṇaśyati |
atha bilvādyaṃ tailaṃ bādhirye - bālabilvāni gomūtre piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||173|| sājakṣīraṃ ca nīraṃ ca bādhiryaṃ hanti pūraṇāt |

atha kṣāratailaṃ karṇarogeṣu - bālamūlakaśuṅgānāṃ kṣāraḥ kṣārayugaṃ tathā || 174 || lavaṇāni ca pañcaiva hiṅgu śigru mahauṣadham | devadāru vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śatapuṣpā rasāñjanam || 175 || granthikaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak | tailaprasthaṃ ca vipacetkadalībījapūrayoḥ || 176 || rasābhyāṃ madhuśuktena cāturguṇyamitena ca | pūyasrāvaṃ karṇanādaṃ śūlaṃ badhiratāṃ kṛmīn || 177 || anyāṃśca karṇajānrogānmukharogāṃśca nāśayet |

ab.seg: kecittu madhuśuktalakṣaṇametasyāgre paṭhanti tadyathā - madhuśuktam | jambīrāṇāṃ phalarasaḥ prasthaikaḥ kuḍavonmitam ||178||
mākṣikaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ palaikā pippalī smṛtā | etadekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mṛdbhāṇḍe ca nidhāpayet ||179||
vacāmbho madhusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṅgaveraguḍānvitam | dhānyarāśau trirātristhaṃ madhuśuktamudāhṛtam ||180||

div.ab: atha pāṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ pīnase - pāṭhā dve ca niśe mūrvā pippalī jātipallavaiḥ||181|| dantyā ca tailaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ nasyaṃ syāhuṣṭapīnase |
atha vyāghrītailaṃ pīnase - vyāghrīdantīvacāśigrutulasīvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ ||182|| kaphasya pācanaṃ tailaṃ pūtināsodakāpaham |
atha kuṣṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ chikvāyāṃ - kuṣṭhaṃ bilvakaṇāśuṇṭhīdrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat || 183|| sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā nasyātkṣavathunāśanam |
gṛhadhūmatailaṃ nāsārśasi - gṛhadhūmakaṇādārukṣāranaktāhvasaindhavaiḥ || 184 || siddhaṃ śikharibījaiśca tailaṃ nāsārśasāṃ hitam |

ab.seg: atha vajrītailaṃ kuṣṭhādau - vajrīkṣīraṃ ravikṣīraṃ dravaṃ dhattūracitrajam || 185 ||
mahiṣīviḍbhavaṃ drāvaṃ sarvāṃśaṃ tilatailakam | pacettailāvaśeṣaṃ ca gomūtre'tha caturguṇe || 186 ||
tailāvaśeṣaṃ paktvā ca tattailaṃ prasthamātrakam | gandhakāgniśilātālaṃ viḍaṅgātiviṣāviṣam ||187||
tiktakośātakīkuṣṭhavacāmāṃsīkaṭutrayam | pītadāru ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ svarjikākṣārajīrakam ||188||
devadāru ca karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇaṃ taile vinikṣipet | vajratailamidaṃ khyātamabhyaṅgātsarvakuṣṭhanut || 189 ||
karavīrāditailam | karavīraśikhādantītrivṛtkośātakīphakṣam | rambhākṣārodake tailaṃ praśastaṃ lomaśātanam ||190||

div.ab: candanāditailam - (candanāmbunakhairyābhyaṃprakṣiptapāṭhā: yaṣṭīśaileyapadmakam | mañjiṣṭhā saralaṃ dāru sevyailaṃ pūtikesaram ||191|| patrakailaṃ murā māṃsī kaṅkolaṃ vanitāmbudam | haridrā sārivā tiktā lavaṅgāgarukuṅkumam || 192|| tvagreṇunalikā ceti tailaṃ mastu caturguṇam | lākṣārasasamaṃ siddhaṃ grahaghnaṃ balavardhanam || 193 || apasmārajvaronmādakṛtyālakṣmīvināśanam | āyuḥpuṣṭikaraṃ caiva vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 194 || viśeṣātkṣayarogaghnaṃ raktapittaharaṃ param|)

ab.seg: vacātailam - (vacāṃprakṣiptapāṭhāḥ śaṭhīṃ haridre dve devadāruhamahauṣadhī ||195||
harītakīmativiṣāmustamaindrayavānsamān | etāndaśapalānbhāgāṃścaturdroṇe'mbhasaḥpacet||196||
cakramardarasaistailaṃ kaṭukaṃ mṛdunā'gninā | pādaśeṣe vinikṣipya sindūramavatārayet ||197||
etattailaṃ nihantyāśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām|) mahauṣadha: śuṇṭhī, kaṭukaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapam ||195-197||

div.ab: lāṅgalītailam | (nirguṇḍīsvarase tailaṃ lāṅgalīlāṅgalī-kalihārī keṣucitpustakeṣvetat pāṭhabhedatrayaṃ dṛśyate | mūlakalkitam ||198|| tailaṃ nasyānnihantyāśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām |)

dhattūratailam - ‘dhattūrarasamādāya hayamārāntikārasam | bhṛṅgarājarasaścaiva sāriṇī nimbapatrakam || 199 || śobhāñjanaścitrakaśca aśvagandhāprasāriṇī | śirīṣaḥ kuṭajo'nantā śālmalī naktapatrakam||200|| ravipriyo mahānimbo ḍiṇḍighoṣā maheraṇā | balā jyotiṣmatī caiva śyāmākaścakramardakaḥ||20 1|| etaistu rasamādāya tailatulyaṃ ca dīyate | devadāru haridre dve māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ sacandanam ||202|| maricaṃ trivṛtā dantī haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | kampillako gandhakaśca khadiraḥ pippalī vacā ||203|| rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāso raktacandanam | irimedastathā tumbī mañjiṣṭhā sinduvārakaḥ ||204|| karavīrajaṭā rāsnā viśvā śreṣṭhā ca pauṣkaram | śaṭhī tālīsapatraṃ ca priyaṅgū reṇukā tathā ||205|| cāturjātakamañjīraṃ kaṅkolaṃ jātipatrikā | jyotiṣmatī ca palikā viṣasya dvipalaṃ bhavet ||206|| āḍhakaṃ kaṭutailasya gomūtraṃ ca caturguṇam | mṛtpātre lohapātre ca śanairmṛdvagninā pacet ||207|| majjāśritaṃ tvaggataṃ ca vātaṃ cāsthigataṃ tathā | ūrugrahaṃ cāḍhyavātaṃ kṛcchraṃ daṇḍāpatānakam ||208|| kubjatvaṃ cātha śothaṃ ca pakṣāghātaṃ tathārditam | hanustambhaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramam ||209|| apasmāraṃ tathonmādaṃ tathācaivā'patantrakam | ākṣepakaṃ cāsthibhagnaṃ sandhibhagnaṃ ca nāśayet||210|| ityapyadhikaḥ pāṭho dṛśyate | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ ghṛtatailakalpanā nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ |

div.head: atha āsavāriṣṭakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | draveṣu cirakālasthaṃ dramyaṃ yatsaṃdhitaṃ bhavet | āsavāriṣṭabhedaistu procyate bheṣajocitam ||1||
yadapakvauṣadhāmbubhyāṃ siddhaṃ madyaṃ sa āsavaḥ | ariṣṭaḥ kvāthasiddhaḥ syāttayormānaṃ jalonmitam ||2||
anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu jalādipramāṇamāha - anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu dravadroṇe tulāṃ guḍam | kṣaudraṃ kṣipedguḍādardhaṃ prakṣepaṃ daśamāṃśikam || 3 ||
atha kvāthabhedena sīdhulakṣaṇamāha - jñeyaḥ śītarasaḥ sīdhurapakvamadhuradravaiḥ | paripakvānnasandhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | siddhaḥ pakvarasaḥ sīdhuḥ saṃpakvamadhuradravaiḥ || 4 ||
atha surāprasannādīnāṃ madyabhedānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - paripakvānnasaṃdhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | surāmaṇḍaḥ prasannā syāttataḥ kādambarī ghanaḥ || 5 ||
tadadho jagalo jñeyo medako jagalāddhanaḥ | vakvaso hṛtasāraḥ syātsurābījaṃ ca kiṇvakam ||6||

div.ab: atha vāruṇīmāha - yattālakharjūrarasaiḥ saṃdhitā sā hi vāruṇī |

atha śuktamāha - kandamūlaphalādīni sasnehalavaṇāni ca || 7 || yatra drave'bhiṣūyante tacchuktamabhidhīyate | vinaṣṭamamlatāṃ yātaṃ madyaṃ vā madhuradravam || 8 || vinaṣṭaḥ saṃdhito yastu taccukramabhidhīyate | guḍāmbunā satailena kandamūlaphalaistathā || 9 || saṃdhitaṃ cāmlatāṃ yātaṃ guḍaśuktaṃ taducyate |

ab.seg: ikṣuśuktam - evamevekṣuśuktaṃ syānmṛdvīkāsaṃbhavaṃ tathā ||10||

div.ab: idānīṃ tuṣāmbukāñjikamapyāha - tuṣāmbu saṃdhitaṃ jñeyamāmairvidalitairyavaiḥ | yavaistu nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ sauvīraṃ saṃdhitaṃ bhavet || 1 1||
atha kāñjikam - kulmāṣadhānyamaṇḍādi saṃdhitaṃ kāñjikaṃ viduḥ |

ab.seg: atha saṇḍākī -- saṇḍākī saṃdhitā jñeyā mūlakaiḥ sārṣapādibhiḥ || 12||

div.ab: atha āsavāḥ - raktapittādau uśīrāsavaḥ - uśīraṃ vālakaṃ padmaṃ kāśmarīṃ nīlamutpalam | priyaṅguṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ dhanvayāsakam ||13 || pāṭhāṃ kirātatiktaṃ ca nyagrodhodumbaraṃ śaṭhīm | parpaṭaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca paṭolaṃ kāñcanārakam || 14 || jambūśālmaliniryāsaṃ pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitān | bhāgānsucūrṇitānkṛtvā drākṣāyāḥ palaviṃśatim||15|| dhātakīṃ ṣoḍaśapalāṃ jaladroṇadvaye kṣipet | śarkarāyāstulāṃ dattvā kṣaudrasyaikatulāṃ tathā || 16 || māsaikaṃ sthāpayedbhāṇḍe māṃsīmaricadhūpite | uśīrāsava ityeṣa raktapittavināśanaḥ || 17 || pāṇḍukuṣṭhapramehārśaḥ kṛmiśothaharastathā |

kumāryāsavaḥ -- (supakvarasasaṃśuddhaṃprakṣiptam | mākṣikaṃ madhu na tu mākṣikadhātu:, pakvalohaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ, cāturjātakaṃ cūrṇādhyāyoktaṃ, kramukaṃ pūgīphalaṃ, phalatrikaṃ harītakyādikaṃ, madhurasā drākṣā|| kumāryāḥ patramāharet || 18 || yatnena rasamādāya pātre pāṣāṇamṛnmaye | droṇe guḍatulāṃ dattvā ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||12 || mākṣikaṃ pakvalohaṃ ca tasminnardhatulāṃ kṣipet | kaṭutrikaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca cāturjātakameva ca || 20|| citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī | cavikaṃ hapuṣā dhānyaṃ kramukaṃ kaṭurohiṇī || 21 || mustā phalatrikaṃ rāsnā devadāru niśādvayam | mūrvā madhurasā dantī mūlaṃ puṣkarasaṃbhavam || 22 || balā cātibalā caiva kapikacchūstrikaṇṭakam| śatapuṣpā hiṅgupatrī ākallakamuṭiṅgaṇam || 23 || punarnavādvayaṃ lodhraṃ dhātumākṣikameva ca | eṣāṃ cārdhapalaṃ dattvā dhātakyāstu palāṣṭakam ||24|| palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ caiva paladvayamudāhṛtam | vapurvayaḥpramāṇena balavarṇāgnidīpanam || 25 || bṛhaṇaṃ rocanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ paṅktiśūlanivāraṇam | aṣṭāvudarajānrogānkṣayamugraṃ ca nāśayet || 26 || viṃśatiṃ mehajānrogānudāvartamapasmṛtim | mūtrakṛcchramapasmāraṃ śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 27 || kṛmijaṃ raktapittaṃ ca nāśayettu na saṃśayaḥ |)

ab.seg: pippalyāsavaḥ kṣayādau | pippalī maricaṃ cavyaṃ haridrā citrako ghanaḥ ||28||
viḍaṅgaṃ kramuko lodhraḥ pāṭhā dhātryelavālukam | uśīraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṅgaṃ tagaraṃ tathā || 29 ||
māṃsī tvagelāpatraṃ ca priyaṅgurnāgakeśaram | eṣāmardhapalānbhāgānsūkṣmacūrṇīkṛtānśubhān ||30||
jaladroṇadvaye kṣiptvā dadyādguḍatulātrayam | palāni daśa dhātakyā drākṣā ṣaṣṭipalā bhavet ||31 ||
etānyekatra saṃyojya mṛdbhāṇḍe ca vinikṣipet | jñātvā''gatarasaṃ tasya pāyayedagnyapekṣayā || 32 ||
kṣayaṃ gulmodaraṃ kārśyaṃ grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gadam | arśāṃsi nāśayecchīghraṃ pippalyādyāsavastvayam||33||
pāṇḍvādau lohāsavaḥ | lohacūrṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ ca yavānikām | viḍaṅgaṃ mustakaṃ citraṃ catuḥsaṃkhyāpalaṃ pṛthak || 34 ||
dhātakīkusumānāṃ tu prakṣipetpalaviṃśatim | cūrṇīkṛtya tataḥ kṣaudraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ kṣipet || 35 ||
dadyādguḍatulāṃ tatra jaladroṇadvayaṃ tathā | ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya nidadhyānmāsamātrakam||36||
lohāsavamamuṃ martyaḥ pibedvahnikaraṃ param | pāṇḍuśvayathugulmāni jaṭharāṇyarśasāṃ rujam || 37 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ plīhāmayaṃ kaṇḍūṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhagandaram | arocakaṃ ca grahaṇīṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca vināśayet || 38 ||

div.ab: mṛdvīkāriṣṭaḥ | (mṛdvīkāyāḥprakṣiptam| tatra mṛdvīkā gostanīṃ, kesaraṃ nāgakesaram| palaśataṃ caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet | droṇaśeṣe suśīte ca pūte tasminpradāpayet || 39 || tule dve kṣaudrakhaṇḍābhyāṃ dhātakyāḥ prasthameva ca | kaṅkolakaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca phalaṃ jātyāstathaiva ca || 40 || palāṃśakaṃ ca maricatvagelāpatrakesaram | pippalī citrakaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlareṇuke || 41 || ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya candanāgarudhūpite | karpūravāsito hyeṣa grahaṇyā dīpanaḥ paraḥ || 42 || arśasāṃ nāśane śreṣṭha udāvartasya gulmanut | jaṭharakrimikuṣṭhāni vraṇāstu vividhāstathā || 43 || akṣirogaśirorogagalarogāṃśca nāśayet |)

athāriṣṭāḥ, tatrādau kuṭajāriṣṭaḥ jvarādau - tulāṃ kuṭajamūlasya mṛdvīkārdhatulāṃ tathā || 44 || madhūkapuṣpakāśmaryabhāgāndaśapalonmitān | caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā kvāthe droṇāvaśeṣite ||45|| dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca tulāṃ kṣipet | māsamātraṃ sthito bhāṇḍe kuṭajāriṣṭasaṃjñitaḥ ||46|| jvarānpraśamayetsarvānkuryāttīkṣṇaṃ dhanañjayam |

ab.seg: atha viḍaṅgāriṣṭaḥ vidradhyādau - viḍaṅgaṃ granthikaṃ rāsnā kuṭajatvakphalāni ca || 47 ||
pāṭhailavālukaṃ dhātrī bhāgānpañcapalānpṛthak | aṣṭadroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā kuryāddroṇāvaśeṣitam ||48||
pūte śīte kṣipettatra kṣaudraṃ palaśatatrayam | dhātakīṃ viṃśatipalāṃ trijātaṃ dvipalaṃ tathā || 49 ||
priyaṅgukāñcanārāṇāṃ salodhrāṇāṃ palaṃ palam | vyoṣasya ca palānyaṣṭau cūrṇīkṛtya pradāpayet ||50||
ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya māsamekaṃ nidhāpayet | tataḥ pibedyathārhaṃ tu jayedvidradhimutthitam || 52||
ūrustambhāśmarīmehānpratyaṣṭhīlābhagandarān | gaṇḍamālāṃ hanustambhaṃ viḍaṅgāriṣṭasaṃjñakam || 53 ||
atha devadārvyādyariṣṭaḥ pramehādau - tulārdhaṃ devadāroḥ syādvāsā ca palaviṃśati: | mañjiṣṭhendrayavā dantī tagaraṃ rajanīdvayam || 53 ||
rāsnā kṛmighnaṃ mustaṃ ca śirīṣaṃ khadirārjunau | bhāgāndaśapalāndadyādyavānyā vatsakasya ca || 54 ||
candanasya guḍūcyāśca rohiṇyāścitrakasya ca | bhāgānaṣṭapalānetānaṣṭadroṇe'mbhasa: pacet ||55||
droṇaśeṣe kaṣāye ca pūte śīte pradāpayet | dhātakyāḥ ṣoḍaśapalaṃ mākṣikasya tulātrayam || 56||
vyoṣasya dvipalaṃ dadyāttrijātasya catuṣpalam | catuṣpalaṃ priyaṅgośca dvipalaṃ nāgakeśaram || 57 ||
sarvāṇyetani saṃcūrṇya ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet | māsādūrdhvaṃ pibedenaṃ pramehaṃ hanti durjayam || 458 ||
vātarogāngrahaṇyarśomūtrakṛcchrāṇi nāśayet | devadārvādiko'riṣṭaḥ kaṇḍūkuṣṭhavināśanaḥ’dadrukuṣṭhanivāraṇaḥ pāya- || 59 ||
atha khadirāriṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhādau - khadirasya tulārdhaṃ tu devadāru ca tatsamam | bākucī dvādaśapalā dārvī syātpalaviṃśatiḥ || 60 ||
triphalā viṃśatipalā hyaṣṭadroṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet | kaṣāye droṇaśeṣe ca pūte śīte vinikṣipet || 61 ||
tulādvayaṃ mākṣikasya tulaikā śarkarā matā | dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ kaṅkolaṃ nāgakeśaram || 62 ||
jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgailātvakpatrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak | palonmitāni kṛṣṇāyā dadyātpalacatuṣṭayam || 63 ||
ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya māsādūrdhvaṃ pibennaraḥ | mahākuṣṭhāni hṛdrogaṃ pāṇḍurogārbude tathā || 64 ||
gulmaṃ granthiṃ kṛmīnkāsaṃ śvāsaṃ plīhodaraṃ jayet | eṣa vai khadirāriṣṭaḥ sarvakuṣṭhanivāraṇaḥ ||65||

div.ab: atha babbūlāriṣṭaḥ kṣayakāsādau -- tulādvayaṃ tu babbūlyāścaturdroṇe jale pacet | droṇaśeṣe rase śīte guḍasya ca tulāṃ kṣipet ||66|| dhātakīṃ ṣoḍaśapalāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca dvipalāṃ tathā | jātīphalāni kaṅkolamelātvakpatrakeśaram || 67 || lavaṅgaṃ maricaṃ caiva palikānyupakalpayet | māsaṃ bhāṇḍe sthitastveṣa babbūlāriṣṭako jayet|| 68|| kṣayaṃ kuṣṭhamatīsāraṃ pramehaśvāsakāsakam |

atha drākṣāriṣṭaḥ puṣṭyādau - drākṣātulārdhaṃ dvidroṇe jalasya vipacetsudhīḥ || 69 || pādaśeṣe kaṣāye ca pūte śīte vinikṣipet | guḍasya dvitulāṃ tatra tvagelāpatrakeśaram || 70 || priyaṅgurmaricaṃ kṛṣṇā viḍaṅgaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | pṛthakpalonmitairbhāgaistato bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||71|| samantato ghaṭṭayitvā pibejjātarasaṃ tataḥ | uraḥkṣataṃ kṣayaṃ hanti kāsaśvāsagalāmayān || 72 || drākṣāriṣṭāhvayaḥ prokto balakṛnmalaśodhanaḥ |

atha rohitakāriṣṭaḥ gudajagrahaṇyādau - rohitakatulāmekāṃ caturdroṇe jale pacet || 73 || pādaśeṣe rase śīte pūte palaśatadvayam | dadyādguḍasya dhātakyāḥ palaṣoḍaśikaṃ matam || 74 || pañcakolaṃ trijātaṃ ca triphalāṃ ca vinikṣipet | cūrṇayitvā palāṃśena tato bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||75|| māsādūrdhvaṃ ca pibatāṃ gudajā yānti sakṣayam | grahaṇīpāṇḍuhṛdrogaplīhagulmodarāṇi ca || 76 || kuṣṭhaśophāruciharo rohitāriṣṭasaṃjñakaḥ |

atha daśamūlāriṣṭaḥ vātādau - (parṇyau bṛhatyau gokaṇṭo bilvo'gnimanthako'raluḥ || 77 || pāṭhalā kāśmarī ceti daśamūlamihocyate |) daśamūlāni kurvīta bhāgaiḥ pañcapalaiḥ pṛthak || 78 || pañcaviṃśatpalaṃ kuryāccitrakaṃ pauṣkaraṃ tathā | kuryādviṃśatpalaṃ lodhraṃ guḍūcī tatsamā bhavet ||79 || palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdhātrī ravisaṃkhyairdurālabhā | khadiro bījasāraśca pathyā ceti pṛthakpalaiḥ || 80 || aṣṭabhirgaṇitaiḥ kuṣṭhaṃ mañjiṣṭhā devadāru ca | viḍaṅgaṃ madhukaṃ bhārgī kapittho'kṣaḥ punarnavā || 81 || cavyaṃ māṃsī priyaṅguśca sārivā kṛṣṇajīrakam | trivṛtā reṇukaṃ rāsnā pippalī kramukaḥ śaṭhī ||82 || haridrā śatapuṣpā ca padmakaṃ nāgakeśaram | mustamindrayavaḥ śuṇṭhī jīvakarṣabhakau tathā ||83|| medā cānyā mahāmedā kākolyau ṛddhivṛddhike | kuryātpṛthagvipalikānpacedaṣṭaguṇe jale || 84 || caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā mṛdbhāṇḍe saṃnidhāpayet | tataḥ ṣaṣṭipalāṃ drākṣāṃ pacennīre caturguṇe || 85 || tripādaśeṣaṃ śītaṃ ca pūrvakvāthe śṛtaṃ kṣipet | dvātriṃśatpalikaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyādguḍacatuḥśatam || 364 || triṃśatpalāni dhātakyāḥ kaṅkolaṃ jalacandanam | jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca tvagelāpatrakeśaram || 87 || pippalī ceti saṃcūrṇya bhāgairdvipalikaiḥ pṛthak | śāṇamātrāṃ ca kastūrīṃ sarvamekatra nikṣipet ||88|| bhūmau nikhātayedbhāṇḍaṃ tato jātarasaṃ pibet | katakasya phalaṃ kṣiptvā rasaṃ nirmalatāṃ nayet ||89|| grahaṇīmaruciṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ gulmaṃ bhagandaram | vātavyādhiṃ kṣayaṃ chardiṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca kāmalām ||90|| kuṣṭhānyarśāṃsi mehāṃśca mandāgnimudarāṇi ca | śarkarāmaśmarīṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ dhātukṣayaṃ jayet || 91 || kṛśānāṃ puṣṭijanano vandhyānāṃ garbhadaḥ paraḥ | ariṣṭo daśamūlākhyastejaḥśukrabalapradaḥ ||92|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe āsavāriṣṭakalpanā nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha dhātuśodhanamāraṇakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | athedānīṃ dhātūnāṃ samudāyena śodhanamāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - svarṇatārāratāmrāṇi nāgavaṅgau ca tīkṣṇakam | dhātavaḥ sapta vijñeyāstatastān śodhayedbudhaḥ ||1||
idānīṃ tacchodhanamāraṇamāha -- svarṇatārāratāmrāyaḥpatrāṇyagnau pratāpayet| | niṣiñcettaptataptāni taile takre ca kāñjike || 2 ||
gomūtre ca kulatthānāṃ kaṣāye ca tridhā tridhā | evaṃ svarṇādilohānāṃ viśuddhiḥ saṃprajāyate || 3 ||
nāgavaṅgau prataptau ca gālitau tau niṣiṃcayet | tridhā tridhā viśuddhiḥ syādravidugdhena ca tridhā ||4||

div.ab: atha svarṇamāraṇam -- svarṇāñca dviguṇaṃ sūtamamlena saha mardayet | tadgolakasamaṃ gandhaṃ nidadhyādadharottaram || 5 || golakaṃ ca tato rundhyāccharāvadṛḍhasaṃpuṭe | triṃśadvanopalairdadyātpuṭānyevaṃ caturdaśa ||6 || nirutthaṃ jāyate bhasma gandho deyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |

ab.seg: athāparo vidhiḥ- kāñcane gālite nāgaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśena nikṣipet || 7 ||
cūrṇayitvā tathāmlena ghṛṣṭvā kṛtvā ca golakam | golakena samaṃ gandhaṃ dattvā caivādharottaram || 8 ||
śarāvasaṃpuṭe dhṛtvā puṭet triṃśadvanopalaiḥ | evaṃ saptapuṭairhema nirūtthaṃ bhasma jāyate || 9 ||
anyacca svarṇamāraṇamāha - kāñcanārarasairghṛṣṭvā samasūtakagandhayoḥ | kajjalyā hemapatrāṇi lepayetsamamātrayā || 10 ||
kāñcanāratvacaḥ kalkairmūṣāyugmaṃ prakalpayet | dhṛtvā tatsaṃpuṭe golaṃ mṛnmūṣāsaṃpuṭe pacet || 11 ||
nidhāya saṃdhirodhaṃ ca kṛtvā saṃśoṣya kokilaiḥ | vahniṃ kharataraṃ kuryādevaṃ dadyātpuṭatrayam || 12 ||
nirutthaṃ jāyate bhasma sarvakāryeṣu yojayet | kāñcanāraprakāreṇa lāṅgalī hanti kāñcanam || 13 ||
jvālāmukhī yathā hanyāttathā hanti manaḥśilā | athānyadapi svarṇamāraṇaprakāramāha - śilāsindūrayoścūrṇaṃ samayorarkadugdhakaiḥ ||14||
saptaiva bhāvanā dadyācchoṣayecca punaḥ punaḥ | tatastu gālite hemni kalko'yaṃ dīyate samaḥ || 15||
punardhamedatitarāṃ yathā kalko vilīyate | evaṃ velātrayaṃkṣāratrayaṃ iti pā. | dadyātkalkaṃ hemamṛtirbhavet || 16 ||
athānyaprakāramāha - pārāvatamalairlimpedathavā kukkuṭodbhavaiḥ | hemapatrāṇi teṣāṃ ca pradadyādantarāntaram ||17 ||
gandhacūrṇaṃ samaṃ dhṛtvā śarāvayugmasaṃpuṭe | pradadyātkukkuṭapuṭaṃ pañcabhirgomayopalaiḥ || 18 ||
evaṃ navapuṭāndadyāddaśamaṃ ca mahāpuṭam | triṃśadvanopalairdeyaṃ jāyate hemabhasmakam || 19 ||
(suvarṇaṃkecidimaṃ na paṭhanti | ca bhavetsvādu tiktaṃ snigdhaṃ himaṃ guru | buddhividyāsmṛtikaraṃ viṣahāri rasāyanam || 20 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ raupyamāraṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - bhāgaikaṃ tālakaṃ mardyaṃ jambenāmlena kenacit | tena bhāgatrayaṃ tārapatrāṇi parilepayet || 21 || dhṛtvā mūṣāpuṭe ruddhvā puṭet triṃśadvanopalaiḥ | samuddhṛtya punastālaṃ dattvā ruddhvā puṭe pacet || 22 || evaṃ caturdaśapuṭaistāraṃ bhasma prajāyate |

ab.seg: aparamapi tāramāraṇamāha - snuhīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ mākṣikaṃ tena lepayet || 23 ||
tālakasya prakāreṇa tārapatrāṇi buddhimān | puṭeccaturdaśapuṭaistāraṃ bhasma prajāyate ||24 ||

div.ab: pītalohamāraṇamāha - arkakṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭo gandhakastena lepayet | samenārasya patrāṇi śuddhānyamladravairmuhuḥ || 25 || tato mūṣāpuṭe dhṛtvā puṭedgajapuṭena ca | evaṃ puṭadvayenaiva bhasmāraṃ bhavati dhruvam || 26 || āravatkāṃsyamapyevaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti niścitam | aparamapyāha - arkakṣīravadājaṃarkakṣīraṃ vaṭakṣīraṃ nirguṇḍī kṣīrikā tathā i. pā. | syātkṣīranirguṇḍikā tathā || 27 || tāmrarītidhvanivadhe samagandhakayogataḥ |

ab.seg: samprati tāmramāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - sūkṣmāṇi tāmrapatrāṇi kṛtvā saṃsvedayedbudhaḥ | vāsaratrayamamlena tataḥ khalve vinikṣipet || 28 ||
pādāṃśaṃ sūtakaṃ dattvā yāmamamlena mardayet | tata uddhṛtya patrāṇi lepayeddviguṇena ca || 29 ||
gandhakenāmlaghṛṣṭena tasya kuryācca golakam | tataḥ ṣiṣṭvā ca mīnākṣīṃ cāṅgerīṃ vā punarnavām ||30||
tatkalkena bahirgolaṃ lepayedaṅgulonmitam | dhṛtvā tadgolakaṃ bhāṇḍe śarāveṇa ca rodhayet ||31||
vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha vibhūtilavaṇāmbubhiḥ | dattvā bhāṇḍamukhe mudrāṃ tataścullyāṃ vipācayet||32||
kramavṛddhāgninā samyagyāvadyāmacatuṣṭayam | svāṅgaśītalamuddhṛtya mardayetsūraṇadravaiḥ || 33 ||
dinaikaṃ golakaṃ kuryādardhagandhena lepayet | saghṛtena tato mūṣāṃ puṭe gajapuṭe pacet || 34 ||
sāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | vāntiṃ bhrāntiṃ klamaṃ mūrcchāṃ na karoti kadācana ||35||

div.ab: atha sīsakamāraṇamāha - tāmbūlīrasasaṃpiṣṭaśilālepātpunaḥ punaḥ || 36 || dvātriṃśadbhiḥ puṭairnāgo niruttho yāti bhasmatām |

aśvatthaciñcātvakcūrṇaṃ caturthāṃśena nikṣipet || 37 || mṛtpātre drāvite nāge lohadarvyā pracālayet | yāmaikena bhavedbhasma tattulyāṃ ca manaḥśilām ||38|| kāñjikena dvayaṃ piṣṭvā pacedṛḍhapuṭena ca | svāṅgaśītaṃ punaḥ piṣṭvā śilayā kāñjikena ca ||39|| punaḥ puṭeccharāvābhyāmevaṃ ṣaṣṭipuṭairmṛtiḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ vaṅgamāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - mṛtpātre drāvite baṅge ciñcāśvatthatvaco rajaḥ || 40 ||
kṣiptvā kṣiptvā caturthāṃśamayodarvyā pracālayet | tato dviyāmamātreṇa vaṅgabhasma prajāyate || 41 ||
atha bhasmasamaṃ tālaṃ kṣiptvāmlena pramardayet | tato gajapuṭe paktvā punaramlena mardayet || 42 ||
tālena daśamāṃśena yāmamekaṃ tataḥ puṭet | evaṃ daśapuṭaiḥ pakvo vaṅgastu mriyate dhruvam || 43 ||
atha lohamāraṇamāha - śuddhaṃ lohabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ pātālagaruḍīrasaiḥ | mardayitvā puṭedvahnau dadyādevaṃ puṭatrayam || 44 ||
puṭatrayaṃ kumāryā ca kuṭhārakulattharasaiḥ | puṭaṣaṭkaṃ tato dadyādevaṃ tīkṣṇamṛtirbhavet || 45 ||

div.ab: anyaccetyaparamapi māraṇamāha - kṣipedvā daśamāṃśena daradaṃ tīkṣṇacūrṇataḥ | mardayetkanyakādrāvairyāmayugmaṃ tataḥ puṭet || 46 || evaṃ saptapuṭairmṛtyuṃ lohacūrṇamavāpnuyāt | rasaiḥ kuṭhāracchinnāyāḥ pātālagaruḍīrasaiḥ ||47 || stanyena cārkadugdhena tīkṣṇasyaivaṃ mṛtirbhavet |
