anyadapi māraṇamāha - sūtakāddviguṇaṃ gandhaṃ dattvā kuryācca kajjalīm ||48|| dvayoḥ samaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ mardayetkanyakādravaiḥ | yāmayugmaṃ tataḥ piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tāmrasya pātrake ||49|| gharme dhṛtvā rubūkasya patrairācchādayedbudhaḥ | yāmārdhenoṣṇatāṃ bhūyāddhānyarāśau nyasettataḥ ||50|| dattvopari śarāvaṃ tu tridinānte samuddharet | piṣṭvā ca gālayedvastrādevaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet || 51 || evaṃ sarvāṇi lohāni svarṇādīnyapi mārayet | śilāgandhārkadugdhāktāḥ svarṇādyāḥ sarvadhātavaḥ||52|| mriyante dvādaśapuṭaiḥ satyaṃ guruvaco yathā |
athopadhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ, te ke upadhātavaḥ ? iti darśayannāha - mākṣikaṃ tutthakābhre ca nīlāñjanaśilālakāḥ ||53|| rasakaśceti vijñeyā ete saptopadhātavaḥ |

atha mākṣikaśodhanamāraṇam - mākṣikasya trayo bhāgā bhāgaikaṃ saindhavasya ca ||54|| mātuluṅgadravairvātha jambīrotthadravaiḥ pacet | cālayellohaje pātre yāvatpātraṃ tu lohitam ||55|| bhavettatastu saṃśuddhiṃ svarṇamākṣikamṛcchati | kulatthasya kaṣāyeṇa ghṛṣṭvā tailena vā puṭet || 56 || takreṇa vājamūtreṇa mriyate svarṇamākṣikam | karkoṭīmeṣaśṛṅgyutthairdravairjambīrajairdinam || 57 || bhāvayedātape tīvre vimalā śudhyati dhruvam |

ab.seg: atha tutthakaśodhanamāha -- viṣṭhayā mardayettutthaṃ mārjārakakapotayoḥ || 58 | daśāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dattvā pacenmṛdupuṭena tu | puṭaṃ dadhnā puṭaṃ kṣaudrairdeyaṃ tutthaviśuddhaye || 59 ||

div.ab: athābhrakaśodhanam - kṛṣṇābhrakaṃ dhamedvahnau tataḥ kṣīre vinikṣipet | bhinnapatraṃ tu tatkṛtvā taṇḍulīyāmlayordravaiḥ ||60| bhāvayedaṣṭayāmaṃ tadevaṃ śuddhyati cābhrakam |

atha māraṇam | kṛtvā dhānyābhrakaṃ tattu śoṣayitvātha mardayet || 61|| arkakṣīrairdinaṃ khalve cakrākāraṃ ca kārayet | veṣṭayedarkapatraiśca samyaggajapuṭe pacet || 62 || punarmardyaṃ punaḥ pācyaṃ saptavāraṃ prayatnataḥ | tato vaṭajaṭākvāthaistadvaddeyaṃ puṭatrayam || 63|| mriyate nātra saṃdehaḥ sarvayogeṣu yojayet | tulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ mṛtābhreṇa lohapātre vipācayet || 64 || ghṛte jīrṇe tadabhraṃ tu sarvayogeṣu yojayet | mṛtaṃ tvabhraṃ harenmṛtyuṃ jarāpalitanāśanam || 65 || anupānaiśca saṃyuktaṃ tattadrogaharaṃ param |

athānyaprakāro'bhrakamāraṇasya tamapi vyācaṣṭe - śuddhaṃ dhānyābhrakaṃ mustaṃ śuṇṭhīṣaḍbhāgayojitam||66|| mardayetkāñjikenaiva dinaṃ citrakajai rasaiḥ | tato gajapuṭaṃ dadyāttasmāduddhṛtya mardayet || 67 || triphalāvāriṇā tadvatpuṭedevaṃ puṭaistribhiḥ | balāgomūtramusalītulasīsūraṇadravaiḥ || 68 || marditaṃ puṭitaṃ vahnau tritrivelaṃ vrajenmṛtim |
abhrasatvaprakāraḥ |kṣepakamidam| dhānyābhrakasya bhāgaikaṃ dvau bhāgau ṭaṅkaṇasya na | piṣṭvā tadandhamūṣāyāṃ ruddhvā tīvrāgninā pacet ||69|| svabhāvaśītalaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvayogeṣu yojayet |

atha nīlāñjanam - nīlāñjanaṃ cūrṇayitvā jambīradravabhāvitam || 70 || dinaikamātape śuddhaṃ bhavetkāryeṣu yojayet | evaṃ gairikakāsīsaṭaṅkaṇāni varāṭikā || 71|| taurī śaṅkhaṃ ca kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ śuddhimāyāti niścitam |
atha manaḥśilāśodhanam -- pacettryahamajāmūtrairdolāyantre manaḥśilām || 72 || bhāvayetsaptadhā pittairajāyāḥ śuddhimṛcchati |

atha tālakaśuddhiḥ - tālakaṃ kaṇaśaḥ kṛtvā sacūrṇaṃ kāñjike kṣipet ||73|| dolāyantreṇa yāmaikaṃ tataḥ kūṣmāṇḍajairdravai | tilataile pacedyāmaṃ yāmaṃ ca triphalājalaiḥ || 74 || evaṃ yantre caturyāmaṃ pācyaṃ śudhyati tālakam |
atha rasakaśuddhiḥ -- naramūtraiśca gomūtraiḥ saptāhaṃ rasakaṃ pacet || 75 || dolāyantreṇa śuddhiḥ syāttataḥ kāryeṣu yojayet |

ab.seg: athedānīṃ samudāyena sattvanirgamaṃ prakaṭayannāha - lākṣā mīnā payaśchāgaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ mṛgaśṛṅgakam ||76||
piṇyākaṃ sarṣapāḥ śigrurguñjorṇāguḍasaindhavāḥ | yavāstiktā ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ yathālābhaṃ vicūrṇayet ||77||
ebhirvimiśritāḥ sarve dhātavo gāḍhavahninā | mūṣādhmātāḥ prajāyante muktasatvā na saṃśayaḥ ||78||

div.ab: atha ratnānāṃ śodhanamāraṇam - kulatthakodravakvāthairdolāyantre vipācayet | vyāghrīkandagataṃ vajraṃ tridinaṃ tadviśudhyati || 79 || taptaṃ taptaṃ tu tadvajraṃ kharamūtrairniṣecayet | punastapyaṃ punaḥ secyamevaṃ kuryāttrisaptadhā || 80 || matkuṇaistālakaṃ piṣṭvā yāvadbhavati golakam | tadgole nihitaṃ vajraṃ tadgolaṃ vahninā dhamet || 81 || siñcayedaśvamūtreṇa tadgole ca kṣipetpunaḥ | ruddhvā dhmātaṃ punaḥ secyamevaṃ kuryāttrisaptadhā ||82|| evaṃ ca mriyate vajraṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatra yojayet |

ab.seg: athānyadapi vajramāraṇamāhvajrakamṛtirnaiva sugamā | kharadaṃṣṭrāmadhye bhavatyeva iti kecana | - hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyukte kvāthe kaulatthaje kṣipet || 83 ||
taptaṃ taptaṃ punarvajraṃ bhūryāccūrṇaṃ trisaptadhā | aparamapi vajramāraṇamāha - maṇḍūkaṃ kāṃsyaje pātre nigṛhya sthāpayetsudhīḥ ||84||
sa bhīto mūtrayettatra tanmūtre vajramāvapet | taptaṃ taptaṃ ca bahudhā vajrasyaivaṃ mṛtirbhavet || 85 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ vaikrāntamāraṇamāha - vaikrāntaṃ vajravacchodhyaṃ nīlaṃ vā lohitaṃ tathā | hayamūtreṇa tatsecyaṃ taptaṃ taptaṃ dvisaptadhā || 86 || tatastu meṣadugdhasya pañcāṅge golakaṃ kṣipet | puṭenmūṣāpuṭe ruddhvā kuryādevaṃ ca saptadhā || 87 || vaikrāntaṃ bhasmatāṃ yāti vajrasthāne niyojayet |

idānīṃ śeṣaratnaśodhanamāraṇamapyāha -- svedayeddolikāyantre jayantyāḥ svarasena ca || 88 || maṇimuktāpravālāni yāmaikaṃ śodhanaṃ bhavet | kumāryāstaṇḍulīyena stanyena ca niṣecayet ||89|| pratyekaṃ saptavelaṃ ca taptataptāni kṛtsnaśaḥ | mauktikāni pravālāni tathā ratnānyaśeṣataḥ || 90 || kṣaṇādvividhavarṇāni mriyante nātra saṃśayaḥ | uktamākṣikavanmuktāḥ pravālāni ca mārayet ||91|| vajravatsarvaratnāni śodhayenmārayettathā |

ab.seg: athedānīṃ śilājatuśodhanaprakāraṃ darśayannāha -- śilājatu samānīya grīṣmataptaśilācyutam ||92||
godugdhaistriphalākvāthairbhṛṅgadrāvaiśca mardayet | ātape dinamekaikaṃ tacchuddhaṃ śuddhatāṃ vrajet || 93 ||

div.ab: athānyakaraṇaprakāramāha -- mukhyāṃ śilājatuśilāṃ sūkṣmakhaṇḍaprakalpitām | nikṣipyātyuṣṇapānīye yāmaikaṃ sthāpayetsudhīḥ || 94 || mardayitvā tato nīraṃ gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam | sthāpayitvā ca mṛtpātre dhārayedātape budhaḥ || 95 || uparisthaṃ dhanaṃ yatsyāttatkṣipedanyapātrake | dhārayedātape tasmāduparisthaṃ ghanaṃ nayet || 96 || evaṃ punaḥ punarnītvā dvimāsābhyāṃ śilājatu | bhūyātkāryakṣamaṃ vahnau kṣiptaṃ liṅgopamaṃ bhavet || 97 || nirdhūmaṃ ca tataḥ śuddhaṃ sarvakarmasu yojayet | adhaḥsthitaṃ ca yaccheṣaṃ tasminnīraṃ vinikṣipet || 98 || vimardya dhārayeddharme pūrvavaccaiva tannayet |

atha maṇḍūrakaraṇam - akṣāṅgārairdhametkiṭṭaṃ lohajaṃ tadgavāṃ jalaiḥ || 99 || secayettaptataptaṃ ca saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | cūrṇayitvā tataḥ kvāthairdviguṇaistriphalābhavai: ||100|| āloḍya bharjayedvahnau maṇḍūraṃ jāyate varam |

atha kṣārakalpanāṃ darśayitumāha -- kṣīravṛkṣasya kāṣṭhāni śuṣkāṇyagnau pradīpayet || 101|| nītvā tadbhasma mṛtpātre kṣiptvā nīre caturguṇe | vimardya dhārayedrātrau prātaracchaṃ jalaṃ nayet || 102 || tannīraṃ kvāthayedvahnau yāvatsarvaṃ viśuṣyati | tataḥ pātrātsamullikhya kṣāro grāhyaḥ sitaprabhaḥ || 103|| cūrṇābhaḥ pratisāryaḥ syātpeyaḥ syātkvāthavatsthitaḥ | iti kṣāradvayaṃ dhīmānyuktakāryeṣu yojayet || 104 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracittāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe dhātuśodhanamāraṇaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha rasakalpanādhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ athedānīṃ rasapraśaṃsāpūrvakaṃ tacchodhanamāraṇādikamāha - pāradaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ jetā puṣṭikaraḥ smṛtaḥ | sudine‘sujñena’ gū.dī. sammata: | sādhitaḥ kuryātsaṃsiddhiṃ dehalohayoḥ || 1||
idānīṃ rasarājasya paryāyanāmānyāha - rasendraḥ pāradaḥ sūto harajaḥ sūtako rasaḥ | budhaistasyeti‘mukundaśce’ti gū.dī. sammata: | nāmani jñeyāni rasakarmasu || 2 ||

div.ab: tāmratārāranāgāśca hemavaṅgau ca tīkṣṇakam | kāṃsyakaṃ kāntalohaṃ ca dhātavo nava ye smṛtāḥ ||3|| sūryādīnāṃ grahāṇāṃ te kathitā nāmabhiḥ kramāt |

idānīṃ rasaśodhanakarmāha - rājīrasonamūṣāyāṃ rasaṃ kṣiptvā vibandhayet || 4 || vastreṇa dolikāyantre svedayetkāñjikaistryaham | dinaikaṃ mardayetsūtaṃ kumārīsaṃbhavairdravaiḥ || 5 || tathā citrakajaiḥ kvāthairmardayedekavāsaram | kākamācīrasaistadvaddinamekaṃ ca mardayet || 6 || triphalāyāstathā kvāthai raso mardyaḥ prayatnataḥ | tatastebhyaḥ pṛthakkuryātsūtaṃ prakṣālya kāñjikaiḥ || 7 || tataḥ kṣiptvā rasaṃ khalve rasādardhaṃ ca saindhavam | mardayennimbukarasairdinamekamanāratam || 8 || tato rājī rasonaśca mukhyaśca navasādaraḥ | etai rasasamaistadvatsūto mardyastuṣāmbunā || 9 || tataḥ saṃśoṣya cakrābhaṃ kṛtvā liptvā ca hiṅgunā | dvisthālīsaṃpuṭe dhṛtvā pūrayellavaṇena ca || 10 || adhaḥ sthālīṃ tato mudrāṃ dadyādṛḍhatarāṃ budhaḥ | viśoṣyāgniṃ vidhāyādho niṣiñcedambunopari || 11 || tatastu kuryāttīvrāgniṃ tadadhaḥ praharatrayam | evaṃ nipātayedūrdhvaṃ raso doṣavivarjitaḥ || 12 || athordhvapiṭharīmadhye lagno grāhyo rasottamaḥ |

atha gandhakaśodhanam - lohapātre vinikṣipya ghṛtamagnau pratāpayet || 13 || tapte ghṛte tatsamānaṃ kṣipedgandhakajaṃ rajaḥ | vidrutaṃ gandhakaṃ jñātvā dugdhamadhye vini:kṣipet || 14|| evaṃ gandhakaśuddhiḥ syātsarvakāryeṣu yojayet |
idānīṃ daradaśodhanamapyāha - meṣīkṣīreṇa daradamamlavargaiśca bhāvitam || 15 || saptavāraṃ prayatnena śuddhimāyāti niścitam |

ab.seg: atha daradādrasākṛṣṭirbhavati tāmapi darśayannāha - nimbūrasairnimbapatrarasairvā yāmamātrakam || 16 ||
piṣṭvā daradamūrdhvaṃ ca pātayetsūtayuktivat | tataḥ śuddharasaṃ tasmānnītvā kāryeṣu yojayet ||17 ||

div.ab: athoddhṛtasya sukhakaraṇam - kālakūṭo vatsanābhaḥ śṛṅgakaśca pradīpaka: | hālāhalo brahmaputro hāridraḥ saktukastathā ||18 || saurāṣṭrika iti proktā viṣabhedā amī nava | arkasehuṇḍadhattūralāṅgalīkaravīrakam || 19 || guñjāhiphenāvityetāḥ saptopaviṣajātayaḥ | etairvimarditaḥ sūtaśchinnapakṣaḥ prajāyate || 20|| mukhaṃ ca jāyate tasya dhātūṃśca grasate kṣaṇāt |

ab.seg: anyadapi mukhakaraṇamāha - athavā kaṭukakṣārau rājī lavaṇapañcakam || 21 ||
rasono navasāraśca śigruścaikatra cūrṇitaiḥ | samāṃśaiḥ pāradādetairjambīreṇa draveṇa vā || 22 ||
nimbutoyaiḥ kāñjikairvā soṣṇakhalve vimardayet | ahorātratrayeṇa syādrase dhātucaraṃ mukham || 23 ||
aparamapi mukhakaraṃ darśayitumāha - athavā bindulīkīṭai raso mardyastrivāsaram | lavaṇāmlairmukhaṃ tasya jāyate dhātuhṛttvarā‘dhātughasmaraṃ’ gū. dī. sammataḥ | || 24 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ gandhakajāraṇanimittaṃ karma darśayannāha - atha kacchapayantreṇa gandhajāraṇamucyate | mṛtkuṇḍe nikṣipettoyaṃ tanmadhye ca śarāvakam||25|| mahatkuṇḍapidhānābhaṃ madhye mekhalayā yutam | liptvā ca mekhalāmadhyaṃ cūrṇenātra rasaṃ kṣipet||2 6|| rasasyopari gandhasya rajo dadyātsamāṃśakam | dattvopari śarāvaṃ ca bhasmamudrāṃ pradāpayet || 27 || tasyopari puṭaṃ dadyāccaturbhirgomayopalaiḥ | evaṃ punaḥ punargandhaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ jārayedbudhaḥ || 28 || gandhe jīrṇe bhavetsūtastīkṣṇāgniḥ sarvakarmasu |

ab.seg: atha pāradamāraṇam - dhūmasāraṃ rasaṃ torīṃ gandhakaṃ navasādaram || 29 ||
yāmaikaṃ mardayedamlairbhāgaṃ kṛtvā samāṃśakam | kācakupyāṃ vinikṣipya tāṃ ca mṛdvastramudrayā ||30||
vilipya parito vakre mudrāṃ dattvā ca śoṣayet | adhaḥsacchidrapiṭharīmadhye kūpīṃ niveśayet || 31 ||
piṭharīṃ vālukāpūrairbhṛtvā cākūpikāgalam | niveśya cullyāṃ tadadhaḥ kuryādvahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||32||
tasmādapyadhikaṃ kiṃcitpāvakaṃ jvālayetkramāt | evaṃ dvādaśabhiryāmairmriyate sūtakottamaḥ || 33 ||
sphoṭayetsvāṅgaśītaṃ tamūrdhvagaṃ gandhakaṃ tyajet | adhaḥsthaṃ mṛtasūtaṃ ca sarvakarmasu yojayet || 34 ||

div.ab: anyadapi rasamāraṇamāha - apāmārgasya bījānāṃ mūṣāyugmaṃ prakalpayet | tatsaṃpuṭe nyasetsūtaṃ malayūdugdhamiśritam || 35 || droṇapuṣpīprasūnāni viḍaṅgamirimedakaḥ | etaccūrṇamadhordhvaṃ ca dattvā mudrāṃ pradīyate || 36 || taṃ golaṃ sandhayetsamyagmṛnmūṣāsaṃpuṭe sudhīḥ | mudrāṃ dattvā śoṣayitvā tato gajapuṭe pacet ||37|| ekamekapuṭenaiva jāyate bhasma sūtakam |

ab.seg: anyadapi rasamāraṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - kāṣṭhodumbarikādugdhai rasaṃ kiṃcidvimardayet || 38 ||
taddugdhaghṛṣṭahiṅgośca mūṣāyugmaṃ prakalpayet | kṣiptvā tatsaṃpuṭe sūtaṃ tatra mudrāṃ pradāpayet || 39 ||
dhṛtvā taṃ golakaṃ prājño mṛnmūṣāsaṃpuṭe'dhike | pacenmṛdupuṭenaiva sūtako yāti bhasmatām ||40||
aparamapi pāradamāraṇaṃ darśayannāha - nāgavallīrasairghṛṣṭaḥ karkoṭīkandagarbhitaḥ | mṛṇmūṣāsaṃpuṭe paktvā sūto vātyeva bhasmatām || 41||
atha jvarādau rasāḥ procyante – jvarāṅkuśaḥ | khaṇḍitaṃ mṛgaśrṛṅgaṃ ca jvālāmukhyā rasaiḥ samam | ruddhvā bhāṇḍe pacecculyāṃ yāmayugmaṃ tato nayet ||42||
aṣṭāṃśaṃ trikaṭuṃ dadyānniṣkamātraṃ ca bhakṣayet | nāgavallīrasaiḥ sārdhaṃ vātapittajvarāpaham || 43 ||
ayaṃ jvarāṃkuśo nāma rasaḥ sarvajvarāpahaḥ | aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ ca tryāhikaṃ vā na saṃśayaḥ ||44||

div.ab: atha jvarārirasaḥ -- pāradaṃ rasakaṃ tālaṃ tutthaṃ ṭaṅkaṇagandhakaṃ | sarvametatsamaṃ śuddhaṃ kāravellīrasairdinam || 45 || mardayellepayettena tāmrapātrodaraṃ bhiṣak | aṅgulyardhapramāṇena tato ruddhvā ca tanmukham || 46 || pacettaṃ vālukāyanttre kṣiptvā dhānyāni tanmukhe ||47|| yadā sphuṭanti dhānyāni tadā siddhaṃ vinirdiśet | tato nayetsvāṅgaśītaṃ tāmrapātrodarādbhiṣak ||48|| rasaṃ jvarārināmānaṃ vicūrṇya maricaiḥ samam | māṣaikaṃ parṇakhaṇḍena bhakṣayennāśayejjvaram || 49 || tridinairviṣamaṃ tīvramekadvitricaturthakam |

ab.seg: atha śītajvarārirasaḥ | tālakaṃ tutthakaṃ tāmraṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ manaḥśilām ||50||
karṣaṃ karṣaṃ prayoktavyaṃ mardayettriphalāmbubhiḥ | golaṃ nyasetsaṃpuṭake puṭaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ || 51 ||
tato nītvārkadugdhena vajrīdugdhena saptadhā | kvāthena dantyāḥ śyāmāyā bhāvayetsaptadhā punaḥ ||52||
māṣamātraṃ rasaṃ divyaṃ pañcāśanmaricairyutam | guḍaṃ gadyāṇakaṃ caiva tulasīdalayugmakam || 53 ||
bhakṣayettridinaṃ bhaktyā śītārirdurlabhaḥ paraḥ | pathyaṃ dugdhaudanaṃ deyaṃ viṣamaṃ śītapūrvakam || 54 ||
dāhapūrvaṃ haratyāśu tṛtīyakacaturthakau | dvyāhikaṃ satataṃ caiva vaivarṇyaṃ ca niyacchati || 55 ||
jvaraghnī guṭikā | bhāgaikaḥ syādrasācchuddhādaileyaḥ pippalī śivā | ākārakarabho gandhaḥ kaṭutailena śodhitaḥ ||56||
phalāni cendravāruṇyāścaturbhāgamitā amī | ekatra mardayeccūrṇamindravāruṇikārasaiḥ || 57 ||
māṣonmitāṃ guṭīṃ kṛtvā dadyātsarvajvare budha: | chinnārasānupānena jvaraghnī guṭikā matā || 58 ||

div.ab: atha lokanātharasaḥ kṣayādau - śuddho bubhukṣitaḥ sūto bhāgadvayamito bhavet | tathā gandhasya bhāgau dvau kuryātkajjalikāṃ tayoḥ ||59|| sūtāccaturguṇeṣveva kapardeṣu vinikṣipet | bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ dattvā gokṣīreṇa vimardayet || 60 || tathā śaṅkhasya khaṇḍānāṃ bhāgānaṣṭau prakalpayet | kṣipetsarvaṃ puṭasyāntaścūrṇaliptaśarāvayoḥ || 61 || garte hastonmite dhṛtvā puṭedgajapuṭena ca | svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddhṛtya piṣṭvā tatsarvamekataḥ || 62 || ṣaḍguñjāsaṃmitaṃ cūrṇamekonatriṃśadūṣaṇaiḥ | ghṛtena vātaje dadyānnavanītena pittaje || 63 || kṣaudreṇa śleṣmaje dadyādatīsāre kṣaye tathā | arucau grahaṇīroge kārśye mandānale tathā || 64 || kāsaśvāseṣu gulmeṣu lokanātharaso hitaḥ | tasyopari ghṛtānnaṃ ca bhuñjīta kavalatrayam || 65 || mañce kṣaṇaikamuttānaḥ śayītānupadhānake | anamlamannaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhuñjīta madhuraṃ dadhi || 66 || prāyeṇa jāṅgalaṃ māṃsaṃ pradeyaṃ ghṛtapācitam | sudugdhabhaktaṃ dadyācca jāte'gnau sāṃdhyabhojane ||67|| saghṛtānmudgavaṭakānvyañjaneṣvavacārayet | tilāmalakakalkena snāpayetsarpiṣā'thavā || 68 || abhyañjayetsarpiṣā ca snānaṃ koṣṇodakena ca | kvacittailaṃ na gṛhṇīyānna bilvaṃ kāravellakam ||69|| vārtākaṃ śapharīṃ ciñcāṃ tyajedvyāyāmamaithune | madyaṃ saṃdhānakaṃ hiṅgu śuṇṭhīṃ māṣānmasūrakān ||70|| kūṣmāṇḍaṃ rājikāṃ kopaṃ‘kola’ pā.| kāñjikaṃ caiva varjayet | tyajedayuktanidrāṃ ca kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam ||71|| kakārādiyutaṃ sarvaṃ tyajecchākaphalādikam | pathyo'yaṃ‘grāhyo’ pā.| lokanāthastu śubhanakṣatravāsare || 72 || pūrṇātithau site pakṣe jāte candrabale tathā | pūjayitvā lokanāthaṃ kumārī bhojayettataḥ || 73|| dānaṃ dattvā dvighaṭikāmadhye grāhyo rasottamaḥ | rasāccejjāyate tāpastadā śarkarayā sutam || 74 || sattvaṃ guḍūcyā gṛhṇīyādvaṃśarocanayā yutam | kharjūraṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣāmikṣukhaṇḍāni cārayet‘śca dāpayet’ pā.| ||75|| arucau nistuṣaṃ dhānyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ saśarkaram | dadyāttathā jvare dhānyaguḍūcīkvāthamāharet || 76 || uśīravāsakakvāthaṃ dadyātsamadhuśarkaram | raktapitte kaphe śvāse kāse ca svarasaṃkṣaye || 77 || agnibhṛṣṭajayācūrṇaṃ madhunā niśi dīyate | nidrānāśe'tisāre ca grahaṇyāṃ mandapāvake ||78|| sauvarcalābhayākṛṣṇācūrṇamuṣṇodakaiḥ pibet | śūle'jīrṇe tathā kṛṣṇā madhuyuktā jvare hitā ||79|| plīhodare vātarakte chardyāṃ caiva gudāṅkure | nāsikādiṣu rakteṣu rasaṃ dāḍimapuṣpajam || 80 || dūrvāyāḥ svarasaṃ nasye pradadyāccharkarāyutam | kolamajjā kaṇā barhipakṣabhasma saśarkaram || 81 || madhunā lehayecchardihikkākopopaśāntaye | vidhireṣa prayojyastu sarvasminpoṭṭalīrase || 82 || mṛgāṅke hemagarbhe ca mauktikākhye'pareṣu ca | ityayaṃ lokanāthākhyo rasaḥ sarvarujo jayet ||83|| (varāṭabhasma maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayitvā ghṛte pacet | tatsamaṃ maricaṃ cūrṇaṃ nāgavallyā vibhāvitam || 84 || taccūrṇaṃ madhunā lehyamathavā navanītakaiḥ | māṣamātraṃ kṣayaṃ hanti yāme yāme ca bhakṣitam ||85|| lokanātharaso hyeṣa maṇḍalādrājayakṣmanut |)

ab.seg: atha mṛgāṅkapoṭṭalīrasaḥ kṣayādau - bhūrjavattanupatrāṇi hemnaḥ sūkṣmāṇi kārayet ||86||
tulyāni tāni sūtena khalve kṣiptvā vimardayet | kāñcanārarasenaiva jvālāmukhyā rasena vā || 87 ||
lāṅgalyā vā rasaistāvadyāvadbhavati piṣṭikā | tato hemnaścaturthāṃśaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ tatra nikṣipet || 88 ||
piṣṭemauktikacūrṇaṃ ca hemadviguṇamāvapet | teṣu sarvasamaṃ gandhaṃ kṣiptvā caikatra mardayet || 89 ||
teṣāṃ kṛtvā tato golaṃ vāsobhiḥ pariveṣṭayet | paścānmṛdā veṣṭayitvā śoṣayitvā ca dhārayet||90||
śarāvasaṃpuṭasyāntastatra mudrāṃ pradāpayet | lavaṇāpūrite bhāṇḍe dhārayettaṃ ca saṃpuṭam || 91 ||
mudrāṃ dattvā śoṣayitvā bahubhirgomayaiḥ puṭet | tataḥ śīte samāhṛtya gandhaṃ sūtasamaṃ kṣipet ||92||
ghṛṣṭvā ca pūrvavatkhalve puṭedgajapuṭena ca | svāṅgaśītaṃ tato nītvā guñjāyugmaṃ prayojayet ||93 ||
aṣṭabhirmaricairyuktaḥ kṛṣṇātrayayuto'thavā | vilokya deyo doṣādīnekaikā rasaraktikā || 94 ||
sarpiṣā madhunā vāpi dadyāddoṣādyapekṣayā | lokanāthasamaṃ pathyaṃ kuryātsvasthamanāḥ śuciḥ ||95||
śleṣmāṇaṃ grahaṇīṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ kṣayamarocakam | mṛgāṅko'yaṃ raso hanyātkṛśatvaṃ balahīnatām ||96||
kṣayaśvāsādau hemagarbhapoṭṭalīrasaḥ | sūtātpādapramāṇena hemnaḥ piṣṭaṃ prakalpayet | tayoḥ syāddviguṇo gandho mardayetkāñcanārakaiḥ ||97||
kṛtvā golaṃ kṣipenmūṣāsaṃpuṭe mudrayettataḥ | pacedbhūdharayantreṇa vāsaratritayaṃ budhaḥ || 98 ||
tata uddhṛtya tatsarvaṃ dadyādgandhaṃ ca tatsamam | mardayedārdrakarasaiścitrakasvarasena ca || 99 ||
sthūlapītavarāṭāṃśca pūrayettena yuktitaḥ | etasmādauṣadhātkuryādaṣṭamāṃśena ṭaṅkaṇam || 100||
ṭaṅkaṇārdhaṃ viṣaṃ dattvā piṣṭvā sehuṇḍadugdhakaiḥ | mudrayettena kalkena varāṭānāṃ mukhāni ca || 101||
bhāṇḍe cūrṇapralipte ca dhṛtvā mudrāṃ pradāpayet | garte hastonmite dhṛtvā puṭedgajapuṭena ca || 102 ||
svāṅgaśītaṃ rasaṃ jñātvā pradadyāllokanāthavat | pathyaṃ mṛgāṅkavajjñeyaṃ tridinaṃ lavaṇaṃ tyajet || 103 ||
yadā chardirbhavettasya dadyācchinnāśṛtaṃ‘rasaṃ’ pā. | tadā | madhuyuktaṃ tathā śleṣmakope dadyāduḍārdrakam || 104 ||
vireke bharjitā bhaṅgā pradeyā dadhisaṃyutā | jayetkāsaṃ kṣayaṃ śvāsaṃ grahaṇīmaruciṃ tathā || 105 ||
agniṃ ca kurute dīptaṃ kaphavātaṃ niyacchati | hemagarbhaḥ paro jñeyo rasaḥ poṭṭalikābhidhaḥ || 106 ||
atha dvitīyo hemagarbhapoṭṭalīrasaḥ - rasasya bhāgāścatvārastāvantaḥ kanakasya ca | tayośca ṣiṣṭikāṃ kṛtvā gandho dvādaśabhāgikaḥ ||107 ||
kuryātkajjalikāṃ teṣāṃ muktābhāgāśca ṣoḍaśa | caturviṃśacca śaṅkhasya bhāgaikaṃ ṭaṅkaṇasya ca || 108 ||
ekatra mardayetsarvaṃ pakvanimbūkajai rasaiḥ | kṛtvā teṣāṃ tato golaṃ mūṣāsaṃpuṭake nyaset ||109||
mudrāṃ dattvā tato hastamātre garte ca gomayaiḥ | puṭedgajapuṭenaiva svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddharet || 110 ||
piṣṭvā guñjācaturmānaṃ dadyādgavyājyasaṃyutam | ekonatriṃśadunmānamaricaiḥ saha dīyate || 911 ||
rājate mṛnmaye pātre kācaje‘kāñcane’ pā. | vā'valehayet | lokanāthasamaṃ pathyaṃ kuryācca svasthamānasaḥ‘prayata’ pā. | || 112||
kāse śvāse kṣaye vāte kaphe grahaṇikāgade | sūtīsāre prayoktavyā poṭṭalī hemagarbhikā || 113 ||

div.ab: atha mahājvarāṅkuśaḥ viṣamajvarādau - śuddhasūto viṣaṃ gandhaḥ pratyekaṃ śāṇasaṃmitam | dhūrtabījaṃ triśāṇaṃ syātsarvebhyo dviguṇā bhavet ||114|| hemāhvā kārayedeṣāṃ sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇaṃ prayatnataḥ | deyaṃ jambīramajjābhiścūrṇaṃ guñjādvayonmitam || 115|| ārdrakasvarasairvāpi jvaraṃ hanti tridoṣajam | aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikaṃ vā tryāhikaṃ vā caturthakam ||116|| viṣamaṃ ca jvaraṃ hanyādvikhyāto'yaṃ jvarāṅkuśaḥ |

ab.seg: daradaṃ vatsanābhaṃ ca maricaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kaṇām || 117 ||
cūrṇayetsamabhāgena raso hyānandabhairavaḥ | guñjaikaṃ vā dviguñjaṃ vā balaṃ jñātvā prayojayet ||118 ||
madhunā lehayeccānu kuṭajasya phalaṃ tvacam | cūrṇitaṃ karṣamātraṃ tu tridoṣotthātisārajit || 119||
dadhyannaṃ dāpayetpathyaṃ gavājyaṃ takrameva ca | pipāsāyāṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ vijayā ca hitā niśi ||120||

div.ab: atha laghusūcikābharaṇo rasastridoṣe - viṣaṃ palamitaṃ sūtaḥ śāṇikaścūrṇayeddvayam | taccūrṇaṃ saṃpuṭe kṣiptvā kācaliptaśarāvayoḥ || 121 || mudrāṃ dattvā ca saṃśoṣya tataśculyāṃ niveśayet | vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryātpraharadvayasaṃkhyayā || 122 || tata udghāṭayenmudrāmuparisthāṃ śarāvakāt | saṃlagno yo bhavetsūtastaṃ gṛhṇīyācchanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 123|| vāyusparśo yathā na syāttathā kupyāṃ niveśayet | yāvatsūcyā mukhe lagnaṃ kupyā niryāti bheṣajam ||124|| tāvanmātro raso deyo mūrcchite saṃnipātini | kṣureṇa pracchite mūrdhni tatrāṅgulyā ca gharṣayet||125|| raktabheṣajasaṃparkānmūrcchito'pi hi jīvati | tathaiva sarpadaṣṭastu mṛtāvastho'pi jīvati || 126 || yadā tāpo bhavettasya madhuraṃ tatra dīyate |

ab.seg: atha jalabandhurasaḥ sannipāte - sūtabhasmasamaṃ gandhaṃ dhātryā dadyānmanaḥśilā || 127||
mākṣikaṃ pippalī vyoṣaṃ pratyekaṃ śilayā samam | cūrṇayedbhāvayetpittairmatsyamāyūrasaṃbhavaiḥ || 128 ||
saptadhā bhāvayecchuṣkaṃ deyaṃ guñjādvayaṃ hitam | tālaparṇīrasaścānu pañcakolaśṛto'thavā || 129 ||
jalabandhuraso nāma saṃnipātaṃ niyacchati | jalayogaśca kartavyastena vīryaṃ bhavedrase || 130 ||
pañcavakrarasaḥ | śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ maricaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ kaṇām | mardayeddhūrtajadrāvairdinamekaṃ ca śoṣayet || 131 ||
pañcavakro raso nāma dviguñjaḥ saṃnipātajit | arkamūlakaṣāyaṃ tu satryūṣamanupāyayet || 132 ||
yuktaṃ dadhyodanaṃ pathyaṃ jalayogaṃ ca kārayet | rasenānena śāmyanti sakṣaudreṇa kaphodbhavāḥ || 133||
madhvārdrakarasaṃ cānu pibedagnivivṛddhaye | yatheṣṭaṃ ghṛtamāṃsāśī śakto bhavati pāvakaḥ || 134 ||

div.ab: athonmatto rasaḥ sannipāte - rasaṃ gandhakatulyāṃśaṃ dhattūraphalajadravaiḥ | mardayeddinamekaṃ tu tattulyaṃ trikaṭu kṣipet || 135 || unmattākhyo raso nāmnā nasye syātsaṃnipātajit |

atha sannipāte'ñjanaṃ rasāḥ - nistvagjaipālabījaṃ ca daśaniṣkaṃ vicūrṇayet ||136|| maricaṃ pippalīṃ sūtaṃ pratiniṣkaṃ vimiśrayet | bhāvyo jambīrajairdrāvaiḥ saptāhaṃ saṃprayatnataḥ || 137 || raso'yamañjane dattaḥ saṃnipātaṃ vināśayet |

ab.seg: atha mahānārācarasaḥ śūlādau - sūtaṃ ṭaṅkaṇakaṃ tulyaṃ maricaṃ sūtatulyakam || 138 ||
gandhakaṃ pippalīṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dvau dvau bhāgau vicūrṇayet| sarvatulyaṃ kṣipeddantībījaṃ nistuṣitaṃ bhiṣak || 139||
dviguñjaṃ recanaṃ siddhaṃ nārāco'yaṃ mahārasaḥ | ādhmānaṃ malaviṣṭambhānudāvartaṃ ca nāśayet || 140||
atha icchābhedī rasaḥ śūlādau -- daradaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ śuṇṭhī pippalī caikakārṣikā | hemāhvā palamātrā syāddantībījaṃ ca tatsamam ||141 ||
vicūrṇyaikatra sarvāṇi godugdhenaiva sādhayet | triguñjaṃ recanaṃ dadyādviṣṭambhādhmānarogiṣu || 142 ||

div.ab: vasantakusumākararasaḥprakṣiptamidaṃ | hemabhūtiḥ svarṇabhasma, gaganam abhrakabhasma, pravālaṃ vidrumabhasma, mauktikaṃ muktāphalabhasma, āṭaruṣakaḥ sahacaraḥ | haridrāvāriṇā haridrāsvarasenetyarthaḥ | tadabhāve haridrākvāthena kāryā | mocakandaḥ śālmalīniryāsaḥ, śatapatraḥ sevaṃtīkusumaḥ ‘gulāba’ hati prasiddhaḥ | candraḥ karpūra: bhīmasenī grāhya: || | dvau bhāgau hemabhūteśca gaganaṃ cāpi tatsamam | lohabhasma trayobhāgāścatvāro rasabhasmanaḥ || 143 || vaṅgabhasma tribhāgaṃ syātsarvamekatra mardayet | pravālaṃ mauktikaṃ caiva rasasāmyena dāpayet ||144|| bhāvanāṃ gavyadugdhena rasairghṛṣṭvāṭarūṣakaiḥ | haridrāvāriṇā caiva mocakandarasena ca || 145 || śatapatrarasenāpi mālatyāḥ svarasena ca | paścānmṛgamadaścandratulasīrasabhāvitaḥ ||146 || kusumākara ityeṣa vasantapadapūrvaka: | guñjādvayaṃ dadītāsya madhunā sarvamehanut || 147 || sitācandanasaṃyuktaścāmlapittādirogajit |

kṣayādau rājamṛgāṅkarasaḥ | sūtabhasma trayo bhāgā bhāgaikaṃ hemabhasmakam ||148 || mṛtatāmrasya bhāgaikaṃ śilāgandhakatālakam | pratibhāgadvayaṃ śuddhamekīkṛtya vicūrṇayet || 149 || varāṭānpūrayettena chāgīkṣīreṇa ṭaṅkaṇam | piṣṭvā tena mukhaṃ ruddhvā mṛdbhāṇḍe tannirodhayet ||150|| śuṣkaṃ gajapuṭaṃ paktvā cūrṇayetsvāṅgaśītalam | raso rājamṛgāṅko'yaṃ caturguñjaḥ kṣayāpahaḥ || 151 || daśapippalikākṣaudrairekonatriṃśadūṣaṇaiḥ | saghṛtaṃkeṣucinnāsti | dāpayetpathyaṃ strīkopāgniśramāṃstyajet || 152 || pathyaṃ vā laghumāṃsāni rājarogapraśāntaye |

athāgnināmā rasa kṣayaśvāsādau - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ kuryātkhalvena kajjalīm ||153|| tayoḥ samaṃ tīkṣṇacūrṇaṃ mardayetkanyakādravaiḥ | dviyāmānte kṛtaṃ golaṃ tāmrapātre vinikṣipet ||154|| ācchādyairaṇḍapatreṇa yāmārdhe'tyuṣṇatā bhavet | dhānyarāśau nyasetpaścādahorātrātsamuddharet || 155|| saṃcūrṇya gālayedvastre satyaṃ vāritaraṃ bhavet | (bhāvayetkanyakādrāvaiḥdīpikā'sammata: pāṭha: | saptadhā bhṛṅgajaistathā ||156|| kākamācīkuraṇṭotthadravairmuṇḍyāpunarnavaiḥ | sahadevyamṛtānīlīnirguṇḍīcitrajaistathā || 157 || saptadhā tu pṛthagdrāvairbhāvyaṃ śoṣyaṃ tathātape | siddhayogo hyayaṃ khyātaḥ siddhānāṃ ca mukhāgataḥ ||158|| anubhūto mayā satyaṃ sarvarogagaṇāpahaḥ | svarṇādīnmārayedevaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya tu lohavat ||159||) triphalāmadhusaṃyuktaḥ sarvarogeṣu yojayet| trikaṭutriphalailābhirjātīphalalavaṅgakaiḥ || 160 || navabhāgonmitairetaiḥ samaḥ pūrvaraso bhavet | saṃcūrṇya loḍayetkṣaudrairbhakṣyaṃ niṣkadvayaṃ dvayam || 161|| svayamagniraso nāmnā kṣayakāsanikṛntanaḥ |

amṛtārṇavarasaḥprakṣiptam | | pāradaṃ gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ mṛtalohaṃ ca ṭaṅkaṇam || 162 || rāsnāviḍaṅgatriphalā devadāru kaṭutrayam| amṛtā padmakaṃ kṣaudraṃ viśvaṃ tulyāṃśacūrṇitam||166|| triguñjaṃ sarvakāsārtaḥ sevayedamṛtārṇavam | atha sūryāvarto rasaḥ śvāse - sūtārdho gandhako mardyo yāmaikaṃ kanyakādravaiḥ || 164 || dvayostulyaṃ tāmrapatraṃ pūrvakalkena lepayet | dinaikaṃ sthālikāyantre pakvamādāya cūrṇayet || 165 || sūryāvarto raso hyeṣa dviguñjaḥ śvāsajidbhavet |

ab.seg: atha svacchandabhairavaraso vātaroge - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ lohaṃ tāpyaṃ gandhakatālake || 166 ||
pathyāgnimanthaṃ nirguṇḍī tryūṣaṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ viṣam | tulyāṃśaṃ mardayetkhalve dinaṃ nirguṇḍikādravaiḥ ||167||
muṇḍīdrāvairdinaikaṃ tu dviguñjaṃ vaṭakīkṛtam | bhakṣayedvātarogārto nāmnā svacchandabhairava: || 168||
rāsnāmṛtādevadāruśuṇṭhīvātārijaṃ śṛtam | lagugguluṃ pibetkoṣṇamanupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 169 ||
atha haṃsapoṭṭalīrasaḥ grahaṇīroge - dagdhvā kapardakaṃ piṣṭvā tryūṣaṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ viṣam | gandhakaṃ śuddhasūtaṃ ca tulyaṃ jambīrajairdravaiḥ || 170 ||
mardayedbhakṣayenmāṣaṃ maricājyaṃ lihedanu | nihanti grahaṇīrogaṃ pathyaṃ takraudanaṃ hitam ||171 ||
atha trivikramarasaḥ aśmaryāṃ - mṛtaṃ tāmramajākṣīraiḥ pācyaṃ tulyairgatadravam | tattāmraṃ śuddhasūtaṃ ca gandhakaṃ ca samaṃ samam ||172||
nirguṇḍīsvararasairmardyaṃ tadgolaṃ sandhayeddinam | yāmaikaṃ vālukāyantre pācyaṃ bhojyaṃ dviguñjakam ||173 ||
bījapūrakamūlaṃ tu sajalaṃ cānupāyayet | rasastrivikramo nāmnā māsaikenāśmarīpraṇut ||174||

div.ab: sarvakuṣṭhādau mahātāleśvararasaḥ - tālaṃ‘tāraṃ’ | tāpyaṃ śilā sūtaṃ śuddhaṃ saindhavaṭaṅkaṇe | samāṃśaṃ cūrṇayetkhalve sūtāddviguṇagandhakam ||175|| gandhatulyaṃ mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ jambīrairdinapañcakam | mardyaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ puṭaiḥ pācyaṃ bhūdhare saṃpuṭodare ||176|| puṭe puṭe dravairmardyaṃ sarvametattu ṣaṭpalam | dvipalaṃ māritaṃ‘maricaṃ’ pā.| tāmraṃ lohabhasma catuṣpalam ||177|| jambīrāmlena tatsarvaṃ dinaṃ mardyaṃ puṭellaghu | triṃśadaṃśaṃ viṣaṃ cāsya kṣiptvā sarvaṃ vicūrṇayet ||178 || māhiṣājyena saṃmiśraṃ niṣkārdhaṃ bhakṣayetsadā | madhvājyairbākucīcūrṇaṃ karṣamātraṃ lihedanu || 179 || sarvakuṣṭhāni hantyāśu mahātāleśvaro rasaḥ |

ab.seg: atha kuṣṭhakuṭhāro rasaḥ - bhasmasūtasamo gandho mṛtāyastāmraguggulūn ||180||
triphalā ca mahānimbaścitrakaśca śilājatu | ityeccūrṇitaṃ kuryātpratyekaṃ śāṇaṣoḍaśa ||181 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭhiḥ karañjasya bījacūrṇaṃ prakalpayet | catuḥṣaṣṭirmṛtaṃ cābhraṃ madhvājābhyāṃ viloḍayet ||982||
snigdhabhāṇḍe dhṛtaṃ khādeddviniṣkaṃ sarvakuṣṭhanut | rasaḥ kuṣṭhakuṭhāro'yaṃ galatkuṣṭhanivāraṇa: ||183 ||

div.ab: athodayādirasaḥ śvetakuṣṭhādau - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ mardyaṃ kanyādravairdinam | tadgolaṃ piṭharīmadhye tāmrapātreṇa rodhayet || 184 || sūtakāddviguṇenaiva śuddhenādhomukhena ca | pārśve bhasma nidhāyātha pātrordhvaṃ gomayaṃ jalam ||185 || kiṃcitkiṃcitpradātavyaṃ cullyāṃ yāmadvayaṃ pacet | caṇḍāgninā taduddhṛtya svāṅgaśītaṃ vicūrṇayet || 186|| kāṣṭhodumbarikāvahnitriphalārājavṛkṣakam | viḍaṅgaṃ bākucībījaṃ kvāthayettena bhāvayet || 187 || dinaikamudayādityo raso deyo dviguñjakaḥ | vicarcikāṃ dadrukuṣṭhaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca nāśayet || 188 || anupānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bākucīphalacūrṇakam | khadirasya kaṣāyeṇa samena paripācitam || 189 || triśāṇaṃ tadgavāṃ kṣīraiḥ kvāthairvā traiphalaiḥ pibet | tridinānte bhavetsphoṭaḥ saptāhādvā kilāsake ||190|| nīlīṃ guñjāṃ ca kāsīsaṃ dhattūraṃ haṃsapādikām | sūryabhaktāṃ ca cāṅgerīṃ piṣṭvā mūlātpralepayet || 191 || sphoṭasthānapraśāntyarthaṃ saptarātraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | śvetakuṣṭhaṃ nihantyāśu sādhyāsādhyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ||192|| aparaḥ śvitralepo'pi kathyate'tra bhiṣagvaraiḥ | guñjāphalāgnicūrṇaṃ ca lepitaṃ śvetakuṣṭhanut || 193 || śilāpāmārgabhasmāpi liptaṃ śvitraṃ vināśayet |

ab.seg: atha kuṣṭhādau sarveśvaro rasaḥ -- śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ caturgandhaṃ palaṃ yāmaṃ vicūrṇeyet || 194||
mṛtatāmrābhralohānāṃ daradasya palaṃ palam | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva pratyekaṃ daśaniṣkakam || 195 ||
māṣaikaṃ mṛtavajraṃ ca tālaṃ śuddhaṃ paladvayam | jambīronmattavāsābhiḥ snuhyarkaviṣamuṣṭhibhi: ||196||
mardyaṃ hayārijairdrāvaiḥ pratyekena dinaṃdinam | evaṃ saptadinaṃ mardyaṃ tadgolaṃ vastraveṣṭitam ||197 ||
vālukāyantragaṃ svedyaṃ tridinaṃ laghuvahninā | ādāya cūrṇayecchlakṣṇaṃ palaikaṃ yojayedviṣam || 198||
dvipalaṃ pippalīcūrṇaṃ miśraṃ sarveśvaro rasaḥ | dviguñjo lihyate kṣaudraiḥ suptimaṇḍalakuṣṭhanut || 199||
bākucī devakāṣṭhaṃ ca karṣamātraṃ sucūrṇayet | lihedairaṇḍatailāktamanupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 200||
atha suptyādau svarṇakṣīrīrasaḥ - hemāhvāṃ pañcapalikāṃ kṣiptvā takraghaṭe pacet | takre jīrṇe samuddhṛtya punaḥ kṣīraghaṭe pacet ||201||
kṣīre jīrṇe samuddhṛtya kṣālayitvā viśodhayet | taccūrṇaṃ pañcapalikaṃ maricānāṃ paladvayam||202||
palaikaṃ mūrcchitaṃ sūtamekīkṛtya tu bhakṣayet | niṣkaikaṃ suptikuṣṭhārtaḥ svarṇakṣīrīraso hyayam ||203||
atha mehabaddho rasaḥ pramehe - bhasmasūtaṃ mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ muṇḍabhasma śilājatu | śuddhaṃ tāpyaṃ śilā vyoma triphalāṃ kolabījakam ||204||
kapitthaṃ rajanīcūrṇaṃ bhṛṅgarājena bhāvayet | triṃśadvāraṃ viśoṣyātha madhuyuktaṃ lihetsadā ||205||
niṣkamātro harenmehānmehabaddho raso mahān | mahānimbasya bījāni piṣṭvā ṣaṭsaṃmitāni ca ||206||
palataṇḍulatoyena ghṛtaniṣkadvayena ca | ekīkṛtya pibeccānu hanti mehaṃ ciratanam ||207||
atha mahāvahnirasamāha - catuḥsūtasya gandhāṣṭau rajanī triphalā śivā | pratyekaṃ na dvibhāgaṃ syāttrivṛjjaipālacitrakam ||208||
pratyekaṃ ca tribhāgaṃ syātryūṣaṃ dantī ca jīrakam | pratyekamaṣṭabhāgaṃ syādekīkṛtya vicūrṇayet ||209||
jayantīsnukpayobhṛṅgavahnivātāritailakaiḥ | pratyekena kramādbhāvyaṃ saptavāraṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 210||
mahāvahniraso nāma niṣkamuṣṇajalaiḥ pibet | virecanaṃ bhavettena takrabhaktaṃ sasaindhavam || 211 ||
dinānte dāpayetpathyaṃ varjayecchītalaṃ jalam | sarvodaraharaḥ prokto mūḍhavātaharaḥ paraḥ || 212||

div.ab: atha vidyādharo rasaḥ gulmaplīhādau - gandhakaṃ tālakaṃ tāpyaṃ mṛtatāmraṃ manaḥśilām | śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ ca tulyāṃśaṃ mardayedbhāvayeddinam ||213|| pippalyāstu kaṣāyeṇa vajrīkṣīreṇa bhāvayet | niṣkārdhaṃ bhakṣayetkṣaudrairgulmaṃ plīhādikaṃ jayet||214|| raso vidyādharo nāma gomūtraṃ ca pibedanu |

ab.seg: atha trinetro rasaḥ paktiśūlādau - ṭaṅkaṇaṃ hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ svarṇaṃ śulbaṃ mṛtaṃ rasam ||215||
dinaikamārdrakadrāvairmardyaṃ ruddhvā puṭe pacet | trinetrākhyarasasyaikaṃ māṣaṃ madhvājyakairlihet || 216||
saindhavaṃ jīrakaṃ hiṅgu madhvājyābhyāṃ lihedanu | paktiśūlaharaḥ khyāto māsamātrānna saṃśayaḥ ||217||
atha śūlagajakesarīrasaḥ śūle - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ yāmaikaṃ mardayeddṛḍham | dvayostulyaṃ śuddhatāmraṃ saṃpuṭe tannirodhayet ||218||
ūrdhvādho lavaṇaṃ dattvā mṛdbhāṇḍe dhārayedbhiṣak | tato gajapuṭe paktvā svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddharet ||219||
saṃpuṭaṃ cūrṇayetsūkṣmaṃ parṇakhaṇḍe dviguñjakam | bhakṣayetsarvaśūlārto hiṅgu śuṇṭhī ca jīrakam ||220||
vacāmaricajaṃ cūrṇaṃ karṣamuṣṇajalai: pibet | asādhyaṃ nāśayecchūlaṃ raso'yaṃ gajakesarī ||221 ||

div.ab: athāgnituṇḍavaṭīsarasaḥ agnimāndyādau - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhamajamodāṃ phalatrayam | svarjikṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ vahnisaindhavajīrakam || 222 || sauvarcalaṃ viḍaṅgāni sāmudraṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ samam | viṣamuṣṭiṃ sarvatulyaṃ jambīrāmlena mardayet || 223 || maricābhāṃ vaṭīṃ khādedvahnimāndyapraśāntaye |

ab.seg: athājīrṇakaṇṭako rasaḥ - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ samaṃ sarvaṃ vicūrṇayet || 224 ||
maricaṃ sarvatulyāṃśaṃ kaṇṭakāryāḥ phaladravaiḥ | mardayedbhāvayetsarvamekaviṃśativārakam || 225 ||
vaṭīṃ guñjātrayaṃ khādetsarvājīrṇapraśāntaye | ajīrṇakaṇṭakaḥ so'yaṃ raso hanti viṣūcikā || 226 ||
kaphādau manthānabhairavarasaḥ | mṛtaṃ sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ hiṅgu puṣkaramūlakam | saindhavaṃ gandhakaṃ tālaṃ kaṭukīṃ cūrṇayetsamam ||227||
punarnavādevadālīnirguṇḍītaṇḍulīyakaiḥ | tiktakośātakīdrāvairdinaikaṃ mardayeddṛḍham || 228 ||
māṣamātraṃ lihetkṣaudrai rasaṃ manthānabhairavam | kapharogapraśāntyarthaṃ nimbakvāthaṃ pibedanu || 229 ||

div.ab: atha vātanāśano rasaḥ - sūtahāṭakavajrāṇi tāmraṃ lohaṃ ca mākṣikam| tālaṃ nīlāñjanaṃ tutthamahiphenaṃ samāṃśakam ||230|| pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca bhāgamekaṃ vimardayet | vajrīkṣīrairdinaikaṃ tu ruddhvādho bhūdhare pacet || 231 || māṣaikamārdrakadrāvairlehayedvātanāśanam | pippalīmūlajakvāthaṃ sakṛṣṇamanupāyayet || 232 || sarvānvātavikārāṃstu nihantyākṣepakādikān|

ab.seg: atha kanakasundaraḥ sannipātādau - kanakasyāṣṭaśāṇāḥ syuḥ sūto dvādaśabhirmataḥ ||233 ||
gandho'pi dvādaśa proktastāmraṃ śāṇadvayonmitam | abhrakaṃ syāccatuḥśāṇaṃ mākṣikaṃ ca dviśāṇikam ||234||
vaṅgo dviśāṇaḥ sauvīraṃ triśāṇaṃ lohamaṣṭakam | viṣaṃ triśāṇikaṃ kṛtvā lāṅgalī palasaṃmitā ||235||
mardayeddinamekaṃ tu rasairamlaphalodbhavaiḥ | dadyānmṛdupuṭaṃ vahnau tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ vicūrṇayet ||236||
māṣamātro raso deyaḥ saṃnipāte sudāruṇe | ārdrakasvarasenaiva rasonasya rasena vā || 237 ||
kilāsaṃ sarvakuṣṭhāni visarpaṃ ca bhagandaram | jvaraṃ garamajīrṇaṃ ca jayedrogaharo rasaḥ ||238 ||
atha sannipātabhairavo rasaḥ -- raso gandhastrikarṣaḥ syāt kuryātkajjalikāṃ tayoḥ | tāmratārāravaṅgāhisārāścaikaikakārṣikāḥ ||239||
śigrujvālāmukhīśuṇṭhībilvebhyastaṇḍulīyakān | pratyekaṃ svarasaiḥ kuryādyāmaikaikaṃ vimardanam || 240 ||
kṛtvā golaṃ vṛtaṃ vastre lavaṇāpūrite nyaset | kācabhāṇḍe tataḥ sthālyāṃ kācakūpīṃ niveśayet || vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha vahniryāmadvayaṃ bhavet | tata uddhṛtya taṃ golaṃ cūrṇayitvā vimiśrayet ||242||
pravāṇacūrṇakarṣeṇa śāṇamātraviṣeṇa ca | kṛṣṇasarpasya garalairdvivelaṃ bhāvayettathā || 243 ||
tagaraṃ muśalī māṃsī hemāhvā cetasaḥ kaṇā | nīlinī patrakaṃ cailā citrakaśca kuṭherakaḥ || 244 ||
śatapuṣpā devadālī dhattūrāgastyamuṇḍikāḥ | madhūkajātīmadanarasaireṣāṃ vimardayet || 245 ||
pratyekamekavelaṃ ca tataḥ saṃśoṣya dhārayet | bījapūrārdrakadrāvairmaricaiḥ ṣoḍaśonmitaiḥ || 246 ||
raso dviguñjāpramitaḥ saṃnipāteṣu dīyate | prasiddho'yaṃ raso nāmnā saṃnipātasya bhairavaḥ ||247||
atīsārādau grahaṇīkapāṭaḥ - tāramauktikahemāni sāraścaikaikabhāgikāḥ | dvibhāgo gandhakaḥ sūtastribhāgo mardayedimān||248||
kapitthasvarasairgāḍhaṃ mṛgaśṛṅge tataḥ kṣipet | puṭenmadhyapuṭenaiva tata udbhṛtya mardayet ||249||
balārasaiḥ saptavelamapāmārgarasaistridhā | lodhraprativiṣāmustadhātakīndrayavāmṛtāḥ || 250 ||
pratyekameṣāṃ svarasairbhāvanā syāttridhā tridhā | māṣamātro raso deyo madhunā maricaistathā || 251 ||
hanyātsarvānatīsārāngrahaṇīṃ sarvajāmapi | kapāṭo grahaṇīroge raso'yaṃ vahnidīpanaḥ || 252 ||

div.ab: atha grahaṇīvajrakapāṭaḥ - mṛtasūtābhrakaṃ gandhaṃ yavakṣāraṃ saṭaṅkaṇam | agnimanthaṃ vacāṃ kuryātsūtatulyānimānsudhīḥ ||253|| tato jayantījamvīrabhṛṅgadrāvairvimardayet | trivāsaraṃ tato golaṃ kṛtvā saṃśoṣya dhārayet ||254|| lohapātre śarāvaṃ ca dattvopari vimudrayet | adho vahniṃ śanaiḥ kuryādyāmārdhaṃ tata uddharet||255|| rasatulyāṃ prativiṣāṃ dadyānmocarasaṃ tathā | kapitthavijayādrāvairbhāvayetsaptadhā pṛthak ||256|| dhātakīndrayavā mustā lodhraṃ bilvaṃ guḍūcikā | etadrasairbhāvayitvā velaikaikaṃ ca śoṣayet || 257|| rasaṃ vajrakapāṭākhyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ madhunā lihet | vahniṃ śuṇṭhīṃ biḍaṃ bilvaṃ lavaṇaṃ cūrṇayetsamam ||258|| pibeduṣṇāmbunā cānu sarvajāṃ grahaṇīṃ jayet |

atha madanakāmadevo vājīkaraṇe - tāraṃ vajraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ sūtakagandhakam || 259 || lohaṃ kramavivṛddhāni kuryādetāni mātrayā | vimardya kanyakādrāvairnyasetkācamaye ghaṭe || 260 || vimudrāṃ piṭharīmadhye dhārayetsaindhavāvṛte | piṭharīṃ mudrayetsamyak tataścullyāṃ niveśayet||261 || vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryāddinaikaṃ tata uddharet | svāṅgaśītaṃ ca saṃcūrṇya bhāvayedarkadugdhakaiḥ || 262 || aśvagandhā ca kākolī vānarī muśalīkṣurā‘kṣuka:’ pā. | | tritrivelaṃ rasairāsāṃ śatāvaryāśca bhāvayet || 263 || padmakandakaserūṇāṃ rasaiḥ kāśasya bhāvayet | kastūrī vyoṣakarpūrakaṅkolailālavaṅgakam || 264 || pūrvacūrṇādaṣṭamāṃśametaccūrṇaṃ vimiśrayet | sarvai: samāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dattvā śāṇonmitāṃ pibet ||265 || godugdhadvipalenaiva madhurāhārasevakaḥ | asya prabhāvātsaundaryaṃ balaṃ tejo'bhivardhate ||266|| taruṇī ramayedvahvīḥ śukrahānirna jāyate |

vājīkaraṇe kandarpasundararasamāha - sūto vajramahirmuktā tāraṃ hemāsitābhrakam ||267|| rasaiḥ karṣāṃśakānetānmardayedirimedajaiḥ | pravālacūrṇaṃ gandhaṃ ca dvidvikarṣaṃ vimiśrayet ||268|| tato'śvagandhāsvarasairvimardya mṛgaśṛṅgake | kṣiptvā mṛdupuṭe paktvā bhāvayeddhātakrīrasaiḥ ||269|| kākolī madhukaṃ māṃsī balātrayabiseṅgude | drākṣāpippalavandākaṃ varī parṇīcatuṣṭayam || 270 || parūṣakaṃ kaseruśca madhūkaṃ vānarī tathā | bhāvayitvā rasaireṣāṃ śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet||271|| elātvakpatrakaṃ vāṃśī lavaṅgāgarukeśaram | mustaṃ mṛgamadaḥ kṛṣṇā jalaṃ candraśca miśrayet ||272|| etaccūrṇaiḥ śāṇamitai rasaṃ kandarpasundaram | khādecchāṇamitaṃ rātrau sitā dhātrī vidārikā ||273|| etāsāṃ karṣacūrṇena sarpiṣkarṣeṇa saṃyutam | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibetsusthitamānasaḥ ||274|| ramaṇī ramayedbahvīrna hāniṃ kvāpi gacchati |

ab.seg: atha loharasāyanam - śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ dvibhāgaṃ śuddhagandhakam ||275||
kṣipetkajjalikāṃ kuryāttatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ rajaḥ | kṣiptvā kajjalikātulyaṃ praharaikaṃ vimardayet ||276||
tataḥ kanyādravairgharme tridinaṃ parimardayet | tataḥ saṃjāyate tasya soṣṇo dhūmodgamo mahān ||277||
atyantaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātre nidhāpayet | madhye dhānyakuśūlasya tridinaṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ || 278 ||
uddhṛtya tasmātkhalve ca kṣiptvā gharme nidhāya ca | rasaiḥ kuṭhāracchinnāyāstrivelaṃ paribhāvayet || 279 ||
saṃśoṣya gharme kvāthaiśca bhāvayettrikaṭostridhā | vāsāmṛtācitrakāṇārasairbhāvyaṃ kramāttridhā ||280||
lohapātre tataḥ kṣiptvā bhāvayettriphalājalaiḥ | nirguṇḍīdāḍimatvagbhirbisabhṛṅgakuraṇṭakaiḥ || 281 ||
palāśakadalīdrāvairbījakasya śṛtena ca | nīlikālambuṣādrāvairbabbūlaphalikārasaiḥ || 282 ||
bhāvayettritrivelaṃ ca tato nāgabalārasaiḥ | śatāvarīgokṣurubhiḥ pātālagaruḍīdravaiḥ || 283 ||
tritrivelaṃ yathālābhaṃ bhāvayedebhirauṣadhaiḥ | tataḥ prātarlihetkṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ kolamātrakam||284||
palamātraṃ varākvāthaṃ pibedasyānupānakam| māsatrayaṃ śīlitaṃ syādvalīpalitanāśanam ||285||
mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsau ca pāṇḍutāṃ kaphamārutau | pippalīmadhusaṃyuktaṃ hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ ||286 ||
vātāsraṃ mūtradoṣāṃśca grahaṇīṃ gudajāṃ rujam | aṇḍavṛddhiṃ jayedetacchinnāsattvamadhuplutam || 287 ||
balavarṇakaraṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | jayetsarvāmayānkālādidaṃ loharasāyanam || 288 ||
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tilatailaṃ ca māṣānnaṃ rājikāṃ tathā | madyamamlarasaṃ caiva tyajellohasya sevakaḥ ||289||

jaipālaśodhanam - (jaipālaṃprakṣiptam | rahitaṃ tvagaṅkurarasajñābhirmale māhiṣe nikṣiptaṃ tryahamuṣṇatoyavimalaṃ khalve savāso'rditam liptaṃ nūtanakharpareṣu vigatasnehaṃ rajaḥsaṃnibhaṃ nimbūkāmbuvibhāvitaṃ ca bahuśaḥ śuddhaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ bhavet ||290||

div.ab: viṣaśodhanam | viṣaṃ tu khaṇḍaśa: kṛtvā vastrakhaṇḍena bandhayet | gomūtramadhye nikṣipya sthāpayedātape tryaham ||291|| gomūtraṃ ca pradātavyaṃ nūtanaṃ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥ | tryahe'tīte samuddhṛtya śoṣayenmṛdu peṣayet ||292|| śuddhyatyevaṃ viṣaṃ tacca yogyaṃ bhavati cārtijit | khaṇḍīkṛtya viṣaṃ vastraparibaddhaṃ tu dolayā || 293 || ajāpayasi saṃsvinnaṃ yāmataḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt | ajādugdhābhāvatastu gavyakṣīreṇa śodhayet ||294|| ) iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe rasakalpanā nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | samāpto'yaṃ madhyamakhaṇḍaḥ ||

div.head: atha snehādhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha snehapānavidhiḥ |
snehaścaturvidhaḥ prokto ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ tathā vasā | majjā ca -

ab.seg: kaḥ kāla ’ etasya uttaramāha -- taṃ pibenmartyaḥ kiṃcidabhyudite ravau || 1 ||

div.ab: ‘kiṃyonayaḥ’ etasyottaramāha - sthāvaro jaṃgamaścaiva dviyoniḥ sneha ucyate |

ab.seg: varāvaratvamāha - tilatailaṃ sthāvareṣu jaṅgameṣu ghṛtaṃ varam || 2 ||

div.ab: militasnehanāmānyāha - dvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhistairyamakastrivṛto mahān |
snehasātmye kālāvadhimāha -- pibetryahaṃ caturahaṃ pañcāhaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ tathā || 3 || sāptarātrātparaṃ snehaḥ sātmībhavati sevitaḥ |
atha snehapānamātrāviṣayamāha - doṣakālāgnivayasāṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayojayet || 4 || hīnāṃ ca madhyamāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ mātrāṃ snehasya buddhimān |
amātrādisevitasya snehasya doṣamāha - amātrayā tathā'kāle mithyāhāravihārataḥ || 5 || snehaḥ karoti śophārśastandrānidrāvisaṃjñatāḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ snehapānamātrāmāha - deyā dīptāgnaye mātrā snehasya palasaṃmitā | madhyamāya trikarṣā syājjaghanyāya dvikārṣikī || 7 ||

div.ab: atha vikalpāntaravihitāṃ mātrāṃ darśayannāha - athavā snehamātrāḥ syustisro'nyāḥ sarvasaṃmatāḥ | ahorātreṇa mahatī jīryatyahni tu madhyamā || 8 || jīryatyalpā dinārdhena sā vijñeyā sukhāvahā |

ab.seg: alpādīnāṃ guṇānāha - alpā syāddīpanī vṛṣyā svalpadoṣeṣu pūjitā || 9 ||
madhyamā snehanī jñeyā bṛṃhaṇī bhramahāriṇī | jyeṣṭhā kuṣṭhaviṣonmādagrahāpasmāranāśinī || 10 ||
atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa snehaviṣayamāha - kevalaṃ paittike sarpirvātike lavaṇānvitam | peyaṃ bahukaphe cāpi vyoṣakṣārasamanvitam || 11 ||
yeṣāṃ sarpirdīyate tānāha - rūkṣakṣataviṣārtānāṃ vātapittavikāriṇām | hīnamedhāsmṛtīnāṃ ca sarpiṣpānaṃ praśasyate || 12 ||
tailayogyānāha -- kṛmikoṣṭhānilāviddhāḥ pravṛdhdakaphamedasaḥ | pibeyustailasātmyā ye tailaṃ dārḍhyārthinastu ye || 13||
vasāyogyānāha - vyāyāmakarṣitāḥ śuṣkaretoraktā mahārujaḥ | mahāgnimārutaprāṇā vasāyogyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14||
majjāyogyānāha -- krūrāśayāḥ kleśasahā vātārtā dīptavahnayaḥ | majjānaṃ ca pibeyuste sarpirvā sarvato hitam || 15 ||

div.ab: snehapānakālaḥ | śītakāle divā snehamuṣṇakāle pibenniśi | vātapittādhike rātrau vātaśleṣmādhike divā ||1 6||

ab.seg: atha tailaghṛtayorviśiṣṭakarma darśayannāha — nasyābhyañjanagaṇḍūṣamūrdhakarṇākṣitarpaṇaiḥ | tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā yuñjīta dṛṣṭvā doṣabalābalam || 17 ||
idānīṃ snehānāmanupānānyāha - ghṛte koṣṇaṃ jalaṃ peyaṃ taile yūṣaḥ praśasyate | vasāmajjñoḥ pibenmaṇḍamanupānaṃ sukhāvaham || 18 ||
sānnasnehasya viṣayamāha - snehadviṣaḥ śiśūnvṛddhānsukumārān kṛśānapi | udyākāmānuṣṇakāle saha bhaktena pāyayet || 19 ||
idānīṃ snehaṃ vināpi yavāgvā snehanamāha - sarpiṣmatī bahutilā yavāgūḥ svalpataṇḍulā | sukhoṣṇā sevyamānā tu sadyaḥ snehanakāriṇī ||20||
śarkarācūrṇasaṃghṛṣṭe dohanasthe ghṛte tu gām | dugdhvā kṣīraṃ ṣibeduṣṇaṃ sadyaḥ snehanamucyate || 21 ||
atha snehājīrṇe cikitsāmāha — mithyācārādbahutvādvā yasya sneho na jīryati | viṣṭabhya vāpi jīryeta vāriṇoṣṇena vāmayet ||22||
snehājīrṇe anyadapi pratīkāramāha -- srehasyājīrṇaśaṅkāyāṃ pibeduṣṇodakaṃ naraḥ | tenodgāre bhavecchuddho bhaktaṃ prati rucistathā || 23 ||

div.ab: snehopadravabhūtāyāstṛṣṇāyāścikitsāmāha - snehena paittikasyāgniryadā tīkṣṇatarīkṛtaḥ | tadāsyodīrayettṛṣṇāṃ viṣamāṃ tasya vāmayet || 24 || śītaṃ jalaṃ pāyayecca pipāsā tena śāmyati |

atha snehā'yogyānāha - ajīrṇī varjayetsnehamudarī taruṇajvarī || 25 || durbalo'rocakī sthūlo mūrcchārto madapīḍitaḥ | dattabastirviraktaśca vāntastṛṣṇāśramānvitaḥ || 26 || akālaprasravā nārī durdine ca vivarjayet |

ab.seg: yeṣāṃ snehapānaṃ praśastaṃ tānāha - svedyasaṃśodhyamadyastrīvyāyāmāsaktamānasāḥ || 27 ||
vṛddhā bālāḥ kṛśā rūkṣāḥ kṣīṇāsrāḥ kṣīṇaretasaḥ | vātārtāstimirārtā ye teṣāṃ snehanamuttamam || 28 ||

div.ab: samyak snigdhasya lakṣaṇamāha - vātānulomyaṃ dīpto'gnirvarcaḥ snigdhamasaṃhatam | mṛdusnigdhāṅgatā glāniḥ snehodvego'tha lāghavam ||29|| vimalendriyatā samyak snigdhe
rūkṣe lakṣaṇamāha – ---- rūkṣe viparyayaḥ |
atisnigdhalakṣaṇamāha -- bhaktadveṣo mukhasrāvo gude dāhaḥ pravāhikā ||30|| tandrātīsārapāṇḍutvaṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhasya lakṣaṇam |

ab.seg: athahīnātisnigdhasyopakramamāha - rūkṣasya snehanaṃ snehairatisnigdhasya rūkṣaṇam || 31 ||

div.ab: rūkṣayogamāha - śyāmākacaṇakādyaiśca takrapiṇyākasaktubhiḥ |
atha snehasevino lakṣaṇamāha - dīptāgniḥ śuddhakoṣṭhaśca puṣṭadhāturdṛḍhendriyaḥ || 32 || nirjaro balavarṇāḍhyaḥ snehasevī bhavennaraḥ |

ab.seg: snehasevāyāṃ varjyānyāha - snehe vyāyāmasaṃśītavegāghātaprajāgarān || 33 ||

divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | divāsvapnamabhiṣyandi rūkṣānnaṃ ca vivarjayet | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehavidhirnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

div.head: atha svedavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha svedavidhiḥ

ab.seg: tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ svedasaṃkhyāmāha - svedaścaturvidhaḥ proktastāpoṣmasvedasaṃjñakau | upanāho dravaḥ svedaḥ sarve vātārtihāriṇaḥ || 1 ||
svedau tāpoṣmajau prāyaḥ śleṣmaghnau samudīritau | upanāhastu vātaghnaḥ pittasaṅge dravo hitaḥ || 2 ||
atha trividhasvedasya viśeṣamāha - mahābale mahāvyādhau śīte svedo mahānsmṛtaḥ | durbale durbalaḥ svedo madhye madhyatamo mataḥ || 3 ||
atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa svedaviśeṣamāha – balāse rūkṣaṇasvedo rūkṣasnigdhaṃ kaphānile | kaphamedovṛte vāte koṣṇaṃ gehaṃ raveḥ karān ||4||
niyuddhaṃ mārgagamanaṃ guruprāvaraṇaṃ kṣudhaḥ | cintāvyāyāmabhārāṃśca sevetāmayamuktaye ||5||
prāksvedyāḥ - yeṣāṃ nasyaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bastiścāpi hi dehinām | śodhanīyāśca ye kecitpūrvaṃ svedyāśca te matāḥ ||6||
paścātsvedyāḥ - paścātsvedyā gate śalye mūḍhagarbhagade tathā | kāle prajātā'kāle vā paścātsvedyā nitambinī ||7||

kāladvayasvedyānāha -- svedyā: pūrvaṃ trayaḥ’traya’ iti padaṃ plīhādīnāṃ labdhe tritve tridoṣajanyatvaparaṃ jñeyam | arśasa iti arśorogī ’arśa āditvādac’ plīhabhagandaryarśasastathā | aśmaryaścāturo jantuḥ samaye śastrakarmaṇaḥ || 8 ||

div.ab: svedakālaḥ - savānsvedān nivāte ca jīrṇāhāre ca kārayet |
svedaphalam - svedāddhātusthitā doṣāḥ snehaklinnasya dehinaḥ ||9|| dravatvaṃ prāpya koṣṭhāntargatvā yānti virekatām |

sveditasya rakṣā | svidyamānaśarīrasya hṛdayaṃnanu hṛdayadṛṣṭayoḥ prāk rakṣaṇamuktaṃ, iha tu mṛdusve- do'bhihita iti viruddham? maivam, carake tūttaratantre śūlādau svedo vihitaḥ sa tu saṃmilitākṣairbāhye kriyate, na dṛṣṭau | carake'pyayameva pāṭho likhitaḥ | tadagre ca madhyamaṃ akṣṇau śeṣamaṅgāvayavamiṣṭataḥ svedayet | ru. śītalaiḥ spṛśet || 10 || snehābhyaktaśarīrasya śītairācchādya cakṣuṣī |
asvedārhāḥ - ajīrṇī durbalo mehī kṣatakṣīṇaḥ pipāsitaḥ ||11|| atisārī raktapittī pāṇḍurogī tathodarī | madārto garbhiṇī caiva nahi svedyā vijānatā || 12|| etānapi mṛdusvedaiḥ svedasādhyānupācaret |

ab.seg: kecidatrārdhaṃ paṭhanti- ’mṛdusvedaṃ prayuñjīta tathā hṛnmuṣkadṛṣṭiṣu || 13 ||
svedātiyogajā rogāḥ - atisvedātsandhipīḍā dāhatṛṣṇā klamo bhramaḥ | pittāsṛkpiḍakākopastatra śītairupācaret || 14 ||
tāpasvedaḥ - teṣu tāpābhidhaḥ svedo vālukāvastrapāṇibhiḥ | kapālakandukāṅgārairyathāyogyaḥ prayujyate || 15 ||
ūṣmasvedaḥ - ūṣmasvedaḥ prayoktavyo lohapiṇḍeṣṭakāśmabhiḥ | ataptairamlasiktaiśca kāye naktakaveṣṭite || 16 ||
athavā vātanirnāśidravyakvātharasādibhiḥ | uṣṇairghaṭaṃ pūrayitvā pārśve chidraṃ vidhāya ca || 17 ||
vimudryāsyaṃ trikhaṇḍāṃ ca dhātujāṃ kāṣṭhavaṃśajām | ṣaḍaṅgulāsyāṃ gopucchāṃ nalīṃ yuñjyādvihastikām ||18||
sukhopaviṣṭaṃ svabhyaktaṃ guruprāvaraṇāvṛtam | hastiśuṇḍikayā nāḍyāṃ svedayedvātarogiṇam || 19||
puruṣāyāmamātrāṃ vā bhūmimutkīrya khādiraiḥ | kāṣṭhairdagdhvā tathābhyukṣya kṣīradhānyāmlavāribhiḥ ||20||
vātaghnapatrairācchādya śayānaṃ svedayennaram | evaṃ māṣādibhiḥ svinnaiḥ śayānaṃ svedamācaret ||21||

div.ab: upanāhasvedamāha - athopanāhasvedaṃ ca kuryādvātaharauṣadhaiḥ | pradihya dehaṃ vātārtaṃ kṣīramāṃsarasānvitaiḥ || 22 || amlapiṣṭaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ snehasaṃyutaiḥ | upagrāmyānūpamāṃsairjīvanīyagaṇena ca || 23 || dadhi-sauvīraka-kṣīrairvīratarvādinā tathā | kulattha-māṣa-godhūmairatasī-tila-sarṣapaiḥ || 24 || śataṣuṣpā-devadāru-śephālī-sthūlajīrakaiḥ | eraṇḍamūlaṃ bījaiśca rāsnāmūlakaśigrubhiḥ || 25 || miśi-kṛṣṇā-kuṭheraiśca lavaṇairamlasaṃyutaiḥ | prasāriṇyaśvagandhābhyāṃ balābhirdaśamūlakaiḥ || 26 || guḍūcī-vānarībījairyathālābhaṃ samāhṛtaiḥ | kṣuṇṇaiḥ svinnaiśca vastreṇa baddhaiḥ saṃsvedayennaram ||27|| mahāśālvaṇasaṃjño'yaṃ yogaḥ sarvānilārtihṛt |
dravasvedavidhi: | dravasvedastu vātaghno dravyakvāthena pūritam || 28 || kaṭāhaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ vā'pi sūpaviṣṭo'vagāhayet |

ab.seg: idānīṃ dravasya parimāṇamāha - nābheḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ yāvanmagnaḥ kvāthasya dhārayā || 29 ||
koṣṇayā skandhayoḥ siktastiṣṭhet snigdhatanurnaraḥ | evaṃ tailena, dugdhena, sarpiṣā svedayennaram || 30 ||

div.ab: ekāntaro dvyantaro vā snehayukto'vagāhane |
avagāhanaphalam - sirāmukhai romakūpairdhamanībhiśca tarpayet || 31 || śarīre balamādhatte yuktaḥ sneho'vagāhane |

ab.seg: dhātuvardhanamāha - jalasiktasya vardhante yathāmūle'ṅkurāstaroḥ || 32 ||
tathā dhātuvivṛddhirhi snehasiktasya jāyate | nātaḥ parataraḥ kaścidupāyo vātanāśanaḥ || 33 ||
śītaśūlādyuparame stambhagauravanigrahe | dīptāgnau mārdave jāte svedanādviratirmatā || 34 ||
susvinnasya paścāt karma darśayati - samyak svinnaṃ vimṛditaṃ snānamuṣṇāmbubhiḥ śanaiḥ | bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi vyāyāmaṃ na ca kārayet ||35||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe svedavidhirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

div.head: atha vamanavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: vamanapradhāno vidhiḥ vamanavidhiḥ śodhanaprakāraḥ | ata evāha - śaratkāle vasante ca prāvṛṭkāle ca dehinām | vamanaṃ recanaṃ caiva kārayetkuśalo bhiṣak || 1 ||
vāmyāḥ - balavantaṃ kaphavyāptaṃ hṛllāsādinipīḍitam | tathā vamanasātmyaṃ ca dhīracittaṃ ca vāmayet ||2||

div.ab: vamanārhā rogāḥ - viṣadoṣe stanyadoṣe mando'gnau śrlīpade'rbude | hṛdroga-kuṣṭha-vīsarpa-mehā-jīrṇa-bhrameṣu ca || 3 || vidārikā-pacī-kāsa-śvāsa-pīnasa-vṛddhiṣu | apasmāre jvaronmāde tathā raktātisāriṣu ||4 || nāsā-tālvoṣṭha-pākeṣu karṇasrāve dvijihvake | galaśuṇḍyāmatīsāre pittaśleṣmagade tathā || 5 || medogade'rucau caiva vamanaṃ kārayet bhiṣak |

ab.seg: athāvāmyānāha - na vāmanīyastimirī na gulmī nodarī kṛśaḥ || 6 ||
nātivṛddho garbhiṇīṃ ca na sthūlo na kṣudhāturaḥ | madārto bālako rūkṣaḥ śudhitaśca nirūhitaḥ || 7 ||
udāvartyūrdhvaraktī ca duśchardī kevalānilī | pāṇḍarogī kṛmivyāptaḥ paṭhanātsvaraghātakaḥ || 8 ||
atha yadyapyete'pyajīrṇādivyāpitāstadā vāmanīyā iti vicāryāha - ete'pyajīrṇavyathitā vāmyā ye viṣapīḍitāḥ | kaphavyāptāśca te vāmyā madhukvāthasya pānataḥ || 9 ||
sukumāraṃ kṛśaṃ bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ bhīruṃ ca vāmayet | pīttvā yavāgūmākaṇṭhaṃ kṣīratakradadhīni vā || 10 ||
asātmyaiḥ śleṣmalairbhojyairdoṣānutkliśya dehinaḥ | snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate ||11 ||

div.ab: ?madhusaindhavayoḥ prādhānyam - vamaneṣu ca sarveṣu saindhavaṃ madhu‘vā’ śabdo'tra na bhinnakrame, apiśabdārthe dvayorapyekatra yogāt | uktaṃca vāmmaṭe-’yathāvikāravihitāṃ madhusaindhavasaṃyutām | koṣṭhaṃ vibhajya bhaiṣajvamātrāṃ madhābhimadhitām | brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkā'nilā'nalāḥ | ṛṣaya: sauṣaghigrāmā bhūtasaṃghāśca pāṃtu vaḥ | rasāyanamivaṣīṃṇāmamarāṇāmivā'mṛtam | sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te || oum namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyagurave vaiḍūrya prabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | tadyathā- oum bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahābhaiṣajye samudgate svāhā | prāḍmukhaṃ pālyetpīte muhartamanupāyayet’ ityādi | ru. vā hitam |

ab.seg: vamanārhaṃ dravyam - bībhatsaṃ vamanaṃ dadyāt viparītaṃ virecanam || 12 ||
kvāthyakvāthayormānam - kvāthyadravyasya kuḍavaṃ śrapayitvā jalāḍhake | ardhabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca vamaneṣvavacārayet || 13 ||
bheḍamatena vamane kvāthapānamātrā - kvāthapāne navaprasthā jyeṣṭhā mātrā prakīrtitā | madhyamā ṣaṇmitā proktā triprasthā ca kanīyasī ||14||
kalkādimānam - kalkacūrṇāvalehānāṃ viphalaṃ śreṣṭhamātrayā | madhyamāṃ dvipalāṃ vidyātkanīyā palasaṃmitā ||15||
vamanavegāḥ - vamane cā'pi vegāḥ syuraṣṭau pittāntamuttamāḥ | ṣaḍvegā madhyamā vegāścatvārastvavare smṛtāḥ ||16||
prasthamānam | vamane ca vireke ca tathā śoṇitamokṣaṇe | sārdhatrayodaśapalaṃ prasthamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 17 ||
atha doṣaviśeṣeṇa dravyaviśeṣamāha - kaphaṃ kaṭukatīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ pittaṃ svāduhimairjayet | susvādulavaṇāmloṣṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ vāyunā kapham ||18||
kṛṣṇā rāṭhaphalaṃ sindhu kaphe koṣṇajalaiḥ pibet | paṭolavāsānimbaiśca pitte śītajalaṃ pibet || 19 ||
saśleṣmavātapīḍāyāṃ sakṣīraṃ madanaṃ pibet | ajīrṇe koṣṇapānīyaiḥ sindhu pītvā vametsudhīḥ ||20||

div.ab: uttamaśuddhiparyantaṃ vamanasūcanārthaṃ vamanavidhimāha - vamanaṃ pāyayitvā ca jānumātrāsane sthitam | kaṇṭhameraṇḍanālena spṛśantaṃ vāmayedbhiṣak || 21 || lalāṭaṃ vamataḥ puṃsaḥ pārśve dve ca pradāpayet |

ab.seg: durvāntalakṣaṇamāha - praseko hadgrahaḥ koṭha: kaṇḍūrduśchardite bhavet ||22||

div.ab: ativānterlakṣaṇamāha - ativānte bhavet tṛṣṇā hikkodgārau visaṃjñitā | jihvāniḥsarpaṇaṃ cākṣṇorvyāvṛttirhanusaṃhatiḥ || 23 || raktacchardiḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ ca kaṇṭhapīḍā ca jāyate |

ab.seg: vamanotpannarogacikitsāmāha - vamanasyātiyoge tu mṛdu kuryādvirecanam || 24 ||
vamanāntaḥ praviṣṭāvāṃ jihvāyāṃ kavalagrahaḥ | snigdhāmlalavaṇairhṛdyairghṛtakṣīrarasairhitaḥ || 25 ||
phalānyamlāni khādeyustasya cānye'grato narā:| ni:sṛtāṃ tu tiladrākṣākalkaṃ liptvā praveśayet ||26||
vyāvṛtte'kṣṇi ghṛtābhyakte pīḍayecca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | hanumokṣe smṛtaḥ svedo nasyaṃ ca śleṣmavātahṛt ||27||
raktapittavidhānena raktacchardimupācaret | dhātrīrasāñjanośīralājācandanavāribhiḥ || 28 ||
manthaṃ kṛtvā pāyayecca saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram | śāmyantyanena tṛṣṇādyā pīḍāśchardisamudbhavāḥ ||29||
atha samyagvāntalakṣaṇamāha - hṛtkaṇṭhaśirasāṃ śuddhirdīptāgnitvaṃ ca lāghavam | kaphapittavināśaśca samyagvātasya lakṣaṇam || 30 ||
atha vāntasya pathyamāha - tato'parāhṇe dīptā'gniṃ mudgaṣaṣṭikaśālibhiḥ | hṛdyaiśca jāṅgalarasaiḥ kṛtvā yūṣaṃ ca bhojayet || 31 ||
suvāntasyaite pīḍādyarthaṃ na bhavanti ityāha - tandrā nidrāsyadaurgandhyaṃ kaṇḍūśca grahaṇī viṣam | suvāntasya na pīḍāyai bhavantyete kadācana || 32||
vamane yanniṣiddhaṃ tadāha - ajīrṇaṃ śītapānīyaṃ vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ tathā | snehābhyaṅgaṃ prakopaṃ ca dinaikaṃ varjayetsudhī: || 33 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa praṇītāyāṃ śārṅgādharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe vamanavidhirnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

div.head: atha virecanavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha virecanādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ - atha virecanavidhiḥ |
virecanaviṣayamāha - snigdhasvinnasya vāntasya dadyātsamyag virecanam |

vamane'pyakṛte sati doṣamāha - avāntasya tvadhaḥ srasto grahaṇīṃ chādayetkaphaḥ || 1 || mandāgniṃ gauravaṃ kuryājjanayedvā pravāhikām | athavā pācanairāmaṃ balāsaṃ ca vipācayet || 2 || snigdhasya snehanaiḥ kāryaṃ svedaiḥ svinnasya recanam |
svamate tu - virecanakālamāha - śaradṛtau vasante ca deyaṃ śuddhau virecanam || 3 || anyadātyayike kārye svedanaṃ śīlayedbudhaḥ |
śarīraśuddhau śodhanamuktaṃ tasya phalamāha - doṣāḥ kadācitkupyanti jitā laṅghanapācanaiḥ ||4|| ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ |

atha pittādau virecanam | pitte virecanaṃ yuñjyādāmodbhūte gade tathā || 5 || udare cacakārāt pittasaṃyoge'pi pittolbaṇe yojyam - uktaṃca vāgbhaṭe - ‘kaphe vidadhyādvamanaṃ saṃyāge vā kapholbeṇe | tadvadvirecanaṃ pitte’ iti | tathā'dhmāne koṣṭhaśuddhyai viśeṣataḥ ||

idānīṃ ye virecane niṣiddhāstānāha - bālavṛddhāvatisnigdhaḥ kṣatakṣīṇo bhayānvitaḥ || 6 || śrāntastṛṣārtaḥ sthūlaśca garbhiṇī ca navajvarī | navaprasūtā nārī ca mandāgniśca madātyayī || 7 || śalyārditaśca rūkṣaśca na virecyā vijānatā |

ab.seg: virecanayogyānāha - jīrṇajvarī garavyāpto vātaraktī bhagandarī || 8 ||
arśaḥ pāṇḍūdaragranthihṛdrogārucipīḍitāḥ | yonirogapramehārtā gulmaplīhavraṇārditāḥ || 9 ||
vidradhicchardivisphoṭavisūcīkuṣṭhasaṃyutāḥ | karṇanāsāśirovakragudameḍhrāmayānvitāḥ || 10 ||
plīhaśothākṣirogārtā: krimikṣīṇānilārditā: | śūlino mūtraghātārtā virekārhā narā matāḥ || 11 ||
atha virecanajñānārthaṃ koṣṭhabhedānāha - bahupitto mṛduḥ koṣṭho jahuśleṣmā ca madhyamaḥ | bahuvātaḥ krūrakoṣṭho durvirecya: sa kathyate || 12 ||
koṣṭhānurūpāṃ mātrāmāha - mṛdvī mātrā mṛdukoṣṭhe madhyakoṣṭhe ca madhyamā | krūre tīkṣṇā matā dravyairmṛdumadhyamatīkṣṇakaiḥ ||13||

div.ab: mṛdvādidravyāṇi kāni tāni ityata āha - mṛdurdrākṣāpayaścāmbutailairapi viricyate | madhyamastrivṛtātiktārājavṛkṣairviricyate || 14 || krūraḥ snukpayasāhemakṣīrīdantīphalādibhiḥ |
virekasyottamādimātrāyai vāṅgakailiṅgakaparimāṇamāha - mātrottamā virekasya triṃśadvegaiḥ kaphāntagā || 15|| vegairviṃśatibhirmadhyā hīnoktā daśavegakaiḥ |

idānīṃ kaṣāyaguṭikācūrṇātmakānāṃ virecanadravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha - dvipalaṃ śreṣṭhamākhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ ca palaṃ bhavet || 16|| palārdhaṃ ca kaṣāyāṇāṃ kanīyastu virecanam | kalkamodakacūrṇānāṃ karṣaṃ madhvājyalehataḥ || 17 || karṣadvayaṃ palaṃ vā'pi vayorogādyapekṣayā |

trivṛtācūrṇam | atha vātādīnāṃ koṣṭhamātrādibhedena katipayayogān darśayannāha - pittottare trivṛccūrṇaṃ drākṣākkāthādibhiḥ pibet ||18|| triphalākkāthagomūtraiḥ pibedvyoṣaṃ kaphārditaḥ | trivṛtsaindhavaśuṇṭhīnāṃ cūrṇamamlaiḥ pibennaraḥ || 19 || vātārdito virekāya jāṅgalānāṃ rasena vā |
eraṇḍatailaprayogaḥ | eraṇḍatailaṃ triphalākkāthena dviguṇena ca || 20 || yuktaṃ pītaṃ payobhirvā nacireṇa viricyate |

ab.seg: ṣaḍṛtuvirecanam | trivṛtā kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam || 21 ||
samṛdvīkārasakṣaudraṃ varṣākāle virecanam | trivṛddurālabhā mustā śarkarodīcyacandanam || 22 ||
drākṣāmbunā sayaṣṭyāhvaṃ śītalaṃ ca ghanātyaye | pippalī nāgaraṃ sindhu śyāmā ca trivṛtā saha ||23 ||
lihetkṣaudreṇa śiśire vasante ca virecanam | trivṛtā śarkarā tulyā grīṣmakāle virecanam ||24||

div.ab: tadyathā - trivṛtāṃ hapuṣāṃ dantīṃ saptalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm | svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca saṃcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayetryaham ||25|| eṣa sarvartuko yogaḥ snigdhānāṃ maladoṣahā |

ab.seg: abhayādimodakāḥ | abhayā maricaṃ śuṇṭhīviḍaṅgāmalakāni ca || 26 ||
pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ tvakpatraṃ mustameva ca | etāni samabhāgāni dantī ca dviguṇā bhavet ||27||
trivṛdaṣṭaguṇā jñeyā ṣaḍguṇā cātra śarkarā | madhunā modakānkṛtvā karṣamātrapramāṇataḥ || 28 ||
ekaikaṃ bhakṣayetprātaḥ śītaṃ cānu pibejjalam | tāvadviricyate janturyāvaduṣṇaṃ na sevate || 29 ||
pānāhāravihāreṣu bhavenniryantraṇaḥ sadā | viṣamajvaramandāgnipāṇḍukāsabhagandarān || 30 ||
durnāmakuṣṭhagulmārśogalagaṇḍabhramodarān | (vidīpikā'saṃmata:| dāhaplīhamehāṃśca yakṣmāṇaṃ nayanāmayān ||31||
vātarogāṃstathādhmānaṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṇi cāśmarīm| ) pṛṣṭapārśvorujaghanajaṅghodararujo jayet || 32 ||
satataṃ śīlanādeṣāṃ palitāni praṇāśayet | abhayāmodakā hyete rasāyanavarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||33||
virecanaṃ pītvā kiṃ kuryāttadāha -- pītvā virecanaṃ śītajalaiḥ saṃsicya cakṣuṣī | sugandhiṃ kiñcidāghrāya tāmbūlaṃ śīlayedvaram ||34||
nivātastho na vegāṃśca dhārayenna svapettathā | śītāmbu na spṛśet kkāpi koṣṇanīraṃ pibenmuhuḥ ||35||
samyagvāntalakṣaṇena samyagvirekalakṣaṇamāha - balāsauṣadhapittāni vāyurvānte yathā vrajet | rekāttathā malaṃ pittaṃ bheṣajaṃ ca kapho vrajet ||36||

div.ab: atha durviriktalakṣaṇamāha - durviriktasya nābhestu stabdhatvaṃ kukṣiśūlatā | purīṣavātasaṃgaśca kaṇḍūmaṇḍalagauravaḥ || 37 || vidāho'rucirādhmānaṃ bhramaśchardiśca jāyate |
athāsya durviriktasya punaḥ cikitsāmāha -- taṃ puna: pācanaiḥ snehaiḥ paktvā saṃsnehya recayet ||38|| tenā'syopadravā yānti dīptāgnerlaghutā bhavet |

ab.seg: idānīṃ virekātiśayasya lakṣaṇamāha - virekasyātiyogena mūrcchā bhraṃśo gudasya ca ||39||
śūlaṃ kaphātiyogaḥ syānmāṃsadhāvanasaṃnibham | medonibhaṃ jalābhāsaṃ raktaṃ vā'pi viricyate ||40||

div.ab: atha virekātiyogacikitsāmāha -- tasya śītāmbubhiḥ siktvā śarīraṃ taṇḍulāmbubhiḥ | madhumiśraistathā śītaiḥ kārayedvamanaṃ mṛdu || 41 || sahakāratvacaḥ kalko dadhnā sauvīrakeṇa vā | piṣṭvā nābhipralepena hantyatīsāramulbaṇam || 42 || ajākṣīraṃ rasaṃ vā'pi vaiṣkiraṃ hāriṇaṃ tathā | śālibhiḥ ṣaṣṭikaiḥ svalpaṃ masūrairvāpi bhojayet ||43|| śītaiḥ saṃgrāhibhirdravyaiḥ kuryāt saṃgrahaṇaṃ bhiṣak |
samyagviriktasya pācanādiprakāramāha - lāghavaṃ manasastuṣṭiranulomaṃ gate'nile || 44|| suviriktaṃ naraṃ jñātvā pācanaṃ pāyayenniśi |
virecanasya phalamāha -- indriyāṇāṃ balaṃ buddheḥ prasādaṃ vahnidīpanam || 45 || dhātusthairyaṃ vaya:sthairyaṃ bhavedrecanasevanāt |
kṛtavirecanasya pravātādīn niṣedhayati - pradātasevāśītāmbusnehābhyaṅgamajīrṇatām || 46 || vyāyāmaṃ maithunaṃ caiva na seveta virecitaḥ |

ab.seg: atha viriktasya pathyārthaṃ peyādi dravyāṇyāha - śāliṣaṣṭikamudgādyairyavāgūṃ bhojayetkṛtām || 47 ||
jaṅghālaviṣkirāṇāṃ vā rasaiḥ śālyodanaṃ hitam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharapraṇītāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe virecanavidhirnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

div.head: atha snehabastividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha bastividhiṃ vyākhyātuṃ pratijānīte - atha bastividhiḥ | tatrā'yaṃ sambandhaḥ - ‘pañcakarma vamī, reko, nirūho'nvāsa-nāvanam’ iti | vamanavirekayoruktatvātpāriśeṣyādvastividhimāha - bastirdvidhānuvāsākhyo nirūhaśca tataḥ param | bastibhirdīyate vasmāttasmādvastiriti smṛtaḥ || 1 ||
tayorlakṣaṇamāha - yaḥ snehairdīyate sa syādanuvāsananāmakaḥ | kaṣāya-kṣīra-tailairyo nirūhaḥ sa nigadyate || 2 ||

div.ab: athānuvāsanādīnāmanukramavidhānamāha -- tatrānuvāsanākhyo hi bastiryaḥ so'tra kathyate | pūrvameva tato bastirnirūhākhyo bhaviṣyati || 3 || nirūhāduttaraṃ caiva bastiḥ syāduttarābhidhaḥ |

ab.seg: athavā kathanakrameṇaiva bastiranuvāsanabheda eva ityata āha - anuvāsanabhedaśca mātrā bastirudīritaḥ || 4 ||

div.ab: tasya mātrāmāha - paladvayaṃ tasya mātrā tasmādardhā'pi vā bhavet |

ab.seg: anuvāsanayogyāḥ | anuvāsyastu rūkṣaḥ syāttīkṣṇāgniḥ kevalānilī ||5||

div.ab: athānuvāsane ye tyājyāstānāha - nānuvāsyastu kuṣṭhī syānmehī sthūlastathodarī | nāsthāpyā nānuvāsyāścājīrṇonmādatṛḍarditāḥ ||6|| śokamūrcchārucibhayaśvāsakāsakṣayāturāḥ |

bastikaraṇadravyāṇi - netraṃ kāryaṃ suvarṇādidhātubhirvṛkṣaveṇubhiḥ || 7 || nalairdantairviṣāṇāgrairmaṇibhirvā vidhīyate | ekavarṣāttu ṣaḍvarṣaṃ yāvanmānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam || 8 || tato dvādaśakaṃ yāvanmānaṃ syādaṣṭasaṃmitam | tataḥ paraṃ dvādaśabhiraṅgulairnetradīrghatā || 9 || mudgacchidraṃ kalāyāmaṃ chidraṃ kolāsthisaṃnibham | yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavennetraṃ ślakṣṇaṃ gopucchasannibham || 10|| āturāṅguṣṭhamānena mūle sthūlaṃ vidhīyate | kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhamagre ca guṭikāmukham || 11 || tanmūle karṇike dve ca kārye bhāgāccaturthakāt | yojayettatra bastiṃ ca bandhadvayavidhānataḥ || 12 || mṛgājaśūkaragavāṃ mahiṣasyāpi vā bhavet | mūtrakoṣasya bastistu tadalābhena carmajaḥ || 13 || kaṣāyaraktaḥ sumṛdurbastiḥ snigdho dṛḍho hitaḥ | vraṇabastestu netraṃ syācchlakṣṇamaṣṭāṅgulonmitam || 14|| mudgacchidraṃ gṛdhrapakṣanalikāpariṇāhi ca |
bastisevāguṇānāha - śarīropacayaṃ varṇaṃ balamārogyamāyuṣaḥ || 15 || kurute parivṛddhiṃ ca bastiḥ samyagupāsitaḥ |

ab.seg: atha basteḥ kālaniyamamāha - divā śīte vasante ca snehabastiḥ pradīyate || 16 ||
grīṣmavarṣāśaratkāle rātrau syādanuvāsanam | na cātisnigdhamaśanaṃ bhojayitvā'nuvāsayet ||17||
madaṃ mūrcchāṃ ca janayedvidhisnehaḥ prayojitaḥ | rūkṣaṃ bhuktavato'tyannaṃ balaṃ varṇaṃ ca dīyate || 18 ||
atha basterhīnātimātrayorniṣedhamāha - hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau smṛtau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || 19 ||
bastimātrā uttamasya palaiḥ ṣaḍbhirmadhyamasya palaistribhiḥ | palasyārdhena hīnasya yuktā mātrā'nuvāsane || 20 ||
sa ca snehaḥ kenopahito deyaḥ ? ityāha - śatāhvā saindhavābhyāṃ ca deyaṃ snehe ca cūrṇakam | tanmātrottamamadhyāntā ṣaṭcaturdvayamāṣakaiḥ || 21||
anuvāsanaviṣayamāha - virecanātsaptarātre gate jātabalāya ca | bhuktānnāyānuvāsyāya bastirdeyo'nuvāsanaḥ ||22||
athānuvāsyaṃ svabhyaktamuṣṇāmbusveditaṃ śanaiḥ | bhojayitvā yathāśāstraṃ kṛtacaṅkramaṇaṃ tataḥ ||23||
utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ yojayetsnehabastinā | suptasya vāmapārśvena vāmajaṅghāprasāriṇaḥ ||24 ||
kuñcitāparajaṅghasya netraṃ snigdhagude nyaset | vaddhvā bastimukhaṃ sūtrairvāmahastena dhārayet || 25 ||
pīḍayeddakṣiṇenaiva madhyavegena dhīradhīḥ | jṛmbhākāsakṣavādīṃśca bastikāle na kārayet ||26||
triṃśanmātrāmitaḥ kālaḥ prokto bastestu pīḍane | tataḥ praṇihitaḥ sneha uttāno vākśataṃ bhavet ||27||
jānumaṇḍalamāveṣṭya kuryācchoṭikayā yutam | ekā mātrā bhavedeṣā sarvatraiṣa viniścayaḥ. || 28 ||
prasāritaiḥ sarvagātrairyathāvīryaṃ visarpati | tāḍayettalayorenaṃ trīnvārāṃśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 29 ||
sphijoścaivaṃ tataḥ śroṇīṃ śayyāṃ caivotkṣipettataḥ | jāte vidhāne tu tataḥ kuryānnidrāṃ yathāsukham ||30||
samyaganuvāsitalakṣaṇamāha - sānilaḥ sapurīṣaśca snehaṃ pratyeti yasya vai | upadravaṃ vinā śīghraṃ sa samyaganuvāsitaḥ || 31||
snehāgate vidhimāha - jīrṇānnastvatha sāyāhne snehe pratyāgate punaḥ | laghvannaṃ bhojayet kāmaṃ dīptāgnistu naro yadi ||32||
anuvāsanavyāpattau pratīkāramāha - anuvāsitāya dātavyamitare'hni sukhodakam | dhānyaśuṇṭhīkaṣāyaṃ vā snehavyāpattināśanam ||33||

div.ab: athoktaprakāramupasaṃharan bastidānasaṃkhyāmāha - anena vidhinā sapta cāṣṭau vātha navā'pi vā | vidheyā bastayasteṣāmantarā tu nirūhaṇam || 34|| (dattastuprakṣiptamidam | prathamo bastiḥ snehayet bastivaṃkṣaṇaiḥ | samyagdatto dvitīyastu mūrdhasthamanilaṃ jayet ||35|| balaṃ varṇaṃ ca janayettṛtīyastu prayojitaḥ | caturthapañcamau dattau snehayetāṃ rasāsṛjī || 36 || ṣaṣṭho māṃsaṃ snehayati saptamo meda eva ca | aṣṭamo navamaścāpi majjānaṃ ca yathākramam || 37 || evaṃ śukragatāndoṣāndviguṇaḥ sādhu sādhayet | aṣṭādaśāṣṭādaśakānbastīnāṃ yo niṣevate || 38 || sa kuñjarabalo'pyaśvaṃ jayettulyo'maraprabhaḥ | rūkṣāya bahuvātāya snehabastiṃ dine dine || 39 || dadyādvaidyastathānyeṣāmanyāṃ bādhāmapāharet | sneho'lpamātro rūkṣāṇāṃ dīrghakālamanatyayaḥ ||40|| tathā nirūhaḥ snigdhānāmalpamātraḥ praśasyate |)

nivṛtte'nuvāsane snehe punarapi anuvāsanamāha - athavā yasya tatkālaṃ sneho niryāti kevalaḥ ||41|| tasyānyo'lpataro deyo na hi snihyatyatiṣṭhati | aśuddhasya malonmiśra: sneho naiti yadā punaḥ ||42|| tadā śaithilyamādhmānaṃ śūlaṃ śvāsaśca jāyate | pakvāśaye gurutvaṃ ca tatra dadyānnirūhaṇam || 43 || tīkṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇauṣadhairyuktā phalavartirhitā tathā | yathānulomanaṃ vāyurmalaṃ snehaśca jāyate || 44 || yathā virecanaṃ dadyāttīkṣṇaṃ nasyaṃ ca śasyate | yasya nopadravaṃ kuryātsnehabastiraniḥsṛtaḥ || 45 || sarvo'lpo vā vṛte raukṣyādupekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā |

ab.seg: ahorātrādaniḥsṛte pratīkāramāha -- anāyātaṃ tvahorātre snehaṃ saṃśodhanairharet | snehabastāvanāyāte nānyaḥ sneho vidhīyate || 46 ||

div.ab: athānuvāsanārthaṃ guḍūcyāditailamāha - guḍūcyeraṇḍapūtīkabhārṅgīvṛṣakarohiṣam || 47 || śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palonmitām | yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthānprasṛtonmitān || 48 || caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca | pacettailāḍhakaṃ peṣyairjīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 49 || anuvāsanametaddhi sarvavātavikāranut |

ab.seg: idānīṃ snehavyāpatcikitsāmāha ṣaṭsaptativyāpadastu‘ata ūrdhvaṃ vyāpado vakṣyāma: - tatra netracalitaṃ (1) vivartitaṃ (2) pārśvāvapīḍitaṃ (3,) atyutkṣiptam (4) avasannaṃ (5) tiryakkṣiptam (6) iti ṣaṭ praṇidhānadoṣāḥ, atisthūlaṃ (7) karkaśam (8) avanatam (9) aṇu (10) bhinnaṃ (11) sannikṛṣṭa-(12) viprakṛṣṭakarṇikaṃ (13) sūkṣmā- (14) tichidraṃ (15) atidīrgham (16) atihrasvaṃ (17) ityekādaśa netradoṣāḥ | bahalatā (18) alpatā (19) sacchidratā (20) prastīrṇatā (21) durbaddhatā (22) iti pañca bastidoṣāḥ | atipīḍitatā (23) śithilapīḍitatā (24) bhūyobhūyo'vapīḍanaṃ (25) kālātikramaḥ (26) iti catvāraḥ pīḍanadoṣāḥ | āmatā (27) hīnatā (28) atimātratā (29) atiśītatā (30) atyuṣṇatā (31) atitīkṣṇatā (32) atimṛdutā (33) atisnigdhatā (34) atirūkṣatā (35) atisāndratā (36) atidravatā (37) ityekādaśa dravyadoṣāḥ | (38) avāk- (39) śīrṣo-(40)cchīrṣa-nyubjo-(41) ttāna (42)saṅkucita (43) dehasthitatā-dakṣiṇā(44)pārśvaśāyina: pradānam, iti sapta śayyādoṣāḥ | evametāścatuścatvāriṃśat (44) vyāpado vaidyanimittāḥ | āturanimittā: pañcadaśa (15) āturopadravacikitsite vakṣyante (59)| snehastvaṣṭābhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pratihato na pratyāgacchati, tribhirdoṣaiḥ (1) aśanābhibhūto, (2) malavyāmiśro, (3) dūrānupraviṣṭo, (4) asvinnasya, (5) anuṣṇo, (6) alpaṃ bhuktavato, (7) alpaśceti (8) vaidyāturanimittā bhavanti (68) | 1 ayogastūbhayo-2 rādhmānaṃ, 3 parikartikā, 4 parisrāvaḥ, 5 pravāhikā, 6 hṛdayopasaraṇaṃ, 7 aṅgapragraho, 8 atiyogo jīvādānaṃ iti nava vyāpado vaidyanimittā bhavanti | (76) || suśru. ci. a. 36 jāyante bastikarmaṇā | dūṣitāt samudāyena tāścikitsyāstu suśrutāteṣāṃ cikitsā coktā suśrute - atha netre vicalite tathā caiva vivartite | gude kṣataṃ rujā vā syāttatra sadyaḥ kṣatakriyāḥ || atyutkṣipte'vasanne ca netre pāyau bhavedrujā | vidhiratrā'pi pittaghnaḥ kāryaḥ snehaiśca secanam || tiryakpraṇihite netre tathā pārśvāvapīḍite | mukhasyāvaraṇādbastirna samyakpratipadyate || ṛju netraṃ vidheyaṃ syāttatra samyagvijānatā | atisthūle karkaśe ca netre cāvanate tathā || gude bhavet kṣataṃ rukca sādhanaṃ pūrvavatsmṛtam | āsannakarṇike netre bhinne'ṇau vāpyapārthakaḥ || avaseko bhavedbastestasmāddoṣān vivarjayet | prakṛṣṭakarṇike raktaṃ gudamarmaprapīḍanāt || kṣaratyatrā'pi pittaghno vidhirbastiśca picchilaḥ | pratyāgacchaṃstataḥ kuryādrogān bastivighātajān || dīrghe mahāsrotasi ca jñeyamatyavapīḍavat | prastīrṇe bahale cāpi bastau durbaddhadoṣavat || bastāvalpe'lpatā vā'pi dravyasyā'lpaguṇā matāḥ | durbaddhe cāṇubhinne ca vijñeyaṃ bhinnanetravat || atiprapīḍito bastiḥ prayātyāmāśayaṃ tataḥ | vāterito nāsikābhyāṃ mukhato vā prapadyate || tatra tūrṇaṃ galāpīḍaṃ kuryāccāpyavadhūnanam | śiraḥkāyavirekau ca tīkṣṇau sekāṃśca śītalān || śanaiḥ prapīḍito bastiḥ pakvādhānaṃ na gacchati | na ca sampādayatyarthāṃstasmādyuktaṃ prapīḍayet || bhūyo bhūyo'vapīḍena vāyurantaḥ prapīḍyate | tenādhmānaṃ rujaścogrā yathāsvaṃ tatra bastayaḥ || kālātikramaṇātkleśo vyādhiścābhipravardhate| tatra vyādhibalaghnaṃ tu bhūyo vastiṃ nidhāpayet || gudopadehaśophau tu sneho'pakva: karoti hi | tatra saṃśodhano bastirhitaṃ cāpi virecanam || hīnamātrāvubhau bastī nātikāryakarau matau | atimātrau tathā'nāhaklamātīsārakārakau || mūrcchāṃ dāhamatīsāraṃ pittaṃ cātyuṣṇatīkṣṇakau | mṛduśītāvubhau vātavibandhādhmānakārakau || tatra hīnādiṣu hitaḥ pratyanīkaḥ kriyāvidhiḥ| tatra sāndre tanuṃ basti tanau sāndraṃ ca dāpayet|| snigdho'tijāḍyakṛdrūkṣastambhādhmānakṛducyate | basti rūkṣamatisnigdhe snigdhaṃ rūkṣe ca dāpayet || atipīḍitavaddoṣān vidhiṃ cāpyavaśīrṣake |ucchīryake samunnāhaṃ bastiḥ kuryācca mehanam || tatrottaro hito bastiḥ sukhinnasya sukhāvahaḥ | nyubjasya bastirnāpnoti pakvādhānaṃ vimārgagaḥ || hṛdgudaṃ bādhate cātra vāyuḥ koṣṭhamathāpi ca | uttānasyāvṛte mārge bastirnāntaḥ prapadyate || netrasaṃvejanabhrānto vāyuścāntaḥ prakupyati | dehe saṅkucite dattaḥ sakthnorapyubhayastathā || na samyaganilāviṣṭo bastiḥ pratyeti dehinaḥ | sthitasya bastirdattastu kṣipramāyātyavāṅmukhaḥ || na cāśayaṃ tarpayati tasmānnārthakaro hi saḥ | nāpnoti bastirdattastu kṛtsnaṃ pakvāśayaṃ punaḥ || dakṣiṇāśritapārśvasya vāmapārśvānugo yataḥ | nyubjādīnāṃ pradānaṃ ca basternaiva praśasyate || paścādanilakopo'tra yathāsvaṃ tatra kārayet | vyāpadaḥ snehabastestu vakṣyante taccikitsite || ayogādyāstu vakṣyāmi vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ | anuṣṇo'lpauṣadho hīno bastirnaiti prayojitaḥ || viṣṭambhādhmānaśūlaiśca tamayogaṃ pracakṣate | tatra tīkṣṇā hito bastistīkṣṇaṃ cāpi virecanam || saśeṣānne'thavā bhukte bahudoṣe ca yojitaḥ | atyāśitasyātibahurbastirmandoṣṇa eva ca || anuṣṇalavaṇasneho hyatimātro'thavā punaḥ | tathā bahupurīṣaśca kṣipramādhmāpayennaram || hṛtkaṭīpārśvapṛṣṭheṣu śūlaṃ tatrātidāruṇam | tatra tīkṣṇataro bastirhitaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇo rūkṣo bastiḥ prayojitaḥ | sapittaṃ kopayedvāyuṃ kuryācca parikartikām || nābhibastigudaṃ tatra chinattīvātidehinaḥ | picchābastirhitastasya snehaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ || atyamlalavaṇastīkṣṇaḥ parisrāvāya kalpate | daurbalyamaṅgasādaśca jāyate tatra dehinaḥ || parisravettataḥ pittaṃ dāhaṃ sañjanayedgude | picchābastirhitastatra bastiḥ kṣīraghṛtena ca || pravāhikā bhavettīkṣṇānnirūhāt sānuvāsanam | sadāhaśūlaṃ kṛcchreṇa kaphāsṛgupaveśyate || picchābastirhitastatra payasā caiva bhojanam | sarpirmadhurakaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ cāpyanuvāsanam || atitīkṣṇo nirūho vā savāte cānuvāsanaḥ | hṛdayasyopasaraṇaṃ kurute cāṅgapīḍanam || doṣaistatra rujāstāstā mado mūrcchāṅgagauravam | sarvadoṣaharaṃ bastiṃ śodhanaṃ tatra dāpayet || rūkṣasya bahuvātasya tathā duḥśayitasya ca | bastiraṅgagrahaṃ kuryādrūkṣo mṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ || tatrāṅgasādaḥ prastambho jumbhodveṣṭanavepakāḥ | parvabhedaśca tatreṣṭā: svedābhyañjanabastayaḥ || atyuṣṇatīkṣṇo'tibahurdatto'tisveditasya ca | alpadoṣasya vā bastiratiyogāya kalpate || virecanātiyogena samānaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam | picchābastiprayogaśca tatra śītaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || atiyogātparaṃ yatra jīvādānaṃ viriktavat | deyastatra hitaścāpi picchābastiḥ saśoṇitaḥ || navaitā vyāpado yāstu nirūhaṃ pratyudāhṛtāḥ | snehabastiṣvapi hitā vijñeyāḥ kuśalairiha || ityuktā vyāpadaḥ sarvāḥ salakṣaṇacikitsitāḥ | bhiṣajā ca tathā kāryaṃ yathaitā na bhavanti hi || iti ||50||

div.ab: anuvāsane pānādipathyamāha - pānāhāravihāraśca parihāraśca kṛtsnaśaḥ | snehapānasamāḥ kāryā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 51 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe snehabastividhirnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha nirūhabastividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: atha ṣaṣṭho'dhpāyaḥ | atha (pāriśeṣyāt) nirūhabastividhimāha - tatra tadbhedānāha - nirūhabastirbahudhā bhidyate kāraṇāntarai: | taireva tasya nāmāni kṛtāti muniṣuṅgavaiḥ ||1||
nirūhasyāparaṃ nāma proktamāsthāpanaṃ budhai: | svasthānasthāpanāddoṣadhātūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ matam || 2 ||
atha doṣādyapekṣayā mātrāmāha - nirūhasya pramāṇaṃ ca prasthaṃ pādottaraṃ param | madhyamaṃ prasthamuddiṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ ca kuḍavāstraya: ||3||
athānāsthāpanīyānāha - atisnigdhotkliṣṭadoṣau kṣatoraska: kṛśastathā | ādhmānacchardihikkārśa: kāsaśvāsaprapīḍitaḥ || 4 ||
gudaśophātisārārto viṣūcīkuṣṭhasaṃyutaḥ | garbhiṇī madhumehī ca nāsthāpyaśca jalodarī || 5 ||
atha nirūhyānāha - vātavyādhāvudāvarte vātāsṛgviṣamajvare | mūrcchātṛṣṇodarānāhamūtrakṛcchrāśmarīṣu ca ||6||
vṛddhāsṛgdaramandāgniprameheṣu nirūhaṇam | śūle'mlapitte hṛdroge yojayedvidhivadbudha: || 7 ||

div.ab: yena prakāreṇa nirūhaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ tadāha - utsṛṣṭānilaviṇmūtraṃ snigdhasvinnamabhojitam | madhyāhne gṛhamadhye ca yathāyogyaṃ nirūhayet || 8 || snnehabastividhānena budhaḥ kuryānnirūhaṇam | jāte nirūhe ca tato bhavedutkaṭakāsanaḥ || 9 || tiṣṭhenmuhūrtamātraṃ tu nirūhāgamanecchayā | anāyātaṃ muhūrtaṃ tu nirūhaṃ śodhanairharet ||10|| nirūhaireva matimānkṣāramūtrāmlasaindhavaiḥ |

ab.seg: atha sunirūḍhalakṣaṇamāha - yasya krameṇa gacchanti viṭpittakaphavāyavaḥ | lāghavaṃ copajāyeta sunirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||11 ||
atha durnirūhalakṣaṇamāha -- yasya syādvastiralpālpavego hīnamalānilaḥ | mūrcchārtijāḍyārujimān durnirūhaṃ tamādiśet ||12||
nirūhasya bastidānavaddeyatāmāha - anena vidhinā yuñjyānnirūhaṃ bastidānavat | dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathocitam || 13||
atha bhojanakramamāha - pittaśleṣmānilāviṣṭaṃ kṣīrayūṣarasaiḥ kramāt | nirūhaṃ bhojayitvā ca tatastamanuvāsayet || 14 ||
idānīṃ bālavṛddhayormṛdubastimāha - sukumārasya vṛddhasya bālasya ca mṛdurhitaḥ | bastistīkṣṇaḥ prayuktastu teṣāṃ hanyādbalāyuṣī ||15||
idānīṃ bastīnāṃ dānakramamāha - dadyādutkleśanaṃ pūrvaṃ madhye doṣaharaṃ tataḥ | paścāt saṃśamanīyaṃ ca dadyādbastiṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 16 ||
atha teṣāṃ svarūpāṇyāha -- utkleśanabastiḥ | eraṇḍabījaṃ madhukaṃ pippalī saindhavaṃ vacā | hapuṣā phalakalkaṃ ca bastirutkleśanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||17||
atha doṣaharabastimāha - śatāhvā madhukaṃ bilvaṃ kauṭajaṃ phalameva ca | sakāñjikaḥ sagomūtro bastirdoṣaharo mataḥ || 18||
atha teṣāṃ doṣaharamāha -- priyaṅgu madhukaṃ mustaṃ tathaiva ca rasāñjanam | sakṣīraḥ śasyate bastirdoṣāṇāṃ śamanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||19||
śodhanabastimāha - śodhanadravyani:kvāthaistatkalkaiḥ snehsaindhavaiḥ | yuktyā khajena mathitā bastaya: śodhanā: smṛtā: ||20||
lekhanabastimāha - triphalākkāthagomūtrakṣaudrakṣārasamāyutāḥ | uṣakādipratīvāpā bastayo lekhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||21||
atha bṛṃhaṇabastīnāha - bṛṃhaṇadravyaniṣkvāthā: kalkairmadhurakairyutāḥ | sarpirmāṃsarasopetā bastayo bṛṃhaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 ||

div.ab: picchilabastimāha - badaryai-rāvatī-śelu-śālmalī-dhanvanāgarāḥ | kṣīrasiddhāḥ kṣaudrayuktā nāmrā picchilasaṃjñitāḥ | ajorabhraiṇarudhirairyuktā deyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 23 || mātrā picchilabastīnāṃ palairdvādaśabhirmatā |

atha nirūhārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇapūrvakaṃ vidhānamāha - dattvādau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtidvayam || 24 || vinirmathya tato dadyātsnehasya prasṛtitrayam | ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtiṃ kṣipet ||25|| saṃmūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtisaṃmitam | kṣiptvā vimathya dadyācca nirūhaṃ kulaśo bhiṣak ||26|| vāte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ dadyātsnehasya ṣaṭpalam | pitte catuṣpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ snehaṃ dadyātpalatrayam || 27 || kaphe ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣipetsnehaṃ catuṣpalam |

ab.seg: madhutailikasaṃjñaṃ bastividhānamāha - eraṇḍakkāthatulyāṃśaṃ madhutailaṃ palāṃśakam || 28 ||
śatapuṣpāpalārdhena saindhavārdhena saṃyutam | madhutailakasaṃjño'yaṃ basti: khajaviloḍita: || 29 ||
medogulmakṛmiplīhamalodāvartanāśana:| balavarṇakaraścaiva vṛṣyo dīpanabṛṃhaṇaḥ || 30 ||
atha yāpanabastimāha - kṣaudrā-jya-kṣīra-tailānāṃ prasṛtaṃ prasṛtaṃ bhavet | hapuṣāsaindhavākṣāṃśo basti: syāddīpanaḥ para: || 31 ||
atha yuktarathabastimāha - eraṇḍamūlaniṣkvātho madhutailaṃ sasaindhavam | eṣa yuktaratho basti: savacāpippallīphalaḥ || 32 ||
atha siddhabastimāha - pañcamūlasya niṣkvāthastailaṃ māgadhikā madhu | sasaindhava: samadhukaḥ siddhabastiriti smṛta: || 33 ||
pathyāpathyamāha - snānamuṣṇodakaiḥ kuryāt divā svapnamajīrṇatām | varjayedaparaṃ sarvam, ācaretsnehabastivat || 34 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nirūhabasti- vidhiradhyāya: samāpta: || 6 ||

div.head: atha uttarabastividhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | pāriśeṣyāduttarabastimāha - ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bastimuttarasaṃjñitam | dvādaśāṅgulakaṃ netraṃ madhye ca kṛtakarṇikam || 1 || mālatīpuṣpavṛntābhaṃ chidraṃ sarṣapasannibham |
snehamātrāmāha - pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇāmadho mātrā dvikārṣikā || 2 || tadūrdhvaṃ palamātrā ca snehasyoktā bhiṣagvaraiḥ |

athottarabastervidhānamāha - athāsthāpanaśuddhasya tṛptasya snānabhojanaiḥ || 3 || sthitasya jānumātre ca pīṭhe'nviṣya śalākayā | snigdhayā meḍhramārge ca tato netraṃ niyojayet || 4 || śanaiḥ śanairghṛtābhyaktaṃ meḍhrarandhre'ṅgulāni ṣaṭ | tato'vapīḍayedbastiṃ śanairnetraṃ ca nirharet || 5 || tataḥ pratyāgate snehe snehabastikramo hitaḥ |

ab.seg: puṃsāmuttarabastinetramuktvā strīṇāmuttarabastimāha - strīṇāṃ kaniṣṭhikāsthūlanetraṃ kuryāddaśāṃgulam || 6 ||
mudgapraveśayogyaṃ ca yonyantaścaturaṅgulam | dvyaṅgulaṃ mūtramārge ca sūkṣmaṃ netraṃ niyojayet || 7 ||
bālānāmapi netraparimāṇamāha - mūtrakṛcchravikāreṣu bālānāṃ tvekamaṅgulam | śanairniṣkampamādheyaṃ sūkṣmanetraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 8 ||
athāpatyamūtramārgayorviṣayatvāt snehaparimāṇamāha - yonimārgeṣu nārīṇāṃ snehamātrā dvipālikī | mūtramārge palonmānā bālānāṃ ca dvikārṣikī ||9||

div.ab: atha strīṇāmuttarabastiḥ kathaṃ yojyaḥ ? ityāha - uttānāyai striyai dadyādūrdhvajānvai vicakṣaṇaḥ | apratyāgacchati bhiṣagbastāvuttarasaṃjñite || 10 || bhūyo bastiṃ nidadhyācca saṃyuktaiḥ śodhanairgaṇaiḥ | phalavartiṃ nidadhyādvā yonimārge dṛḍhāṃ bhiṣak || 11|| sūtrairvinirmitāṃ snigdhāṃ śodhanadravyasaṃyutām | dahyamāne tathā bastau dadyādbastiṃ viśāradaḥ || 12 || kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa payasā śītalena vā | bastiḥ śukrarujaḥ puṃsāṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam|| 13|| hanyāduttarabastistu nocito mehināṃ kkacit |
uttarabasteḥ snehabastisamānāyāḥ guṇadoṣānāha - samyagdattasya liṅgāni vyāpadaḥ krama eva ca || 14 || basteruttarasaṃjñasya samānaṃ snehabastinā |

ab.seg: atha pūrvoddiṣṭāṃ phalavartimāha - ghṛtābhyakte gude kṣepyā ślakṣṇā svāṅguṣṭhasannibhā ||15||
malapravartanī vartiḥ phalavartiśca sā smṛtā | iti śrīdāmodarasūnuśārṅgadharācāryapraṇītaśārṅgadhara- saṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe uttarabastividhirnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||

div.head: atha nasyavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha nasyavidhiḥ | nasyasya niruktimāha - nasyaṃ tatkathyate nīrairnāsāgrāhyaṃ yadauṣadham | nāvanaṃ nasyakarmeti tasya nāmadvayaṃ matam || 1 ||
nasyabhedānāha - nasyabhedo dvidhā prokto recanaḥ snehanastathā | recanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ snehanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ matam || 2 ||
nasyakarmakālamāha - kaphapittāniladhvaṃse pūrvamadhyāparāhṇake | dine tu gṛhyate nasyaṃ rātrāvapyutkaṭe gade || 3 ||

div.ab: nasyaṃ yasminkāle tyājyaṃ yaiśca tyājyaṃ tānāha - nasyaṃ tyajedbhojanānte durdine cāpatarpite | tathā navapratiśyāyī garbhiṇī garadūṣitaḥ || 4 || ajīrṇī dattabastiśca pītasnehodakāsavaḥ | kruddhaḥ śokābhibhūtaśca tṛṣārto vṛddhabālakau || 5 || vegāvarodhī snātaśca snātukāmaśca varjavet |
nasyārhānarhānāha -- aṣṭavarṣasya bālasya nasyakarma samācaret || 6 || aśītivarṣādūrdhvaṃ ca nāvanaṃ naiva dīyate |
atha vairecanaṃ nasyamāha - atha vairecanaṃ nasyaṃ grāhyaṃ tailaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ || 7 || tīkṣṇabheṣajasiddhairvā snehaiḥ kvāthai rasaistathā |
virecanasya mātrāmāha - nāsikārandhrayoraṣṭau ṣaṭ catvāraśca bindavaḥ || 8 || pratyekaṃ recane yojyā mukhyamadhyāntyamātrayā |

nasyārthaṃ dravyāṇāṃ parimāṇamāha - nasyakarmaṇi dātavyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ tīkṣṇamauṣadham || 9 || hiṅgu syādyavamātraṃ tu māṣaikaṃ saindhavaṃ matam | kṣīraṃ caivāṣṭaśāṇaṃ syātpānīyaṃ ca trikārṣikam ||10|| kārṣikaṃ madhuraṃ dravyaṃ nasyakarmaṇi yojayet |
