atha śirovirecanabhedānāha - bhavapīḍapradhamanau dvau bhedāvaparau smṛtau || 11 || śirovirecanasyātra tau tu deyaṃ yathāyatham |

athāvapīḍapradhamanayoḥ svarūpamāha - kalkīkṛtādauṣadhādyaḥ pīḍito niḥsṛto rasaḥ || 12|| so'vapīḍaḥ samuddiṣṭastīkṣṇadravyasamudbhavaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgulā dvivaktrā yā nāḍī cūrṇaṃ tathā dhamet ||13|| tīkṣṇaṃ kolamitaṃ vakravātaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hi tat |

ab.seg: ūrdhvajatrugate roge kaphaje svarasaṃkṣaye || 14 ||
arocake pratiśyāye śiraḥśūle ca pīnase | śophā'pasmārakuṣṭheṣu nasyaṃ vairecanaṃ hitam || 15 ||

div.ab: atha bṛṃhaṇanasyaviṣayamāha - bhīrustrīkṛśabālānāṃ nasyaṃ snehena śasyate |
yeṣu avapīḍanaṃ yujyate tānāha - galaroge sannipāte nidrāyāṃ viṣamajvare || 16 || manovikāre kṛmiṣu yujyate cāvapīḍanam |
yeṣu pradhamanaṃ yujyate tānāha -- atyantotkaṭadoṣeṣu visaṃjñeṣu ca dīyate || 17 || cūrṇaṃ pradhamanaṃ dhīraistaddhi tīkṣṇataraṃ yataḥ |
idānīmavapīḍanapradhamanayoḥ katipayayogānāha - guḍādinasyam | nasyaṃ syādguḍaśuṇṭhībhyāṃ -

ab.seg: pippalyādinasyam | pippalyāḥ saindhavena vā || 18 ||
jalapiṣṭena tenākṣikarṇanāsāśirogadāḥ | manyāhanugalodbhūtā naśyanti bhujapṛṣṭhajāḥ || 19 ||

div.ab: madhūkasārādinasyam - madhūkasārakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vacāmaricasaindhavaiḥ | nasyaṃ koṣṇajale piṣṭaṃ dadyātsaṃjñāprabodhanam ||20|| apasmāre tathonmāde saṃnipāte'patantrake |
tandrāyāṃ saindhavādinasyam - saindhavaṃ śvetamaricaṃ sarṣapāḥ kuṣṭhameva ca || 21 || bastamūtreṇa piṣṭāni nasyaṃ tandrānivāraṇam |

ab.seg: maricādinasyam - rohitamatsyapittena bhāvitaṃ saindhavaṃ vacā || 22 ||
maricaṃ pippalī śuṇṭhī kaṅkolaṃ laśunaṃ puram | kaṭphalaṃ ceti taccūrṇaṃ deyaṃ pradhamanaṃ budhaiḥ || 23 ||

div.ab: iti virecananasyakalpanā | atha bṛṃhaṇanasyakalpanāmāha – atha bṛṃhaṇanasyasya kalpanā kathyate'dhunā | marśaśca pratimarśaśca dvau bhedau snehanī matau || 24 || marśasya tarpaṇī mātrā mukhyā śāṇaiḥ smṛtā'ṣṭabhiḥ | madhyamā ca catuḥśāṇairhīnā śāṇamitā smṛtā ||25|| ekaikasmiṃstu mātreyaṃ deyā nāsāpuṭe budhaiḥ | marśasya dvitrivelaṃ vā vīkṣya doṣabalābalam || 26 || ekāntaraṃ dvyantaraṃ vā nasyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tryahaṃ pañcāhamathavā saptāhaṃ vā suyantritam || 27 || marśe śirovireke ca vyāpado vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ | doṣotkleśātkṣayāccaiva vijñeyāstā yathākramam ||28|| doṣotkleśanimittāsu yuñjyādvamanaśodhanam | atha kṣayanimittāsu yathāsvaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ hitam || 29 || śironāsākṣirogeṣu sūryāvartārdhabhedake | dantaroge bale hīne manyābahvaṃsaje gade || 30 || mukhaśoṣe karṇanāde vātapittagade tathā | akālapalite caiva keśaśmaśruprapātane || 31 || yujyate bṛṃhaṇaṃ nasyaṃ snehairvā madhuradravaiḥ |

ab.seg: kuṅkumanasyam| saśarkaraṃ paya:piṣṭaṃ bhṛṣṭamājyena kuṅkumam || 32 ||
nasyaprayogato hanyādvātaraktabhavā rujaḥ | bhrūśaṅkhākṣiśiraḥkarṇasūryāvartārdhabhedakān || 33 ||
anyabṛṃhaṇanasyamāha - nasyaṃ syādaṇutailena tathā nārāyaṇena vā | māṣādinā vā sarpirbhistattadbheṣajasādhitaiḥ || 34 ||
doṣeṣu snehavyavasthā | tailaṃ kaphe syādvāte ca kevale pavane vasām | dadyānnasyaṃ sadā pitte sarpirmajjānameva ca || 35 ||
māṣādinasyam | māṣā'tmaguptārāsnābhirbalārubukarohiṣaiḥ | kṛto'śvagandhayā kvātho hiṅgusaindhavasaṃyutaḥ || 36 ||
koṣṇo nasyaprayogeṇa pakṣāghātaṃ sakampanam | jayedarditavātaṃ ca manyāstambhāpabāhukau || 37 ||

div.ab: atha pratimarśamāha - pratimarśasya mātrā tu dvidvibindumitā matā | pratyekaśo nastakayoḥ sneheneti viniścitam || 38 || snehe granthidvayaṃ yāvannimagnā coddhṛtā tataḥ | tarjanīyaṃ sravedbinduṃ sā mātrā bindusaṃjñitā ||39|| evaṃvidhairbindusaṃjñairaṣṭabhiḥ śāṇa ucyate | sa deyo marśanasye tu pratimarśo dvibindukaḥ ||40|| samayāḥ pratimarśasya budhaiḥ proktāścaturdaśa | prabhāte dantakāṣṭhānte gṛhānnirgamane tathā ||41|| vyāyāmādhvavyavāyānte viṇmūtrānte'ñjane kṛte | kavalānte bhojanānte divāsuptotthite tathā || 42|| vamanānte tathā sāyaṃ pratimarśaḥ prayujyate | īṣaducchikkanātsneho yadā vaktraṃ prapadyate || 43 || nasye niṣiktaṃ taṃ vidyātpratimarśaṃ pramāṇataḥ | ucchindanna pibeccaitanniṣṭhīvenmukhamāgatam || 44 || kṣīṇe tṛṣṇāsyaśoṣārte bāle vṛddhe ca yujyate | pratimarśena śāmyanti rogāścaivordhvajatrujāḥ ||45|| valīpalitanāśaśca balamindriyajaṃ bhavet |
atha palite nasyam | bibhītanimbakambhārī śivā śeluśca kākinī ||46|| ekaikatailanasyena palitaṃ naśyati dhruvam |

ab.seg: atha nasyagrahaṇe nasyavidhimāha -- atha nasyavidhiṃ vakṣye nasyagrahaṇahetave || 47 ||
deśe vātarajomukte kṛtadantanigharṣaṇam | viśuddhaṃ dhūmapānena svinnabhālagalaṃ tathā || 48 ||
uttānaśāyinaṃ kiṃcitpralambaśirasaṃ naram | āstīrṇahastapādaṃ ca vastrācchāditalocanam || 49 ||
samunnamitanāsāgraṃ vaidyo nasyena yojayet | koṣṇamacchinnadhāraṃ ca hematārādiśuktibhiḥ || 50 ||
śuktyā vā yatra yuktyā vā plotairvā nasyamācaret | nasyeṣvāsicyamāneṣu śiro naiva prakampayet || 51 ||
na kupyenna prabhāṣeta nocchidenna hasettathā | etairhi vihitaḥ sneho naivāntaḥ saṃprapadyate || 52 ||
tataḥ kāsapratiśyāyaśiro'kṣigadasaṃbhavaḥ | śṛṅgāṭakamabhiplāvya sthāpayenna gileddravam || 53 ||

div.ab: atha nasyadhāraṇārthaṃ mātrāsaṃkhyāmāha - pañca sapta daśaiva syurmātrā nasyasya dhāraṇe |

ab.seg: nasyadānānantaraṃ kiṃ kartavyam ? ityata āha - upaviśyātha niṣṭhīvennāsāvaktragataṃ dravam || 54 ||
vāmadakṣiṇapārśvābhyāṃ niṣṭhīvetsaṃmukhe na hi | nīte nasye manastāpaṃ rajaḥ krodhaṃ ca saṃtyajet ||55||
śayīta nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca prottāno vākśataṃ naraḥ | tathā vairecanaścānte dhūmo vā kavalo hitaḥ || 56 ||
atha nasye kati lakṣaṇāni bhavanti ? ityāha - nasye trīṇyupadiṣṭāni lakṣaṇāni prayogataḥ | śuddhihīnātiyogāni viśeṣācchāstracintakaiḥ ||57||
nasyaśuddhilakṣaṇamāha - lāghavaṃ manasaḥ śuddhiḥ srotasāṃ vyādhisaṃkṣayaḥ | cittendriyaprasādaśca śirasaḥ śuddhilakṣaṇam || 58 ||
atha hīnaśuddherlakṣaṇamāha - kaṇḍūpadehau gurutā srotasāṃ kaphasaṃsravaḥ | mūrdhni hīnaviśuddhestu lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || 59 ||
atiśayaśuddhasya lakṣaṇamāha - mastuluṅgāgamo vātavṛddhirindriyavibhramaḥ | śūnyatā śirasaścāpi mūrdhni gāḍhaṃ virecite ||60||
hīnātiśuddhau cikitsāmāha - hīnātiśuddhe śirasi kaphavātaghnamācaret | samyak viśuddhe śirasi sarpirnasye niṣecayet ||61||

div.ab: atisnigdhalakṣaṇacikitsāmāha - kaphaprasekaḥ śiraso gurutendriyavibhramaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ tadatisnigdhe tatra rūkṣaṃ pradāpayet || 62 || bhojayeccānabhiṣyandi tasyācārikamādiśet |

prakaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - vamanaṃ recanaṃ nasyaṃ nirūhaścānuvāsanam | etāni pañca karmāṇi kathitāni munīśvaraiḥ ||63|| iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nasyavidhi- rnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

div.head: atha dhūmapānavidhiradhyāyaḥ
div.ab: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha dhūmapānavidhiḥ | dhūmasaṃkhyā - dhūmastuanyatra trividhaḥ proktaḥ | tathāhi carake - ‘prāyogikaḥ snehikaḥ doṣavairecanika:’ iti | tatra prāyogike kāsaharaṃ, vairecanike vāmanīyamantarbhāvyam | vāgbhaṭe'pi snigdho madhyastīkṣṇaśceti | atrā'pi snigdhe śamanavraṇadhūpanabṛṃhaṇānāmantarbhāvaḥ | tīkṣṇe recanavāmayoriti virodhaparihāraḥ || ṣaḍvidhaḥ proktaḥ śamano bṛṃhaṇastathā | recanaḥ kāsahā caiva vāmano ghrāṇadhūpanaḥ || 1 || śamanasya tu paryāyau madhya: prāyogikastathā | bṛṃhaṇasyāpi paryāyau snehiko mṛdureva ca || 2 || recanasyāpi paryāyau śodhanastīkṣṇa eva ca |

ab.seg: yeṣāṃ dhūmo na vihitastānāha - adhūmārhāśca khalvete śrānto bhītaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||3||
dattabastirviriktaśca rātrau jāgaritastathā | pipāsitaśca dāhārtastāluśoṣī tathodarī || 4 ||
śiro'bhitāpī timirī chardyādhmānaprapīḍitaḥ | kṣatoraskaḥ pramehārtaḥ pāṇḍurogī ca garbhiṇī ||5||
rūkṣaḥ kṣīṇo'bhyavahṛtakṣīrakṣaudraghṛtāsavaḥ | bhuktānnadadhimatsyaśca bālo vṛddhaḥ kṛśastathā || 6 ||

akāle dhūmapāne doṣaṃ tatpratīkāraṃ cāha - akāle cātipītaśca dhūmaḥ kuryādupadravāntaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe - ‘raktapittāndhyabādhiryatṛṇmūrcchāmadamehakṛt’ iti | | tatreṣṭaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ nāvanāñjanatarpaṇam || 7 ||
sarpirikṣurasaṃ drākṣāṃ payo vā śarkarāmbu vā | madhurāmlau rasau vāpi śamanāya pradāpayet || 8 ||

div.ab: dhūmaḥ kadā gṛhyate ko vā guṇa ityāha - dhūmastu dvādaśādvarṣādgṛhyate'śītikānna ca | kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyānmanyāhanuśirorujaḥ || 9 || vātaśleṣmavikārāṃśca hanyāddhūmaḥ suyojitaḥ | dhūmaprayogātpuruṣaḥ prasannendriyavāṅmanāḥ || 10 || dṛḍhakeśadvijaśmaśru: sugandhivadano bhavet |

ab.seg: yayā nāḍyā dhūmo gṛhyate tadvidhānamāha - dhūmanāḍī bhavettatra trikhaṇḍā ca triparvikā || 11 ||
kaniṣṭhikāparīṇāhā rājamāṣāgamāntarā | dhūmanāḍī bhaveddīrghā śamane rogiṇo'ṅgulaiḥ || 12 ||
catvāriṃśanmitaistadvaddvātriṃśadbhirmṛdau matā | tīkṣṇe caturviṃśatibhiḥ kāsaghnī ṣoḍaśonmitaiḥ ||13||
daśāṅgulairvāmanīye tathā syādvraṇanāḍikā | kalāyamaṇḍalasthūlā kulitthāgamarandhrakā || 14 ||

div.ab: idānīṃ dhūmapānārthaṃ īṣikāvidhānamāha - atheṣikāṃ pralimpecca suślakṣṇāṃ dvādaśāṅgulām | dhūmadravyasya kalkena lepaścāṣṭāṅgulaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15|| kalkaṃ karṣamitaṃ liptvā chāyāśuṣkaṃ ca kārayet | īṣikāmapanīyātha snehāktāṃ vartimādarāt ||16|| aṅgārairdīpitāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā netrasya randhrake | vadanena pibeddhūmaṃ vadanenaiva saṃtyajet || 17 || nāsikābhyāṃ tataḥ pītvā mukhenaiva vametsudhīḥ | śarāvasaṃpuṭe kṣiptvā kalkamaṅgāradīpitam || 18 || chidre netraṃ niveśyātha vraṇaṃ tenaiva dhūpayet |

śamanadhūmādau yaddravyakalko dhūmārthaṃ deyastadāha - elādikalkaṃ śamane snigdhaṃ sarjarasaṃ mṛdau || 19 || recane tīkṣṇakalkaṃ ca kāsaghnaṃ kṣudrikoṣaṇam | vāmane snāyucarmādyaṃ dadyāddhūmasya pānakam || 20 || vraṇe nimbavacādyaṃ ca dhūpanaṃ saṃpraśasyate |

ab.seg: bālagrahādau dhūmapānamāha - aparājito dhūpaḥ anye'pi dhūmā geheṣu kartavyā rogaśāntaye ||21||
mayūrapicchaṃ nimbasya patrāṇi bṛhatīphalam | maricaṃ hiṅgu māṃsī ca bījaṃ kārpāsasaṃbhavam ||22||
chāgaromāhinirmokaṃ viṣṭhā vaiḍālikī tathā | gajadantaśca taccūrṇaṃ kiṃciddhṛtavimiśritam ||23||
geheṣu dhūpanaṃ dattaṃ sarvānbālagrahāñjayet | piśācānrākṣasāñjitvā sarvajvaraharaṃ bhavet || 24 ||
dhūmapāne pathyaṃ, netradravyāṇyāha - parihārastu dhūmeṣu kāryo recananasyavat | netrāṇi dhātujānyāhurnalavaṃśādijānyapi || 25 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe dhūmapānavidhirnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||

div.head: atha gaṇḍūṣavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha gaṇḍūṣakavalapratisāraṇavidhiḥ | ūrṣvagatadoṣaharatvasāmānyāt dhūmapānamabhidhāya saṃpratigaṇḍūṣaṃ kavalaṃ pratisāraṇavidhimārabhyate || caturvidhaḥsuśrute - snehī, prasādī, saṃśodhanaropaṇāvityanyathā caturvidhatvamuktam | tathā tantrāntare vairecanasaṃśamanābhyāṃ ṣadvidhatvamuktaṃ tathāpyatra saṃśodhane vairecanasya prasādane śamanasyāntarbhāvānna virodhaḥ | syādgaṇḍūṣaḥ snaihikaḥ śamanastathā | śodhano ropaṇaścaiva kavalaścāpi tadvidhaḥ || 1 ||
snigdhaistu snaihiko vāte svāduśītaiḥ prasādanaḥ | pitte kaṭvamlalavaṇairuṣṇaiḥ saṃśodhanaḥ kaphe || 2 ||
kaṣāyatiktamadhuraiḥ kaduṣṇo ropaṇo vraṇe | catuṣprakāro gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaścāpi kīrtitaḥ || 3 ||
asaṃcārī mukhe pūrṇe gaṇḍūṣaḥ kavalaścaraḥ | tatra draveṇa gaṇḍūṣaḥ kalkena kavalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 ||
dadyāddraveṣu cūrṇaṃ ca gaṇḍūṣe kolamātrakam | karṣapramāṇaḥ kalkaśca dīyate kavale budhaiḥ || 5 ||

div.ab: kasmin vayasi gaṇḍūṣo dhāryate kiyatparimitā gaṇḍūṣāḥ kāryā ityāha - dhāryante pañcamādvarṣādgaṇḍūṣakavalādayaḥ | gaṇḍūṣānsusthitaḥ kuryātsvinnabhālagalādikaḥ ||6|| manuṣyastrīṃstathā pañca sapta vā doṣanāśanāt | kaphapūrṇāsyatā yāvacchedo doṣasya vā bhavet || 7 || netraghrāṇasrutiryāvattāvadgaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam |

vāte snaihikagaṇḍūṣamāha - tilakalkodakaṃ kṣīraṃ sneho vā snaihike hitaḥ ||8|| tilā nīlotpalaṃ sarpiḥ śarkarā kṣīrameva ca | sakṣaudro hanuvaktrastho gaṇḍūṣo dāhanāśanaḥ || 9 || vaiśadyaṃ janayatyāsye saṃdadhāti mukhavraṇān | dāhatṛṣṇāpraśamanaṃ madhugaṇḍūṣadhāraṇam || 10 || viṣakṣārāgnidagdhe ca sarpirdhāryaṃ payo'thavā | tailasaindhavagaṇḍūṣo dantacāle praśasyate || 11 || śoṣaṃ mukhasya vairasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣaḥ kāñjiko jayet | sindhutrikaṭurājībhirārdrakeṇa kaphe hitaḥ || 12 || triphalāmadhugaṇḍūṣaḥ kaphāsṛkpittanāśanaḥ |

atha mukhapāke gaṇḍūṣaḥ - (pratisāraṇacūrṇam) dārvī guḍūcī triphalā drākṣā jātyāśca pallavāḥ ||13|| yavāsaśceti takkāthaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśakṣaudrasaṃyutaḥ | śīto mukhe dhṛto hanyānmukhapākaṃ tridoṣajam ||14|| yasyauṣadhasya gaṇḍūṣastasya vai pratisāraṇam | kavalaścāpi tasyaiva jñeyo'tra kuśalairnaraiḥ || 15 || keśaraṃ mātuluṅgasya saindhavoṣaṇasaṃyutam | hanyātkavalato jāḍyamaruciṃ kaphavātajām ||16|| kalko'valehacūrṇaṃ ca trividhaṃ pratisāraṇam | aṅgulyagragṛhītaṃ ca yathāsvaṃ mukharogiṇam ||17|| kuṣṭhaṃ dārvī samaṅgā ca pāṭhā tiktā ca pītikā | tejanī mukhalodhre ca cūrṇaṃ syātpratisāraṇam ||18|| raktasnutiṃ dantapīḍāṃ śothaṃ dāhaṃ ca nāśayet |
hīnayogamāha - hīnayogātkaphotkleśo rasājñānārucī tathā ||19|| atiyogānmukhe pākaḥ śoṣastṛṣṇā klamo bhavet |

ab.seg: śuddhagaṇḍūṣalakṣaṇamāha - vyādherapacayastuṣṭirvaiśadyaṃ vaktralāghavam || 20 ||
indriyāṇāṃ prasādaśca gaṇḍūṣe śuddhilakṣaṇam | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadhareṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe gaṇḍūṣādi- vidhirnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||

div.head: atha lepanādividhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha kavalādīnāṃ vidhimabhidhāya saṃpratilepamūrddhatailakarṇapūraṇavidhimārabhyate | tatra tāvatpralepanāmānyāha - ālepasya ca nāmāni lipto lepaśca lepanam | doṣaghno viṣahā varṇyo mukhalepastridhā mataḥ || 1 ||
tripramāṇaścaturbhāgatribhāgā'rdhāṅgulonnata: | ārdro vyādhiharaḥ sa syācchuṣko dūṣayati cchavim ||2||
doṣaghno lepo yathā - punarnavāṃ dāru śuṇṭhīṃ siddhārthaṃ śigrumeva ca | piṣṭvā caivāranālena pralepa: sarvaśothajit || 3 ||

div.ab: atha dāhe lepaḥ vibhītaphalamajjāyā lepo dāhārtināśanaḥ |

ab.seg: atha daśāṅgalepo visarpaśothavraṇādau – (daśāṅgalepaḥ) śirīṣaṃ madhuyaṣṭī ca tagaraṃ raktacandanam || 4 ||
elā māṃsī niśāyugmaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vālakameva ca | iti saṃcūrṇya lopo'yaṃ pañcamāṃśaghṛtapluta: || 5 ||
jalena kriyate sujñairdaśāṅga iti saṃjñitaḥ | visarpānviṣavisphoṭāñśothānduṣṭavraṇāñjayet ||6||
viṣaghno lepo yathā - ajādugdhatilairlepo navanītena saṃyutaḥ | śothamāruṣkaraṃ hanti lepo vā kṛṣṇamṛttikaiḥ ||7||
atha kīṭaghnalepaḥ - lāṅgalyativiṣālābujālinīmūlabījakaiḥ | lepo dhānyāmbusaṃpiṣṭa: kīṭavisphoṭanāśanaḥ || 8 ||
varṇyo lepo yathā - raktacandanamañjiṣṭhālodhrakuṣṭhapriyaṅgavaḥ | vaṭāṅkurā masūrāśca vyaṅgaghnā mukhakāntidāḥ || 9 ||
mātuluṅgajaṭā sarpiḥ śilā gośakṛto rasaḥ | mukhakāntikaro lepaḥ piṭikāvyaṅgakālajit ||10||
lodhradhānyavacālepastāruṇyapiṭikāpahaḥ | tadvadgorocanāyuktaṃ maricaṃ mukhalepanam || 11 ||
siddhārthakavacālodhrasaindhavaiśca pralepanam | vyaṅgeṣu cārjunatvagvā mañjiṣṭhā vā samākṣikā || 12||
lepaḥ sanavatīto vā śvetāśvakhurajā maṣī | arkakṣīraharidrābhyāṃ mardayitvā vilepanāt || 13 ||
mukhakārṣṇyaṃ śamaṃ yāti cirakālodbhavaṃ dhruvam | vaṭasya pāṇḍupatrāṇi mālatī raktacandanam || 14 ||
kuṣṭhaṃ kālīyakaṃ lodhramebhirlepaṃ prayojayet | tāruṇyapiṭikāvyaṅganīlikādivināśanam || 15 ||
athāruṃṣikāyāṃ lepaḥ - purāṇamatha piṇyākaṃ purīṣaṃ kukkuṭasya ca | mūtrapiṣṭa: pralepo'yaṃ śīghraṃ hanyādaruṃṣikām ||16||
khādirāriṣṭajambūnāṃ tvagbhirvā mūtrasaṃyutaiḥ | kuṭajatvaksaindhavaṃ ca lepo hanyādaruṃṣikām ||17||

div.ab: dāruṇe lepaḥ - priyālabījamadhukakuṣṭhamāṣaiḥ sasaindhavaiḥ | kāryo dāruṇake mūrdhni pralepo madhusaṃyutaḥ || 18 || dugdhena khākhasaṃ bījaṃ pralepāddāruṇaṃ jayet | āmrabījasya cūrṇaṃ tu śivācūrṇasamaṃ dvayam || 19 || dugdhapiṣṭha: pralepo'yaṃ dāruṇaṃ hanti dāruṇam |

athendralupte - rasastiktapaṭolasya patrāṇāṃ tadvilepanāt || 20 || indraluptaṃ śamaṃ yāti tribhireva dinairdhruvam | indraluptāpaho lepo madhunā bṛhatīrasaḥ || 21 || guñjāmūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi bhallātakaraso'pi vā | gokṣurastilapuṣpāṇi tulye ca madhusarpiṣī || 22 || śiraḥpralepanaṃ tena keśasaṃvardhanaṃ param | hastidantamaṣīṃ kṛtvā chāgīdugdhaṃ rasāñjanam ||29|| romāṇyanena jāyante lepātpāṇitaleṣvapi | yaṣṭīndīvaramṛdvīkātailājyakṣīralepanaiḥ || 24 || indraphalaṃ śamaṃ yāti keśāḥ syuḥ saghanā dṛḍhā: | catuṣpadānāṃ tvagromanakhaśrṛṅgāsthibhasmabhiḥ || 25 || tailena saha lepo'yaṃ romasaṃjananaḥ paraḥ |

palite lepāḥ indravāruṇikābījatailenābhyaṅgamācaret || 26 || pratyahaṃ tena jāyante kuntalā bhṛṅgasaṃnibhāḥ | ayorajo bhṛṅgarājastriphalā kṛṣṇamṛttikā || 27 || sthitamikṣurase māsaṃ lepanātpalitaṃ jayet | dhātrīphalatrayaṃ pathye dve tathaikaṃ bibhītakam || 28 || pañcāmramajjā lohasya karṣaikaṃ ca pradīyate | piṣṭvā lohamaye bhāṇḍe sthāpayeduṣitaṃ niśi ||29|| lepo'yaṃ hanti nacirādakālapalitaṃ mahat | triphalā nīlikāpatraṃ lohaṃ bhṛṅgarajaḥ samam ||30|| avimūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ lepātkṛṣṇīkaraṃ smṛtam | triphalā lohacūrṇaṃ ca dāḍimatvagbisaṃ tathā ||31|| pratyekaṃ pañcapalikaṃ cūrṇaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | bhṛṅgarājarasasyāpi prasthaṣaṭkaṃ pradāpayet || 32 || kṣisvā lohamaye pātre bhūmimadhye nidhāpayet | māsamekaṃ tataḥ kuryācchāgīdugdhena lepanam || 33 || kūrce śirasi rātrau ca saṃveṣṭyairaṇḍapatrakaiḥ | svapetprātastataḥ kuryātsnānaṃ tena ca jāyate || 34 || palitasya vināśaśca tribhirlepairna saṃśayaḥ |

ab.seg: atha romaśātane - śaṅkhacūrṇasya bhāgā dvau haritālaṃ ca bhāgikam ||35||
manaḥśilā cārdhabhāgā svarjikā caikabhāgikā | lepo'yaṃ vāripiṣṭastu keśānutpāṭya dīyate || 36 ||
anayā lepayuktyā ca saptavelaṃ prayuktayā | nirmūlaṃ keśasthānaṃ syātkṣapaṇasya śiro yathā ||37||
tālakaṃ śāṇayugmaṃ syātṣaṭśāṇaṃ śaṅkhacūrṇakam| dviśāṇikaṃ palāśasya kṣāraṃ dattvā pramardayet || 38 ||
kadalīdaṇḍatoyena ravipatrarasena vā | asyāpi saptabhirlepai romṇāṃ śātanamuttamam || 39 ||
śvitre lepāḥ | suvarṇapuṣpī kāsīsaṃ viḍaṅgāni manaḥśilā | rocanā saindhavaṃ caiva lepanācchvitranāśanam || 40 ||
vāyasyeḍagajākuṣṭhakṛṣṇābhirguṭikā kṛtā | bastamūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭā pralepācchvitranāśinī || 41 ||
tālakaṃ śāṇamātraṃ syāccatuḥśāṇā ca bākucī | gomūtrapiṣṭaṃ taccūrṇaṃ lepanācchvitranāśanam || 42 ||
bākucī vetaso lākṣā kākodumvarikā kaṇā | rasāñjanamayaścūrṇaṃ tilāḥ kṛṣṇāstadekataḥ || 43 ||
cūrṇayitvā gavāṃ pittaiḥ piṣṭvā ca guṭikā kṛtā | asyāḥ pralepācchvitrāṇi praṇaśyantyativegataḥ ||44||

atha śvitranāśanāyāha - suvarṇapuṣpī sonīśabdavācyo viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tadabhāve bṛhadbalā grāhyā apare ca sthūlakaṃ gṛhṇanti | śīśaṃ sīsakaṃ | sīsakasthāne kāsīsamiti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | rocanā gorocanā prasiddhā | lepo'tra jalena | vāyasī kākamācī | eḍagajaḥ prapunnāṭaḥ tasya bījāni | kṛṣṇā pippalī | vatsa iti govatsaḥ | athavā chāgaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ | tālako haritālaḥ | bākucī somarājī tasyāḥ phalāni prasiddhāni śeṣaṃ sugamam | bākucī prasiddhā vetaso niculaḥ jalavetasa iti loke vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ | lākṣā laktakajananī kākondumbarikā kaṭumariśabdavācyā | kaṇā pippalī| rasāñjanaṃ prasiddham | tadabhāve dāru haridrā grāhyā tatsaṃbhavatvāt | ayaścūrṇaṃ lohacūrṇaṃ | kṛṣṇāstilā iti | śvetatilaniṣedhārtham | gavāṃ pittairiti | goyakṛdekakhaṇḍaikadeśalagnaṃ dravarūpaṃ pittamiti vācyam | tadabhāve gomūtreṇa pracāraḥ iti sarvatra || 40-44 ||
atha sidhme lepaḥ - dhātrī sarjarasaścaiva yavakṣāraśca cūrṇitaḥ | sauvīreṇa pralepo'yaṃ prayojyaḥ sidhmanāśane || 45 ||
dārvī mūlabījāni tālakaṃ suradāru ca | tāmbūlapatraṃ sarvāṇi kārṣikāṇi pṛthakpṛthak ||49||
śaṅkhacūrṇaṃ śāṇamātraṃ sarvāṇyekatra kārayet | lepo'yaṃ vāriṇā piṣṭaḥ sidhmanāṃ nāśanaḥ paraḥ ||47||
atha netraroge lepaḥ- harītakī saindhavaṃ ca gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam | biḍālako jale piṣṭaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ || 48 ||
rasāñjanaṃ vyoṣayutaṃ saṃpiṣṭaṃ vaṭakīkṛtam | kaṇḍūpākānvitāṃ hanti lepādañjananāmikām||49||
atha kaṇḍvādau lepaḥ | prapunnāṭasya bījāni bākucī sarṣapāstilāḥ | kuṣṭhaṃ niśādvayaṃ mustaṃ piṣṭvā takreṇa caikataḥ || 50 ||
pralepādasya naśyanti dadrūkanḍūvicarcikāḥ | hemakṣīrī viḍaṅgāni daradaṃ gandhakastathā || 51 ||
dadrughnaḥ kuṣṭhasindūre sarvāṇyekatra mardayet | dhattūranimbatāmbūlīpatrāṇāṃ svarasaiḥ pṛthak || 52 ||
asya pralepamātreṇa pāmādadrūvicarcikāḥ | kaṇḍūśca rasakaścaiva praśamaṃ yānti vegataḥ || 53 ||
dūrvā'bhayā saindhavaṃ ca cakramardaḥ kuṭherakaḥ | ebhistakrayuto lepaḥ kaṇḍūdadrūvināśanaḥ || 54 ||
dūrvāniśāyuto lepaḥ kaṇḍūpāmāvināśanaḥ | kṛmidadrūharaścaiva śītapittāpahaḥ smṛtaḥ || 55 ||
siddhārtharajanīkuṣṭhaprapunnāṭatilaiḥ saha | kaṭutailena saṃmiśraṃ dadrughnaṃ ca pralepanam || 56 ||
atha vātavisarpādau lepāḥ - rāvā nīlotpalaṃ dāru candanaṃ madhukaṃ balā | ghṛtakṣīrayuto lepo vātavīsarpanāśanaḥ || 57 ||
mṛṇālaṃ candanaṃ lodhramuśīraṃ kamalotpalam | sārivāmalakī pathyā lepaḥ pittavisarpanut ||58||
triphalā padmakośīraṃ samaṅgā karavīrakam | nalamūlamanantā ca lepaḥ śleṣmavisarpahā || 59 ||

div.ab: vātarakte pittarakte ca yogaḥ - māṃsī sarjaraso lodhraṃ madhukaṃ sahareṇukam | mūrvā nīlotpalaṃ padmaṃ śirīṣakusumaiḥ saha || 60 || pralepaḥ pittavātāsre śatadhautaghṛtaplutaḥ | āmalaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ tu piṣṭaṃ kāñjikavāribhiḥ || 61 || jayenmūrdhni pralepena raktaṃ nāsikayā sṛtam |

ab.seg: śiroroge yogāḥ | kuṣṭhameraṇḍatailena lepātkāñjikapeṣitam || 62 ||
śiro'rtiṃ vātajāṃ hanyātpuṣpaṃ vā mucukundajam | devadāru nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ naladaṃ viśvabheṣajam || 63||
sakāñjikaḥ snehayukto lepo vātaśiro'rtinut | candanośīravaṣṭyāhvabalāvyāghranakhotpalaiḥ ||64||
kṣīrapiṣṭaiḥ pralepaḥ syādraktapittaśiro'rtijit | dhātrīkaseruhrīberapadmapadmakacandanaiḥ || 65 ||
dūrvośīranalānāṃ ca mūlaiḥ kuryātpralepanam | śiro'rtiṃ pittajāṃ hanyādraktapittarujaṃ tathā ||66||
hareṇunataśaileyamustailāgarudārubhiḥ | māṃsīrāsnārubūkaiśca koṣṇo lepaḥ kaphārtinut ||67||
śuṇṭhīkuṣṭhaprapunnāṭadevakāṣṭhaiḥ sarohiṣaiḥ | sukhoṣṇairmūtrapiṣṭaiśca lepaḥ śleṣmaśiro'rtinut ||68||
sārivākuṣṭhamadhukavacākṛṣṇotpalaistathā | lepaḥ sakāñjikasnehaḥ sūryāvartārdhabhedayoḥ || 69 ||
varī nīlotpalaṃ dūrvā tilāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ punarnavā | śaṅkhake'nantavāte ca lepaḥ sarvaśiro'rtijit ||70||

div.ab: athānyo lepavidhiḥ kathyate - atha lepavidhiścānyaḥ procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ | dvau tasya kathitau bhedau pralepākhyapradehakau ||71|| carmārdraṃ māhiṣaṃ yadvatpronnataṃ sā mitistayoḥ | śītastanurviśoṣī ca pralepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 72 || ārdro ghanastathoṣṇaḥ syātpradehaḥ śleṣmavātahā | romābhimukhamādeyau pralepākhyapradehakau || 73 || vīryaṃ samyagviśatyāśu romakūpaiḥ śirāmukhaiḥ | na rātrau lepanaṃ kuryācchuṣyamāṇaṃ na dhārayet ||74|| śuṣyamāṇamupekṣeta pradehaṃ pīḍanaṃ prati | (tamasādīpikāsammataḥ | pihito hyūṣmā romakūpamukhe sthitaḥ ||75|| vinā lepena niryāti rātrau no lepayedataḥ|) rātrāvapi pralepādividhiḥ kāryo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 76 || apakkaśothe gambhīre raktaśleṣmasamudbhave |

idānīṃ vraṇaviṣayakramamāha - ādau śothaharo lepo dvitīyo raktasecanaḥ || 77 || tṛtīyaścopanāhaḥ syāccaturthaḥ pāṭanakramaḥ | pañcamaḥ śodhano bhūyātṣaṣṭho ropaṇa iṣyate || 78 || saptamo varṇakaraṇo vraṇasyaite kramānmatāḥ |

ab.seg: idānīṃ sa yathetyanena vraṇasya saptaviṣayakramāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ yogānāha - bījapūrajaṭā hiṃsrā devadāru mahauṣadham || 79 ||
rāsnāgnimantho lepo'yaṃ vātaśothavināśanaḥ | madhukaṃ candanaṃ mūrvā nalamūlaṃ ca padmakam || 80 ||
uśīraṃ vālakaṃ padmaṃ pittaśothe pralepanam | kṛṣṇā purāṇapiṇyākaṃ śigrutvaksikatā śivā ||81||
mūtrapiṣṭa sukhoṣṇo'yaṃ pradehaḥ śleṣmaśothahā | dve niśe candane dve ca śivā dūrvā punarnavā || 82 ||
uśīraṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ gairikaṃ ca rasāñjanam | āgantuje raktaje ca śothe kuryātpralepanam ||83||
śaṇamūlakaśigrūṇāṃ phalāni tilasarṣapāḥ | savacaḥ kiṇvamatasī pradehaḥ pācanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||84||
dantī citrakamūlatvaksnuhyarkapayasī guḍaḥ | bhallātakāsthi kāsīsaṃ saindhavaṃ dāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||85||
ciribilvo'gniko dantī citrako hayamārakaḥ | kapotakaṅkagṛdhrāṇāṃ malaṃ lepena dāraṇam || 86 ||
svarjikāyāvaśūkādyā: kṣārā lepena dāraṇāḥ | hemakṣīryāṃstathā lepo vraṇe paramadāraṇaḥ || 87 ||
| tilasaindhavayaṣṭyāhvanimbapatraniśāyugaiḥ | trivṛddhṛtayutaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ pralepo vraṇaśodhanaḥ || 88 ||
nimbapatraghṛtakṣaudradārvīmadhukasaṃyutaḥ | tilaiśca saha saṃyukto lepaḥ śodhanaropaṇaḥ ||89||
karañjāriṣṭanirguṇḍī lepo hanyādvraṇakrimīn | laśunasyāthavā lepo hiṅgunimbabhavo'thavā ||90||
nimbapatraṃ tilā dantī trivṛtsaindhavamākṣikam | duṣṭavraṇapraśamano lepaḥ śodhanaropaṇaḥ || 91 ||
athodaraśūlādau lepaḥ - madanasya phalaṃ tiktāṃ piṣṭvā kāñjikavāriṇā | koṣṇaṃ kuryānnābhilepaṃ śūlaśāntirbhavettataḥ || 92 ||
idānīṃ vraṇaropaṇakramadvāreṇa sarveṣāṃ vraṇajātīnāṃ śamanayogānāha tatra tāvatpūrvaṃ vidradhau - śigruśephālikairaṇḍayavagodhūmamudgakaiḥ | sukhoṣṇo bahalo lepaḥ prayojyo vātavidradhau ||93||
paittike sarpiṣā lājāmadhukaiḥ śarkarānvitaiḥ | pralimpetkṣīrapiṣṭairvā payasyośīracandanaiḥ || 94 ||
iṣṭikā sikatā lohakiṭṭaṃ gośakṛtā saha | sukhoṣṇa: syātpradeho'yaṃ mūtraiḥ syācchleṣmavidradhau ||95||
raktacandanamañjiṣṭhāniśāmadhukagairikaiḥ | kṣīreṇa vidradhau lepo raktāgantunimittaje || 96 ||
atha galagaṇḍe - niculaḥ śigrubījāni daśamūlamathāpi vā | pradeho vātagaṇḍeṣu sukhoṣṇaḥ saṃpradīyate || 97 ||
devadāru viśālā ca kaphagaṇḍe pradehakaḥ | sarṣapāriṣṭapatrāṇi dagdhvā bhallātakaiḥ saha || 98 ||
chāgamūtreṇa saṃpiṣṭamapacīghnaṃ pralepanam | sarṣapāḥ śigrubījāni śaṇabījātasīyavā: || 99 ||
mūlakasya ca bījāni takreṇāmlena peṣayet | gaṇḍamālārbudaṃ gaṇḍaṃ lepenānena śāmyati ||100||
atha gṛdhrasyādiṣu lepaḥ - takṣayitvā kṣureṇāṅgaṃ kevalānilapīḍitam | tatra pradehaṃ dadyācca piṣṭaṃ guñjāphalaiḥ kṛtam ||101||
tenāpabāhujā pīḍā viśvācī gṛdhrasī tathā | anyāpi vātajā pīḍā praśamaṃ yāti vegataḥ ||102||
atha ślīpade - dhattūrairaṇḍanirguṇḍīvarṣābhūśigrusarṣapaiḥ | pralepaḥ śrīpadaṃ hanti cirotthamapi dāruṇam || 103||
atha aṇḍavṛddhau lepaḥ | ajājīhapuṣākuṣṭhameraṇḍabadarānvitam | kāñjikena tu saṃpiṣṭaṃ kuraṇḍaghnaṃ pralepanam || 104 ||
athopadaṃśe - karavīrasya mūlena paripiṣṭena vāriṇā | asādhyāpi vrajatyastaṃ liṅgotthā rukpralepanāt ||105||
dahetkaṭāhe triphalāṃ sā maṣī madhusaṃyutā | upadaṃśe pralepo'yaṃ sadyo ropayati vraṇam || 106 ||
rasāñjanaṃ śirīṣeṇa pathyayā ca samanvitam | sakṣaudraṃ lepanaṃ yojyamupadaṃśagadāpaham || 107 ||

div.ab: athāgnidagdhe - agnidagdhe tugākṣīrīplakṣacandanagairikaiḥ | sāmṛtaiḥ sarpiṣā snigdhairālepaṃ kārayedbhiṣak || 108|| tindukītvakkaṣāyairvā ghṛtamiśraiḥ pralepayet | yavāndagdhvā maṣī kāryā tailena yutayā tayā ||109|| dadyātsarvāgnidagdheṣu pralepo vraṇaropaṇaḥ |

idānīṃ lepaprakaraṇatvādanyānapi lepānāha tatrādau bhagasaṃkocaḥ - palāśodumbaraphalaistilatailasamanvitaiḥ || 110 || madhunā yonimālimpedgāḍhīkaraṇamuttamam | mākandaphalasaṃyuktamadhukarpūralepanāt || 111 || gate'pi yauvane strīṇāṃ yonirgāḍhā'tijāyate |

ab.seg: atha liṅgavṛddhau yonisaṃkoce - maricaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇā tagaraṃ bṛhatīphalam || 112 ||
apāmārgastilāḥ kuṣṭhaṃ yavā māṣāśca sarṣapāḥ | aśvagandhā ca taccūrṇaṃ madhunā saha yojayet || 113||
asya saṃtatalepena mardanācca prajāyate | liṅgavṛddhiḥ stanotsedhaḥ saṃhatirbhujakarṇayoḥ || 114||
sitāśvagandhāsindhūtthachāgakṣīrairghṛtaṃ pacet | tallepānmardanālliṅgavṛddhiḥ saṃjāyate parā || 115 ||
indravāruṇikāpatrarasaiḥ sūtaṃ vimardayet | raktasya karavīrasya kāṣṭhena ca muhurmuhuḥ || 116 ||
talliptaliṅgasaṃyogādyonidrāvo'bhijāyate | tāmbūlapatracūrṇaṃ tu cūrṇaṃ kuṣṭhaśivābhavam || 117 ||
vāriṇā lepanaṃ kuryādgātradaurgandhyanāśanam | kulitthasaktavaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī candanajaṃ rajaḥ ||118||
saktavaścaṇakasyaiva tvakcaivaikatra kārayet | svedadaurgandhyanāśaśca jāyate'syāvadhūlanāt || 119||
vacā sauvarcalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rajanyau maricāni ca | etallepaprabhāveṇa vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 120 ||

div.ab: atha mūrdhatailam - abhyaṅgapariṣekaśca picurbastiriti kramāt | mūrdhatailaṃ caturdhā syādbalavacca yathottaram || 121 || trayo'bhyaṅgādayaḥ pūrve prasiddhāḥ sarvataḥ smṛtāḥ |

athābhyaṅgabastiprakāramāha - śirobastividhiścātra procyate sujñasaṃmataḥ ||122|| śirobastiścarmaṇaḥ syāddvimukho dvādaśāṅgulaḥ | śiraḥpramāṇaṃ taṃ badhvā mastake māṣapiṣṭakaiḥ || 126|| sandhirodhaṃ vidhāyāśu snehaiḥ koṣṇaiḥ prapūrayet | tāvaddhāryastu yāvatsyānnāsākarṇamukhasrutiḥ ||124|| vedanopaśamo vāpi mātrāṇāṃ vā sahasrakam | vinā bhojanamevātra śirobastiḥ praśasyate ||225|| prayojyastu śirobastiḥ pañcasaptāhameva vā | vimocya śiraso bastiṃ gṛhṇīyācca samantataḥ ||126|| ūrdhvakāyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇanīraiḥ snānaṃ ca kārayet | anena durjayā rogā vātajā yānti saṃkṣayam ||127|| śiraḥkampādayastena sarvakāleṣu yujyate |

pūrvamuktaṃ lepamūrdhatailakarṇapūraṇaṃ tadidānīṃ karṇapūraṇamāha - svedayetkarṇadeśaṃ tu kiñcinnuḥ pārśvaśāyinaḥ ||128|| mūtraiḥ snehai rasaiḥ koṣṇaistataḥ śrotraṃ prapūrayet | karṇaṃ ca pūritaṃ rakṣecchataṃ pañca śatāni vā || 129 || sahasraṃ vāpi mātrāṇāṃ śrotrakaṇṭhaśirogade | svajānunaḥ karāvartaṃ kuryācchoṭikayā yutam || 130|| eṣā mātrā bhavedekā sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ || rasādyai: pūraṇaṃ karṇe bhojanātprākpraśasyate ||131|| tailādyaiḥ pūraṇaṃ karṇe bhāskare'stamupāgate |

ab.seg: karṇaśūle yogāḥ - pītārkapatramājyena liptaṃ vahnau pratāpayet || 132||
tadrasaḥ śravaṇe kṣiptaḥ karṇaśūlaharaḥ paraḥ | karṇaśūlāture koṣṇaṃ bastamūtraṃ sasaindhavam || 133 ||
nikṣipettena śāmyanti śūlapākādikā rujaḥ | śṛṅgaberaṃ ca madhukaṃ madhu saindhavamāmalam || 134 ||
tilaparṇīrasastailaṃ ṭaṅkaṇaṃ nimbukadravam | kaduṣṇaṃ karṇayordeyametadvā vedanāpaham || 135 ||
kapitthamātuluṅgāmlaśṛṅgaberarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sukhoṣṇaiḥ pūrayetkarṇaṃ karṇaśūlopaśāntaye || 136 ||
arkāṅkurānamlapiṣṭāṃstailāktāṃllavaṇānvitān | saṃnidadhyātsnuhīkāṇḍe korite tacchadāvṛte || 137 ||
puṭapākakramaṃ kṛtvā rasaistacca prapūrayet | sukhoṣṇaistena śāmyanti karṇapīḍāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ||138||

div.ab: dīpikātailam | mahataḥ pañcamūlasya kāṇḍānyaṣṭāṅgulāni ca | kṣaumeṇāveṣṭya saṃsicya tailenādīpayettataḥ || 139 || yattailaṃ cyavate tebhyaḥ sukhoṣṇaṃ tena pūrayet | jñeyaṃ taddīpikātailaṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti vedanām ||140|| evaṃ syāddīpikātailaṃ kuṣṭhe devatarau tathā |
syonākatailam | tailaṃ syonākamūlena mande'gnau paripācitam ||141|| haredāśu tridoṣotthaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ prapūraṇāt |
yaṣṭīvasā | kalkakvāthena yaṣṭyāhvakākolīmāṣadhānyakaiḥ ||142|| śūkarasya vasāṃ paktvā karṇanādārtināśinī |

ab.seg: svarjikātailam | svarjikā mūlakaṃ śuṣkaṃ hiṅgu kṛṣṇāsamanvitam ||143||
śatapuṣpā ca taistailaṃ pakkaṃ sūktacaturguṇam | praṇādaṃ śūlabādhiryaṃ srāvaṃ karṇasya nāśayet ||144||
apāmārgakṣāratailaṃ bādhirye - apāmārgakṣārajale tatkṣāraṃ kalkitaṃ kṣipet | tena pakvaṃ jayettailaṃ bādhiryaṃ karṇanādakam || 145 ||
śambūkatailam - śambūkasya tu māṃsena pacettailaṃ tu sārṣapam | tasya pūraṇamātreṇa karṇanāḍī praśāmyati || 146 ||
karṇasrāve yogāḥ - cūrṇaṃ pañcakaṣāyāṇāṃ kapittharasameva ca | karṇasrāve praśaṃsanti pūraṇaṃ madhunā saha || 147 ||
tindukānyabhayā lodhraḥ samaṅgā cāmalakyapi | jñeyāḥ pañca kaṣāyāstu karmaṇyasminbhiṣagvaraiḥ ||148||
svarjikārasayogaḥ - svarjikācūrṇasaṃyuktaṃ bījapūrarasaṃ kṣipet | karṇastrāvarujādāhāḥ praṇaśyanti na saṃśaya: || 149||
āmrāditailam | āmrajambūpravālāni madhukasya vaṭasya ca | ebhiḥ saṃsādhitaṃ tailaṃ pūtikarṇopaśāntikṛt ||150||
karṇakīṭe hīratālādiyogaḥ - pūraṇaṃ haritālena gavāṃ mūtrayutena ca athavā sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ karṇakīṭaharaṃ param || 151 ||
karṇakīṭe – śigrusvarasādiyogaḥ - svarasaṃ śigrumūlasya sūryāvartarasaṃ tathā | tryūṣaṇaṃ cūrṇitaṃ caiva kapikacchūjaṭārasam || 152 ||
kṛtvaikatra kṣipetkarṇe karṇakaṭiharaṃ param | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe lepādividhirnāmai- kādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

div.head: atha raktamokṣavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha śoṇitavisrāvavidhiradhunā vidhīyate atha śoṇitasrāvavidhiḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ yathā lepādayo dehakāntikarāstadvacchoṇitavisrāvaṇamapi | ataḥ śoṇitasrāvaṇamāha - śoṇitaṃ srāvayejjantorāmayaṃ prasamīkṣya ca | prasthaṃ prasthārdhakaṃ vāpi prasyārdhārdhamathāpi vā || 1 ||
śaratkāle svabhāvena kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ | tvagdoṣagranthiśothādyā na syū raktasruteryataḥ || 2 ||
ādau raktasya rasavarṇaguṇādīnāha - madhuraṃ varṇato raktamaśītoṣṇaṃ tathā guru | śoṇitaṃ snigdhavisraṃ syādvidāhaścāsya pittavat ||3||
visratā dravatā rāgaścalanaṃ vilayastathā | bhūmyādipañcabhūtānāmete raktaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 4 ||
duṣṭaraktalakṣaṇe kiṃ bhavatītyāha - rakte duṣṭe vedanā syātpāko dāhaśca jāyate | raktamaṇḍalatā kaṇḍūḥ śothaśca piṭikodgamaḥ || 5 ||
vṛddhe raktāṅganetratvaṃ sirāṇāṃ pūraṇaṃ tathā | gātrāṇāṃ gauravaṃ nidrā mado dāhaśca jāyate || 6 ||
kṣīṇe'mlamadhurākāṅkṣa mūrcchā ca tvaci rūkṣatā | śaithilyaṃ ca sirāṇāṃ syādvātādunmārgagāmitā ||7||
aruṇaṃ phenilaṃ rūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu śīghragam | askandi sūcinistodi raktaṃ syādvātadūṣitam ||8||
pittena pītaṃ haritaṃ nīlaṃ śyāvaṃ ca visrakam | askandyuṣṇaṃ makṣikāṇāṃ pipīlānāmaniṣṭakam ||9||
śītalaṃ bahalaṃ snigdhaṃ gairikodakasaṃnibham | māṃsapeśīprabhaṃ skandi mandagaṃ kaphadūṣitam || 10 ||
dvidoṣaduṣṭaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ triduṣṭaṃ pūtigandhakam | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāñjikābhaṃ ca jāyate || 11 ||
viṣaduṣṭaṃ bhavecchyāvaṃ nāsikonmārgagaṃ tathā | visnaṃ kāñjikasaṃkāśaṃ sarvakuṣṭhakaraṃ bahu || 12 ||

div.ab: prakṛtistharaktalakṣaṇamāha - indragopaprabhaṃ jñeyaṃ prakṛtisthamasaṃhatam |

ab.seg: yeṣu raktasrāvo vihitastānāha - śothe dāhe'ṅgapāke ca raktavarṇe'sṛjaḥ srutau || 13||
vātarakte tathā kuṣṭhe sapīḍe durjaye'nile | pāṇiroge ślīpade pade ca viṣaduṣṭe ca śoṇite || 14 ||
granthyarbudāpacīkṣudrarogaraktādhimanthiṣu | vidārīstanarogeṣu gātrāṇāṃ sādagaurave || 15 ||
raktābhiṣyandatandrāyāṃ pūtighrāṇāsyadehake | yakṛtplīhavisarpeṣu vidradhau piṭikodgame ||16||
karṇauṣṭhaghrāṇavaktrāṇāṃ pāke dāhe śiroruji | upadaṃśe raktapitte raktasrāva: praśasyate || 17||
eṣu rogeṣu śṛṅgairvā jalaukālābukairapi | athavāpi sirāmokṣaiḥ kuryādraktasrutiṃ naraḥ || 18 ||
yeṣu sirāmokṣo niṣiddhaḥ tānāha - na kurvīta sirāmokṣaṃ kṛśasyātivyavāyina:| klībasya bhīrorgarbhiṇyāḥ sūtikāpāṇḍurogiṇām ||19||
pañcakarmaviśuddhasya pītasnehasya cārśasām | sarvāṅgaśothayuktānāmudaraśvāsakāsinām ||20||
chardyatīsāraduṣṭānāmatisvinnatanorapi | ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣasya gatasaptatikasya ca || 21 ||
āghātasrutaraktasya sirāmokṣo na śasyate | eṣāṃ cātyayike roge jalaukābhistu nirharet ||22||
vātādiduṣṭaṃ kena srāvayedityāha - tathā ca viṣaduṣṭānāṃ śirāmokṣo'pi śasyate | gośṛṅgeṇa jalaukābhiralābubhirapi tridhā || 23 ||
vātapittakaphairduṣṭaṃ śoṇitaṃ srāvayedbudhaḥ | dvidoṣābhyāṃ tu saṃduṣṭaṃ tridoṣairapi dūṣitam ||24||
śoṇitaṃ srāvayedyuktyā sirāmokṣaiḥ padaistathā | gṛhṇāti śoṇitaṃ śṛṅgaṃ daśāṅgulamitaṃ balāt ||25||
jalaukā hastamātraṃ tu tumbī ca dvādaśāṅgulam | padamaṅgulamātrasya sirā sarvāṅgaśodhinī || 26 ||
śīte niranne mūrcchāyāṃ tandrābhītimadaśramaiḥ | yutānāṃ na sravedraktaṃ tathā viṇmūtrasaṅginām ||27||
rakte vidhānamāha - apravartitarakte ca kuṣṭhatrikaṭusaindhavaiḥ | mardayedvraṇavaktraṃ ca tena samyakpravartate || 28 ||
idānīṃ sukhavisrāvaṇārthaṃ hitopadeśamāha - tasmānna śīte nātyuṣṇe na svinne nātitāpite | pītvā yavāgūṃ tṛptasya srāvayecchoṇitaṃ budhaḥ ||29||

div.ab: atha kena hetunā raktātipravṛttistaddarśayannāha - atisvinnasyoṣṇakāle tathaivātisirāvyadhāt | atipravartate raktaṃ tatra kuryātpratikriyām || 30|| atipravṛtte rakte ca lodhrasarjarasāñjanaiḥ | yavagodhūmacūrṇairvā dhavadhanvanagairikaiḥ || 31 || sarpanirmokacūrṇairvā bhasmanā kṣaumavastrayoḥ | mukhaṃ vraṇasya baddhvā ca śītaiścopacaredvraṇam || 324|| vidhyedūrdhvaṃ sirāṃ tāṃ ca dahetkṣāreṇa vāgninā | vraṇaṃ kaṣāyaḥ saṃdhatte raktaṃ skandayate himam ||23|| vraṇāsyaṃ pācayetkṣāro dāhaḥ saṃkocayetsirām | vāmāṇḍaśothe dakṣasya karasyāṅguṣṭhamūlajām || 34 || dahetsirāṃ vyatyaye tu vāmāṅguṣṭhasirāṃ dahet | sirādāhaprabhāveṇa muṣkaśothaḥ praṇaśyati || 35 || viṣūcyāṃ pārṣṇidāhena jāyate'gneḥ pradīpanam | saṃkucanti yatastena rasaśleṣmavahāḥ sirāḥ || 36 || yadā vṛddhiryakṛtplīhnoḥ śiśoḥ saṃjāyate'sṛjaḥ | tadā tatsthānadāhena saṃkucantyasṛjaḥ sirāḥ ||37|| rakte duṣṭe'vaśiṣṭe'pi vyādhirnaiva prakupyati | ataḥ srāvyaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ raktaṃ nātikramo hitaḥ ||38|| āndhyamākṣepakaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ timiraṃ śiraso rujam | pakṣaghātaṃ śvāsakāsau hikkāṃ dāhaṃ ca pāṇḍutām ||39|| kurute'tisṛtaṃ raktaṃ maraṇaṃ vā karoti ca | dehasyotpattirasṛjā dehastenaiva dhāryate || 40 || vinā tena vrajejjīvo rakṣedraktamato budhaḥ |

srute rakte'pi doṣakope pratīkāramāha - śītopacāraiḥ kupite srutaraktasya mārute || 41 || koṣṇena sarpiṣā śothaṃ savyathaṃ pariṣecayet | kṣīṇasyaiṇaśaśorabhrahīraṇacchāgamāṃsajaḥ || 42 || rasaḥ samucitaḥ pāne kṣīraṃ vā ṣaṣṭhikā hitāḥ |
atha raktasrāvaṇāt samyak śuddhilakṣaṇānyāha - pīḍāśāntirlaghutvaṃ ca vyādherudrekasaṃkṣayaḥ || 43 || manaḥsvāsthyaṃ bhaveccihnaṃ samyagvisrāvite'sṛji |

ab.seg: vyāyāmamaithunakrodhaśītasrānapravātakān || 44 ||
ekāśanaṃ divāsvapnaṃ kṣārāmlakaṭubhojanam | śokaṃ vādamajīrṇaṃ ca tyajedābaladarśanāt || 45 ||
iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitaśārṅga- dharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śoṇitasrāvavidhi- rnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||

div.head: atha netrakarmavidhiradhyāyaḥ

ab.seg: trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ | atha netraprasādanakarmāṇi vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - śirāvyadhenā'pi netraprasādanaṃ bhavati, tadvatsekādibhirapi | ata āha - tāni kāni karmāṇītyāha - seka āścotanaṃ piṇḍī biḍālastarpaṇaṃ tathā | puṭapāko'ñjanaṃ caibhiḥ kalpairnetramupācaret || 1 ||

div.ab: sekavidhiḥ | sekastu sūkṣmadhārābhiḥ sarvasminnayane hitaḥ | mīlitākṣasya martyasya pradeyaścaturaṅgulāt ||2 || sa cāpi snehano vāte rakte pitte ca ropaṇaḥ | lekhanaśca kaphe kāryastasya mātrā'dhunocyate || 3 || ṣaḍvākśataiḥ snehaneṣu caturbhiścaiva ropaṇe | vākśataiśca tribhiḥ kāryaḥ seko lekhanakarmaṇi ||4|| kāryastu divase seko rātrau cātyayike gade |

atha trividhākṣisvedānāṃ prayogadvāreṇa karma darśayannāha - sa yathā - sa yathetyādinā darśayati granthakāraḥ | eraṇḍatvakpatramūlaiḥ śṛtamājaṃ payo hitam ||5|| sukhoṣṇaṃ secanaṃ netre vātābhiṣyandanāśanam | pariṣeko hito netre payaḥ koṣṇaṃ sasaindhavam || 6 || rajanīdārusiddhaṃ vā saindhavena samanvitam | vātābhiṣyandaśamanaṃ hitaṃ mārutaparyaye || 7 || śuṣkākṣipāke ca hitamidaṃ secanakaṃ sadā | sābaraṃ madhukaṃ tulyaṃ ghṛtabhṛṣṭaṃ sucūrṇitam ||8|| chāgakṣīre ghṛtaṃ sekātpittaraktābhighātajit | triphalālodhrayaṣṭībhiḥ śarkarābhadramustakaiḥ ||9|| piṣṭaiḥ śītāmbunā seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | lākṣāmadhukamañjiṣṭhālodhrakālanusārivāḥ || 10 || puṇḍarīkayutaḥ seko raktābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | śvetalodhraṃ ghṛte bhṛṣṭaṃ cūrṇitaṃ paṭavisrutam || 11 || uṣṇāmbunā vimṛditaṃ sekācchūlaghnamambake |

āścyotanam | athāścyotanakaṃ kāryaṃ niśāyāṃ na kathaṃcana ||12|| unmīlite'kṣṇi dṛṅmadhye bindubhirdvyaṅgulāddhitam | bindavo'ṣṭau lekhaneṣu snehane daśa bindavaḥ || 13 || ropaṇe dvādaśa proktāste śīte koṣṇarūpiṇaḥ | uṣṇe ca śītarūpāḥ syuḥ sarvatraivaiṣa niścayaḥ ||14|| vāte tiktaṃ tathā snigdhaṃ pitte madhuraśītalam | tiktoṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca kaphe kramādāścyotanaṃ hitam ||15|| āścyotanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mātrā syādvākśataṃ hitā | nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ puṃsāmaṅgulyośchoṭikā'thavā || 16|| gurvakṣaroccāraṇaṃ vā vāṅmātreyaṃ smṛtā budhaiḥ |

athāścyotanārthaṃ yogānāha - bilvādipañcamūlena bṛhatyeraṇḍaśigrubhiḥ || 17 || kvātha āścyotane koṣṇo vātābhiṣyandanāśanaḥ | ambupiṣṭairnimbapatraistvacaṃ lodhrasya lepayet || 18 || pratāpya vahninā ṣiṣṭvā tadraso netrapūraṇāt | vātotthaṃ raktapittotthamabhiṣyandaṃ vināśayet || 19|| triphalāścyotanaṃ netre sarvābhiṣyandanāśanam | strīstanyāścyotanaṃ netre raktapittānilārtijit ||20|| kṣīrasarpirghṛtaṃ vāpi vātaraktarujaṃ jayet |

ab.seg: idānīṃ piṇḍikāvidhānamāha - piṇḍī kavalikā proktā badhyate paṭṭavastrakaiḥ ||21||
netrābhiṣyandayogyā sā vraṇeṣvapi nibadhyate | abhiṣyande'dhimanthe ca saṃjāte śleṣmasaṃbhave ||22||
snigdhasvinnottamāṅgasya śirastīkṣṇairvirecayet | adhimantheṣu sarveṣu lalāṭe vyadhayecchirām || 23 ||
aśānte sarvathā manthe bhruvorupari dāhayet | abhiṣyandeṣu sarveṣu badhnīyātpiṇḍikāṃ budhaḥ ||24||

div.ab: idānīṃ piṇḍikārthaṃ prayogavarānāha - vātābhiṣyandaśāntyarthaṃ snigdhoṣṇā piṇḍikā bhavet | eraṇḍapatramūlatvaṅnirmitā vātanāśinī || 25 || pittābhiṣyandanāśāya dhātrīpiṇḍī sukhāvahā | mahānimbaphalodbhūtā piṇḍī vā pittanāśinī ||26|| śigrupatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmābhiṣyandanāśinī | nimbapatrakṛtā piṇḍī śleṣmapittaharā bhavet || 27 || triphalāpiṇḍikā proktā nāśane śleṣmapittayoḥ | piṣṭvā kāñjikatoyena ghṛtabhṛṣṭā ca piṇḍikā ||28|| lodhrasya harati kṣipramabhiṣyandamasṛgbhavam | śuṇṭhīnimbadalaiḥ piṇḍī sukhoṣṇā svalpasaindhavā ||29|| dhāryā cakṣuṣi saṃyogācchothakaṇḍūvyathāpahā |
atha biḍālavidhiḥ | biḍālako bahirlepo netre pakṣmavivarjitaḥ || 30 || tasya mātrā parijñeyā mukhalepavidhānavat |

ab.seg: sa yathā - dī. - atha lepamāha - sa yathetyanena yogān darśayati gnanthakāraḥ | yaṣṭīgairikasindhūtthadārvītārkṣyaiḥ samāṃśakaiḥ ||31||
jalapiṣṭairbahirlepaḥ sarvanetrāmayāpahaḥ | rasāñjanena vā lepaḥ pathyāviśvadalairapi || 32 ||
kumāri kāgnipantrairvā dāḍimīpallavairapi | vacāharidrānimbairvā tathā nāgaragairikaiḥ || 33 ||
dagdhvā sasaindhavaṃ lodhraṃ madhūcchiṣṭayute ghṛte | piṣṭamañjanalepābhyāṃ sadyo netrarujāpaham || 34 ||
lohasya pātre saṃghṛṣṭo raso nimbaphalodbhavaḥ | kiṃcidghano bahirlepānnetrabādhāṃ vyapohati || 35 ||
saṃcūrṇya maricaṃ keśarājasvarasamardanāt | lepanādarmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ karotyeṣa prayogarāṭ || 36 ||
svināṃ bhittvā viniṣpīḍya bhinnāmañjananāmikām | śilailānatāsindhūtthai: sakṣaudrai: pratisārayet || 37||

div.ab: tarpaṇam | atha tarpaṇakaṃ vacmi netratṛptikaraṃ param | yadrūkṣaṃ pariśuṣkaṃ ca netraṃ kuṭilamāvilam || 38 || śīrṇapakṣmaśirotpātakṛcchronmīlanasaṃyutam | timirārjunaśukrādyairabhiṣyandādhimanthakaiḥ || 39 || śuṣkākṣipākaśothābhyāṃ yuktaṃ vātaviparyayaiḥ | tannetraṃ tarpaṇe yojyaṃ netrarogaviśāradaiḥ || 40|| durdinātyuṣṇaśīteṣu cintāyāsabhrameṣu ca | aśāntopadrave cākṣṇi tarpaṇaṃ na praśasyate || 41 || vātātaparajohīne deśe cottānaśāyinaḥ | ādhārau māṣacūrṇena klinnena parimaṇḍalau || 42 || samau dṛḍhāvasaṃbādhau kartavyau netrakośayoḥ | pūrayedghṛtamaṇḍena vilīnena sukhodakai: || 43 || athavā śatadhautena sarpiṣā kṣīrajena vā | nimagnānyakṣipakṣmāṇi yāvatsyustāvadeva hi ||44|| pūrayenmīlite netre tata unmīlayecchanaiḥ | dhārayedvartmarogeṣu vāṅmātrāṇāṃ śataṃ budhaḥ || 45 || svacche kaphe sandhiroge mātrāpañcaśataṃ hitam | śukle ca ṣaṭśataṃ kṛṣṇaroge saptaśataṃ matam ||46|| dṛṣṭirogeṣvaṣṭaśatamadhimanthe sahasrakam | sahasraṃ vātarogeṣu dhāryamevaṃ hi tarpaṇam || 47 || svinnena yavapiṣṭena snehavīryeritaṃ tataḥ | yathāsvaṃ dhūmapānena kaphamasya viśodhayet || 48 || ekāhaṃ vā tryahaṃ vāpi pañcāhaṃ ceṣyate param | tarpaṇe tṛptiliṅgāni netreṣvetāni bhāvayet || 49 || sukhasvapnāvabodhaṃ ca vaiśadyaṃ varṇapāṭavam | nivṛttirvyādhiśāntiśca kriyālāghavameva ca ||57|| atha sāśru guru snigdhaṃ netraṃ syādatitarpitam | rūkṣamasnāvilaṃ rugṇaṃ netraṃ syāddhīnatarpitam || 51 || rūkṣasnigdhopacārābhyāmetayoḥ syātpratikriyā |

ab.seg: puṭapākaḥ | sambandhaścāyaṃ - tarpaṇoktavidhānakriyāvyāpattisamānadharmatvaṃ puṭapākamāha - ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi puṭapākasya sādhanam ||52||
dvau bilvamātrau māṃsasya piṇḍau snigdhau supeṣitau | dravyāṇāṃ bilvamātraṃ tu dravāṇāṃ kuḍavo mataḥ ||53||
tadekasthaṃ samāloḍya patraiḥ supariveṣṭitam | puṭapākena tatpaktvā gṛhṇīyāttadrasaṃ budhaḥ || 54 ||
tarpaṇoktavidhānena yathāvadupacārayet | dṛṣṭimadhye niṣecyaḥ syānnityamuttānaśāyinaḥ ||55||
snehano lekhanaścaiva ropaṇaśceti sa tridhā | hitaḥ snigdho'tirūkṣasya snigdhasyāpi hi lekhanaḥ ||56||
dṛṣṭerbalārthamitaraḥ pittāsṛgvraṇavātanut | sarpirmāṃsavasāmajjāmedaḥsvādvauṣadhaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 57 ||
snehanaḥ puṭapākaśca dhāryo dve vākśate dṛśoḥ | jāṅgalānāṃ yakṛnmāṃsairlekhanadravyasaṃyutaiḥ || 58 ||
kṛṣṇaloharajastāmraśaṅkhavidrumasindhujaiḥ | samudraphenakāsīsasrotojadadhimastubhiḥ || 59 ||
lekhano vākśataṃ dhāryastasyaitāvadvidhāraṇam | stanyajāṅgalamadhvājyatiktakadravyapācitaḥ || 60 ||
lekhanāttriguṇo dhāryaḥ puṭapākastu ropaṇaḥ | vitarettarpaṇoktāṃ tu kriyāṃ vyāpattidarśane || 61 ||
añjanam | atha saṃpakvadoṣasya prāptamañjanamācaret | hemante śiśire caiva madhyāhne'ñjanamiṣyate ||62||
pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe ca grīṣme śaradi ceṣyate | varṣāsu nābhre nāpyuṣṇe vasante ca sadaiva hi ||63||
lekhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva tathā syātsnehanāñjanam | lekhanaṃ kṣāratīkṣṇāmlarasairañjanamiṣyate || 64 ||
kaṣāyatiktarasayuksasnehaṃ ropaṇaṃ matam | madhuraṃ snehasaṃpannamañjanaṃ tu prasādanam ||95 ||
guṭikārasacūrṇāṃni trividhānyañjanāni ca | kuryācchalākayā'ṅgulyā hīnāni ca athottaram ||66||
śrānte prarudite bhīte pītamadye navajvare | ajīrṇe vegaghāte ce nāñjanaṃ saṃpraśasyate || 67||
hareṇumātrāṃ kurvīta vārtiṃ tīkṣṇāñjane bhiṣak | pramāṇaṃ madhyame'dhyardhaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu mṛdau bhavet ||68||
rasakriyā tūttamā syāttriviḍaṅgamitā hitā | madhyamā dviviḍaṅgā syāddhīnā tvekaviḍaṅgikā ||69||
vairecanekacūrṇaṃ tu dviśalākaṃ vidhīyate | mṛdau tu triśalākaṃ syāccatasra: snaihike'ñjane ||70||
mukhayoḥ kuṇṭhitā ślakṣṇā śalākāṣṭāṅgulonmitā | aśmajā dhātujā vā syātkalāyaparimaṇḍalā ||71||
tāmralohāśmasaṃjātā śalākā lekhane matā | suvarṇarajatodbhūtā śalākā snehane matā || 72 ||
aṅgulīva mṛdutvena kathitā ropaṇe budhaiḥ | sāyaṃ prātarvāñjanaṃ syāttatsadā naiva kārayet ||73||
nātiśītoṣṇavātābhravelāyāṃ saṃpraśasyate | kṛṣṇabhāgādadhaḥ kuryādapāṅgaṃ yāvadañjanam || 74 ||

pūrvamuktaṃ lekhanaropaṇasnehanabhedena trividhāñjaneṣu vartirasacūrṇatrividharūpaṃ, tatrādau lekhanīvartiradhunā vidhīyase | candrodayā | śaṅkhanābhirvibhītasya majjā pathyā manaḥśilā | pippalī maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vacā ceti samāṃśakam ||75||
chāgīkṣīreṇa saṃpiṣya vartiṃ kṛtvā yavonmitām | hareṇumātrāṃ saṃghṛṣya jalaiḥ kuryādathāñjanam || 76 ||
timiraṃ māṃsavṛddhiṃ ca kācaṃ paṭalamarbudam | rātryāndhyaṃ vārṣikaṃ puṣpaṃ vartiścandrodayā jayet ||77||
karañjavartiḥ | palāśapuṣpasvarasairbahuśaḥsaptavāramityarthaḥ | paribhāvitā | karañjabījavartistu dṛṣṭeḥ puṣpaṃ vināśayet ||78||
samudraphenādivartiḥ | samudraphenasindhūtthaśaṅkhadakṣāṇḍavalkalaiḥ | śigrubījayutairvartiḥ śukādīṃśchastravallikhet || 79 ||

div.ab: dantavartiḥ | dantairdantivarāhoṣṭragohayājakhurodbhavaiḥ | śaṅkhamuktāmbhodhiphenayutaiḥ sarvairvicūrṇitaiḥmaricapādikairiti paṭhanīyaṃ vāgbhaṭasaṃvādāt | || 80 || dantavartiḥ kṛtā ślakṣṇā śukrāṇāṃ nāśinī parā |
nīlotpalavartiḥ | nīlotpalaṃ śigrubījaṃ nāgakeśarakaṃ tathā || 81 || etatkalkaiḥ kṛtā vartiratinidrāṃ nivārayet |

puṣpavartiḥ | tilapuṣpāṇyaśītiḥ syuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ pippalitaṃḍulāḥ ||82|| jātī kusuma pañcāśanmaricāni ca ṣoḍaśa | sūkṣmaṃ piṣṭvā jale vartiḥ kṛtā kusumikābhidhā ||83|| timirārjunaśukrāṇāṃ nāśinī māṃsavṛddhihṛt | (etasyāścāñjane mātrāprakṣiptam | proktā sārdhahareṇukā ||84||)

ab.seg: rasāñjanavartiḥ | rasāñjanaṃ haridre dve mālatīnimbapallavā: | gośakṛdrasasaṃyuktā vartirnaktāndhyanāśinī || 85 ||

div.ab: dhātryādivartiḥ | dhātryakṣapathyābījāni ekadvitriguṇāni ca | piṣṭvā vartiṃ jalaiḥ kuryādañjanaṃ dvihareṇukam || 86 || netrasrāvaṃ haratyāśu vātaraktarujaṃ tathāasyāgre - pārāvatamalaṃ niṣkaṃ maricaṃ māṣamātrakam | ghṛṣṭvā ca nimbavartīnāṃ toyaṃ paryuṣitaṃ jayet || naktāṃdhyaṃ cirakālasthaṃ haṃti sājyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śvetaṃ palāṇḍusvarasaṃ haṃti naktāṃdhyamānavam || saurāṣṭrīkarṣamekaṃ tu tatsamaṃ kharpare nyaset| | ṭaṃkārdha tutthakaṃ yojyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā sa caikataḥ || kāṃsyapātreṇa tāmreṇa gharṣayennimbukadravaiḥ | caturthadinaparyantaṃ mardayecchodhayetpunaḥ || ghṛtena saṃhitāṃ yustvā vaṭikāṃ kārayedvudhaḥ | nāryāḥ stanyena vartiḥ sā netradṛṣṭiprasādinī || ājanmagatavartmānaḥ punareva bhavaṃti ca | kaṇḍūsrāvaṃ harecchīghraṃ gṛdhradṛṣṭirbhavennaraḥ||’ ityadhikamupalabhyate kutracit || |

rasakriyā | tutthamākṣikasindhūtthaṃ sitāśaṅkamanaḥśilāḥ ||87|| gairikodadhiphenaṃ ca maricaṃ ceti cūrṇayet | saṃyojya madhunā kuryādañjanārthaṃ rasakriyām || 88 || vartmarogārmatimirakācaśukraharāṃ parām |
tathāca lekhanī rasakriyā -- vaṭakṣīreṇa saṃyukto mukhyaḥ karpūrajaḥ kaṇaḥ || 89 || kṣipramañjanato hanti kusumaṃ tu dvimāsikam |
atinidrāyāṃ yogaḥ - kṣaudrāśvalālāsaṃghṛṣṭairmaricairnetramañjayet ||90|| atinidrā śamaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodayādiva |

prabodhanāñjanam | jātīpuṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca maricaṃ kaṭukī vacā || 91 || saindhavaṃ bastamūtreṇa piṣṭaṃ tandrāghnamañjanam | śirīṣabījagomūtrakṛṣṇāmaricasaindhavaiḥ || 92 || añjanaṃ syātprabodhāya sarasonaśilāvacaiḥ |

ab.seg: dārvyādirasakriyā | dārvī paṭolaṃ madhukaṃ sanimbapadmakotpalam || 93 ||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ caitāni pacettoye caturguṇe | vipācya pādaśeṣaṃ tu śṛtaṃ nītvā punaḥ pacet ||94||
śīte tasminmadhu sitāṃ dadyātpādāṃśikāṃ nara: | rasakriyaiṣā dāhāśruraktarāgarujo haret || 95 ||
rasāñjanādirasakriyā | rasājanaṃ sarjaraso jātīpuṣpaṃ manaḥśilā | samudrapheno lavaṇaṃ gairikaṃ maricāni ca ||96||
etatsamāṃśaṃ madhunā piṣṭvā praklinnavartmani | añjanaṃ kledakaṇḍūghnaṃ pakṣmaṇāṃ ca prarohaṇam || 97 ||
guḍūcīsvarasaḥ karṣaḥ kṣaudraṃ syānmāṣakonmitam | saindhavaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ syātsarvamekatra mardayet || 98 ||
añjayennayanaṃ tena pillārmatimiraṃ jayet | kācaṃ kaṇḍūṃ liṅganāśaṃ śuklakṛṣṇagatāngadān ||99 ||

div.ab: punarnavārasakriyā | dugdhena kaṇḍūṃ kṣaudreṇa netrasrāvaṃ ca sarpiṣā | puṣpaṃ tailena timiraṃ kāñjikena niśāndhatām ||100|| punarnavā jayedāśu bhāskastimiraṃ yathā |

babbūlarasakiyā | babbūladalani:kātho lehībhūtastadañjanāt || 101 || netrasrāvaṃ jayatyeṣa madhuyukto na saṃśayaḥ | hiñjalarasakriyā | hiñjalasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā pānīye nityamañjanam ||102|| cakṣu:srāvopaśāntyarthaṃ kāryametanmahauṣadham |
idānīṃ snehanī rasakriyā katakarasakriyā | katakasya phalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā madhunā netramañjayet || 103 || īṣatkarpūrasahitaṃ smṛtaṃ netraprasādanam |

ab.seg: atha śirotpāte rasakriyā | sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ cāñjanaṃ syācchirotpātasya śāntaye ||104||
gū. - sarpirghṛtam || 104 ||
kṛṣṇasarpavasārasakriyā | kṛṣṇasarpavasā śaṅkha: katakātphalamañjanam | rasakriyeyamacirādandhānāṃ darśanapradā || 105 ||
lekhanāñjanam | dakṣāṇḍatvakśilākācaśaṅkhacandanasaindhavaiḥ | dravyairañjanayogo'yaṃ puṣpārmādivilekhanaḥ || 106 ||
kaṇārasakriyā | kaṇā chāgayakṛnmadhye paktvā netrayuge'ñjitā | acirāddhanti naktāndhyaṃ tadvatsakṣaudramūṣaṇam ||107||
cūrṇāñjanam| śāṇārdhaṃ maricaṃ dvau ca pippalyarṇavaphenayo: | śāṇārdhaṃ saindhavaṃ śāṇā nava sauvīrakāñjanāt ||108||
piṣṭaṃ susūkṣmaṃ citrāyāṃ cūrṇāñjanamidaṃ śubham | kaṇḍūkācakaphārtānāṃ malānāṃ ca viśodhanam ||109||

div.ab: idānīṃ ropaṇacūrṇāñjanamāha - (mṛducūrṇāñjanam) śilāyāṃ rasakaṃ piṣṭvā samyagāplāvya vāriṇā | gṛhṇīyāttajjalaṃ sarvaṃ tyajeccūrṇamadhogatam || 110 || śuṣkaṃ ca tajjalaṃ sarvaṃ parpaṭīsaṃnibhaṃ bhavet | vicūrṇya bhāvayetsamyaktrivelaṃ triphalārasaiḥ || 111|| karpūrasya rajastatra daśamāṃśena nikṣipet | añjayennayane tena sarvadoṣaharaṃ hi tat || 112 || sarvarogaharaṃ cūrṇaṃ cakṣuṣoḥ sukhakāri ca |

prasādanāñjanam (sauvīrāñjanam) agnitaptaṃ hi sauvīraṃ niṣiñcettriphalārasaiḥ ||113|| saptavelaṃ tathā stanyaiḥ strīṇāṃ siktaṃ vicūrṇitam | añjayettena nayane pratyahaṃ cakṣuṣorhitam || 114 || sarvānakṣivikārāṃstu hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ |

ab.seg: atha dṛṣṭiprasādanī nāgaśalākā vikhyātā, tāmapi darśayannāha - triphalābhṛṅgaśuṇṭhīnāṃ rasaistadvacca sarpiṣā ||115||
gomūtramadhvajākṣīraiḥ sikto nāgaḥ pratāpitaḥ | tacchalākā haratyeva sarvānnetrabhavāngadān || 116 ||
pratyañjanam | gatadoṣamapetāśru saṃpaśyansamyagambhasi | prakṣālyākṣi yathādoṣaṃ kāryaṃ pratyañjanaṃ tataḥ ||117||
na vā'nirgatadoṣe'kṣṇi dhāvanaṃ saṃprayojayet | pratyañjanaṃ tīkṣṇatapte netre cūrṇaṃ prasādanam || 118 ||
nayanāmṛtāñjanam | śuddhe nāge drute śuddhaṃ tulyaṃ sūtaṃ vinikṣipet | kṛṣṇāñjanaṃ tayostulyaṃ sarvamekatra cūrṇayet || 119 ||
daśamāṃśena karpūraṃ tasmiṃścūrṇe pradāpayet | etatkṛtāñjanaṃ netragadajinnayanāmṛtam || 120 ||
sarpaviṣe saṃjīvanāñjanam | jayapālabhavāṃ majjāṃ bhāvayennimbukadravai: | ekaviṃśativelaṃ tu tato vartiṃ prakalpayet ||121||
manuṣyalālayā ghṛṣṭvā tato netre tayā'ñjayet | sarpadaṣṭaviṣaṃ jitvā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||122||
atha dṛṣṭiprasādanārthaṃ sārvakālikaṃ yogadvayamāha - bhuktvā pāṇitalaṃ ghṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣordīyate yadi | jātā rogā vinaśyanti timirāṇi tathaiva ca ||123||
śītāmbupūritamukha: prativāsaraṃ ya: kālatrayeṇa nayanadvitayaṃ jalena | āsiñcati dhruvamasau na kadācidakṣi- rogavyathāvidhuratāṃ bhajate manuṣya: || 124||

div.ab: atha trikhaṇḍānāṃ pāriśeṣyāt kavirapi khaguṇaprakarṣatāṃ solluṇṭhavacanena dyotayati -- āyurvedasamudrasya gūḍhārthamaṇisaṃcayam | jñātvā kaiścidbudhaistaistu kṛtā vividhasaṃhitāḥ ||125|| kiṃcidarthaṃ tato nītvā kṛteyaṃ saṃhitā mayā | kṛpākaṭākṣanikṣepamasyāṃ kurvantu sādhavaḥ || 126 || vividhagadārtidaridranāśanaṃ yā hariramaṇīva karoti yogaratnaiḥ | vilasatu śārṅgadharasya saṃhitā sā kavihṛdayeṣu sarojanirmaleṣu || 127 || alpāyuṣāmalpadhiyāmidānīṃ kṛtaṃ samastaśrutipāṭhaśaktyā | tadatra yuktaṃ pratibījamātra- mabhyasyatāmātmahitaṃ prayatnāt || 128 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe netrakarmavidhi- rnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ |
